text.title: 永恒宝藏
text.objectives: 在永恒岛上找到秘密宝藏。
text.description: 根据日志显示，在岛屿四处埋藏着丰富的宝藏，有时候看似诱人却又遥不可及，另一些时候则是藏在黑暗的洞穴和深谷隙洞里。许多个世代以前，在这里究竟藏下了什么？$b$b也许更为重要的问题是，藏东西的人是谁？$b$b在岛上寻找这类宝藏，然后带着你的发现回来找我。需要提醒你的是，并非所有闪闪发光的东西都是金子，反之亦然。有时那种被挖空的树桩却是用来埋藏奇珍异宝的理想场所。
text.completion: I am happy that you have discovered some riches for your efforts, though we are no closer to unraveling this mystery than before. Take solace in the knowledge that many such bounties are surely scattered throughout the island, eagerly awaiting your exploration skills and combat prowess.$B$BOh, one last thing, my young adventurer - do not forget to look to the skies now and again.
text.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

english.title: Timeless Treasures
english.objectives: Find a hidden treasure on the Timeless Isle.
english.description: The journal indicates that treasures abound across the island, sometimes temptingly out of reach, and other times hidden in dark caves and hollows. What might have been secreted away here, many generations ago?$b$bAnd perhaps more importantly, by whom?$b$bSearch the island for such treasures, and return to me with your findings. Be warned that all that glitters is not gold, yet the reverse is also true. Sometimes the simple hollowed-out stump is the best hiding place for one's valuables.
english.completion: I am happy that you have discovered some riches for your efforts, though we are no closer to unraveling this mystery than before. Take solace in the knowledge that many such bounties are surely scattered throughout the island, eagerly awaiting your exploration skills and combat prowess.$B$BOh, one last thing, my young adventurer - do not forget to look to the skies now and again.
english.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

text.title: 强者方能存活
text.objectives: 在永恒岛上击败五位稀有或稀有精英生物。
text.description: 一座迷失在时间长河中的岛屿，又生机勃勃地重现在人们的视野中！$b$b这座岛屿之前去了哪里？它只是进行了一次时空穿越，还是在暗无天日的扭曲虚空中饱受了摧残？$b$b可以肯定的是，住在岛上的生物远比看上去强大得多。我在它们的身体里感觉到的一股隐藏的力量，这股力量已经历尽了亘古万世的磨砺。去找出这些物种当中的勇士，它们都有着过人的力量和实力，然后征服五位稀有生物。$b$b我们或许能通过尸体找到要找的线索。
text.completion: An interesting story of combat and bravery, though I fear that we learned little from your endeavors save that you are quite the adventurer. It seems that we find ourselves at an impasse with each twist and turn of this tale. Time is a fickle mistress.$B$BYou may wish to spend some time honing your skills here, before the sun sets.
text.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

english.title: Strong Enough To Survive
english.objectives: Defeat five Rare or Rare Elite creatures on the Timeless Isle.
english.description: An island lost in time and yet it returns flourishing with life!$b$bWhere did this island travel to? Did it simply hop forward in time, or did it languish in the dark reaches of the Twisting Nether?$b$bThere is one thing for certain: the creatures that inhabit this place are far more than they seem. I sense a hidden power in them, forged by the eons. Seek out the champions of their species, duly marked by their power and prowess, and vanquish five such creatures.$b$bIn death, we may find the clues we seek.
english.completion: An interesting story of combat and bravery, though I fear that we learned little from your endeavors save that you are quite the adventurer. It seems that we find ourselves at an impasse with each twist and turn of this tale. Time is a fickle mistress.$B$BYou may wish to spend some time honing your skills here, before the sun sets.
english.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

text.title: 末代皇帝
text.objectives: 与皇帝少昊交谈。
text.description: 从我搜集到的信息来看，这个地方原来是某种比赛的场地，来自潘达利亚各地的战士们会通过跟随末代皇帝少昊的步伐，展现自己的实力。$b$b我听说当少昊完成他的试炼时，他与大地化为了一体，并将潘达利亚笼罩在一片浓雾之中，就连我们足以洞悉时间之流的能力都无法发现它的踪影。$b$b那听起来相当有趣，也许你应该和他谈谈？
text.completion: In my pride, I sought to keep Pandaria a secret, and once again I have found myself learning great lessons from this land. I am glad to be able to share my stories with my people, once again, in that they may learn as I have, and learn from my mistakes. Perhaps you, too, can still learn a thing or two from the lessons of Pandaria.
text.completed: Speak with Emperor Shaohao on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

english.title: The Last Emperor
english.objectives: Speak with Emperor Shaohao.
english.description: From what I have gathered, this place used to be a tournament ground of sorts, where warriors from throughout Pandaria would show their prowess by following in the footsteps of their last emperor, Shaohao.$b$bI have heard that when Shaohao completed his trials, he became one with the land, and enveloped Pandaria in a thick mist, obscuring it from even our abilities to penetrate the passages of time.$b$bThat sounds quite interesting, perhaps you should speak with him?
english.completion: In my pride, I sought to keep Pandaria a secret, and once again I have found myself learning great lessons from this land. I am glad to be able to share my stories with my people, once again, in that they may learn as I have, and learn from my mistakes. Perhaps you, too, can still learn a thing or two from the lessons of Pandaria.
english.completed: Speak with Emperor Shaohao on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

text.title: 时间精华
text.objectives: 从永恒岛的某个生物身上收集一块纪元之石。
text.description: 是时候跟你透露我在这座岛屿上的真实意图了。$b$b青铜龙军团的力量被大为削弱——我们现在只能捕捉到时间长河中的浮光掠影。这真是令人感到……相当沮丧。$b$b可我们也没到彻底无计可施的地步。我手里拿的是时光之眼，它是我自创的神器。岛上的生物穿越了时空，也许会携带一些精华。有了这个，我们就能装满沙漏，再次开启一扇通往时间之流的窗口。
text.progress: Have you found anything?
text.completion: Epoch stones are quite rare. The crystallized essence of time, they require a rapid passage through the ages to form. Their presence here indicates that the island may not exist in one time at all, but shift rapidly from timeway to timeway.$B$BThat is of little importance at the moment, though. There are important moments in time that require our attention. Give me a moment to grind the stone and add it to the Vision of Time hourglass.
text.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

english.title: The Essence of Time
english.objectives: Obtain an Epoch Stone from one of the creatures on the Timeless Isle.
english.description: It is about time that I revealed to you my purpose on this island.$b$bThe bronze dragonflight's powers have diminished greatly - we can now only catch furtive glimpses through time. It is... quite frustrating.$b$bBut we are not entirely without means. I hold in my hand the Vision of Time, an artifact of my own creation. The creatures of this isle have passed through time, and may carry with them some of its essence. With it, we will fill the hourglass, granting us a window into the timeways once more.
english.progress: Удалось что-нибудь найти?
english.completion: Epoch stones are quite rare. The crystallized essence of time, they require a rapid passage through the ages to form. Their presence here indicates that the island may not exist in one time at all, but shift rapidly from timeway to timeway.$B$BThat is of little importance at the moment, though. There are important moments in time that require our attention. Give me a moment to grind the stone and add it to the Vision of Time hourglass.
english.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

text.title: 时光之景
text.objectives: 在决战奥格瑞玛中使用时光之眼。
text.description: 瞧瞧时光之眼的反应！真是太令人震惊了！即便是在现在，它仍然显示着在我们身边不断飞掠而过的时间流的影子。尽管我们用的不是时光沙漏里真正的沙粒，但精心研磨的纪元之石无疑也有着自身独特的力量。我们的首要任务是利用它们对时光之眼进行校准。$b$b将时光之眼带到历史正在被缔造的地方——决战奥格瑞玛的战场上。到了之后翻转沙漏，看看会发生什么。
text.completion: How very intriguing. I will have to make some additional modifications, and perhaps locate a more proper catalyst. Thank you for performing this experiment, I trust that you did not experience any adverse effects? Should you feel up to the task, I may have use of your services again shortly.
text.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

english.title: A Vision in Time
english.objectives: Use the Vision of Time in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
english.description: Look at how the Vision reacts! Astounding! Even now it shows shadows of timeways that flit around us constantly. Though not true sands of the Hourglass of Time, the finely-ground epoch stones certainly have a power all their own. Our first task is to use them to calibrate the Vision of Time.$b$bTake the Vision of Time to a location where history is in the making: the Siege of Orgrimmar. Once there, turn the hourglass and see what happens.
english.completion: How very intriguing. I will have to make some additional modifications, and perhaps locate a more proper catalyst. Thank you for performing this experiment, I trust that you did not experience any adverse effects? Should you feel up to the task, I may have use of your services again shortly.
english.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

text.title: 强化沙漏
text.objectives: 从永恒岛的生物身上收集纪元之石。
text.description: 沙漏终于让我们得以窥见时间之流，想当初我们曾经如履平地般地在其中自由行走。$b$b去收集更多的纪元之石，那样我们才能继续利用沙漏的力量探究时间之流的秘密。$b$b未来的希望全在于此。
text.progress: Epoch stones are rare, crystallized temporal essence.
text.completion: Give me a moment to grind the stones and add them to the hourglass, and we shall see what new events unfold.$B$BIt's really quite convenient, I've a particular affinity for specific moments, rather than lengthy chains of events.$B$BThe timeways tell me that we will have need of its power many times in the near future.
text.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

english.title: Empowering the Hourglass
english.objectives: Collect Epoch Stones from creatures on the Timeless Isle.
english.description: The hourglass gives us glimpses into the streams of time we once walked as easily as a well-worn path.$b$bGather additional epoch stones, so that we may continue to use the power of the hourglass to delve into the mysteries of the timeways.$b$bThe future depends on it.
english.progress: Epoch stones are rare, crystallized temporal essence.
english.completion: Give me a moment to grind the stones and add them to the hourglass, and we shall see what new events unfold.$B$BIt's really quite convenient, I've a particular affinity for specific moments, rather than lengthy chains of events.$B$BThe timeways tell me that we will have need of its power many times in the near future.
english.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

text.title: 永恒精魄
text.objectives: 在永恒岛上吃下成熟的脆果、覆沙龟蛋、充能的水晶、巨型牦牛烤肉、烤熟的种子或火粟花。
text.description: 如你所想，这座岛屿上的动植物群相当不同寻常。但并非所有解释都是神秘难懂的。有时候，我们必须聆听大地的声音，去听一听身边世界的故事。你可曾想过，岛上的生物单凭从你脚下的土地中汲取精魄就能长成如此大小？$b$b你可以在岛屿各处找到大量精魄——在成熟的水果、蛋、肉、花、坚果，甚至是石头里都蕴藏着精魄。把它们吃下去，并探明这片土地的力量。
text.completion: The island gives in abundance, in nutriment and in answers. You only need look around to find what you seek.
text.completed: Speak with Emperor Shaohao on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

english.title: Timeless Nutriment
english.objectives: Consume a Ripe Crispfruit, Sand-Covered Egg, Charged Crystal, Huge Yak Roast, Roasted Seed, or Fire Poppy on the Timeless Isle.
english.description: As you have surmised, the flora and fauna of this island are quite unusual. Not all explanations are mysterious, however. Sometimes, we must listen to the land, to hear the tales of the world around us. Have you considered that the creatures of this island grew to such proportions simply from the nutriment of the land you walk upon?$b$bYou will find nutriment in abundance throughout the island: ripe fruits, eggs, meat, flowers, nuts, and even the stones themselves. Eat, and discover the power of the land.
english.completion: The island gives in abundance, in nutriment and in answers. You only need look around to find what you seek.
english.completed: Speak with Emperor Shaohao on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

text.title: 天神悟道圣坛
text.objectives: 找到激活的迷时圣坛并获得天神的祝福。
text.description: 许多年前，这里曾是供我族人朝圣的地方。他们可以在这里聆听天神的教诲，然后静思冥想长达数天之久。通过冥想，他们可以找出折磨自己灵魂的恐惧、愤怒、绝望、怀疑与暴力情绪。$b$b在他们面前会出现一条条通往启迪的坦途。每个人面前的坦途都是不一样的。但无一例外都是以智慧为起点。$b$b像他们一样在岛上走一走吧，找出一座失落的天神悟道圣坛。
text.completion: You have experienced the power and wisdom of the Celestials. Let it flow through you now, and remain in your heart for all time.
text.completed: Speak with Emperor Shaohao on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

english.title: Wayshrines Of The Celestials
english.objectives: Find an active Time-Lost Shrine and request a blessing from the celestials.
english.description: Many years ago, these grounds were a place where my people would come in pilgrimage. Here, they would listen to the words of the celestials, and meditate for many days. In their meditations, they found the fear, anger, despair, doubt, and violence that plagued their spirits.$b$bBefore them would be a pathway to enlightenment. For each, the pathway would be different. For all of them, the pathway began with wisdom.$b$bTravel the island, as they did, and discover one of the lost wayshrines of the celestials.
english.completion: You have experienced the power and wisdom of the Celestials. Let it flow through you now, and remain in your heart for all time.
english.completed: Speak with Emperor Shaohao on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

text.title: 驱退烈焰
text.objectives: 击败永恒岛上的野牛人军队，从而与少昊的声望达到尊敬。
text.description: 从前，熊猫人和斡耳朵野牛人曾在这片土地上和谐共处。当岛屿突然消失时，斡耳朵面临着难逃一死的局面。在万般绝望的情况下，首席萨满祭司请求火焰之王出手相救，并得到了回应。$b$b这名萨满名叫斡耳朵斯。现在，他成为了愤怒与暴力的化身。尽管他的族人得救了，但他却要永无止境地苦苦忍受炽热烈焰的烧蚀。$b$b往日的和谐之景不复存在。斡耳朵野牛人想要夺取天神庭院，要把我们所有人献祭给斡耳朵斯。去击退他们，让平衡再现。
text.completion: Your accomplishments are many, and your bravery cannot be questioned. The Ordon have been driven back for the moment, but do not underestimate them. To restore harmony to the isle, we must continue to be vigilant.
text.completed: Speak with Emperor Shaohao on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

english.title: Drive Back The Flame
english.objectives: Earn an Honored Reputation with Shaohao by defeating yaungol forces on the Timeless Isle.
english.description: The pandaren once existed in harmony with the Ordon yaungol. When the island suddenly disappeared, the Ordon faced certain death. In their desperation, the chief shaman called out for aid to the Fire Lords, and was answered.$b$bOrdos was his name. Now, he is a creature of anger and violence. Though his people were saved, he burns endlessly in molten agony.$b$bThere is harmony no longer. The Ordon seek to take the Celestial Court, and sacrifice us all to Ordos. Drive them back, and restore balance.
english.completion: Your accomplishments are many, and your bravery cannot be questioned. The Ordon have been driven back for the moment, but do not underestimate them. To restore harmony to the isle, we must continue to be vigilant.
english.completed: Speak with Emperor Shaohao on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

text.title: 烈焰祭司阿克鲁斯
text.objectives: 召唤并击败烈焰祭司阿克鲁斯。
text.description: 你的努力已经击退了斡耳朵野牛人，为天神庭院带来了和平，但这局面不会持续太久。是时候让斡耳朵斯的头号使者烈焰祭司阿克鲁斯闭嘴了。$b$b与织雾者顾严交谈并购买挑战卷轴，然后前往北方的三息台。在挑战石处发起挑战，那一定会引起斡耳朵野牛人的注意，将阿克鲁斯从斡耳朵圣殿引出来。这是你唯一的机会。
text.completion: The emissaries of Ordos have been silenced, for a time.$B$BKnow that anger, violence, and hatred will never cease. Wherever there is the darkness within one's spirit, you will find these Sha awaiting you. They may become manifest in many forms: a warlord hungering for power, a dagger in your back in the night, a young prince following a dark path, and even your own battle against forces not aligned with your own.$B$BLearn from the lessons of these emotions, lest you lose yourself to the darkness.
text.completed: Speak with Emperor Shaohao on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

english.title: The Archiereus Of Flame
english.objectives: Summon and defeat the Archiereus of Flame.
english.description: Your efforts have driven back the Ordon and brought peace to the Celestial Court, but it will not last. It is time to silence the great emissary of Ordos - the Archiereus of Flame.$b$bSpeak with Mistweaver Ku and purchase a scroll of challenge, then travel to Three-Breeze Terrace to the north. Issue a challenge at the challenge stone, it will undoubtedly catch the attention of the Ordon, drawing the archiereus out of the Ordon Sanctuary. It is your only chance.
english.completion: The emissaries of Ordos have been silenced, for a time.$B$BKnow that anger, violence, and hatred will never cease. Wherever there is the darkness within one's spirit, you will find these Sha awaiting you. They may become manifest in many forms: a warlord hungering for power, a dagger in your back in the night, a young prince following a dark path, and even your own battle against forces not aligned with your own.$B$BLearn from the lessons of these emotions, lest you lose yourself to the darkness.
english.completed: Speak with Emperor Shaohao on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

text.objectives: 把武器送到$1oa位霜狼奴隶手上。
text.description: 利戈拉带着额外的武器去武装那些被奴役的霜狼成员了。$b$b把霜狼奴隶们武装起来，好让他们冲破奴隶主的桎梏。
text.completion: The ogres appear to be in disarray and many of my people are now free.

english.description: Ligra was sent with extra weapons to equip enslaved Frostwolves.$b$bArm the Frostwolf Slaves so they can cut their way from their slavers.

text.objectives: 将月牙的毛皮交给暗月岛上暗月马戏团的亚布·尼比盖尔。
text.description: 这是暗月岛上可怕兽穴之母身上的毛皮。$B$B暗月马戏团的驯兽师亚布·尼比盖尔要是得知那只幽灵狼和她的崽子们再也无法祸害他的动物，他一定会感到非常高兴的……哪怕只是暂时的。把毛皮交给他。
text.progress: Is that what I think it is?
text.completion: At last, that vicious beast has been slain! Thank you.

english.objectives: Bring Moonfang's Pelt to Yebb Neblegear at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
english.description: This is the pelt of Darkmoon Island's monstrous den mother.$B$BYebb Neblegear, beastmaster of the Darkmoon Faire, will be happy to know the ghostly wolf and her spawn will no longer be terrorizing his menagerie... at least for a little while. Bring it to him.

text.title: 汤面时间：奖励
text.objectives: 在半山面档排队上工，然后完成奖励目标。
text.description: 你好，$n。你认为自己是一位非常杰出的汤面大厨？$B$B那就让我们瞧瞧你的本事吧！
text.completion: Excellent work $n! Everyone always loves it when they hear that you'll be making noodle soup. People come from all over Pandaria just to try a taste.

text.title: 到坠星岗哨来找我们
text.objectives: 在坠星岗哨与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
text.description: 大法师在山谷里发现了潜在的暗影议会势力。他让我通知你一声。$B$B尽快到坠星岗哨加入我们吧。我们需要你的力量来铲除他们，指挥官。
text.completion: Hello again, $n. You're just in time.$B$BWe've tracked the Shadow Council to a nearby village. I suspect that Gul'dan is with them.

english.title: Meet Us at Starfall Outpost
english.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Starfall Outpost.
english.description: The archmage has uncovered a potential Shadow Council presence in the valley. He asked me to let you know.$B$BAs soon as you can, join us at Starfall Outpost. We're going to need your muscle to root them out, commander.
english.completion: Hello again, $n. You're just in time.$B$BWe've tracked the Shadow Council to a nearby village. I suspect that Gul'dan is with them.

text.title: 迷雾行者之道
text.objectives: 在永恒岛上击败20只精英生物。
text.description: 你已经聆听了天神的教诲，但你在前往圣坛的途中又学到了什么呢？$b$b朝圣的智慧在于明心见性，直指本心。当你双耳听见树欲静而风不止之声，甚至就连翩翩起舞的小小蝴蝶都逃不过你的眼睛时，你就已经敞开了心门，汲取着试炼想要教会我们的最深邃的知识。也许你已经发现在岛屿四处游荡着许多庞大的猛兽？$b$b那就是你即将面对的试炼。潘达利亚让你学会了很多东西，现在就让这些知识接受实践的检验吧。
text.completion: Let this be your daily lesson, and let it hone your strength, wisdom, and fortitude.
text.completed: Return to Emperor Shaohao on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

english.title: Path of the Mistwalker
english.objectives: Defeat 20 Elite creatures on the Timeless Isle.
english.description: You have heard the words of the celestials, but what did you learn on your path to the shrines?$b$bThe wisdom of the pilgrimage is in its silence and simplicity. As you listen to the wind rustling in the trees, and note even the smallest butterfly, your mind is open to learning the deepest lessons the trials have to teach us. Perhaps you noticed the many great beasts that roam the island?$b$bTherein lies your trial. You have learned much from Pandaria, now let us put your knowledge to the test.
english.completion: Let this be your daily lesson, and let it hone your strength, wisdom, and fortitude.
english.completed: Return to Emperor Shaohao on the Timeless Isle near the Jade Forest.

text.title: 完善时光之眼
text.objectives: 在决战奥格瑞玛中使用时光之眼。
text.description: 我已经磨好了石头，并且把沙漏调节到新的时间流序列了。你愿意返回决战奥格瑞玛的现场，再翻转一次沙漏吗？$b$b快点回去，我真是太好奇了。
text.completion: A tale of true heroism, and a powerful moment in history. But not quite what we are after, I am afraid.$B$BNot much time remains - I shall double my efforts.
text.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

english.title: Refining The Vision
english.objectives: Use the Vision of Time in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
english.description: I have finished grinding the stones, and have attuned the hourglass to a new series of timeways. Will you return to the Siege of Orgrimmar and turn the hourglass once more?$b$bReturn quickly, I am most curious.
english.completion: A tale of true heroism, and a powerful moment in history. But not quite what we are after, I am afraid.$B$BNot much time remains - I shall double my efforts.
english.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

text.title: 寻找命运
text.objectives: 在决战奥格瑞玛中使用时光之眼。
text.description: 尽管你已经帮了时光旅行者这么多，我还是没能对你开诚布公。我无法把一切都告诉你，现在还不行，但你要知道的是，在我们当中存在叛徒。别对任何人透露你今天的使命，拿着时光之眼时要留心任何军团成员。$b$b抓紧时间，再次返回决战奥格瑞玛的现场使用沙漏。$b$b注意安全。
text.completion: Was that... me? How very interesting.$B$BNow we are beginning to see the shadows between worlds. Was this the future of our world, or simply one possibility? Regardless, our newfound ability to see more deeply into the timeways will allow us to push forward towards the answers we seek.$B$BAllow me some time to continue my research. And be vigilant, hero, for the timeways are as infinite as our enemies.
text.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

english.title: Seeking Fate
english.objectives: Use the Vision of Time in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
english.description: I have not been completely forthright with you, despite all that you have done to aid the Timewalkers. I cannot tell you everything, not yet, but know this - there is a traitor amongst us. Tell no one of your mission today, and take caution around any of my flight while you hold the Vision of Time.$b$bQuickly now, return to the Siege of Orgrimmar once more and use the hourglass.$b$bAnd be safe.
english.completion: Was that... me? How very interesting.$B$BNow we are beginning to see the shadows between worlds. Was this the future of our world, or simply one possibility? Regardless, our newfound ability to see more deeply into the timeways will allow us to push forward towards the answers we seek.$B$BAllow me some time to continue my research. And be vigilant, hero, for the timeways are as infinite as our enemies.
english.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

text.title: 销声敛迹
text.objectives: 在决战奥格瑞玛中使用时光之眼。
text.description: 你保守了我们使命的秘密，我要为此向你道谢。时间流的知识一旦落在歹人手里，会引发灾难性的毁灭。我的军团现在还无力修复它。我们必须多加小心。$b$b沙漏的力量越来越强了。我相信和之前相比，现在可以用它看到更远的未来了。我希望你能把它的作用发挥到极致。$b$b返回决战奥格瑞玛的现场，把沙漏对准你能找到的最具毁灭性的时间流。
text.completion: Stormwind... destroyed?$B$BI realize that this vision may come as a shock to you. I know little more than you at this time. I will do my best to search for answers, you have my word.
text.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

english.title: Hidden Threads
english.objectives: Use the Vision of Time in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
english.description: You have kept our mission a secret, and for that I thank you. Knowledge of the timeways, when in the wrong hands, can cause catastrophic devastation. My flight has little power to repair it, now. We must be careful.$b$bThe hourglass grows in power. I believe it can now be used to see much further than before. I wish you to push it to its limits.$b$bReturn to the Siege of Orgrimmar, and focus the hourglass on the most devastating timeway you can find.
english.completion: Stormwind... destroyed?$B$BI realize that this vision may come as a shock to you. I know little more than you at this time. I will do my best to search for answers, you have my word.
english.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

text.title: 祈求命运
text.objectives: 在昆莱山的白虎寺使用时光之眼。
text.description: 时光之眼已经渐趋完美了，我们现在对要寻找的景象有了更大的控制力。正是因为你的努力，我们才得以完成这件神器，并使我的军团和我们的时光旅行者盟友恢复了力量。我们所有人都对你感激不尽。$b$b相当幸运的是，我在潘达利亚发现了某种时间的死结——那是时间流的交叉点。把时光之眼带到白虎寺。在那里的地窖中翻转沙漏。
text.completion: Ah, it seems that our little prince has a role to play yet. We should not speak further of this, lest we alter the future ourselves.$B$BThe woods have ears, hero. Keep silent, we will find our answers in time.
text.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

english.title: Courting Destiny
english.objectives: Use the Vision of Time at the Temple of the White Tiger in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.description: The Vision of Time is nearly perfected, we now have much more control over the visions we seek. Your efforts have been instrumental in completing the artifact and restoring the strength of not only my flight, but also our allies in the Timewalkers. All of us are in your debt.$b$bQuite fortunately, I have located a sort of crux in time - an intersection of timeways - right here in Pandaria. Take the Vision of Time to the Temple of the White Tiger. There, in the cellars, turn the hourglass.
english.completion: Ah, it seems that our little prince has a role to play yet. We should not speak further of this, lest we alter the future ourselves.$B$BThe woods have ears, hero. Keep silent, we will find our answers in time.
english.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

text.title: 最终行动
text.objectives: 在塔纳利斯的时光之穴中使用时光之眼。
text.description: 我不愿意再开口对你提出这个请求，可我不知道还有谁可以信任。我一直在用时光之眼收集信息，而在我的研究中，我相信我已经找到了时间的另一个交汇点。就在时光之穴。$b$b当我初次看到那番景象时，我不愿意相信这是真的，可我不能坐视不理，让这个信息白白溜走。时光之穴——你必须马上前往那里，使用时光之眼。$b$b动作要快！
text.completion: Soridormi, the prime consort of Nozdormu, dead? And I was there as well?$B$BWe cannot know what this means, or what will come to pass, or even if this vision takes place in our timeway. You must speak of this vision to no one, lest we alter the course of time and cause great danger to us all. All we can do now is complete the Vision of Time - it will show us what the future truly holds.
text.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

english.title: One Final Turn
english.objectives: Use the Vision of Time in the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.
english.description: I do not wish to ask this of you again, but I do not know who I can trust any longer. I have been using the Vision of Time to gather information, and in my searches, I believe I have found another crux in time. It is in the Caverns of Time itself.$b$bI did not want to believe it when the vision first came to me, but I cannot sit idly by and let this information pass. The Caverns of Time - you must go there, now, and use the Vision of Time.$b$bMove quickly!
english.completion: Soridormi, the prime consort of Nozdormu, dead? And I was there as well?$B$BWe cannot know what this means, or what will come to pass, or even if this vision takes place in our timeway. You must speak of this vision to no one, lest we alter the course of time and cause great danger to us all. All we can do now is complete the Vision of Time - it will show us what the future truly holds.
english.completed: Return to Kairoz on the Timeless Isle.

text.objectives: 在血棘洞穴里找到艾瑞克、黛安妮和祖罗。
text.description: 陌生人，请你帮帮我！$B$B我和我的同伴们来这猎杀一只巨大的蜂后，目的是要换取赏金。$B$B当我们在山下扎营后，就沉沉睡去。结果半夜却被这些可怕而又苍白的……怪物给袭击了！$B$B我不知道我的朋友们都去了什么地方，但我听到了从洞穴深处传来的尖叫声。$B$B拜托了，快去找我的同伴们！我决不能一个人离开这里！

We were attacked in the middle of the night by these horrid, pale... things!$B$BI don't know where my friends have gone, but I heard screams from further down the cavern.$B$BPlease, find my companions. I can't leave here without them!

text.description: 准备好迎接更有难度的挑战了吗？在这项挑战中有一段额外的赛程：$B$B跑过拱门……$B抵达蓝色标记……$B抵达绿色标记……$B然后在钟敲响15下之前返回这里。$B$B祝你好运！

english.completed: test trial completion text.

text.title: 我们是愤怒的化身
text.objectives: 到你霜火岭的要塞与战争大师佐格谈一谈。
text.description: 等德雷克塔尔调整好自己就会没事的。元素的幻象对他产生了强大的影响，这将使他成为这个世界上最伟大的萨满祭司。$b$b你也许愿意回要塞把这里发生的一切告知战争大师佐格。$b$b他应该能派出更多军队来增强我们的力量。
text.completion: Well done, commander. I shall see what forces we can dispatch to the area for further clean-up.
text.completed: 到你在霜火岭的要塞与战争大师佐格谈一谈。

english.title: Ours is the Fury
english.objectives: Speak with Warmaster Zog at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description: Drek'Thar will be fine, once he adjusts. The vision the elemental has bestowed upon him is powerful, and he is on the path of becoming this world's greatest shaman.$b$bYou may wish to inform Warmaster Zog in your garrison of what has transpired here.$b$bHe should be able to deploy some of your troops to the area to further secure the area.
english.completion: Превосходно, командир. Я посмотрю, какие силы мы можем направить туда для дальнейшей зачистки.
english.completed: Speak with Warmaster Zog at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge.

objectiveDetails.description: Be at the arch after the buzzer fires

text.title: 弱肉强食
text.objectives: 收集$1oa个霜火微粒。
text.description: 德雷克塔尔认为艾索洛托斯被鬣蜥人吞噬掉的那部分也许毫无价值。可我不打算在没有尝试尽量找回这些“微粒”的情况下就贸然行动。$b$b在玛戈纳洛克消灭你所能找到的任何鬣蜥人，看看能否把霜火微粒从他们体内逼出来。
text.progress: Have you had any luck recovering those motes?
text.completion: Goren are abominations. They were created to eat the world. Your have done well.
text.completed: Find Draka at the Ascent of Frostfire.

english.title: Eatercology
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Motes of Frostfire.
english.description: Drek'Thar thinks the portions of Exurotus consumed by the goren might be worthless. I am not about to step before the fury without at least trying to recover as many of these "motes" as possible.$b$bSlay any goren you find at Magnarok and see if you can extract the motes of Frostfire from them.
english.progress: Have you had any luck recovering those motes?
english.completion: Gorens are just monsters. They were created to eat this world. You've done a good job...
english.completed: Find Draka at the Ascent of Frostfire.

text.title: Northwestern Medicine
text.objectives: Gather 20 Redleaf Herbs from supply bags in Thunderfall.
text.description: There is an herb which grows in the crevices and crags of Frostfire Ridge, in places where the icy breath of the sky sips the boiling blood of the earth. Thunderlord climbers gather it often, for it has potent healing properties.$B$BLook for stores of these herbs in Thunderfall, and take what you can. Give them to me when next we meet, and they can be used to save lives in Stonefang.
text.completed: Speak with Makar Stonebinder in Thunderfall.

english.objectives: Gather 20 Redleaf Herbs from supply bags in Thunderfall.
english.description: There is an herb which grows in the crevices and crags of Frostfire Ridge, in places where the icy breath of the sky sips the boiling blood of the earth. Thunderlord climbers gather it often, for it has potent healing properties.$B$BLook for stores of these herbs in Thunderfall, and take what you can. Give them to me when next we meet, and they can be used to save lives in Stonefang.
english.completed: Speak with Makar Stonebinder in Thunderfall.

text.title: 督军护卫
text.objectives: 收集桑克的徽记、古尔洛克的徽记和斯普洛戈的徽记。
text.description: 我不知道你以前是怎么样的，旅行者，不过这是一片弱肉强食的土地。也许杜隆坦本来就想除掉你。谁知道呢。$b$b你必须消灭鲜血之环的督军。只要你能得手，就能一举打败这里的食人魔。但首先，你得先找到他才行。$b$b我在附近发现了他的护卫。干掉他们，然后把他们的徽记带回来给我。这样我们就一定能把他们的督军给引出来。
text.progress: You still draw breath, hmm?$B$BHave you dealt with the warlord's underlings?
text.completion: You have done well in this, but do not become proud. This land has dangers far greater than what you have seen here.
text.completed: Return to Igrimar the Resolute at the Circle of Blood.

english.title: The Warlord's Guard
english.objectives: Gather the Head of Thunk, the Head of Gullok, and the Head of Splorg.
english.description: I don't know what you are accustomed to, traveler, but these lands devour the weak. Perhaps Durotan wishes to rid himself of you. We shall see.$b$bYou must kill the Warlord of the Circle of Blood. Do this and the ogres here will be defeated. But first, you must find him.$b$bI have located his bodyguards nearby. Slay them and bring me their heads. With them, we shall lure the Warlord into the open.
english.progress: You still draw breath, hmm?$B$BHave you dealt with the warlord's underlings?
english.completion: You have done well in this, but do not become proud. This land has dangers far greater than what you have seen here.
english.completed: Return to Igrimar the Resolute at the Circle of Blood.

text.title: 愈伤
text.objectives: 治疗5名霜狼角斗士。
text.description: 懦夫！真是没用的饭桶！$b$b刀塔食人魔总是把我们的伤员劫回老巢，把他们当成奴隶，让他们像狗一样地为他们战斗。$b$b为了报复我们的攻击，刀塔食人魔毒害了兽人囚犯，让他们在无尽的痛苦与折磨中死去。$b$b只有他们的占卜师身上才有解毒药，旅行者。用这种药来治愈霜狼囚犯身上的毒伤。
text.completion: You have done the Frostwolf Clan a service, traveler. I shall be sure to tell Durotan of your deeds.
text.completed: Return to Igrimar the Resolute in the Circle of Blood.

english.title: The Cure
english.objectives: Cure 5 Frostwolf Gladiators.
english.description: Cowards! A curse on these wretched meatbags!$b$bThe Bladespire have always taunted the orc clans by taking our wounded as slaves to fight like dogs in their pits.$b$bIn retaliation for our assault they have poisoned their orc prisoners, leaving them to suffer and die an excruciating death.$b$bOnly their geomancers carry the antidote, traveler. Use it to cure the Frostwolf prisoners.
english.completion: You have done the Frostwolf Clan a service, traveler. I shall be sure to tell Durotan of your deeds.
english.completed: Return to Igrimar the Resolute in the Circle of Blood.

text.title: 幽影游戏猎手
text.objectives: 在幽影林地里收集材料。
text.description: <你在一张羊皮纸上发现了一份列表。$b$b阿塞尼奥正在你的要塞准备新食谱，他需要一些材料。>
text.progress: Did you find all the ingredients I need?
text.completion: Nice! Thanks so much! I can use these to make a delicious wolf meat, frog leg, mushroom stew.
text.completed: Return to Arsenio in your garrison.

english.title: Gloomshade Game Hunter
english.objectives: Collect ingredients in Gloomshade Grove.
english.description: <You find a list on a piece of parchment.$b$bArsenio needs some ingredients for a new recipe he's preparing at your garrison.>
english.progress: Ты уже $Gсобрал:собрала; все продукты?
english.completion: Nice! Thanks so much! I can use these to make a delicious wolf meat, frog leg, mushroom stew.
english.completed: Return to Arsenio in your garrison.

text.title: 一日雷神
text.objectives: 制造5个雷神抓钩。
text.description: 地上有几截雷神锁链。锁链的设计非常简单，但却十分有效。$b$b只要有足够的零部件，哪怕是完全未经训练的新手都能组装出一根锁链，像雷神飞爪兵一样得心应手地使其发挥威力。
text.progress: This shoddy, beaten anvil is used mostly for crafting chains and what little other metal working the Thunderlord require.
text.completion: With a quick tap of a hammer and a snip of the rings, the Thunderlord Grapple is as good as new.
text.completed: Find the Chaincrafter's Anvil at Collossal's Fall in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Thunderlord for a Day
english.objectives: Build a Thunderlord Grapple.
english.description: Pieces of a Thunderlord chain lay on the ground. It is of a very simple design, but effective.$b$bWith enough parts, even the most unskilled person could assemble a chain and grapple as effective as those used by the Thunderlord Grapplers.
english.progress: This shoddy, beaten anvil is used mostly for crafting chains and what little other metal working the Thunderlord require.
english.completion: With a quick tap of a hammer and a snip of the rings, the Thunderlord Grapple is as good as new.
english.completed: Find the Chaincrafter's Anvil at Collossal's Fall in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: The Iron Tide
text.objectives: Slay Arnokk the Burner and 10 Iron Horde troops within Karabor.
text.description: The majority of Karabor's defensive troops are dealing with the main battle front, just west of here. We must not ignore our flanks while dealing with that assault.$b$bOne of the enemy leaders, Arnokk, is directing the mayhem on this side of the temple. Take him out, along with as many of his orcish followers as you can stomach.$b$bOnce you've finished, meet me in front of the temple.
text.completed: Report to Prophet Velen at the front side of Karabor.
text.giverWindow: The orc is fixated on fire.

english.title: The Iron Tide
english.objectives: Slay Arnokk the Burner and 10 Iron Horde troops within Karabor.
english.description: The majority of Karabor's defensive troops are dealing with the main battle front, just west of here. We must not ignore our flanks while dealing with that assault.$b$bOne of the enemy leaders, Arnokk, is directing the mayhem on this side of the temple. Take him out, along with as many of his orcish followers as you can stomach.$b$bOnce you've finished, meet me in front of the temple.
english.completed: Report to Prophet Velen at the front side of Karabor.
english.giverWindow: The orc is fixated on fire.

text.title: From Over the Walls
text.objectives: Dislodge 6 Blackrock Grappling Hooks near Karabor's outer walls.
text.description: Karabor is falling. The Iron Horde will not stop this assault until every last one of us is dead and cold on the ground.$b$bI don't know about you, but I don't plan on letting that happen.$b$bNow, there must be something we can do to prevent them from scaling the walls...
text.completed: Report to the staging area near Karabor's western entrance.

english.title: From Over the Walls
english.objectives: Dislodge 6 Blackrock Grappling Hooks near Karabor's outer walls.
english.description: Karabor is falling. The Iron Horde will not stop this assault until every last one of us is dead and cold on the ground.$b$bI don't know about you, but I don't plan on letting that happen.$b$bNow, there must be something we can do to prevent them from scaling the walls...
english.completed: Report to the staging area near Karabor's western entrance.

text.title: 督军的陨殁
text.objectives: 击败督军布尔特。
text.description: 真没想到你居然能走到这一步，陌生人。我们现在要做的就剩下解决竞技场的督军了。$b$b这将成为你在这里要面对的第一个真正考验。即使对于身经百战的霜狼战士来说，布尔特也很难应付。$b$b把你所收集到的徽记挂到霜火竞技场的尖刺上。这样一定能激怒他们的督军，逼他跟你动手。$b$b带着胜利凯旋而归吧，这才能证明杜隆坦没有信错人。
text.completion: Impressive work.
text.completed: Speak to Snowrunner Rolga at Bladespire Citadel.

english.title: The Fall of the Warlord
english.objectives: Kill Warlord Bult.
english.description: You've managed to survive this long, stranger. All that remains to be done here is to fell the Warlord of the arena.$b$bThis will be your first true test here. Bult would provide a challenge to even a battle-hardened Frostwolf.$b$bPlace the heads you've collected on spikes in the Frostfire Arena. They are sure to enrage the warlord and lure him into battle.$b$bCome out of the arena victorious and it will show that Durotan's trust in you was not misplaced.
english.completion: Impressive work.
english.completed: Speak to Snowrunner Rolga at Bladespire Citadel.

text.title: 拯救狼村
text.objectives: 从雷神氏族手中救下沃高尔。
text.description:
懦弱的雷神氏族……

在堡垒一战中，信使们带来消息，说铁狼正在攻击我们的家园。他在那可没那么容易得手，德拉卡会让他们为今天的恶行付出十倍的代价，但我们必须尽快赶回去，把那些杂碎赶尽杀绝。

你和你的军队用行动证明了自己是霜狼氏族珍贵的盟友。我们欢迎你们帮忙守卫沃高尔。

要是你们愿意加入的话，那就在战场上见吧。
text.completion: Durotan's trust in you is well-placed, $n. You have mine as well.
text.completed: Speak with Draka at Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Save Wolf Home
english.objectives: Save Wor'gol from the Thunderlord clan.
english.description:
Cowardly Thunderlords...

During the battle for the citadel, runners informed me that the Iron Wolf is striking at our home. He'll find no easy footing there, Draka will make them pay tenfold for any of ours that they slay, but we must return quickly and chase the mongrels off.

You and your forces have proven valuable allies of the Frostwolves. We'd welcome your aid in securing our Wor'gol.

I'll see you on the battlefield if you choose to come.
english.completion: Durotan's trust in you is well-placed, $n. You have mine as well.
english.completed: Speak with Draka at Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 先知
text.objectives: 抵达幻象之池并消灭督军贾拉克。
text.description: 雷神战争领袖……$n，你必须制止他。$B$B他去西北边的幻象之池攻击德雷克塔尔了！
text.completion: Wolf Home is saved, but I sense a stronger enemy just over the horizon.
text.completed: Speak with Farseer Drek'Thar at the Pool of Visions.
text.giverWindow: 在他杀死先知德雷克塔尔之前干掉他！

english.title: The Farseer
english.objectives: Get to the Pool of Visions and kill Warleader Gargrak.
english.description: The Thunderlord warleader... $n, you have to stop him.$B$BHe went to attack Drek'Thar at the Pool of Visions to the northwest!
english.completion: Wolf Home is saved, but I sense a stronger enemy just over the horizon.
english.completed: Speak with Farseer Drek'Thar at the Pool of Visions.
english.giverWindow: Kill him before he kills Farseer Drek'Thar!

text.title: 幻象之池
text.objectives: 在幻象之池与先知德雷克塔尔交谈来开始幻象仪式。
text.description: 一场席卷四野的风暴即将到来，$c。$B$B我已经准备了一场仪式。你必须问问池水，看看命运的走向。
text.completion: This Iron Tide threatens to sweep over all of Draenor.$B$BThe pool has shown you a possible future. This vision of the Frostwolf clan's destruction must not be allowed to come to pass.$B$BYou must stop it, $n.
text.completed: Speak with Farseer Drek'Thar at the Pool of Visions.

english.title: Pool of Visions
english.objectives: Speak with Farseer Drek'Thar at the Pool of Visions to begin the ritual of vision.
english.description: A terrible storm gathers on the horizon, $c.$B$BI have prepared a ritual. You must consult the pool to see what destiny holds for us all.
english.completion: This Iron Tide threatens to sweep over all of Draenor.$B$BThe pool has shown you a possible future. This vision of the Frostwolf clan's destruction must not be allowed to come to pass.$B$BYou must stop it, $n.
english.completed: Speak with Farseer Drek'Thar at the Pool of Visions.

text.title: 返回刀塔堡垒
text.objectives: 回刀塔堡垒找杜隆坦。
text.description: 你必须把你所看到的一切告诉杜隆坦。普尔·塑风可以送你回去。$B$B霜狼氏族……和德拉诺的命运，就全押在你身上了，$n。
text.completion: Grim news indeed, $n.$B$BFor saving Wolf Home, I would name you wolf-$g brother:sister;.$B$BNow we must defend Frostfire Ridge from the Thunderlord clan and the Iron Horde.
text.completed: Speak with Durotan at Bladespire Citadel.

english.title: Back to Bladespire Citadel
english.objectives: Return to Durotan at Bladespire Citadel.
english.description: Durotan must be told of your vision. Pul Windcarver will offer you a flight back.$B$BThe fate of the Frostwolf... of Draenor, depends upon you, $n.
english.completion: Grim news indeed, $n.$B$BFor saving Wolf Home, I would name you wolf-$g brother:sister;.$B$BNow we must defend Frostfire Ridge from the Thunderlord clan and the Iron Horde.
english.completed: Speak with Durotan at Bladespire Citadel.

text.title: 穆维里克的困境
text.objectives: 从奴隶主图格尔身上取得钥匙，然后找到穆维里克的斧子。
text.description: 你是来这里救我的？看来我们现在是盟友了。$b$b污煤矿洞里的奴隶主图格尔身上肯定有打开这个笼子的钥匙。$b$b你进去以后，你能不能顺便看看是哪个软脚工头把我的斧子拿走了？
text.progress: These ogres will be seeing the other side of my axes soon.
text.completion: You have my sincere gratitude, $n.
text.completed: Return to Mulverick at the Sootstained Mining Camp.

english.title: Mulverick's Plight
english.objectives: Get the key from Slavemaster Turgall and find Mulverick's Axes.
english.description: You were sent here to free me? It seems that makes us allies.$b$bSlavemaster Turgall within the Soostained Mines will certainly have the key to this cage.$b$bWhile you're in there, do you think you could see which of those spineless taskmasters took my axes?
english.progress: These ogres will be seeing the other side of my axes soon.
english.completion: You have my sincere gratitude, $n.
english.completed: Return to Mulverick at the Sootstained Mining Camp.

text.title: 奴隶主之死
text.objectives: 与刀塔堡垒的古丝谈一谈。
text.description: 跟今天被你救出的其他霜狼成员分享这个喜讯吧。他们如果得知有人活着逃出矿井，一定会很高兴的。
text.completion:
You found Mulverick?

It shouldn't be long before those ogres clear out after you defeated their master.

english.title: The Slavemaster's Demise
english.objectives: Speak to Guse at Bladespire Citadel.
english.description: Share word with the others of the Frostwolves you saved this day. They will be glad to know that some made it out of the mines alive.
english.completion:
You found Mulverick?

It shouldn't be long before those ogres clear out after you defeated their master.

text.title: 多人赛跑
text.objectives: 跑过拱门，击中蓝色标记，然后是绿色标记、红色标记和紫色标记，最后返回钢铁精灵游戏营地。
text.description: 跑过拱门……$B抵达蓝色标记……$B抵达绿色标记……$B抵达红色标记$B抵达紫色标记$B返回这里……$B然后再跑一遍。没错——一共跑两遍！$B$B祝你好运！
text.completed: test trial completion text.

english.title: Multiplayer Race
english.objectives: Run through the arch, hit the blue marker, then the green marker, the red marker, the purple marker, then return to the Ironelf games camp.
english.description: Run through the arch...$BGet to the blue marker...$BGet to the green marker...$BGet to the red marker$BGet to the purple marker$BReturn here...$BThen do it all again. That's right - 2 laps!$B$BGood luck!
english.completed: test trial completion text.

objectiveDetails.description: 在比赛开始时到拱门处就位

text.title: 北郡短跑大赛
text.objectives: 跑过拱门，击中蓝色标记和绿色标记，然后返回钢铁精灵游戏营地。
text.description: 欢迎来到钢铁侏儒游戏营地！在这项挑战中：跑过拱门……$B抵达蓝色标记……$B再抵达绿色标记……$B然后返回这里。$B$B你有足够的时间来完成这项挑战。
text.completed: test trial completion text.

english.title: Northshire Sprint Practice
english.objectives: Run through the arch, hit the blue marker, then the green marker, then return to the Ironelf games camp.
english.description: Welcome to the Irongnome games! For this challenge: run through the arch...$BGet to the blue marker...$BGet to the green marker...$Bthen return here.$B$BYou have all the time you need for this.
english.completed: test trial completion text.

text.title: 卷土重来
text.objectives: 在你的要塞与杜隆坦谈一谈。
text.description: 我的一部分大脑同意卡格的观点——我们现在可以对铁狼发起挑战。当我一听到他的名字就会握紧双拳。我全身上下的肌肉都在渴望复仇。$B$B但在我内心深处，我能感觉到阿莎。她在安抚着我，指引着我。她的智慧令我感到愧不敢当，但我没理由浪费这份馈赠。$B$B<洛卡拉眯眼看着天空。>$B$B杜隆坦和其他人此刻应该在你的要塞集合了。我们应该见见他们。
text.completion: Lokra has always lacked the patience and control of her older sister. She approaches problems head-first, and relies on her raw talents to succeed.$B$BSeeing the way her and Karg look at each other, I am not surprised she chased him all the way to Grom'gar. What surprises me is that they made it back.$B$BAs usual, I expect we have you to thank for that. You continue to honor us with your deeds.
text.completed: 在你的要塞与杜隆坦谈一谈。

english.title: Return to the Pack
english.objectives: Speak with Durotan at your garrison.
english.description: Part of me agrees with Karg - we COULD challenge the Iron Wolf right now. My fists clench at the mention of his name. My muscles scream for vengeance.$B$BBut then, in my heart, I feel Asha. Calming me. Guiding me. I do not deserve her wisdom, but it is a gift I will not waste.$B$B<Lokra squints at the sky.>$B$BDurotan and the others will be gathering at your garrison about now. We should meet them.
english.completion: Lokra has always lacked the patience and control of her older sister. She approaches problems head-first, and relies on her raw talents to succeed.$B$BSeeing the way her and Karg look at each other, I am not surprised she chased him all the way to Grom'gar. What surprises me is that they made it back.$B$BAs usual, I expect we have you to thank for that. You continue to honor us with your deeds.
english.completed: Speak with Durotan at your garrison.

text.title: Unexpected Assault
text.objectives: Slay $1oa Bonechewer Orcs and direct $2oa Auchenai to safety in the Court of Souls.
text.description: Thank the Light you're here. The Bonechewer orcs have invaded!$B$BWe've dealt with the occasional raid before, but they've never attacked Auchindoun with such numbers before.$B$BWe arrived as quickly as we could to respond to the threat, but the local guard had already fallen. We cannot afford to lose more men!$B$BKill all of the Bonechewer you can and help consolidate our forces back to our defensive line. The Bonechewer must not be allowed to step foot in Auchindoun!
text.completed: Return to Exarch Maladaar at the Auchindoun North Gate in Talador.

text.objectives: Slay $1oa Bonechewer Orcs and direct $2oa Auchenai to safety in the Court of Souls.
text.description: My scouts have reported that the Bonechewer clan is attacking Auchindoun, $n. The Auchenai guard are here, but I fear they won't be enough.$B$BI sense a dark presence nearby... we cannot chance leaving their defenses weak. Too much power lies within those hallowed halls.$B$BSlay the Bonechewer and direct any of the Auchenai injured back to their defensive line. I will direct my scouts throughout the area to try to ascertain the Bonechewers' motives.
text.completed: Return to Lady Liadrin at Liadrin's Watch in Talador.

text.title: 布莱克松的党羽
text.objectives: 消灭阿鲁克斯、莫德雷斯和麦什伦。
text.description: 亚门纳尔的化身临近了。为了保护仪式的顺利进行，亡语者布莱克松派他最信任的副官挡住了我们的去路。$B$B疫病蜘蛛阿鲁克斯在它的幼蛛附近筑了巢，周围有亡首魔灵师保护。莫德雷斯将亚门纳尔的军队集结在了白骨之堆上。最后，麦什伦把守着通往荆棘螺旋的入口。$B$B等你击败这些守卫者后，我会与你会合，一同去面对布莱克松。
text.completion: You have done well, but this is only half of the battle. With his support structure in disarray it is time to strike at Death Speaker Blackthorn.
text.completed: Return to Koristrasza.

english.title: Blackthorn's Lieutenants
english.objectives: Kill Aarux, Mordresh, and Mushlump.
english.description: Amnennar's reincarnation is imminent. In order to protect the ceremony Death Speaker Blackthorn has placed his most trusted lieutenants between us and him.$B$BAarux, a plagued spider nests near his young, tended to by the Death's Head Aranomancers. Mordresh rallies Amnennar's forces upon the Bone Pile. Finally, Mushlump stands guarding the entrance to the Spiral of Thorns.$B$BOnce you defeat these guardians I will join you and together we will confront Blackthorn.
english.completion: Отличная работа – но это только полдела. Теперь, когда вестник смерти Черношип лишился поддержки, пришло время покончить с ним.
english.completed: Return to Koristrasza.

text.title: 仪式
text.objectives: 杀掉寒冰之王亚门纳尔。
text.description: 你能这么快赶来真是太好了。我必须再次要你以身涉险来拯救卡利姆多。$B$B亚门纳尔的学徒——亡语者布莱克松想把他的主人带回活人的世界！我们必须尽快赶到荆棘螺旋顶部，在仪式完成前将他击败。只有联合你我的力量合力出击，才有希望制止他！
text.completion: A job well done, $n. With Amnennar's phylactery now protected by the Red dragonflight we can now rest at ease.
text.completed: Return to Koristrasza.
text.giverWindow: 当心他强大的魔法！

english.title: The Ritual
english.objectives: Kill Amnennar the Coldbringer.
english.description: You are good to have come so quickly.  I must ask you to put your lives in danger once more in order to save Kalimdor.$B$BAmnennar's apprentice, Death Speaker Blackthorn, hopes to return his master to the realm of the living!  We must quickly make our way atop the Spiral of Thorns and defeat him before the ritual can be completed.  We must strike together, only with our combined force can we hope to stop him!
english.completion: Мы молодцы, $n! Теперь, когда филактерия Амненнара находится под защитой рода красных драконов, мы наконец можем вздохнуть спокойно.
english.completed: Return to Koristrasza.
english.giverWindow: Be wary of his powerful magic!

text.title: Un-Safety First
text.objectives: Disable 4 Safety Valves.
text.description: These plans were designed to be read by even the most unskilled of metallurgists. It has big symbols on specific pipes for what valves NOT to turn unless risking woeful amounts of destruction.
text.completed: Speak with Durotan in the Warfuel Depot of Gorgrond.

text.title: Save Auchenai Caretakers
text.objectives: Direct 6 Auchenai Caretakers to safety in the Court of Lights in Talador.
text.description: I was fortunate enough to be delivering a report to the Exarch when the demons attacked, but the rest of my brethren were out tending to the Court of Lights!$B$BWe caretakers are not the fighters of our order. Go to the court northwest of here and help direct them to safety.
text.completed: Return to Levixus at the Auchindoun North Gate in Talador.

english.completed: Return to Levixus at the Auchindoun North Gate in Talador.

text.title: Felblood
text.objectives: Collect $1oa Felblood Samples by killing Stormreaver Fearmongers in the Court of Lights in Talador.
text.description: Fascinating. The doomguard in the courtyard southwest of here have disguised themselves as orcs and do not die when defeated in battle.$B$BYou see, they are powerful magical beings, and their essence manifests nearby as a blood creature that revives its body upon reaching it.$B$BI would like to study these essences without dealing with the demons myself. Bring me a few samples, would you?
text.completed: Return to Mage-Lord Astalor Bloodsworn at Liadrin's Watch in Talador.

english.title: Felblood
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Felblood Samples by killing Stormreaver Fearmongers in the Court of Lights in Talador.
english.description: Fascinating. The doomguard in the courtyard southwest of here have disguised themselves as orcs and do not die when defeated in battle.$B$BYou see, they are powerful magical beings, and their essence manifests nearby as a blood creature that revives its body upon reaching it.$B$BI would like to study these essences without dealing with the demons myself. Bring me a few samples, would you?
english.completed: Return to Mage-Lord Astalor Bloodsworn at Liadrin's Watch in Talador.

text.title: 敲山震虎
text.objectives: 把$1oa面霜狼军旗插到刀塔食人魔的尸体上。
text.description: 刀塔氏族多年来一直让我的族人不堪其扰。$b$b那一切都将在今天终结！$b$b现在用食人魔能明白的方式去向他们解释吧。$b$b要是你仍然想要帮助我们，就去把我们的军旗插到我们对手的尸体上。$b$b当他们看到遍地都是霜狼氏族的战利品时，一定会被吓得落荒而逃！$b$b这就是我们的行事方式。等你完成这项任务，我会到前面与你会合。
text.completion: These are no ordinary enemies, yet you did not show any signs of weakness.
text.completed: Meet with Durotan in Bladespire Citadel.

english.title: These Colors Don't Run
english.objectives: Use $1oa Frostwolf Banners on Bladespire Ogre corpses.
english.description: Bladespire has been a plague on my people for many years.$b$bThat ends today!$b$bNow to explain it to the ogres in a way they will understand.$b$bIf you still wish to help us, place our banner in the corpses of our adversaries. $b$bTheir courage will falter as they behold a field of Frostwolf trophies!$b$bThis is our way. I will meet with you ahead when you have completed this deed.
english.completion: These are no ordinary enemies, yet you did not show any signs of weakness.
english.completed: Meet with Durotan in Bladespire Citadel.

text.title: 最后一步
text.objectives: 沿着链条爬上去，并击败戈尔索格。
text.description: 贾纳尔在震怒之下居然去找食人魔之王戈尔索格对决。$b$b他孤身一人，而且通往王座大厅的斜坡又被堵住了。$b$b我们已经见识了你的足智多谋。也许你能找其它路上去？$b$b我在来的路上受了伤，但我可以杀出一条血路，到斜坡上与你会合。$b$b抓紧时间，旅行者，霜狼氏族一定要攻取堡垒。
text.completion: We called you outsider, $r, but you have shown the strength and heart of a Frostwolf.
text.completed: Speak with Durotan.
text.giverWindow: 刀塔堡垒之王。

english.title: Last Steps
english.objectives: Climb the chain and kill Gorr'thog.
english.description: In a rage, Ga'nar ascended to fight Gorr'thog, the ogre king.$b$bHe is alone, and the ramp to the throne room is now blocked.$b$bYou've proven resourceful. Perhaps you could find another way up?$b$bI sustained wounds on my way here, but I will work to cut my way through and up the ramp so we may rejoin.$b$bHurry traveler, ensure that the Frostwolf clan wins our assault on the citadel.
english.completion: We called you outsider, $r, but you have shown the strength and heart of a Frostwolf.
english.completed: Speak with Durotan.
english.giverWindow: Lord of Bladespire Citadel.

text.title: Nightmare in the Tomb
text.objectives: Investigate the ritual in the Tomb of Souls.
text.description: In the tomb... horrible... bodies everywhere...$B$BA dark ritual... please... you must stop it...
text.completed: Speak to Lady Liadrin at Liadrin's Watch in Talador.

english.title: Nightmare in the Tomb
english.objectives: Investigate the ritual in the Tomb of Souls.
english.description: In the tomb... horrible... bodies everywhere...$B$BA dark ritual... please... you must stop it...
english.completed: Speak to Lady Liadrin at Liadrin's Watch in Talador.

text.title: 陵墓梦魇
text.objectives: 调查幽魂陵墓里的仪式。
text.description: 下面……太可怕了……到处都是尸体……$B$B黑暗的仪式……拜托……你必须终止它……
text.completion: If this Teron'gor gains control of Auchindoun, the results would be catastrophic!$B$BWe must stop him before his power grows!
text.completed: Speak to Exarch Maladaar at Exarch's Refuge in Talador.

english.title: Nightmare in the Tomb
english.objectives: Investigate the ritual in the Tomb of Souls.
english.description: Down there... horrible... bodies everywhere...$B$BDark ritual... please... you must stop it...
english.completion: If this Teron'gor gains control of Auchindoun, the results would be catastrophic!$B$BWe must stop him before his power grows!
english.completed: Speak to Exarch Maladaar at Exarch's Refuge in Talador.

text.title: 戈尔隆德的秘密
text.objectives: 到戈尔隆德的荒林洼地与伊瑞尔谈一谈。跟要塞飞行管理员交谈来飞往那里。
text.description: 我们今天的胜利代价高昂。损失太过惨重。没人能保证我们是否还能经受得住下一波攻势。$b$b我们得弄清楚钢铁部落下一步的计划，而且只有一个地方能让我们找出答案。$b$b那就是戈尔隆德。$b$b戈尔隆德是一片荒蛮之地，很多人都是有去无回。$b$b我是说我们要到那里去，找出他们在黑石的据点，并调查出怎样才能击败这些邪恶的兽人。$b$b你愿意加入我吗，指挥官？
text.completion: Welcome to Gorgrond, Commander. We only just arrived ourselves.
text.completed: Seek Yrel at the Wildwood Wash in Gorgrond. Speak with your Garrison Gryphon Master to fly there.

english.title: The Secrets of Gorgrond
english.objectives: Seek Yrel at the Wildwood Wash in Gorgrond. Speak with your Garrison Gryphon Master to fly there.
english.description: Our victory today was costly. Too costly. There is no guarantee that we can turn another attack.$b$bWe need to know what the Iron Horde is up to, and there is only one place we can go to find out.$b$bGorgrond.$b$bIt is a savage land that few ever return from.$b$bI mean to go there, I mean to find their stronghold at Blackrock, and I mean to learn how we can defeat these vile orcs.$b$bWill you join me, Commander?
english.completion: Welcome to Gorgrond, commander. We just arrived too.
english.completed: Seek Yrel at the Wildwood Wash in Gorgrond. Speak with your Garrison Gryphon Master to fly there.

objectiveDetails.description: 与杜加尔·朗德瑞克交谈，飞往戈尔隆德

text.title: Find D'kaan
text.objectives: Find Rangari D'kaan at Tailthrasher Basin in Gorgrond.
text.description: D'kaan's nearby. He said something about unusual tracks. Hardly what we need to be focusing on at a time like this.$B$BWe need to leave soon. Help him, would you?

english.title: Find D'kaan
english.objectives: Find Rangari D'kaan at Tailthrasher Basin in Gorgrond.
english.description: D'kaan's nearby. He said something about unusual tracks. Hardly what we need to be focusing on at a time like this.$B$BWe need to leave soon. Help him, would you?

text.title: The Element of Demise
text.objectives: Place Thrall's totem at the center of the bridge.
text.description: The Frostwolves are a fierce and noble clan, but distrustful of outsiders.$b$bWe have arrived amidst their assault on a mighty ogre citadel. I will remain here to offer counsel to their chieftain, Durotan.$b$bYou are a proven hero of Azeroth, $n. Demonstrate your value to the Frostwolves. We need them as allies.$b$bUse my totem to thwart the ogre counterattack. This should serve to get their attention.$b$bThe rest is up to you.

english.objectives: Place Thrall's totem at the center of the bridge.

We need them as allies.$b$bUse my totem to thwart the ogre counterattack. This should serve to get their attention.$b$bThe rest is up to you.

text.title: 嘲颅氏族
text.objectives: 找到一位嘲颅氏族成员。
text.description: 啊，$p，很好。我需要派个外族人去和嘲颅氏族谈判。$b$b我们可以让他们帮忙带路，可他们跟戈尔隆德一样，既危险又难以预料。$b$b顺着这条路往前走，看看你能不能找到愿意与你交谈的人。$b$b也许他们能用全新的眼光审视你，并愿意等你开口说完话再动手。
text.completion: Ha! Curious. What are you?
text.completed: Speak with Ripfist at Deadgrin in Gorgrond.

english.title: The Laughing Skull
english.objectives: Find a Laughing Skull clansman.
english.description: Ah, $p, good. I need someone who is not of my clan to negotiate with the Laughing Skull.$b$bWe could use their help navigating this land, but they are dangerous and unpredictable, much like Gorgrond itself.$b$bFollow this road and seek out someone willing to speak with you.$b$bPerhaps they will see you as something new and be willing to talk first and stab later.
english.completion: Ha! Curious. What are you?
english.completed: Speak with Ripfist at Deadgrin in Gorgrond.

text.title: 消失吧，鬣蜥人！
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个酸齿吞噬者。
text.description: 我们……对鬣蜥人不管不顾太久了。它们现在变得胆大包天，都已经忘了我们是谁。$b$b干掉它们！一个不留。撕裂它们的躯体，直到那些家伙惨叫求饶。让它们明白攻击嘲颅村庄的下场。$b$b噢，忘了说，欢迎来到戈尔隆德。
text.completion: Ripfist's dying wish has been satisfied. Goren corpses litter the ground, and these corpses have not gone unnoticed by the nearby goren.

english.title: Goren, Goren, Gone!
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Acidtooth Devourers.
english.description: We... we left the goren alone for too long. They have grown bold and forgotten who we are.$b$bKill them! Kill them all. Rip them apart until they scream. Remind them what happens to anyone who tries to attack a Laughing Skull village.$b$bOh, and welcome to Gorgrond.
english.completion: Ripfist's dying wish has been satisfied. Goren corpses litter the ground, and these corpses have not gone unnoticed by the nearby goren.

text.title: Arkonite Crystals
text.objectives: Gather 8 Arkonite Crystals at the Overload Mine in Talador.
text.description: Mage-Lord Bloodsworn and I recently completed the first of our new blood golems. Once we're in full production, we won't need to risk lives in the field!Unfortunately, they still need a core power crystal.$B$BWe spotted a Draenei mine overrun with crystal-hungry Goren nearby. Do what you must to get enough crystals to power our golems!
text.completed: Return to Mehlar Dawnblade at Liadrin's Watch in Talador.

english.objectives: Gather 8 Arkonite Crystals at the Overload Mine in Talador.
english.description: Mage-Lord Bloodsworn and I recently completed the first of our new blood golems. Once we're in full production, we won't need to risk lives in the field!Unfortunately, they still need a core power crystal.$B$BWe spotted a Draenei mine overrun with crystal-hungry Goren nearby. Do what you must to get enough crystals to power our golems!
english.completed: Return to Mehlar Dawnblade at Liadrin's Watch in Talador.

text.title: 未竟的事业
text.objectives: 收集几桶霜狼燃油，然后交给补给室里的高尔考什。
text.description: 急脾气的贾纳尔还没等我们攻下这里，就匆忙前进了。听着，他是个无与伦比的战士，可他有时却要为自己制定的战术付出高昂的代价。$b$b高尔考什和他的军队奉命摧毁敌人的补给品，但食人魔把他需要的燃油给偷走了。$b$b把燃油找回来，看他们完成自己的任务，旅行者。然后，如果他们仍然活着的话，叫他们到堡垒入口处与我会合。$b$b我必须先把我受伤的兄弟们转移到安全的地方。
text.progress: Lok'tar, traveler.
text.completion: Gol'kosh has completed his mission, then.
text.completed: Meet with Durotan on the outside of Bladespire Citadel in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Deeds Left Undone
english.objectives: Collect barrels of Frostwolf Oil and deliver it to Gol'kosh in the supply room.
english.description: In his haste, Ga'nar advanced before this area was secured. He is a matchless warrior, mind you, but his tactics are sometimes costly.$b$bGol'kosh and his troops were ordered to destroy enemy supplies, but ogres have stolen the oil he needs.$b$bRetrieve the oil and see that their mission is carried out, traveler. Then, if they still live, direct them to rejoin me at the citadel's entrance.$b$bI must see my wounded brothers to safety.
english.progress: Лок'тар, $gпутник:странница;.
english.completion: Gol'kosh has completed his mission, then.
english.completed: Meet with Durotan on the outside of Bladespire Citadel in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: Desperate Times
text.objectives: Ride to the Tomb of Lights with Exarch Maladaar.
text.description: I have heard of the orcs you saw in the tomb before... this is not good news.$B$BIf they seek the key to Auchindoun, we must stop them from obtaining the remaining key fragments. Nyami was right; the fragments are no longer safe where they lay.$B$BThere's no time to waste. We will ride together to the Tomb of Lights and secure them ourselves.
text.completed: Speak to Exarch Maladaar at The Tomb of Lights in Talador.

text.title: 我们笑对死亡！
text.objectives: 收集$1oa个嘲颅面具。
text.description: 你究竟是来帮忙还是添乱的？$b$b这座村庄正在被吞噬，我们必须抓紧时间尽量挽救。$b$b去收集我们死去的嘲颅兄弟姐妹的面具，然后到村子的西边找我。$b$b这些面具对我们氏族的重建工作来说是必不可少的。
text.progress: We are the Laughing Skull! We do not flinch in the face of death. We laugh at it.
text.completion: These are more than fancy facewear. With a mask and some proper incentive, we can make anyone a Laughing Skull.
text.completed: Speak with Kaz the Shrieker at Deadgrin in Gorgrond.

english.title: We Die Laughing!
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Laughing Skull Masks.
english.description: Are you here to help or hinder?$b$bThis village is being eaten, and we must move quickly to salvage what we can.$b$bGather the masks of our fallen Laughing Skull brothers and sisters and meet me on the western side of the village.$b$bI will need them if our clan is to rebuild.
english.progress: Мы бойцы клана Веселого Черепа! Мы не боимся смерти. Мы смеемся ей в лицо.
english.completion: These are more than fancy facewear. With a mask and some proper incentive, we can make anyone a Laughing Skull.
english.completed: Speak with Kaz the Shrieker at Deadgrin in Gorgrond.

text.title: The Cost of Chaos
text.objectives: Find Lorgosh in Bladespire Citadel
text.description: Durotan had a plan.$b$bThere were many paths to victory, but his was the most wise. His would cost the least blood.$b$bHis brother, Ga'nar, is one of our most revered warriors, but he is prone to give in to blood lust. As the first Frostwolf fell, his temper won over his discipline. He ordered the bulk of our forces headlong into the citadel.$b$bThis is not the first time Durotan's brother has abandoned reason, but it may be the most costly.$b$bFind them, stranger. Do what you can to salvage our assault.
text.completed: Find Lorgosh in Bladespire Citadel

text.title: 迷人的眼睛
text.objectives: 找到斯高索瓦之眼。
text.description: 说你呢！要不加入战斗，要不就滚远点。$b$b这可不是一场普通的鬣蜥人入侵。看看那边吧，一只小戈隆正在洗劫我们的粮仓。那个驼背的讨厌鬼还咬了我亲爱的吸髓一口！$b$b去把它的眼睛挖下来交给我。$b$b那应该能拖上一阵子，好让她有时间扫清这个鬣蜥人洞穴。
text.progress: Did you make that thing scream? Did it beg for mercy? Did you kill it before taking its eye? Tell me everything.
text.completion: These puppets of the magnaron will pay for the skulls they claimed today.$b$bFor now, I shall wear this eye across my waist so this fool you have slain may watch as I slowly slaughter his brethren until my dying breath.
text.completed: Return to Limbflayer at Deadgrin in Gorgrond.

english.objectives: Collect Skothwa's Eye.
english.description: You! Get in the fight or get out of our way.$b$bThis is no ordinary goren attack. Look over there, a gronnling is sacking our grubhall. That hunchbacked gorebucket bit a chunk out of my lovely Marrow!$b$bRip the eye out of its forehead and bring it to me.$b$bThat should buy me enough time to get her clear of this goren hole.
english.progress: Ты $gзаставил:заставила; его кричать? Он молил тебя о пощаде? Он был еще жив, когда ты $gвырвал:вырвала; его глаз? Расскажи мне все.
english.completion: These puppets of the magnaron will pay for the skulls they claimed today.$b$bFor now, I shall wear this eye across my waist so this fool you have slain may watch as I slowly slaughter his brethren until my dying breath.

text.objectives: Speak with Crystal-Shaper Barum at the crossroads northwest of Aruuna.
text.description: Aruuna, a draenei mining settlement to the northeast, has been sacked. Strangely, it doesn't sound like the work of the Iron Horde.$B$BMy scouts describe the attackers as "giant fire-breathing birdmen."$B$BI suppose nothing in this place should surprise me anymore...$B$B<QUESTGIVER points to her map.>$B$BRefugees have been seen fleeing along this road. Help them if possible, and learn whatever you can about the attackers.$B$Bif these "birdmen" are a threat, we need to know.
text.completed: Speak with Crystal-Shaper Barum at the crossroads northwest of Aruuna.

text.title: 恐火症
text.objectives: 消灭太阳贤者凯里克斯。
text.description: 我们——我们没干什么招惹鸦人的事儿……为——为什么他们要来攻击阿鲁纳？他们究竟想要干什么？$B$B我想要逃跑，可我……害怕极了。他们的首领会把我烧成土豆片的，一定是这样！$B$B他——他就在旅馆里……
text.completion: You killed him? Oh, oh thank you!$B$BBut what was that he said about an artifact?
text.completed: Return to Raksi in Aruuna.

english.title: Pyrophobia
english.objectives: Slay Sun-Sage Kairyx.
english.description: W- we have done n-n-nothing to provoke the arakkoa... w-why would they attack Aruuna? What do they want from us?$B$BI want to run, but I'm... too afraid. That leader of theirs will burn me to a crisp, I just know it!$B$BH-he's just inside the inn...
english.completion: You killed him? Oh, oh thank you!$B$BBut what was that he said about an artifact?
english.completed: Return to Raksi in Aruuna.

text.title: 德莱尼的发现
text.objectives: 在阿鲁纳水晶矿洞里检查远古棱镜。
text.description: 他们来这是为了一件神器？矿工们肯定是从我们北边的水晶矿洞里发现了什么。$B$B圣光在上，你能想象那东西的力量有多强大，才会把他们千里迢迢地从峰林引来这里吗？$B$B我怀疑那东西已经在他们手里了……除非你疯了才会想要去寻找它……
text.completion: I was worried my little act wouldn't fool you, but you played your role perfectly.$B$BIn fact, I would like to ask for your help again.
text.completed: Speak with Raksi in the Aruuna Crystal Mine.

english.title: What the Draenei Found
english.objectives: Examine the Ancient Prism in the Aruuna Crystal Mine.
english.description: They came here for an artifact? The miners must have found something in our crystal mine to the north.$B$BBy the Light, can you imagine how powerful that thing must be, to attract them all the way here from their spires?$B$BI suppose it is in their hands now... You'd have to be crazy to go looking for it...
english.completion: I was worried my little act wouldn't fool you, but you played your role perfectly.$B$BIn fact, I would like to ask for your help again.
english.completed: Speak with Raksi in the Aruuna Crystal Mine.

text.title: 肃清沙达尔鸦巢
text.objectives: 帮助8位鸦人流亡者逃离沙达尔鸦巢。
text.description: 并非所有鸦人都是一样的。$B$B<艾斯卡卷起了袖子，露出了他那没用的断翅。>$B$B这不是幻象。他们真的对我下了毒手。在我连名字还没有的时候，我在社会中的地位就已经确定了——最底层。$B$B我们人数众多。我们在世界上不为人知的地方建立自己的家园。$B$B沙达尔鸦巢就是这样一个地方，但信徒们发现了它，然后开始了净化。他们这么做也许是为了提振士气，也许只是为了追求刺激而已。$B$B帮我的族人逃离吧，我们会永远感激你的。$B$B等天空燃起熊熊火焰之时，暗影里的同伴就会发挥价值了。
text.completion: Mark my words, $r: Aruuna and Veil Shadar were only the beginning.
text.completed: Return to Shadow-Sage Iskar on Duskfall Island.

english.title: The Purge of Veil Shadar
english.objectives: Help 8 Arakkoa Outcasts evacuate from Veil Shadar.
english.description: Not all arakkoa are alike.$B$B<Iskar lifts his sleeve to reveal a mangled, useless wing.>$B$BIt is no illusion. They did this to me. Before I was even given a name, I was given a place in society: at the bottom.$B$BWe are many. We make our homes in the places this world has forgotten.$B$BVeil Shadar was such a place, but the Adherents have found it and started a purge. For morale. For fun.$B$BHelp my people escape, and we'll be in your debt.$B$BWhen the sky burns, it pays to have allies in the shadows.
english.completion: Mark my words, $r: Aruuna and Veil Shadar were only the beginning.
english.completed: Return to Shadow-Sage Iskar on Duskfall Island.

text.title: 禁断知识
text.objectives: 从沙达尔鸦巢找回6本暗影宝典。
text.description: <黑暗占卜师拉斯托克眯缝着眼睛，上下打量着你。>$B$B那么，你就是艾斯卡雇的帮手？嗯，只要你愿意帮忙，不管你是个$r还是只长太大的蛾子，我根本不在乎。$B$B鲁克玛的信徒们都是固步自封的蠢货！他们禁止钻研暗影法术，把那些敢于在黑暗中寻找答案的人当做异端。$B$B我们在沙达尔鸦巢藏了许多法术禁书。把你能找到的禁书给我带回来，别让它们被一把火烧掉，我会犒赏你的。
text.progress: What kind of sick individual burns a book full of perfectly good dark arts?!
text.completion: Yes, yes. Excellent work, these are some of my favorites.$B$BKnowledge is power, and now I can leave for the spires feeling well-armed.
text.completed: Return to Darkscryer Raastok on Duskfall Island.

english.title: Forbidden Knowledge
english.objectives: Recover 6 Shadow Tomes from Veil Shadar.
english.description: <Darkscryer Raastok narrows his eyes and looks you up and down.>$B$BSo, you are Iskar's hired hand? Well, I care not whether you are |5$r or an overgrown moth, so long as you are willing to help.$B$BThe Adherents of Rukhmar are closed-minded fools! They forbid the study of shadow magic, branding as heretics anyone who dares to seek answers in the dark.$B$BWe kept many tomes of forbidden knowledge in Veil Shadar. Bring any you find to me, and I will reward you for keeping them from the flames.
english.progress: Это ж кем надо быть, чтобы сжечь такую прекрасную книгу по темным искусствам?!
english.completion: Yes, yes. Excellent work, these are some of my favorites.$B$BKnowledge is power, and now I can leave for the spires feeling well-armed.
english.completed: Return to Darkscryer Raastok on Duskfall Island.

text.title: 库拉的报复
text.objectives: 在沙达尔鸦巢里教训飞翼卫士库安。
text.description: 从前，我是一位飞翼卫士。$B$B一天下午，我被发现擅离职守。其实我只是想花一个小时去凑凑节日的热闹……库安原本答应帮我掩饰，结果他却在被上司盘问时吐露了实情。$B$B我因此遭到了惩罚，还被逐出了峰林。$B$B可我还是幸运的，如果不是艾斯卡发现了我，我肯定已经死了。现在，库安又在你以赏金杀手身份现身的这一天来到了沙达尔鸦巢。幸运，真是太幸运了。
text.completion: Speaking of fortune, count yourself lucky that I was not among the defenders in Aruuna, for you'd have seen both ends of your guts before you laid eyes on the Fire-Sage.$B$BAh, sometimes I miss those days.$B$BHere is your coin.
text.completed: Return to Kura the Blind on Duskfall Island.

english.title: Kura's Vengeance
english.objectives: Slay Wing-Guard Kuuan in Veil Shadar.
english.description: I was a wing-guard myself, once upon a time.$B$BOne afternoon, I was caught away from my post. I just wanted an hour to watch the festival... Kuuan was supposed to cover for me, but instead he sold me out to gain favor with our superiors.$B$BThey plucked my eyes, broke my wings, and threw me off the spire.$B$BYet I am the fortunate one, for if Iskar hadn't found me, I'd have died there. And now Kuuan shows his face in Veil Shadar on the same day that you show up willing to kill for coin. Fortunate, indeed.
english.completion: Speaking of fortune, count yourself lucky that I was not among the defenders in Aruuna, for you'd have seen both ends of your guts before you laid eyes on the Fire-Sage.$B$BAh, sometimes I miss those days.$B$BHere is your coin.
english.completed: Return to Kura the Blind on Duskfall Island.

text.title: In Due Time
text.objectives: Return to Foreman Eksos in Talador.
text.description: We are leaving this place.$B$BThere are whispers of a powerful leader among us who has emerged with a plan to overthrow the Adherents. A once great hero who, like all of us, was discarded by the cruel society atop the spires.$B$BAt his behest, the shadows are gathering beneath the Spires of Arak.$B$BWe will find you when we are ready for you to aid our cause. For now, return to your people.

text.title: 追逐暗影
text.objectives: 在流亡者高地与鲁尔坎谈一谈。
text.description: 并非所有影月氏族的兽人都选择了跟随耐奥祖与钢铁部落结盟。$B$B在他们当中，有一位和我在多年前私交甚好的兽人。她也许能把关于耐奥祖“黑暗之星”计划的更多详情说给我们听。$B$B她就在东北边的流亡者高地。我会提前捎信给她，好让她做好与你见面的准备。
text.completion: I felt that this day would come. The draenei prophet is not wrong to seek me, traveler.$B$BThough we do not speak often, he and I have a deep mutual respect for one another.$B$BI know the trouble that his people are suffering, and I no longer believe the Shadowmoon are following our ancestor's path.$B$BFor those reasons, I will help you.

english.title: Chasing Shadows
english.objectives: Speak to Rulkan at Exile's Rise.
english.description: Not all of the Shadowmoon orcs followed Ner'zhul's alliance with the Iron Horde.$B$BAmong them, there is one orc whom I befriended many years ago. She may be able to tell us more about Ner'zhul's plans for this "Dark Star."$B$BShe can be found at Exile's Rise to the northeast. I will send word ahead so she expects your arrival.
english.completion: I felt that this day would come. The draenei prophet is not wrong to seek me, traveler.$B$BThough we do not speak often, he and I have a deep mutual respect for one another.$B$BI know the trouble that his people are suffering, and I no longer believe the Shadowmoon are following our ancestor's path.$B$BFor those reasons, I will help you.

text.title: 紧急求援
text.objectives: 在死神之靥里发射佩妮的信号枪。
text.description:
我收到了一样奇怪的东西，还附了一张字条。你瞧瞧，好像是用你们的语言写的，指挥官。

<亲爱的杜隆坦先生，

我是佩妮……来自艾泽拉斯，你还记得吧？我们在$p的要塞有过一面之缘。

总之，就像我跟你说的那样，我具备了五级黑锤的工程学资质，迫切希望能够为你效劳。越是危险，我就越喜欢！

当你遇到麻烦时，发射这枚老旧的信号枪就行了，我会像闪电一般立即出现在你面前！

祝一切顺利，

佩妮>
text.completion: That didn't seem to do much, commander, except to give away our position to every creature in Gorgrond.$b$bWait, did you hear something?
text.completed: Speak with Durotan at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.

english.title: A Flare for the Dramatic
english.objectives: Shoot Penny's Flare Gun while in Deadgrin.
english.description:
I received a strange object with a note attached. Here, it seems to be written in your tongue, commander.

<Dear Mister Durotan,

I'm Penny... you know, from Azeroth? We met briefly back at $p's garrison. 

Anyway, like I told you, I have a fifth degree black hammer in engineering and I'm eager to serve. The more danger the better!

You just fire this old flare whenever you're in trouble and I'll be there, quick as a quark!

Hopefully,

Penny>
english.completion: That didn't seem to do much, commander, except to give away our position to every creature in Gorgrond.$b$bWait, did you hear something?
english.completed: Speak with Durotan at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.

text.description: 欢迎来到钢铁侏儒游戏营地！在这项挑战中：你需要跑过拱门，然后抵达蓝色标记，并以最快的速度返回这里。$B$B你有足够的时间来完成这项挑战。
text.completed: test trial completion text.

english.objectives: Run through the arch, hit the blue marker, then return to the Ironelf games camp.
english.description: Welcome to the Irongnome games! For this challenge: run through the arch, then get to the blue marker and return here as fast as you can.$B$BYou have all the time you need.
english.completed: test trial completion text.

text.objectives: 在刀塔堡垒里击败$1oa名食人魔。
text.description: 多亏你出手相助，堡垒的入口又畅通无阻了。$b$b但进去是另一回事。设法到里面去，把沿途遇到的食人魔杀得一个不剩。
text.completion: Again we meet...
text.completed: Meet with Durotan inside.

english.title: To the Slaughter
english.objectives: Kill $1oa ogres in Bladespire Citadel.
english.description: This entrance to the fortress is clear again, thanks to your help.$b$bInside is another story. Find your way inside and leave no ogre standing as you go.
english.completion: Again we meet...
english.completed: Meet with Durotan inside.

text.title: 贪吃的鲁特
text.objectives: 在戈尔隆德的鲁特小径给鲁特找食物。
text.description: 那只走失的野猪在钢铁部落留下的垃圾堆里埋头觅食。它停下了咀嚼，抬眼看着你，然后打了个饱嗝儿。$b$b这只猪身上的臭味可真难闻。$b$b它似乎是在咀嚼一大块烂肉。也许你帮它找些健康食品来？
text.progress: That rotten meat looks gross. Find rooter something healthy to eat.
text.completion: You feed the hungry boar the nopales. He devours them whole and smacks his lips.$b$bRooter jumps up onto you and licks your face with his disgusting tongue.$b$bIt looks like you have made a new friend.
text.completed: Return to Rooter at Rooter's Pass in Gorgrond.

english.title: Rooter the Ravenous
english.objectives: Find food for Rooter at Rooter's Pass in Gorgrond.
english.description: The stray boar is digging through garbage left behind by the iron horde. He stops chewing and stares at you-then he burps.$b$bHe smells terrible.$b$bIt looks like he's chewing on a chunk of rotten meat. Maybe you can find something a bit healthier for him to snack on?
english.progress: That rotten meat looks gross. Find rooter something healthy to eat.
english.completion: You feed the hungry boar the nopales. He devours them whole and smacks his lips.$b$bRooter jumps up onto you and licks your face with his disgusting tongue.$b$bIt looks like you have made a new friend.
english.completed: Return to Rooter at Rooter's Pass in Gorgrond.

text.title: Can I Keep It?
text.objectives: Invite Rooter to join your party.
text.description: The little guy sure does look happy. It's pretty clear he wants you to pet him. There is a spot right on the top of his head that isn't totally covered in rotten meat.
text.completed: Return to Rooter the Ravenous at Emberfall Lake in Gorgrond.
