text.title: Insatiable Swarms
text.objectives: Kill $oa Podlings at Kuuros Farm.
text.description: Something has spurred the podlings that live in the nearby forest to come here. They are scaring the talbuk, eating the crops, and slaughtering my people!$B$BI led refugees from Tuurem here in search of safety from the Iron Horde, and now we have to contend with these foul creatures!$B$BPlease, you must help us! I need to attend to my wife's wounds and guide her to safety. Meet me inside the farm proper towards the back when their numbers have been culled back.
text.completed: Return to Beldos at Kuuros Farm.

english.title: Insatiable Swarms
english.objectives: Kill $oa Podlings at Kuuros Farm.
english.description: Something has spurred the podlings that live in the nearby forest to come here. They are scaring the talbuk, eating the crops, and slaughtering my people!$B$BI led refugees from Tuurem here in search of safety from the Iron Horde, and now we have to contend with these foul creatures!$B$BPlease, you must help us! I need to attend to my wife's wounds and guide her to safety. Meet me inside the farm proper towards the back when their numbers have been culled back.
english.completed: Return to Beldos at Kuuros Farm.

text.title: Talbuk Roundup
text.objectives: Rescue 4 Talbuk at Kuuros Farm.
text.description: My father, Karmaan, owns this farm, and our main livestock are talbuk. One of the podlings must have opened the gate to their pen and they all escaped!$B$BThe little terrors could have slaughtered them in the cage, but they like to hunt their prey. I'm afraid that if I stay out here much longer, I'll be their next meal!$B$BWill you round up the talbuk and bring them here? I can't get them myself, and I can't let my dad find out about this!
text.completed: Return to Luuco at Kuuros Farm.

english.title: Talbuk Roundup
english.objectives: Rescue 4 Talbuk at Kuuros Farm.
english.description: My father, Karmaan, owns this farm, and our main livestock are talbuk. One of the podlings must have opened the gate to their pen and they all escaped!$B$BThe little terrors could have slaughtered them in the cage, but they like to hunt their prey. english.completed: Return to Luuco at Kuuros Farm.

text.title: 进驻
text.objectives: 到刀塔堡垒与杜隆坦会面。
text.description: 戈尔索格已经死了。现在是时候稳固我们对刀塔堡垒的控制权了。到下方与我会面，我们就可以开始着手增强我们的实力了。
text.completion: You have accomplished great things. We could not have captured this citadel without you.

english.title: Moving In
english.objectives: Meet Durotan at Bladespire Citadel.
english.description: Gorr'thog is now dead. It is time now to secure our hold on Bladespire Citadel. Meet me below and we can begin strengthening our presence.
english.completion: You have accomplished great things. We could not have captured this citadel without you.

text.title: The Iron Missive
text.objectives: Burn the Iron Horde Supplies and the Iron Horde Camp.
text.description: <The missive outlines a plan to pollute Elekk Acres to ruin the Draenei food supply while their leader, Thokk, sends a force from a camp on the hill to the northwest to slaughter the remaining refugees.>$B$B<If you burn their supplies here and their forward camp with the torches they left here, you can buy precious time to organize a defense against the imminent attack!>
text.completed: Speak to Beldos at Kuuros Farm in Talador.

english.objectives: Burn the Iron Horde Supplies and the Iron Horde Camp.
english.description: <The missive outlines a plan to pollute Elekk Acres to ruin the Draenei food supply while their leader, Thokk, sends a force from a camp on the hill to the northwest to slaughter the remaining refugees.>$B$B<If you burn their supplies here and their forward camp with the torches they left here, you can buy precious time to organize a defense against the imminent attack!>

text.title: 虎人的草药包
text.objectives: 从汽痕高地的刃牙虎人储物箱里找到$1oa个草药包。
text.description: 财物里大部分都是古老的动物肢体碎块和其它垃圾。靠近仔细检查后，你发现里面有残余的草药包和植物。$b$b要是能帮拉克索斯收集一些这种草药包，她也许会更加愿意帮忙……
text.progress: I need more reagents before I return to my brothers and sisters.
text.completion: So they started storing their herbs in personal stashes instead of their storage dens, good to know.$b$bYou have helped me a great deal $p.
text.completed: Bring the herb bundles to Rakthoth at Steamscar Rise in Gorgrond.

english.title: The Sacking of the Saberon
english.objectives: Find $1oa Herb Bundles in saberon stashes at Steamscar Rise.
english.description: The stash mostly contains bits of old animal parts and other junk. Upon closer inspection there are remains of a bundle of herbs and plants.$b$bRakthoth might be more willing to help if some of these herb bundles were found and gathered for her...
english.progress: Мне нужно собрать больше реагентов, прежде чем возвращаться к братьям и сестрам.
english.completion: So they started storing their herbs in personal stashes instead of their storage dens, good to know.$b$bYou have helped me a great deal $p.
english.completed: Bring the herb bundles to Rakthoth at Steamscar Rise in Gorgrond.

text.title: 汽痕“材料”
text.objectives: 从汽痕高地活着的虎人身上收集$1oa颗虎人心脏。
text.description: 现在我们要面对问题的核心了，呵呵。虎人有着强大的心脏，我们的萨满祭司有许多利用这些心脏的方法。$b$b要是你能帮我把那些心脏找来，我会去探索古老的魔法。就这么说定了？
text.progress: I will need those hearts $C.
text.completion: These are good strong hearts! You have done well $c and I will hold my end of the bargain.
text.completed: Speak with Rakthoth at Steamscar Rise in Gorgrond.

english.title: Steamscar "Reagents"
english.objectives: Collect $1oa saberon hearts from living saberon at Steamscar Rise.
english.description: Now we get to the heart of the matter, heh. Saberon have strong hearts, our shaman find many uses for them.$b$bI will search for the ancient's magic if you get me those hearts. Do we have a deal?
english.progress: Мне нужны сердца, |3-6($c).
english.completion: These are good strong hearts! You have done well $c and I will hold my end of the bargain.
english.completed: Speak with Rakthoth at Steamscar Rise in Gorgrond.

text.title: 打脸vs巨石
text.objectives: 让角斗士打脸粉碎巨石障碍物。
text.description: 在虎人把这些植物偷走后，它们撤回了汽痕高地的高处，并垒起了障碍物，把自己与外界隔绝开来。我没办法进去，但你能行。$b$b有条路被一块巨石给堵住了，可那石头看上去不堪一击。任何强大的战士，比如食人魔之类的，都能将它打碎。$b$b我想你刚好认识一位食人魔角斗士……
text.completion: Good work, but we need to move quickly before the plants realize the way is open...
text.completed: Meet up with Rakthoth at Steamscar Rise in Gorgrond.

english.title: Beatface vs. Boulder
english.objectives: Break the boulder barrier using Beatface the gladiator.
english.description: After the saberon stole from these plants, they were forced further up Steamscar Rise and barricaded themselves in. I could not find a way to get in but you have the solution.$b$bOne path is blocked by a boulder, but it looks weak. A strong warrior, such as an ogre, could break it.$b$bI think you know an ogre gladiator...
english.completion: Отлично. Надо спешить, пока растения не поняли, что путь свободен.
english.completed: Meet up with Rakthoth at Steamscar Rise in Gorgrond.

text.title: 切割者大战虎人
text.objectives: 用你的切割机粉碎藤条障碍物。
text.description: 在虎人把这些植物偷走后，它们撤回了汽痕高地的高处，并垒起了障碍物，把自己与外界隔绝开来。我没办法进去，但你能行。$b$b有条路被一团结实的藤条给堵住了。我听说你有台机器，能轻而易举地切断它们。$b$b何不用切割机清理掉那些藤条呢。
text.completion: Good work, but we need to move quickly before the plants realize the way is open...
text.completed: Speak with Rakthoth at Steamscar Rise in Gorgrond.

english.title: Shredder vs. Saberon
english.objectives: Break the vine barrier using your shredder.
english.description: After the saberon stole from these plants, they were forced further up Steamscar Rise and barricaded themselves in. I could not find a way to get in but you have the solution.$b$bOne path is blocked by a tangle of hard vines. I have heard you have a machine that could cut through that with ease.$b$bI would get on a shredder and take those vines down.
english.completion: Good work, but we need to move quickly before the plants realize the way is open...
english.completed: Speak with Rakthoth at Steamscar Rise in Gorgrond.

objectiveDetails.description: 粉碎藤条障碍物，进入虎人营地

text.title: 古树大使
text.objectives: 在戈尔隆德的迪奥诺之劫与贝楚斯谈一谈。
text.description: 我在那片林地里看见了一棵面目摄人的“树”。它不断地在哭号和呻吟，却没有表现出任何敌意。$b$b它也许知道该如何除掉这些植物。去看看能不能行吧。
text.completion: So that is why the saberon have barricaded themselves up there. They are good hunting $p, and I want to get in there!$b$bI have an idea about that...
text.completed: Speak to Rakthoth at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.

english.title: Ambassador to the Ancient
english.objectives: Talk to Birchus at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.
english.description: I have seen a tough looking "tree" in that growth. It cries and moans but does not act hostile.$b$bIt may know how to get rid of these plants. Go and see if it does.
english.completion: So that is why the saberon have barricaded themselves up there. They are good hunting $p, and I want to get in there!$b$bI have an idea about that...
english.completed: Speak to Rakthoth at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.

text.title: That's No Podling
text.objectives: Slay Bloodthrasher.
text.description: <This leaf appears to have come from a plant hydra. The refugee sightings Beldos mentioned must have been true!>$B$B<If one got to the farm, the draenei refugees would stand no chance. Killing it now would buy valuable time for the refugees to reach safety.>$B$B<It must still be at the nearby podling den to the west.>
text.completed: Return to Beldos at Kuuros Farm.

english.title: That's No Podling
english.objectives: Slay Bloodthrasher.
english.description: <This leaf appears to have come from a plant hydra. The refugee sightings Beldos mentioned must have been true!>$B$B<If one got to the farm, the draenei refugees would stand no chance. Killing it now would buy valuable time for the refugees to reach safety.>$B$B<It must still be at the nearby podling den to the west.>
english.completed: Return to Beldos at Kuuros Farm.

text.title: 修剪植物
text.objectives: 在迪奥诺之劫消灭$1oa个守卫者。
text.description: 我在距离这里不远的地方有个狩猎巢穴，我会把战利品和给嘲颅氏族准备的材料都存放在那里。就在不久前，这个巨大的植物怪突然从林地里冲了出来，然后被几个巨大的石头怪物杀死了。在它死后，出现了一些较小的植物怪兽，把这地方搞得一团糟。$b$b还切断了我最好的材料来源。去消灭它们，我会想办法回到我的巢穴，尽量抢救些物资……
text.completion: They just keep coming back! I would hate to lose this hunting ground. We shall find a way to clear this growth, I swear it.
text.completed: Speak to Rakthoth at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.

english.title: Plant Pruning
english.objectives: Kill $1oa defenders at Dionor's Demise.
english.description: I have a hunting den not far from here where I gather my trophies as well as reagents for the Laughing Skull. Not long ago this giant plant monster charged in from the overgrowth and was killed by several of the giant rock monsters. Since it died smaller plant beasts have sprung up and made a mess of the place.$b$bThey have also cut me off from my best source of reagents. Kill them, I will attempt to reach my den and salvage what I can...
english.completion: They just keep coming back! I would hate to lose this hunting ground. We shall find a way to clear this growth, I swear it.
english.completed: Speak to Rakthoth at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.

english.title: Tracking Quest: First Time at Capping Operation

text.title: 拉克索斯的材料
text.objectives: 在戈尔隆德的迪奥诺之劫找到拉克索斯。
text.description: 我们村庄遭受的破坏很难轻易复原。我们最优秀的猎手拉克索斯在为我们的萨满祭司“寻找”材料。$b$b已经有段时间没看到她了，我们眼下正急缺那些材料。去她的狩猎场找找她吧，看看她是否还活着。
text.completion: Marrow sent you? Our village destroyed? I would have been back already if it wasn't for these cursed plant beasts!

english.title: Reagents from Rakthoth
english.objectives: Find Rakthoth at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.
english.description: The destruction of our village will not be easy to come back from. Our best hunter, Rakthoth, "finds" reagents for our shaman.$b$bShe has not been seen for some time and we need those more than ever. Go to her hunting grounds and see if she still lives.
english.completion: Marrow sent you? Our village destroyed? I would have been back already if it wasn't for these cursed plant beasts!

text.title: 夺取凋零之蕾
text.objectives: 从汽痕高地的浓烟之主咆吼身上取得凋零之蕾。
text.description: 你帮助了我，现在该换我帮你了，$p。你要找的花蕾就在附近的洞穴里，在这群虎人新头领的看管之下。$b$b去干掉他，然后把花蕾交给下方的古树。希望这样可以清除掉那些植物，好让我继续正常狩猎……
text.progress: Do you have something for me, little beast?
text.completion: You have... you have brought me the bloom. At last my purpose can be fulfilled!
text.completed: Speak with Birchus at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.
text.giverWindow: 消灭浓烟之主咆吼并夺取凋零之蕾。

english.title: Taking the Death Bloom
english.objectives: Take the Death Bloom from Smokemaster Snarl in Steamscar Rise.
english.description: You have helped me and now I will help you, $p. The bloom you seek is within the nearby cave, being pawed over by the new leader of these saberon.$b$bKill him and take the bloom back to the ancient below. I hope this will clear out those plants and I can get back to my hunting...
english.progress: Ты что-то мне $gпринес, маленький зверь:принесла, маленькая зверушка;?
english.completion: You have... you have brought me the bloom. At last my purpose can be fulfilled!
english.completed: Speak with Birchus at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.
english.giverWindow: Kill Smokemaster Snarl and take the Death Bloom.

text.title: 让迪奥诺安息
text.objectives: 观看贝楚斯的仪式。
text.description: 你给了我这朵花，这简直是一份厚礼。我终于能彻底将迪奥诺送回茂林，结束这场噩梦了。现在剩下的就是举行仪式……待在边上见证你一生难得一见的场面吧……
text.completion: At last it is done.  Dionor has left and his spawn shall follow him in due time.$b$bI grow weary of this conflict and the desire to return to the Overgrowth has left me.$b$bPerhaps I will travel beyond these lands and see what other surprises you little beasts have to share...
text.completed: Speak with Birchus at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.

english.title: Laying Dionor to Rest
english.objectives: Watch Birchus's ritual.
english.description: You have given me a tremendous gift with this bloom. I can finally send Dionor back to the Overgrowth for good and end this nightmare. All that remains is the ritual... stay and behold something you will never see again in your lifetime...
english.completion: At last it is done.  Dionor has left and his spawn shall follow him in due time.$b$bI grow weary of this conflict and the desire to return to the Overgrowth has left me.$b$bPerhaps I will travel beyond these lands and see what other surprises you little beasts have to share...
english.completed: Speak with Birchus at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.

text.title: Demons Among Us - Horde
text.objectives: Deliver Thamuun's Letter to Thalia at Teluuna Observatory.
text.description: If you are reading this, it means I have fallen in battle. As my last request, please deliver this letter to Thalia at Teluuna Observatory.$B$B$BDearest Thalia,$B$B$BYou have always been my best friend, ever since we were children growing up in Tuurem.$B$BI have always been too afraid to tell you my feelings, but I cannot leave this world without finally speaking the truth.$B$BThalia, I love you with all my heart.$B$BI shall wait for you in the next world. I will for eternity for you.$B$BLove,$B$B$BThamuun

text.title: Let's Go!
text.objectives: Start the Tank.
text.description: We know that the Stonemaul have Yrel. We're going to rescue her and we're going to use this filthy ogre slavemaster to do it.$B$BIt's time to go!
text.completed: Speak with Vindicator Maraad at Spineling Crevice in Gorgrond.

text.title: 任务终止
text.objectives: 在附近的洞穴里找到报废的钢铁切割者并从工程师德拉克森手里夺取它。
text.description:
凯特娅·碎铁，

你最新的钢铁切割者已经威胁到了我们自己的士兵。

赶紧报废掉那个样品，并将它放到塔拉多海滩上的洞穴里，直到你解决它的问题为止。

与此同时，我会派工程师德拉克森去继续研究它的。

- 奥格瑞姆·毁灭之锤
text.completion: A prototype Iron Shredder, huh?! I bet we can get this thing working... they didn't have ME to fix it!
text.completed: Speak to Gazlowe at Draka's Den.

english.title: Decommissioned Mission
english.objectives: Find the Decommissioned Iron Shredder in the nearby cave and take it from Engineer Draxen.
english.description:
Ketya Shrediron,

Your new Iron Shredders are a menace to our own soldiers.

Decommission the prototype and store it in the cave on Talador beach until you've worked out the kinks.

I will send Engineer Draxen to work on it in the meantime.

- Orgrim Doomhammer
english.completion: A prototype Iron Shredder, huh?! I bet we can get this thing working... they didn't have ME to fix it!
english.completed: Speak to Gazlowe at Draka's Den.

text.title: 加兹鲁维的解决方案
text.objectives: 摧毁雷神储备点、黑石熔炉和军需品登陆点。
text.description:
我在下方的森林里发现了一些极有价值的目标。

等你靠近一个目标时，可以安装我的解决方案。

一旦完成安装，目标就会被声势浩大地摧毁。
text.completion: I always love a good explosion.
text.completed: Speak to Gazlowe at Draka's Den.

english.title: Gazlowe's Solution
english.objectives: Destroy the Thunderlord Cache, Blackrock Forge, and Munitions Landing.
english.description:
I've identified some high value targets down in the forest below.

When you get near one, you can deploy my solution.

Deploy it and the objectives will be neutralized with great ceremony.
english.completion: I always love a good explosion.
english.completed: Speak to Gazlowe at Draka's Den.

text.title: 百炼成钢
text.objectives: 在奥鲁纳海岸上消灭$1oa个钢铁部落成员。
text.description:
我们绝对不能过早地贸然开战。在我们去追奥格瑞姆之前，我们必须先解决他的军队。

如果我们想要彻底将钢铁部落逐出塔拉多，就得从这片海岸开始。
text.completion: We will have fewer enemies to deal with at our backs. Lok'tar.
text.completed: Speak to Durotan at Draka's Den.

english.title: Too Many Irons in the Fire
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Iron Horde on Orunai Coast.
english.description:
We must not head into battle prematurely. Before we go after Orgrim, we must first deal with his troops.

If we are to succeed in our mission of wiping out the Iron Horde from Talador, we need to start on these shores.
english.completion: We will have fewer enemies to deal with at our backs. Lok'tar.
english.completed: Speak to Durotan at Draka's Den.

text.title: 第几卷第几页？
text.objectives: 在奥金诺攻城营地找到$1oa张手册内页。
text.description:
切割者的操作手册就被塞在那儿，可却丢了很多内页。我们得尽可能地把手册的内页找齐，然后我也许——也许才能让切割者重新工作起来。

从风向判断，我敢打赌内页都朝奥金诺攻城营地的方向飘去了。
text.progress: I don't know why those idiots don't just collect all the pages in one place.
text.completion: Lots of detail... almost as if a goblin wrote it!
text.completed: Speak to Gazlowe at Durotan's Grasp.

english.title: Vol. X Pages ?
english.objectives: Find $1oa Manual Pages at Archenon Siegeyard.
english.description:
The manual for the shredder was wedged in there, but it's missing lots of pages. We need to find as many pages of that manual as possible and I might--MIGHT--be able to get this shredder operational.

Based on the direction of the wind, I bet the pages flew toward Archenon Siegeyard.
english.progress: Я не знаю, почему эти идиоты просто не собрали все страницы в одном месте.
english.completion: Lots of detail... almost as if a goblin wrote it!
english.completed: Speak to Gazlowe at Durotan's Grasp.

text.title: 间谍之眼
text.objectives: 用加兹鲁维的“耳目”看一看。
text.description:
好极了，好极了！我会把这些手册内页研究清楚，然后让钢铁切割者立刻恢复工作！

与此同时，用我的耳目看一眼。那是你很快就将前往的地方！
text.completion: Orgrim seems to be up to no good.
text.completed: Return to Gazlowe at Durotan's Toehold.

english.title: An Eye for a Spy
english.objectives: Look through Gazlowe's Eye 'n' Ear.
english.description:
Excellent, excellent! I'll make sense of these manual pages and will get the Iron Shredder operational immediately!

While I do that, take a look through my Eye 'n' Ear. That's where you'll be headed soon!
english.completion: Orgrim seems to be up to no good.
english.completed: Return to Gazlowe at Durotan's Toehold.

objectiveDetails.description: 用加兹鲁维的“耳目”看一看

text.title: 为切割而生
text.objectives: 在图雷姆用钢铁切割者消灭$2oa个钢铁部落成员。
text.description:
钢铁切割者恢复工作了！它应该已经整装待发，准备帮你把图雷姆的敌人切成碎片！

到里面去，看看你能制造什么破坏吧。我还真有点嫉妒呢。
text.completion: -- ENEMIES ELIMINATED --
text.completed: Check the Iron Shredder's warning display.

english.title: Born to Shred
english.objectives: Kill $2oa Iron Horde in Tuurem using the Iron Shredder.
english.description:
The Iron Shredder is operational! It should be primed and ready for you to shred our enemies in Tuurem!

Head inside and see what damage you can do. Can't say I'm not jealous.
english.completion: -- ENEMIES ELIMINATED --
english.completed: Check the Iron Shredder's warning display.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭图雷姆的钢铁部落

text.title: 酝酿她的死亡
text.objectives: 在图雷姆击败凯特娅·碎铁。
text.description: ——已发现创造者。警报！警报！——
text.completion: Gazlowe has been invaluable in securing Talador. Now, it is up to us.
text.completed: Return to Durotan at Durotan's Grasp.

english.title: Engineering Her Demise
english.objectives: Defeat Ketya Shrediron at Tuurem.
english.description: -- THE MOTHER HAS BEEN DETECTED. WARNING! WARNING! --
english.completion: Gazlowe has been invaluable in securing Talador. Now, it is up to us.
english.completed: Return to Durotan at Durotan's Grasp.

text.title: 沙塔斯之战
text.objectives: 将钢铁部落逐出沙塔斯。
text.description:
为了阻止钢铁部落，我们必须克服成见，进行必要的合作。

部落，联盟，过去，现在……在这样的强敌面前，一切都变得毫无意义。

我们将合力重新夺回沙塔斯……至死方休。
text.completion: I cannot believe Orgrim is truly dead. Blackhand has carved a hole in my heart, and I intend to destroy him when the opportunity presents itself.
text.completed: Speak to Durotan at Vol'jin's Pride.

english.title: The Battle for Shattrath
english.objectives: Repel the Iron Horde from Shattrath.
english.description:
To stop the Iron Horde, we must overcome prejudice and work together, if only for this purpose.

Horde, Alliance, past, present... all meaningless in the face of this enemy.

We will retake Shattrath together... or die trying.
english.completion: I cannot believe Orgrim is truly dead. Blackhand has carved a hole in my heart, and I intend to destroy him when the opportunity presents itself.
english.completed: Speak to Durotan at Vol'jin's Pride.

text.title: Karmaan
text.objectives: Speak with Karmaan.
text.description: You saw iron horde fighting the podlings!? That must be why the podlings are attacking here; they've been displaced!$B$BUnfortunately, they likely followed me and the other refugees from Tuurem to here. Light help me, I've doomed us all.$B$BWe should go tell Karmaan about this. If the iron horde is nearby, podlings might be the least of our problems.
text.completed: Speak with Karmaan at Kuuros Farm.

english.title: Karmaan
english.objectives: Speak with Karmaan.
english.description: You saw iron horde fighting the podlings!? That must be why the podlings are attacking here; they've been displaced!$B$BUnfortunately, they likely followed me and the other refugees from Tuurem to here. Light help me, I've doomed us all.$B$BWe should go tell Karmaan about this. If the iron horde is nearby, podlings might be the least of our problems.
english.completed: Speak with Karmaan at Kuuros Farm.

text.title: 我们的一部分
text.objectives: 找回塑晶者的工具、梅兰妮的洋娃娃和阿鲁纳编年史。
text.description: 当大火烧起来时，我只抓住了女儿的手，奋力逃出火场。那当然是个正确的决定，可我很需要那些被我们丢下的东西。$B$B我是一名技师，擅长切割水晶和宝石。但失去了工具的我，和其他难民没有分别。$B$B我们城镇的记录都被保存在主大厅中的记忆水晶里。有了它，我就能将阿鲁纳的知识与遗产传承下去。$B$B同时，我的女儿吓坏了——要是能让她再次抱住自己心爱的洋娃娃，对她一定会是个莫大的安慰。
text.progress: These are more than mere objects. They are our livelihood, our past and future, our comfort.$B$BThey are pieces of us.
text.completion: Thank you.
text.completed: Speak with Crystal-Shaper Barum in Anchorite's Sojourn.

english.title: Pieces of Us
english.objectives: Retrieve the Crystal-Shaper's Tools, Melani's Doll, and the Annals of Aruuna.
english.description: When the fires broke out, I took only my daughter's hand before we fled. It was the right decision, of course, but I do long for some of the things we left behind.$B$BI am an artificer, a shaper of crystals and gems. Without my tools I am just another refugee.$B$BOur town records are kept in a memory crystal in the main hall. With it, I can carry forward the knowledge and legacy of Aruuna.$B$BAlso, my daughter is terrified - it would be a great comfort for her to hold her favorite doll again.
english.progress: Это не просто вещи. Это наша жизнь, наше прошлое и будущее, наша уверенность в завтрашнем дне.$B$BЭто частицы нас самих.
english.completion: Thank you.
english.completed: Speak with Crystal-Shaper Barum in Anchorite's Sojourn.

text.title: 物资短缺
text.objectives: 收集$1oa份钢铁部落炸药。
text.description:
敌人在下方的海滩上存放了一些炸药。我们必须把这些炸药抢过来，免得自己沦为它们的牺牲品。

情报显示，那一箱箱炸药就分布在海岸线上。

在你寻找的同时，我跟杜隆坦会深入钢铁部落的领地。
text.progress: Have you found the Iron Horde Explosives yet?
text.completion: I believe we can use these at Archenon Siegeyard.
text.completed: Speak to Draka at Draka's Den.

english.title: In Short Supply
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Iron Horde Explosives.
english.description:
The enemy has explosive devices stored on the beach below. We must recover them so they are not used against us.

Reports indicate that crates of explosives are scattered along the shoreline.

While you search, Durotan and I will carve deeper into Iron Horde territory.
english.progress: Do you already have the Iron Horde explosives?
english.completion: I believe we can use these at Archenon Siegeyard.
english.completed: Speak to Draka at Draka's Den.

text.title: 摧钢破铁
text.objectives: 破坏$1oa辆钢铁部落攻城车。
text.description:
兽人本身还不是唯一的威胁。我们也许已经大大削弱了他们的力量，但他们仍然拥有威力巨大的攻城武器。

用你在海滩上收集到的炸药去破坏攻城武器吧。
text.completion: It is a relief to know that their weapons of war cannot be used against us.
text.completed: Speak to Draka at Durotan's Grasp.

english.title: Iron Them Out
english.objectives: Destroy $1oa Iron Horde Siege Engines.
english.description:
The orcs themselves are not the only threat. We may have weakened them considerably, but they still have siege weapons of significant power.

Sabotage siege weapons you find with the explosives you collected from the beach.
english.completion: It is a relief to know that their weapons of war cannot be used against us.
english.completed: Speak to Draka at Durotan's Grasp.

text.title: Strike While the Iron Is Hot

english.title: Strike While the Iron Is Hot

text.title: 火染天际
text.objectives: 在阿鲁纳和阿鲁纳水晶矿洞消灭$1oa个信徒入侵者。
text.description: 一切都发生得太快了。一团白热的闪光点燃了附近的树林，可怕的狂风接踵而至，横扫阿鲁纳各处的烈焰。$B$B片刻之后，鸦人们开始穿过浓烟俯冲而来。$B$B我得把梅兰妮带到朝圣之路。从那里，我们就可以前往学者之家，寻求守备官的保护。眼下鸦人正在当地肆意妄为，我很担心我们会被他们追上，甚至是被蔓延的野火烧死。
text.completion: Their deaths will not bring back Aruuna, but it does give me comfort to know that some among us can stand against them.
text.completed: Speak with Crystal-Shaper Barum in Anchorite's Sojourn.

english.title: Burning Sky
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Adherent Invaders in Aruuna and the Aruuna Crystal Mine.
english.description: It happened so fast. A white-hot flash of light ignited the nearby woods, followed by terrible winds that swept the flames across Aruuna.$B$BMoments later, arakkoa began descending through the smoke.$B$BI need to get Melani to the Pilgrim's Road. From there we can head for Anchorite's Sojourn and the protection of the vindicators. With the arakkoa roaming the area freely, I fear we'll be run down or worse: taken by the spreading wildfires.
english.completion: Their deaths will not bring back Aruuna, but it does give me comfort to know that some among us can stand against them.
english.completed: Speak with Crystal-Shaper Barum in Anchorite's Sojourn.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Y'kish Joins the Party
text.objectives: Invite Rooter to join your party.
text.description: The little guy sure does look happy. It's pretty clear he wants you to pet him. There is a spot right on the top of his head that isn't totally covered in rotten meat.
text.completed: Return to Rooter the Ravenous at Emberfall Lake in Gorgrond.

text.title: Tracking Quest -  Saberon Servent Snip Scene

english.title: Tracking Quest -  Saberon Servent Snip Scene

text.title: Y'kish the Wingless
text.objectives: Ask Y'kish to join your party.
text.description: I'm not sure where to go. Without Skreek I feel so lost.$b$bIt appears Swiftshadow and I have some soul-searching to do while we search for a new home.
text.completed: Speak with Y'kishi at the Giant Cauldron in Gorgrond.

english.title: Y'kish the Wingless
english.objectives: Ask Y'kish to join your party.
english.description: I'm not sure where to go. Without Skreek I feel so lost.$b$bIt appears Swiftshadow and I have some soul-searching to do while we search for a new home.
english.completed: Speak with Y'kishi at the Giant Cauldron in Gorgrond.

text.title: 加兹鲁维的“耳目”
text.objectives: 用加兹鲁维的“耳目”看一看。
text.description:
你的同伴派来了一位名叫加兹鲁维的地精来指导我们应对钢铁部落。到目前为止，他确实发挥了重要作用。

他制作了一台望远镜，声称可以看到很远的地方，甚至还能听见。

使用这台望远镜，然后汇报你所看到的。我还是用我的普通望远镜就好。
text.completion: Orgrim leads these orcs? Why has he pledged himself to the Iron Horde?
text.completed: Return to Durotan at Frostwolf Overlook.

english.title: Through the Looking Glass
english.objectives: Look through Gazlowe's Eye 'n' Ear.
english.description:
Your allies sent along a goblin, Gazlowe, to advise us against the Iron Horde. Thus far, he has proven a valuable asset.

He has a looking glass set up that can see a great distance and, he claims, even hear.

Use this looking glass and report back what you've seen. I will stick to my standard spyglass.
english.completion: Orgrim leads these orcs? Why has he pledged himself to the Iron Horde?
english.completed: Return to Durotan at Frostwolf Overlook.

objectiveDetails.description: 用加兹鲁维的“耳目”看一看

text.title: 第一次测试比赛：2圈
text.objectives: 跑过拱门，击中蓝色标记，然后是绿色标记、红色标记和紫色标记，最后返回钢铁精灵游戏营地。
text.description: 跑过拱门……$B抵达蓝色标记……$B抵达绿色标记……$B抵达红色标记$B然后重复一次。没错——总共跑两圈！$B$B祝你好运！
text.completed: test trial completion text.

english.title: First Test Race: 2 Laps
english.objectives: Run through the arch, hit the blue marker, then the green marker, the red marker, the purple marker, then return to the Ironelf games camp.
english.description: Run through the arch...$BGet to the blue marker...$BGet to the green marker...$BGet to the red marker$BThen do it all again. That's right - 2 laps!$B$BGood luck!
english.completed: test trial completion text.

objectiveDetails.description: 携带一枚暗月游戏代币在起点处就位

text.title: 让我们继续竞速！
text.objectives: 跑过起点，先后抵达蓝色柱标、绿色柱标和红色柱标，最后返回起点。
text.description:
想要继续竞速是吗？那就对了！

看看你是否能打破自己的最佳记录！先后分别抵达蓝色柱标、绿色柱标、红色柱标，最后再回到这里。

时间决定着胜负，所以全速前进吧！
text.completion: Good job, and nice time!

english.title: Let's Keep Racing!
english.objectives: Run through the Start Banner, hit the Blue Post, then the Green Post, then the Red Post, then return to the Start Banner.
english.description:
Want to keep racing, huh? That's the spirit!

See if you can beat your best time! Get to the blue post, then green, then red, then back here. 

Your time matters, so do it fast!
english.completion: Good job, and nice time!

objectiveDetails.description: 携带一枚暗月游戏代币在起点处就位

text.title: 巴伦的笔记
text.objectives: 在阿鲁纳测试1枚磨砂水晶、1枚抛光水晶和1枚谐振水晶的效果。
text.description: <这本厚重的卷册包含了对德拉诺天然宝石与水晶进行精炼与塑形的笔记，其中几页还画满了描绘复杂切割样式的工艺设计图。$B$B最新的几页详细记录了一系列旨在帮助德莱尼守备官战斗的切割方法。>$B$B“……将边缘磨锐，可用此材料直击要害……”$B$B“当切割成圆形并抛光到这种程度时，可抵御伤害……”$B$B“……这是一个惊人的发现，居然可以用这种水晶来调谐佩戴者的活力！”
text.progress: Hm, what is that book you have there?
text.completion: My notes! In the chaos, I completely forgot about them!$B$BThis is my life's work, $p. I cannot thank you enough.
text.completed: Deliver Barum's Notes to Crystal-Shaper Barum in Anchorite's Sojourn.

english.title: Barum's Notes
english.objectives: Test the effects of a Honed Crystal, a Polished Crystal and a Harmonic Crystal in Aruuna.
english.description: <This hefty tome contains notes on the refining and shaping of Draenor's natural gems and crystals, including several full-page technical diagrams depicting complex cut patterns.$B$BThe most recent pages detail a series of cuts intended to aid the draenei vindicators in battle.>$B$B"...honed to a fine edge, the material can expose weaknesses..."$B$B"when rounded and polished to such a degree, it wards off harmful..."$B$B"...this incredible discovery that a crystal can be attuned to the bearer's vitality!"
english.progress: Хм, что это у тебя за книга?
english.completion: My notes! In the chaos, I completely forgot about them!$B$BThis is my life's work, $p. I cannot thank you enough.
english.completed: Deliver Barum's Notes to Crystal-Shaper Barum in Anchorite's Sojourn.

text.title: 黑暗的敌人
text.objectives: 消灭8名影月虚空法师。
text.description: 我们本该欢庆你的到来，英雄，可我担心我们的麻烦才刚刚开始。$B$B督军耐奥祖和他的影月氏族对北边的德莱尼聚居点发动了突然袭击。$B$B先知维伦已经去特鲁纳观星台帮忙照料伤者了，但我们需要更多的防御者。$B$B我必须去协助其他人。要是你愿意帮我们的话，就到茂林幽谷把你见到的所有影月敌人全都杀死吧。
text.completion: The forests are clear of Shadowmoon enemies? Good. I knew that you would not fail.
text.completed: Speak to Prophet Velen at Teluuna Observatory.

english.title: Dark Enemies
english.objectives: Kill 8 Shadowmoon Voidmancers.
english.description: Your arrival should be cause for celebration, hero, but I fear our troubles are just beginning.$B$BWarlord Ner'zhul and his Shadowmoon clan have launched a surprise attack on a draenei settlement to the north.$B$BProphet Velen has gone to aid the wounded at Teluuna Observatory, but we need more defenders.$B$BI must go to assist the others. If you wish to help us, go to Arbor Glen and kill any Shadowmoon enemies that you see.
english.completion: The forests are clear of Shadowmoon enemies? Good. I knew that you would not fail.
english.completed: Speak to Prophet Velen at Teluuna Observatory.

text.title: The Thing in the Cave
text.objectives: Slay the Thing in the Cave, then loot its Dreadful Heart.
text.description: The note reads as follows:$b$b"It cannot be defeated. No matter how many troops we send at it, it seemingly cannot be destroyed.$b$b"We have lost too many lives as it is. I refuse to send another orc after that thing. Instead, we will establish a guard station outside the cave's mouth to keep it from getting out."
text.completed: Return the Dreadful Heart to Ovuun the Dunewalker at your caravan in Gorgrond.

text.title: The Survivalist's Way
text.objectives: Collect $1oa Glowworm Silk and $2oa Razorfang Teeth in The Arbitum in Shadowmoon Valley.
text.description: I was tracking the Iron Horde's movements through the Iron March when I was spotted by one of their chimera riders.$B$BI was able to fight off their kill squad, but I'm too injured to keep going. Stranger, I must obtain as much recon as possible to aid in Karabor's defense.$B$BIf you can bring me silk from the worms and a handful of teeth from the rays at the lake nearby, I can operate on my wounds and fashion a bandage that ought to hold long enough for me to finish my mission.
text.completed: Speak with Kyresh near The Arbitum in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.objectives: Collect $1oa Glowworm Silk and $2oa Razorfang Teeth in The Arbitum in Shadowmoon Valley.

Stranger, I must obtain as much recon as possible to aid in Karabor's defense.$B$BIf you can bring me silk from the worms and a handful of teeth from the rays at the lake nearby, I can operate on my wounds and fashion a bandage that ought to hold long enough for me to finish my mission.
english.completed: Speak with Kyresh near The Arbitum in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: Keeping the Balance
text.objectives: Kill Snapgrip in The Arbitum.
text.description: Look at these teeth, friend. These stress markings suggest that the crocolisk are being subjugated by one of their own. When a crocolisk female grows large enough, she exerts dominance over her kin.$B$BIt is my duty as a hunter to ensure balance is restored to these creatures as thanks for their sacrifice for my own life.$B$BTrack down the beast and slay her while I tend to my wounds. She is likely at the far end of the arbitum.
text.completed: Speak with Kyresh near The Arbitum in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.description: Look at these teeth, friend. These stress markings suggest that the crocolisk are being subjugated by one of their own. When a crocolisk female grows large enough, she exerts dominance over her kin.$B$BIt is my duty as a hunter to ensure balance is restored to these creatures as thanks for their sacrifice for my own life.$B$BTrack down the beast and slay her while I tend to my wounds. She is likely at the far end of the arbitum.
english.completed: Speak with Kyresh near The Arbitum in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: Kuuros Farm
text.objectives: Find Beldos at Kuuros Farm.
text.description: Many refugees from Tuurem have made their way to Kuuros Farm east of here.$B$BIf you are able, please venture there and find Beldos. He led the refugees there from Tuurem and will be the best point of contact.
text.completed: Speak to Beldos.

english.title: Kuuros Farm
english.objectives: Find Beldos at Kuuros Farm.
english.description: Many refugees from Tuurem have made their way to Kuuros Farm east of here.$B$BIf you are able, please venture there and find Beldos. He led the refugees there from Tuurem and will be the best point of contact.
english.completed: Speak to Beldos.

text.title: 戈莫尔塔楼
text.objectives: 从刀塔食人魔手里夺取戈莫尔塔楼。
text.description: 我们是时候对那些想要奴役我们的人发起反击了！$b$b我们要到戈莫尔塔楼，把它从刀塔食人魔手里夺过来。欢迎你与我们同行。$b$b骑上来，我们一起杀进战场！
text.completion: I now understand how you were able to rescue my clan from the clutches of slavery. Such power!
text.completed: Speak with Durotan at Gormaul Tower in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Gormaul Tower
english.objectives: Take Gormaul Tower from the Bladespire ogres.
english.description: It is time for us to strike out against those who would enslave us!$b$bWe travel to Gormaul Tower to wrest it from the Bladespire ogres. I would welcome your company.$b$bMount up, and together we will ride to battle!
english.completion: I now understand how you were able to rescue my clan from the clutches of slavery. Such power!
english.completed: Speak with Durotan at Gormaul Tower in Frostfire Ridge.

objectiveDetails.description: 到戈莫尔塔楼与杜隆坦会面

text.title: 被解救的卡格
text.objectives: 在格罗姆加尔消灭25个雷神兽人。
text.description: 他们带走了我的兄弟姐妹。$B$B他们带走了我的狼。$B$B<卡格举起斧头，目光炯炯地盯着斧刃。>$B$B我们现在去把他们的脑袋砍下来。
text.completion: <Karg scoops up a handful of snow and cleans the gore from his axe.>$B$BYou fight well.
text.completed: Speak with Karg Bloodfury in Grom'gar.

english.title: Karg Unchained
english.objectives: Slay 25 Thunderlord orcs in Grom'gar.
english.description: They took my brothers and sisters.$B$BThey took my wolf.$B$B<Karg lifts his axe and fixes his gaze upon its edge.>$B$BNow we take their heads.
english.completion: <Karg scoops up a handful of snow and cleans the gore from his axe.>$B$BYou fight well.
english.completed: Speak with Karg Bloodfury in Grom'gar.

text.title: 受创的马车
text.objectives: 在影月谷里找到菲奥拉的马车。
text.description: 我收到报告，木精已经开始离开繁木林，攻击沿途过往的旅行者。这太不正常了。$b$b我们已经派出一些游侠去尝试解决这个问题了。$b$b一支来自艾泽拉斯的商队在不久前经过这里，你也许应该去看看你的族人，确保他们安然无恙。
text.completion: Commander! Am I glad to see you.$b$bWe have a situation here.
text.completed: Speak to Fiona at Fiona's Caravan in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Crippled Caravan
english.objectives: Find Fiona's Caravan in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description: I'm getting reports that the botani have started leaving their bloom and attacking wandering travelers. This is most unusual.$b$bWe already dispatched a number of rangari to try and resolve this issue.$b$bA caravan from Azeroth passed through here recently, you should probably check on your people to ensure their safety.
english.completion: Commander! Am I glad to see you.$b$bWe have a situation here.
english.completed: Speak to Fiona at Fiona's Caravan in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 菲奥拉的办法
text.objectives: 收集$1oa个淡水兽之心、$2oa份沼泽荧光虫毒液、$3oa株暴虐藤蔓和$4oa株荧月草。
text.description: 吉德文被一只植物怪攻击了。$b$b从表象上看，他似乎是呈现出麻痹的症状。$b$b我可以研究出疗法，但需要用到一些当地的材料。
text.progress: Do you have the ingredients?
text.completion: Bang-up job, $n! The base is just about ready.
text.completed: Return to Fiona at Fiona's Caravan in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Fiona's Solution
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Riverbeast Heart, $2oa Swamplighter Venom, $3oa Riotvine, and $4oa Moonlit Herbs.
english.description: Gidwin was attacked by one of those plant creatures.$b$bFrom the looks of it, he is suffering from some kind of paralysis.$b$bI can make a cure, but I'll need some local ingredients.
english.progress: $gI got it:I got it; Ingredients?
english.completion: Bang-up job, $n! The base is just about ready.
english.completed: Return to Fiona at Fiona's Caravan in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 烧制不稳定的草药
text.objectives: 帮菲奥拉制造疗伤药剂。
text.description: 基本浆液已经沸腾，就等着加入那些材料了。$B$B把材料一样一样地加进去，每次只加一种，我来负责搅拌和处理泡沫。等你准备好就跟我说吧。
text.completion: Gidwin is looking much better. Thank you, $n.$b$bWe have just enough elixir here to help the others.
text.completed: Speak with Fiona at Fiona's Caravan in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Cooking With Unstable Herbs
english.objectives: Help Fiona brew a curative elixir.
english.description: The base is boiling and ready for those ingredients.$B$BAdd each of the ingredients, one at a time, and I will handle the mixing and frothing. Speak to me when you are ready.
english.completion: Gidwin is looking much better. Thank you, $n.$b$bWe have just enough elixir here to help the others.
english.completed: Speak with Fiona at Fiona's Caravan in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 虚空先驱者
text.objectives: 消灭幽影精魂、黑暗精魂和苦痛精魂。
text.description: 我们的斥候有个可怕的发现，$n。$B$B囚犯的灵魂正被用来从虚空召唤怪物。$B$B有三个黑暗生物已经等在里面了，它们分别是幽影精魂、黑暗精魂和苦痛精魂。$B$B必须立即消灭它们，绝不能让它们释放力量。
text.completion: I knew I could trust this task to you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Prophet Velen outside Anguish Fortress or at Embaari Village.

english.title: Harbingers of the Void
english.objectives: Destroy the Essence of Shadow, Essence of Darkness, and Essence of Anguish.
english.description: Our scouts have made a horrifying discovery, $n.$B$BThe souls of the prisoners are being used to summon creatures from the void.$B$BInside, three beings of darkness already await - the Essence of Shadow, the Essence of Darkness, and the Essence of Anguish.$B$BThey must be destroyed immediately, before their power can be unleashed.
english.completion: I knew I could trust this task to you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Prophet Velen outside Anguish Fortress or at Embaari Village.

text.title: 大救赎
text.objectives: 帮助$1oa名德莱尼囚犯逃脱牢笼。
text.description: 我们发现了那些囚犯的下落。他们正被关押在这，就在影月要塞里。$B$B拜托了，请尽力救出那些囚犯吧。而且动作要快。我们从这里都能听见他们的尖叫声。
text.completion: We are taking care of the survivors now. We owe their lives to you. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Yrel outside Anguish Fortress or at Embaari Village.

english.title: The Great Salvation
english.objectives: Free $1oa Draenei Prisoners from their cages.
english.description: We've located the prisoners. They are being held in captivity here, inside the Shadowmoon fortress.$B$BPlease rescue as many of them as you can. And hurry. We can hear their screams out here.
english.completion: We are taking care of the survivors now. We owe their lives to you. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Yrel outside Anguish Fortress or at Embaari Village.

text.title: 穿越星空
text.objectives: 收集$1oa份星图。
text.description: 影月氏族力量的一个重要来源，是来自他们对星辰及其预兆的解读。$B$B几个世纪以来，他们把星辰的图案和对应解释一一记录下来。$B$B你进入要塞之后，帮我收集一些这种文件。$B$B我们将吸取他们的知识，转而对付他们自己。
text.progress: Your aid is appreciated, $C.
text.completion: Thank you. My acolytes will study these in great detail. With any luck, we will be able to use this knowledge to defeat the Shadowmoon.
text.completed: Return to Prophet Velen outside Anguish Fortress or at Embaari Village.

english.title: Across the Stars
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Star Readings.
english.description: A key source of the Shadowmoon clan's power comes from their understanding of the stars and their omens.$B$BFor centuries, they have recorded the patterns of the stars and their interpretations.$B$BWhile you are in the fortress, collect some of these documents for me.$B$BWe will take their own knowledge and use it against them.
english.progress: Спасибо за помощь, |3-6($c).
english.completion: Thank you. My acolytes will study these in great detail. With any luck, we will be able to use this knowledge to defeat the Shadowmoon.
english.completed: Return to Prophet Velen outside Anguish Fortress or at Embaari Village.

text.title: 解救我们的兄弟姐妹
text.objectives: 解救$1oa个霜狼或沃高尔村民。
text.description: 这些雷神渣子老是用一些懦夫才用的武器，像网和锁链之类的。$B$B我们有许多村民和霜狼兄弟姐妹们被他们困住了。$B$B如果你能把他们救出来的话，他们一定会很荣幸能与你并肩作战。$B$B我们必须赶快平息这场攻击，然后我才能返回刀塔堡垒继续准备工作。
text.completion: The Frostwolf clan cannot be held like beasts.$B$BYou fight with honor, $n.
text.completed: Speak with Draka at Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Free Our Brothers and Sisters
english.objectives: Free $1oa Frost Wolves or Wor'gol Villagers.
english.description: These Thunderlord curs use coward's weapons like nets and chains.$B$BMany of our villagers and wolf-brothers and sisters have been trapped.$B$BIf you free them, they will fight at your side with honor.$B$BWe must quell this attack with haste so I may return to Bladespire Citadel and continue my preparations.
english.completion: The Frostwolf clan cannot be held like beasts.$B$BYou fight with honor, $n.
english.completed: Speak with Draka at Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 沼泽荧光虫女王
text.objectives: 在影月谷里为菲奥拉取得沼泽荧光虫女王的尾巴。
text.description: 看来那些植物怪在攻击吉德文时使用了某种毒药。$b$b那是一种毒性极强的混合物，这还是保守的说法。$b$b如果我们想要治好吉德文，就需要另外一种特殊的材料。这比其它那些恐怕要难找得多。$b$b你愿意接受挑战吗，$n？
text.progress: I just wanted to pick some herbs and relax with my boys... I should have stayed in Azeroth.
text.completion: Wow, that was fast! Ok, let's get to it!
text.completed: Return to Fiona at Fiona's Caravan in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Swamplighter Queen
english.objectives: Obtain The Swamplighter Queen's Tail for Fiona in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description: It looks like those plant creatures used some kind of poison when they attacked Gidwin.$b$bIt's a powerful concoction to say the least.$b$bIf we are going to cure Gidwin we need one more special ingredient. This one might be a bit harder to obtain than the others.$b$bYou up to the challenge, $n?
english.progress: Обычно сбор трав никак не связан с опасностью. Надо было оставаться в Азероте.
english.completion: Wow, that was fast! Ok, let's get to it!
english.completed: Return to Fiona at Fiona's Caravan in Shadowmoon Valley.

objectiveDetails.description: 取得沼泽荧光虫女王的尾巴

text.title: 英雄救龙
text.objectives: 用水桶灭火，救出扭扭。
text.description: 我……<啜泣>……必须跟扭扭……<哽咽>……一起离开！$B$B它……它被……困住了！$B$B你得……把火……扑灭！$B$B<阿莱娜指着房间的另一端，痛哭失声。>
text.completion: You did it! Squiggy is okay!
text.completed: Return to Ariaana at Arbor Glen.

english.title: In Need of a Hero
english.objectives: Save Squiggy by dousing fires with buckets of water.
english.description: I...<sob>... I can't leave...<gulp>... without... Squiggy...!$B$BHe... he's... trapped!$B$BYou need... to put out... the fire!$B$B<Ariaana points across the room and bursts into tears.>
english.completion: You did it! Squiggy is okay!
english.completed: Return to Ariaana at Arbor Glen.

text.title: 快速扩张
text.objectives: 回你在影月谷的要塞向巴隆斯·阿历克斯顿报告。
text.description: 你好，指挥官！$B$B我是代表建筑师巴隆斯·阿历克斯顿来见你的。$B$B我们已经积攒了足够的物资来进行下一阶段的扩张了。$B$B他希望你能在方便的时候尽快去跟他谈一谈。
text.completion: Ah, welcome, commander! Just the person I wished to see.

english.title: Fast Expansion
english.objectives: Report to Baros Alexston at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description: Greetings, Commander.$B$BI am here on behalf of architect Baros Alexston.$B$BWe have gathered enough resources for the next phase of expansion.$B$BHe wishes to speak to you at your earliest convenience.
english.completion: Ah, welcome, commander! Just the person I wished to see.

text.title: 冰与火之歌
text.objectives: 去见杜隆坦。
text.description: 你从塔纳安的奴隶围栏中救出了我的许多族人。他们的自由和黑暗之门的毁灭，已经足够让我把你视作自己人了。$b$b然而，你对我们的领袖杜隆坦来说仍然是个陌生人。我愿意把你引荐给他。
text.completion: I thank you for returning with my people, and I welcome you as an honored guest.
text.completed: Speak with Durotan near the Garrison in Frostfire Ridge

english.title: A Song of Frost and Fire
english.objectives: Meet Durotan.
english.description: You have rescued many of my clan from the slave pens of Tanaan. Their liberation and the destruction of the Dark Portal are more than enough for me to consider you one of us.$b$bHowever, you are still a stranger to our leader, Durotan. I would like to introduce you to him.
english.completion: I thank you for returning with my people, and I welcome you as an honored guest.
english.completed: Speak with Durotan near the Garrison in Frostfire Ridge

text.title: 荣誉的嘉奖
text.objectives: 前往沃高尔的萨满之石并接受祝福。
text.description: 你为我的人民带来了荣耀。现在，我们也希望为你带来荣耀。$b$b在我的氏族里有一种入族仪式。当族人达到规定年龄后，他们会把首个猎物的鲜血涂在自己身上，然后将双手放在萨满之石上面，向自己的先人致敬。$b$b虽然我们相处时间不长，可你却已经杀死了许多强大的敌人，远远超过了我族中的猎手。去吧，去摸摸沃高尔的萨满之石，以平等的身份加入我们。
text.completion: If you choose to continue to help our clan, the other Shamanstones will sense your closeness to the Frostwolves and might bless you with more gifts.
text.completed: Return to Drek'Thar in Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Honor Has Its Rewards
english.objectives: Go to the Shamanstone in Wor'gol and receive a blessing.
english.description: You have honored my people. Now, we wish to honor you.$b$bWe have a rite of initiation in my clan. When one comes of age, they cover themselves in the blood of their first hunt, and rest their hands upon a shamanstone to honor the ancestors who came before them.$b$bIn our brief time together you have already slain many foes more fierce than our hunters have ever had to face. Go, touch the shamanstone here in Wor'gol, and join our pack as an equal.
english.completion: If you choose to continue to help our clan, the other Shamanstones will sense your closeness to the Frostwolves and might bless you with more gifts.
english.completed: Return to Drek'Thar in Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: Signs of a Struggle
text.objectives: Ruffle through the backpack near the bloody journal.
text.description: Judging by the markings, it appears to be a journal kept by a Shadowmoon orc.$B$B<Hagra disappeared last night. She is the fifth in as many nights. Why do they only vanish at night?>$B$B<I will find out. Tonight I wait for whatever manner of beast stalks our village.>$B$B<I will bring the beast's head to Rulkan, and return my kin to their homes.>$B$BPerhaps the beast's head is in one of the bags in the debris up ahead?
text.completed: Break your bonds and speak to Rok'nar.

english.title: Signs of a Struggle
english.objectives: Ruffle through the backpack near the bloody journal.
english.description: Judging by the markings, it appears to be a journal kept by a Shadowmoon orc.$B$B<Hagra disappeared last night. She is the fifth in as many nights. Why do they only vanish at night?>$B$B<I will find out. Tonight I wait for whatever manner of beast stalks our village.>$B$B<I will bring the beast's head to Rulkan, and return my kin to their homes.>$B$BPerhaps the beast's head is in one of the bags in the debris up ahead?
english.completed: Break your bonds and speak to Rok'nar.

text.title: Laabru's Rebellion
text.objectives: Find Laabru at the Gar'mak Quarry in Shadowmoon Valley.
text.description: Laabru wouldn't listen. He killed one of the guards and they dragged him off to one of their tents.$b$bThey are going to kill him for sure!

english.title: Laabru's Rebellion
english.objectives: Find Laabru at the Gar'mak Quarry in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description: Laabru wouldn't listen. He killed one of the guards and they dragged him off to one of their tents.$b$bThey are going to kill him for sure!

english.title: Tracking Quest - Archaeology - Frostfire - Dig Map #1

text.title: 我的狼在哪儿？！
text.objectives: 在格罗姆加尔消灭兽王托拉什并救出奈鲁克。
text.description: 在我和其他人被抓住的同时，我的霜狼奈鲁克也被抓了。我不知道他们把它关在了哪里，可我敢断定那个把我们拖来这里的“兽王”一定知道。$B$B他此刻就在附近的兽栏，向年轻的猎手们吹嘘他的捕猎成果。$B$B看我们把斧子劈进他的脑袋之后他还怎么吹嘘。
text.completion: Nerok and I are the only surviving prisoners, but we cannot leave just yet.
text.completed: Speak with Karg Bloodfury in Grom'gar.

english.title: Where's My Wolf?!
english.objectives: Slay Beastmaster Torash and free Nerok in Grom'gar.
english.description: My frost wolf, Nerok, was captured with me and the others. I do not know where they are keeping him, but I'll bet the so-called "beastmaster" who dragged us here does.$B$BHe is at the beast pens nearby, boasting about his catch to the younger hunters.$B$BWe'll see how he boasts with my axe in his skull.
english.completion: Nerok and I are the only surviving prisoners, but we cannot leave just yet.
english.completed: Speak with Karg Bloodfury in Grom'gar.

text.title: 攻城锻造大师
text.objectives: 在格罗姆加尔消灭攻城锻造大师乌拉托克。
text.description: 就在不久前，雷神氏族能造出的最先进的武器不过是根傻大粗的长矛。黑石兽人一定送来了位技艺高得可怕的匠师，才能让他们如此迅速地生产出火炮。$B$B我们得找出这个人。
text.completion: The Iron Horde combines the strengths of every clan. We must continue looking for ways to sever those connections if we hope to defeat them.
text.completed: Speak with Lokra in Grom'gar.
text.giverWindow: 借调自黑石铸造厂。
text.giverTarget: 攻城锻造大师乌拉托克

english.title: The Master Siegesmith
english.objectives: Slay Master Siegesmith Uratok in Grom'gar.
english.description: Not long ago, the most advanced weapon a Thunderlord could make was a really, really big spear. The Blackrock orcs must have shipped in a fearsome master to have them producing cannons so rapidly.$B$BWe need to find that master.
english.completion: The Iron Horde combines the strengths of every clan. We must continue looking for ways to sever those connections if we hope to defeat them.
english.completed: Speak with Lokra in Grom'gar.
english.giverWindow: On loan from the Blackrock Foundry.

text.title: zzOLD Honor Has its Rewards
text.objectives: [PH] Receive a blessing from the Frostwolf Shamanstone.
text.description:
[PH] You have saved not only me, but our whole clan from the clutches of the Iron Horde.

You will find Shamanstones like the one beside me throughout our lands. They will now respond to your touch and you may receive a blessing from them while within Frostfire Ridge.
text.completed: [PH] Return to Durotan at Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge

english.objectives: [PH] Receive a blessing from the Frostwolf Shamanstone.
english.description:
[PH] You have saved not only me, but our whole clan from the clutches of the Iron Horde.

You will find Shamanstones like the one beside me throughout our lands. They will now respond to your touch and you may receive a blessing from them while within Frostfire Ridge.
english.completed: [PH] Return to Durotan at Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge

text.title: 悬赏：库拉特的獠牙
text.objectives: 消灭库拉特，并将它的獠牙交给安波里村的艾瑞莫尔。
text.description: 发布者：艾瑞莫尔$B$B有人在幽影林地附近看见了一只体型空前巨大的凶猛雷象。$B$B这只被某些人称作白色死神的雷象异常具有攻击性，已经夺走了不少无辜旅行者的性命。$B$B游侠们至今也未能封堵住这只猛兽。任何有本事消灭这只巨兽的人，请把能表明它死亡的证据交给艾瑞莫尔，换取巨额赏金。
text.progress: Are you here for the bounty on Kuu'rat?
text.completion: The ivory death is slain? Impressive, traveler.$B$BThanks to you, we are all safer with Kuu'rat gone. I will share news of this deed with the other villagers.
text.completed: Speak to Eremor at Embaari Village in Shadowmoon Valley.
text.giverWindow: 消灭她，把她的獠牙拿回来。

english.title: Wanted: Kuu'rat's Tusks
english.objectives: Slay Kuu'rat and bring her tusks to Eremor at Embaari Village.
english.description: Posted by: Eremor$B$BA ferocious elekk of unprecedented size has been seen near Gloomshade Grove.$B$BKnown to some as the ivory death, she is abnormally aggressive and has already taken the lives of several unwary travelers.$B$BThe rangari have as yet been unable to corner this creature. Anyone capable of taking down this beast should exchange proof of her demise to Eremor for a hefty bounty.
english.progress: Are you here for the bounty on Kuu'rat?
english.completion: The ivory death is slain? Impressive, traveler.$B$BThanks to you, we are all safer with Kuu'rat gone. I will share news of this deed with the other villagers.
english.completed: Speak to Eremor at Embaari Village in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.giverWindow: Slay her and retrieve her tusks.

text.title: 悬赏：克利亚的毒针
text.objectives: 消灭克利亚并把它的毒针带给安波里村的黛娜。
text.description: 发布者：黛娜$B$B一只凶恶的沼泽荧光虫后在影月谷北边的森林里安了家。$B$B不幸的是，这只毒虫滋扰着安波里村和沙塔斯之间的森林。当地的贸易商冒着生命危险奔波往来，商品价格也因此一涨再涨。$B$B任何能消灭这只巨虫的人，可以把它的尖刺折下来当做证据，交给安波里村的黛娜。贩货商人们一定会慷慨犒赏的。
text.progress: Word around town is you've been hunting Kliaa. Any luck?
text.completion: By the elders of Karabor... that thing is huge!$B$BOur trade routes will be safe once again. Well... as safe as you can be running through the northern forests.$B$BWell done, $c!
text.completed: Speak to Dyuna in Embaari Village in Shadowmoon Valley.
text.giverWindow: 取得它的毒针。

english.title: Wanted: Kliaa's Stinger
english.objectives: Kill Kliaa and bring its stinger to Dyuna at Embaari Village.
english.description: Posted by: Dyuna$B$BA vicious queen swamplighter has made the northern forests of Shadowmoon its home.$B$BUnfortunately, this poisonous pest terrorizes the forest between Embaari Village and Shattrath. As local traders put their lives at risk, prices of goods will continue to rise.$B$BAnyone who can put an end to the beast should detach its stinger as proof and bring it to Dyuna in Embaari Village. The merchant traders will reward generously.
english.progress: Word around town is you've been hunting Kliaa. Any luck?
english.completion: By the elders of Karabor... that thing is huge!$B$BOur trade routes will be safe once again. Well... as safe as you can be running through the northern forests.$B$BWell done, $c!
english.completed: Speak to Dyuna in Embaari Village in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.giverWindow: Retrieve its stinger.

text.title: 悬赏：马伦的蹄子
text.objectives: 拾取马伦的蹄子。
text.description: 发布者：欧林$B$B一只名叫“马伦”的野生塔布羊在安波里村东南边和达克瑞姆西边的山间游荡。$B$B我兄弟被这只恶兽弄伤了，现在还在卧床接受治疗。$B$B为了附近所有村民的安全，我们必须消灭这只凶狠狂暴的怪物！$B$B任何干掉它的人，可以把它的蹄子交给我作为证明，领取丰厚的赏金。
text.progress: My brother, Anduur, gathers wild berries from the hills above our village.$B$BIt was during one of his excursions that he met up with Maa'run.$B$BI demand retribution for his injuries.
text.completion: Thank you, adventurer! We can rest more easily knowing that this beast has been put to its end.
text.completed: Speak to Orrin at The Draakorium in Shadowmoon Valley.
text.giverWindow: 拾取它的蹄子，并领取奖励。

english.title: Wanted: Maa'run's Hoof
english.objectives: Collect Maa'run's Hoof.
english.description: Posted by: Orrin$B$BA wild talbuk called "Maa'run" wanders the hills southeast of Embaari Village and west of The Draakorium.$B$BMy brother was injured by this foul beast, and now lays in recovery.$B$BFor the safety of all the nearby villages, we must put an end to this vicious, rampaging creature!$B$BA handsome reward will be given to anyone who can bring me his hoof as proof of his demise.
english.progress: Мой брат Андуур собирает для меня ягоды на холмах над деревней.$B$BВ одной из последних экспедиций он столкнулся с Маа'руном.$B$BЯ требую отмщения за его боль.
english.completion: Thank you, adventurer! We can rest more easily knowing that this beast has been put to its end.
english.completed: Speak to Orrin at The Draakorium in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.giverWindow: Collect his hoof, collect the reward.

text.title: 黑暗降临
text.objectives: 找到耐奥祖。
text.description: 已经开始了，就在东南方那些山的另一边。$B$B耐奥祖已经具备了召唤黑暗之星所需要的一切。钢铁部落对卡拉波的攻击迫在眉睫。一切都将在这里结束。$B$B勇士，我必须让你先行一步去拖住耐奥祖。我会尽快与你会合。
text.completion: Prophet Velen is gone, and yet there is no time to mourn.$B$BWe will honor Velen's passing once the Iron Horde have fled from these hills.$B$BNow, champion, is the time to fight!
text.completed: Speak to Yrel at Light's Fall.

english.title: Darkness Falls
english.objectives: Find Ner'zhul.
english.description: It is already beginning, over the hills to the southeast.$B$BNer'zhul has everything he needs to summon the Dark Star. The Iron Horde attack on Karabor is imminent. This is where everything ends.$B$BChampion, I must ask you to ride ahead and delay Ner'zhul. I will join you as quickly as I can.
english.completion: Prophet Velen is gone, and yet there is no time to mourn.$B$BWe will honor Velen's passing once the Iron Horde have fled from these hills.$B$BNow, champion, is the time to fight!
english.completed: Speak to Yrel at Light's Fall.

text.title: 锻铸武器
text.objectives: 用纳什拉的矿镐采集$1oa块弗米克矿石。
text.description: 陌生人！感谢万灵把你带到了我面前。我正在铸造一把利刃，决不能在这个微妙的节骨眼上丢下它不管。$b$b可我需要更多矿石来完成这项任务。$b$b给，拿上我的矿锄。它是用当地鬣蜥人的牙齿和酸液做的，能像切白菜一样毫不费力地挖出这里的矿石。$b$b把矿石带回来交给我，我可以把这把利刃借你用用。
text.progress: The power of a weapon comes both from the test of its metal and the skill of the hands that wield it.
text.completion: Perfect timing. The steel of the blade is still malleable. A few more strikes and my work shall be complete.
text.completed: Return to Initiate Na'Shra at the Gate of the Breakers in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Smeltcraft
english.objectives: Use Na'Shra's Mining Pick to collect $1oa Fomic Ore.
english.description: Stranger! Thank the spirits for them sending you to me now. I am forging a blade and cannot leave it at this delicate state.$b$bBut I need more ore to complete this task.$b$bHere, take my mining pick. It is crafted from the teeth and acid of the local goren and will cut through the ore of this area as if it were air.$b$BBring me the ore and I will lend this blade to your cause.
english.progress: The power of a weapon comes both from the test of its metal and the skill of the hands that wield it.
english.completion: Perfect timing. The steel of the blade is still malleable. A few more strikes and my work shall be complete.
english.completed: Return to Initiate Na'Shra at the Gate of the Breakers in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: The Plight of the Worgen
text.objectives: Obtain $1oa Soothpetal Flowers and $2oa Frog Eyes and bring them to Tess Greymane in Twilight Glade.
text.description: King Greymane, my father, has fallen ill! Every day he's worse, losing control over his mind, becoming... feral. He's bedridden in Stormwind as we speak, and he isn't the only one.$B$BKrennan Aranas found what he thought might be the cure in Outland, but it was corrupted beyond recognition. I need to find the cure before he loses every bit of his humanity!$B$BHemma, one of my guards, is sick as well. I need you to collect some soothpetal flowers and frog eyes. We have to try something.
text.completed: Speak to Tess Greymane at Twilight Glade in Twilight Glade.

english.completed: Speak to Tess Greymane at Twilight Glade in Twilight Glade.

text.title: Vignette: Broodmother Reeg'ak
text.objectives: Destroy $1oa Goren Egg Clusters, $2oa Iceforge Ironchewers, and Broodmother Reeg'ak.
text.description: Goren are dangerous, especially in large numbers, and especially when we have a blind, under powered shaman with us.$b$bFortunately, they have very short lifespans. Unfortunately, they multiply fast and grow faster.$b$BIf we are going to do this we need to find the brood mother. Slaying her and her eggs should slow down the onslaught of goren. Check the burrows near the Forge Gates and I will to keep them off of Drek'Thar's scent.
text.completed: Return to Draka at the Forge Gates in Frostfire Ridge.

english.completed: Return to Draka at the Forge Gates in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: The Pale Hunter
text.objectives: Help Helga reclaim her sanity.
text.description: Spiders!$b$bWhere is my father!$b$bI feel so... so... good? Bad? Don't judge me! Leave me alone! I'm sleeping... in my brain.$b$bAHH!! More bunnies!$b$b<The dwarves eyes are extremely dilated. She appears to be hallucinating. >
text.completed: Read Helga's Journal near the Forgotten Caves in Gorgrond.

english.completed: Read Helga's Journal near the Forgotten Caves in Gorgrond.

text.title: 霜狼氏族的家园
text.objectives: 与霜火岭撞毁点的德雷克塔尔谈一谈。
text.description: 你已经抵达霜火岭。先知德雷克塔尔会指引你的行动。
text.completion: <The shaman grins at the harsh, windblown shore.>$b$bWelcome to the home of my people, $n.

english.title: The Home of the Frostwolves
english.objectives: Speak with Drek'Thar at the crash site in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description: You have arrived in Frostfire Ridge. Farseer Drek'Thar can guide you from here.
english.completion: <The shaman grins at the harsh, windblown shore.>$b$bWelcome to the home of my people, $n.

text.title: 寻找先知
text.objectives: 在塔拉多的暮秋岛与先知玛露妮谈一谈。
text.description: 我们一直在观察你，$n。$B$B先知玛露妮—记忆保管者要求与你见上一面，冒险者。$B$B她在很久之前就预见到会有一位伟大的英雄前来驱散潜藏的暗影。我们相信你就是她口中的那位英雄。$B$B到南边不远处的暮秋岛去完成你的使命吧。
text.completion: I am Seer Malune, the great keeper of memories. It is an honor to finally meet you.

english.title: Seek Out the Seer
english.objectives: Speak to Seer Malune on Duskfall Island in Talador.
english.description: We've been watching you, $n.$B$BSeer Malune, keeper of memories, has requested an audience with you, adventurer.$B$BShe has long foretold the coming of a great hero to destroy the lurking shadow. We believe you are that hero.$B$BCome to Duskfall Island, not far south of here, and fulfill your destiny.
english.completion: Я – провидица Малунэ, великая хранительница воспоминаний. Наконец-то мне выпала честь встретиться с тобой.

text.title: 亡者之尘
text.objectives: 从暮秋岛的暮翼蛾身上收集7把暮翼之尘。
text.description: 我以为要是我能把他带到这里来，也许就可以弥补他对光明的亵渎，进而挽救我的儿子！现在我亲爱的阿鲁麦尔已经变成了扭曲的幻象。$b$b我现在别无选择，唯有纠正我的错误，而且我需要你的帮助。$b$b从暮秋岛的飞蛾身上弄些暮翼之尘给我。在你的帮助下，我可以制造出把我们传送进亡者领域的药剂，让阿鲁麦尔安息。
text.progress: Do you have enough dust?
text.completion: Thank you, $n. With this dust and Aruunem berries I will craft the draught of the dead.
text.completed: Return to Seer Malune on Duskfall Island.

english.title: Dust of the Dead
english.objectives: Collect 7 Handfuls of Duskwing Dust from the Duskwing Moths on Duskfall Island.
english.description: I thought if I could just bring him here that I might be able to correct his transgression against the Light. That perhaps I could save my son! Now my beloved Arumel is a twisted phantasm.$b$bI'm left with no choice but to right my wrongs and I need your help.$b$bBring me duskwing dust from the moths on Duskfall Island. With your aid I can craft an elixir that will let us travel to the realm of the dead and lay Arumel to rest.
english.progress: Do you have enough dust?
english.completion: Thank you, $n. With this dust and Aruunem berries I will craft the draught of the dead.
english.completed: Return to Seer Malune on Duskfall Island.

text.title: 阿鲁纳姆疗法
text.objectives: 在暮秋岛上收集60个阿鲁纳姆浆果。
text.description: 我需要你帮忙制造一种可以使我们进入亡者领域的药剂。$b$b为了制造药剂，我需要对当地植物进行取样。这座岛上到处都有阿鲁纳姆浆果。尽量多给我带些回来。$b$b我要提醒你，$n：千万不要生吃！那种浆果含有剧毒，足以让你在几分钟内毙命！
text.progress: Have you collected enough Aruunem berries?
text.completion: I'm glad you did not eat any berries. I'm not sure what I would do if you were to die.
text.completed: Return to Seer Malune on Duskfall Island.

english.title: Cure of Aruunem
english.objectives: Collect 60 Aruunem Berries from around Duskfall Island.
english.description: I need your help in creating an elixir that will allow us passage into the realm of the dead.$B$BIn order to create it I require a sampling of the local vegetation. You will find Aruunem berries scattered about on the island. Bring me as many as you can carry.$b$bBe warned, $n: do not eat them raw! The poison in the berries would kill you within minutes!
english.progress: Ну что, ты $gсобрал:собрала; ягоды Арууны?
english.completion: I'm glad you did not eat any berries. I'm not sure what I would do if you were to die.
english.completed: Return to Seer Malune on Duskfall Island.

text.title: 让阿鲁麦尔安息
text.objectives: 进入灵魂世界，消灭阿鲁麦尔的回忆。
text.description: 我的工作就是观察其他人看不到的东西。我保管记忆，并从别人那里读取记忆，可由于我的儿子，我已经不能再这么做了。$b$b我的儿子背叛了圣光。他死后，我无法接受他的灵魂也许会被奥金顿拒之门外的事实。$B$B于是我选择了介入，把他困在了这里。现在他正在扭曲和摧残那些记忆，使它们无法再被传承。$b$b你必须替我去做我不忍心做的事。用这瓶药剂进入灵魂世界……$B$B……消灭我儿子的灵魂。
text.completion: Some memories are better left forgotten. Thank you, $n.$B$BI will return you to our world.
text.completed: Return to Seer Malune on Duskfall Island.

english.title: Aruumel's Rest
english.objectives: Enter the Spirit Realm and destroy the Memory of Arumel.
english.description: It is my job to see what others cannot. I keep the memories and read them for others, but I can no longer do so because of my son.$b$bMy son turned his back on the light. When he perished I could not stand the thought that his spirit might not be welcomed into Auchindoun.$B$BI interfered and trapped him here. Now he twists and tortures the memories until they cannot be read.$b$bYou must do what I cannot bear to do myself. Use this elixir to enter the spirit realm...$B$B...and destroy my son's spirit.
english.completion: Some memories are better left forgotten. Thank you, $n.$B$BI will return you to our world.
english.completed: Return to Seer Malune on Duskfall Island.

text.title: Goren, Goren, Gone!
text.objectives: Destroy 15 Goren Stonechewers and their leader, Pastrok within the Jorune Quarry.
text.description: It's uncommon to see goren in Talador. We need to get a handle on this situation before it spreads and we lose all of our precious gems.$b$bThe only answer is to dispose of the creatures, and quickly!$b$bIt is imperative that you kill the leader too! If you don't they will just continue to come back.
text.completed: Return to Crystal-Shaper Attica outside of the Jorune Quarry.

text.title: Destroy Diggers [PH]
text.objectives: Collect 6 Solidified Goren Spit Samples from the Jorune Quarry.
text.description: This goren attack was horrible, but maybe we can learn from them. Maybe we can use this tragedy to our benefit.$b$bThe goren's primary weapon is a metal melting spit. You'll need to be careful in there, lest you loose that shiny armor!$b$bIt would be too dangerous to collect it when it's fresh, but maybe once it's solidified...$b$bSee if you can bring me a few samples.$b$bIf my hypothesis is correct we may be able to weaponize it against the Iron Horde.
text.completed: Return to Crystal-Shaper Attica outside of the Jorune Quarry.

text.title: No Miner Left Behind
text.objectives: Rescue 8 Jorune Miners from within the Jorune Quarry.
text.description: In all of my years working the quarry I have never seen goren in this number. They came on so quickly, we had no time to react.$b$bNow the quarry has been weakened from their tunneling and eating. it's only a matter of time before the whole thing collapses.$b$bI refuse to leave anyone to die in there with those things! Please help me, $r. Save as many of my miners as you can.
text.completed: Return to Foreman Raluum outside of the Jorune Quarry.

english.completed: Return to Foreman Raluum outside of the Jorune Quarry.

text.title: Goren, Goren, Gone!
text.objectives: Destroy 15 Goren Stonechewers and their leader, Pastrok within the Jorune Quarry.
text.description: I was all set to take a little trip to the nearby quarry when all of the sudden a bunch of goren bust out of the ground and started wreaking havoc!$b$bIt would be a shame for all of those beautiful gems to be destroyed by those filthy creatures. All they do is eat them! Can you believe that?!$b$bBe a dear and dispose of them. Make sure you get rid of the leader or they will only come back.
text.completed: Return to Crystal in Liadrin's Watch.

text.title: Collect Crystals [PH]
text.objectives: Collect 10 Handfuls of Jorune Crystal Dust from within the Jorune Quarry
text.description: The gems and crystals here are amazing! They're unlike anything I have ever seen. I've heard the Draenei can even trap memories within them.$b$bI have an idea that's crazy, but it just might work!$b$bI need crystal dust from the Jorune Quarry. I'm going to try and make mood gems with it. If the Draenei can trap a memory, how hard could it be to trap a mood?$b$bThey'll be beautiful and effective!
text.completed: Return to Crystal in Liadrin's Watch.

text.title: Can't Live With 'Em, Can't Learn Without 'Em
text.objectives: Rescue 8 Jorune Miners from within the Jorune Quarry.
text.description: The Draenei here are so in touch with the light. It's imperative that we learn as much as we can from them.$b$bWe must find a way to overcome their distrust in us...$b$bThe Jorune Quarry was attacked by goren leaving many helpless miners trapped within. The miners aren't fighters and would probably appreciate help from anywhere at this point.$b$bMaybe if you lend a hand in rescuing them, we may earn ourselves some goodwill.
text.completed: Return to Salindra Lightsworn in Liadrin's Watch.

text.title: 拯救孔雀幼鸟
text.objectives: 救出7只惊恐的孔雀幼鸟，并把它们带回卡雷布身边。
text.description: 那个该死的老什尔坎！他一直在欺负这些可怜的孔雀幼鸟，可这次他太过分了！$b$b当时我正打算转移这群可怜的幼鸟，免遭恶魔的践踏，结果他就发起了攻击！现在那些孔雀幼鸟四散而逃，全都吓坏了！$b$b请帮我把它们全都带回来吧！
text.completion: Oh thank you! Now these little peachicks can be moved to safety.
text.completed: Return to Caleb near his overturned cart.

english.title: Just Peachicky
english.objectives: Rescue 7 Frightened Peachicks and return them to Caleb.
english.description: That mean old Sher'khaan! He's always been a bully to these poor peachicks, but this is crossing the line!$b$bI was trying to move this poor clutch out of the way of the demons when he attacked! Now the peachicks are spread out all over and they're scared!$b$bPlease help me bring them all back!
english.completion: Спасибо тебе! Теперь мы сможем отправиться в безопасное место.
english.completed: Return to Caleb near his overturned cart.

text.title: 什尔坎！
text.objectives: 消灭8只利齿追猎者和什尔坎。
text.description: 这地方的老虎已经完全失去控制了！它们跑得到处都是，而且比以往更加凶残！$b$b什尔坎就是其中最坏的一只！他体型巨大，阴险至极！也许像你这样勇敢的冒险者可以一次性解决掉什尔坎和那些恶虎。
text.completion: You're so brave! I could never have taken Sher'khaan out on my own!$B$BNow I only have to worry about the scary orcs, giant birds, hippos, big bird men, spiders, everything being on fire...$B$BYa'know maybe I shouldn't be out here all by myself...
text.completed: Return to Caleb at his overturned cart.

english.title: Sher'KHAAAAAAANNNN!
english.objectives: Kill 8 Sharpfang Stalkers and Destroy Sher'khaan.
english.description: The tigers here have gotten out of control! They're everywhere and meaner than ever!$b$bSher'khaan is the worst of them! He's huge and mean! Maybe a brave adventurer like you could take care of Sher'khaan and the other tigers once and for all.
english.completion: Невероятно! В одиночку одолеть Шер'хаана... Твоей храбрости нет предела!$b$bТеперь можно никого не бояться! Разве что жутких орков, гигантских птиц, бегемотов, птицелюдей, пауков, пожара...$b$bЗнаешь, пожалуй, не стоит мне тут жить одному...
english.completed: Return to Caleb at his overturned cart.

text.title: 消灭奴贩
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个污煤食人魔。
text.description:
这些食人魔一直在掠夺我的族人，并把他们变为奴隶！

去消灭一些食人魔，要是他们想要逃跑的话，我会拖住他们。
text.completion: You got the fire in you alright.
text.completed: Return to Gol'kosh the Axe outside the Sootstained Mining Camp

english.title: Slaying Slavers
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Sootstained Ogres.
english.description:
These ogres keep takin' my clan and turnin' them into slaves!

Slay some ogres and I'll hold 'em off if they try to run.
english.completion: You got the fire in you alright.
english.completed: Return to Gol'kosh the Axe outside the Sootstained Mining Camp

text.title: Balance of Power
text.objectives: Speak to Romuul's assistants to collect an Optical Disc, Conducting Crystal, and Romuul's Wrench.
text.description: The Prophet needs to locate the arkonite crystals, but in order to do that, I'll need to fix the projection discs on that platform.$B$BSpeak to my assistants around the observatory and bring me an Optical Disc, a Conducting Crystal, and my wrench.
text.completed: Speak to Master Artificer Romuul at Teluuna Observatory in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 关闭传送门
text.objectives: 消灭影月传送大师，关闭3道虚空传送门。
text.description: 影月兽人正在使用传送门输送援军，并将德莱尼俘虏偷偷运走。$B$B要是我们还对夺回村庄抱有任何希望的话，就必须立刻摧毁传送门。$B$B唯一的办法就是消灭看守裂隙的传送大师。
text.completion: Wonderful. That should slow down the attack.$B$BOur forces should be able to retake the forest quickly.
text.completed: Speak to Prophet Velen at Teluuna Observatory.

english.title: Closing the Door
english.objectives: Close 3 Void Portals by killing Shadowmoon Portalmasters.
english.description: The Shadowmoon orcs are using portals to bring in reinforcements and smuggle away draenei captives.$B$BIf we are to have any hope of retaking the village, we must destroy the portals at once.$B$BThe only way to do this is to kill the portalmasters who keep the rifts open.
english.completion: Wonderful. That should slow down the attack.$B$BOur forces should be able to retake the forest quickly.
english.completed: Speak to Prophet Velen at Teluuna Observatory.

text.title: The Power Shards
text.objectives: Retrieve the Shard of Souls in the Tomb of Souls.
text.description: I know what the Bonechewer are after.$B$BAuchindoun is protected by a powerful barrier, which can only be disabled using an ancient key. No being could ever hope to penetrate it.$B$BThe Auchenai, my people, split the key into three shards long ago and hid each piece outside the mausoleum walls. We guard those shards with the same zeal as Auchindoun itself.$B$BGo into the Tomb of Souls and retrieve the key from Soulbinder X. The shards are no longer safe.
text.completed: Return to Soulbinder Nyami at the Auchindoun North Gate in Talador.

text.title: No Draenei Left Behind
text.objectives: Find Yuuri near the Tomb of Souls in the Court of Souls.
text.description: Yuuri, head caretaker of the outer terraces of Auchindoun, hasn't been accounted for yet.$B$BThe last time anyone saw him, he was heading into the Tomb of Souls to protect the key shard. Will you make sure he finds his way here safely?
text.completed: Find Yuuri near the Tomb of Souls in the Court of Souls.

english.objectives: Find Yuuri near the Tomb of Souls in the Court of Souls.
