text.title: Desperate Times
text.objectives: Ride to the Tomb of Lights with Lady Liadrin.
text.description: This alliance between the Bonechewer and Teron'gore does not bode well.$B$BWe cannot allow the remaining two key fragments to fall into their hands. The Auchenai cannot stop the onslaught, so the duty falls on us.$B$BLet us waste no time. We ride for the Tomb of Lights at once.
text.completed: Speak to Lady Liadrin at the Tomb of Lights in Talador.

english.title: Desperate Times
english.objectives: Ride to the Tomb of Lights with Lady Liadrin.
english.description: This alliance between the Bonechewer and Teron'gore does not bode well.$B$BWe cannot allow the remaining two key fragments to fall into their hands. The Auchenai cannot stop the onslaught, so the duty falls on us.$B$BLet us waste no time. We ride for the Tomb of Lights at once.
english.completed: Speak to Lady Liadrin at the Tomb of Lights in Talador.

text.title: Gut Guttra
text.objectives: Kill Guttra Wolfchew.
text.description: Guttra Wolfchew's hunger can be blamed for this massacre. He will pay with his life for the blood spilled today. $b$bYou can find Guttra up on Grimfrost Hill to the north. Slay him and return to me.$b$bWhen you get back we shall drink to our victory.
text.completed: Return to Urukag near the Grimfrost Hill in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Gut Guttra
english.objectives: Kill Guttra Wolfchew.
english.description: Guttra Wolfchew's hunger can be blamed for this massacre. He will pay with his life for the blood spilled today. $b$bYou can find Guttra up on Grimfrost Hill to the north. Slay him and return to me.$b$bWhen you get back we shall drink to our victory.
english.completed: Return to Urukag near the Grimfrost Hill in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 初生牛犊
text.objectives: 找到奥拉克，并让他回家找他的叔叔。
text.description: 我的侄子从来都不注意周围的环境。他一心急于证明自己，再一次地脱离了大部队。$b$b他这样子简直和我年轻时一模一样。$b$b如果你见到奥拉克，记得叫他赶紧回家。我们得完成明天狩猎的准备工作。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. I'm sure Orac will think twice before he strays from the pack again.
text.completed: Return to Gog'rak at Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge

english.title: Young Hearts
english.objectives: Find Orac and tell him to return home to his uncle.
english.description: My nephew never pays attention to his surroundings. In his eagerness to prove himself, he has strayed from the pack -- again.$b$bHe reminds me of myself when I was a youngling.$b$bIf you see Orac, tell him to return home. We need to finish preparing for tomorrow's hunt.
english.completion: Спасибо тебе, $n. Уверен, что теперь-то Орак дважды подумает, прежде чем куда-то уходить в одиночку.
english.completed: Return to Gog'rak at Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge

text.title: 中断供能
text.objectives: 在燃烧前线上摧毁$1oa个燃烧的共鸣水晶。
text.description: 说你呢，我们得阻止恶魔援军的涌入！$B$B你看见遍布前线的那些飘浮着的邪能水晶了吗？就是那些共鸣器在为传送门供能，使我们的军队受到了毁灭性的打击。我需要你去摧毁它们！
text.completion: We can take it from here. Light's blessings to you, $c.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Nobundo in the Burning Front in Talador.

english.title: Disrupting the Flow
english.objectives: Destroy $1oa Burning Resonators in the Burning Front.
english.description: You there, we need to stop the flow of demon reinforcements!$B$BDo you see the floating fel crystals spread throughout the front? Those resonators are powering the portals unleashing hell on our forces. I need you to take them out!
english.completion: We can take it from here. Light's blessings to you, $c.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Nobundo in the Burning Front in Talador.

text.title: 悬赏：戈隆多的赏金
text.objectives: 在龟裂平原消灭戈隆多。
text.description: 有人看见一只名叫戈隆多的疯狂戈隆在龟裂平原上游荡。$b$b这只巨兽已经杀死了好几群裂蹄牛，吃掉了无数无辜的霜狼。我们必须在它抵达要塞前，消除这个威胁。
text.completion: Very good. We don't be needin' a gronn bearin' down on us before we get our defenses all established.
text.completed: Return to Rokhan at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge

english.title: Wanted: Grondo's Bounty
english.objectives: Kill Grondo in the Crackling Plains.
english.description: Grondo, a mad gronn, has been seen roaming the Crackling Plains.$b$bThis beast has been killing entire herds of clefthoof and devouring innocent frost wolves. We must destroy this threat before it reaches the Garrison.
english.completion: Very good. We don't be needin' a gronn bearin' down on us before we get our defenses all established.
english.completed: Return to Rokhan at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge

text.title: 通缉：毁灭者戈特玛什
text.objectives: 在霜火岭消灭毁灭者戈特玛什。
text.description: 戈特玛什不只是个称职的顾问而已。集结一小支队伍，彻底终结他的恐怖统治吧。
text.completion: Gutsmash is dead? I'll drink to that. You're alright, $n.
text.completed: Return to Der'shway at Bladespire Citadel in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Wanted: Gutsmash the Destroyer
english.objectives: Kill Gutsmash the Destroyer in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description: Gutsmash has proven to be more than a worthy adversary. Gather a small group together and end his reign of terror once and for all.
english.completion: Gutsmash is dead? I'll drink to that. You're alright, $n.
english.completed: Return to Der'shway at Bladespire Citadel in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 奥金顿之心
text.objectives: 在燃烧前线击败奥莫格·黑心，并拿到卡拉布恩。
text.description: 一群暗影议会兽人偷走了奥金顿之心！$B$B奥金顿的所有防御护盾都要靠它供能。幸好我们抢救出了它的核心和四块碎片当中的一块。$B$B一位名叫奥莫格·黑心的术士正在用一块被偷走的碎片——卡拉布恩给燃烧前线上最大的传送门充能。把卡拉布恩带回来交给我。
text.progress: I trust you have Karab'uun. I am not known for my patience when the countless souls inside Auchindoun are in danger.
text.completion: <Soulbinder Nyami's lips curl into a smile.>$B$BWell done. Only two pieces remain. I've already dispatched my soulbinders to track them down.
text.completed: Return to Soulbinder Nyami at Exarch's Refuge in Talador.

english.title: The Heart of Auchindoun
english.objectives: Defeat O'mogg Blackheart and retrieve Karab'uun in the Burning Front.
english.description: A band of Shadow Council orcs stole the Heart of Auchindoun!$B$BThe Heart powers all of Auchindoun's defenses. Thankfully we were able to save its core and one of its four pieces.$B$BThe warlock O'mogg Blackheart is using Karab'uun, one of the stolen pieces, to power the largest portal in the Burning Front. Return Karab'uun to me.
english.progress: Надеюсь, Караб'уун у тебя. Когда души Аукиндона находятся в опасности, медлить нельзя.
english.completion: <Soulbinder Nyami's lips curl into a smile.>$B$BWell done. Only two pieces remain. I've already dispatched my soulbinders to track them down.
english.completed: Return to Soulbinder Nyami at Exarch's Refuge in Talador.

text.title: Stolen Axes
text.objectives: Recover $1oa Stolen Frostwolf Axes.
text.description:
The saberon usually keep to themselves, but sometimes they range out of their dens and attack.

A pride of them live in the Windswept Lowland and have been coming too close for comfort, especially at night.

They even attacked a shipment of axes and took them back to their den!
text.completed: Return to Supplymaster Eri

text.title: Demons? In Auchindoun?
text.objectives: Kill O'mogg Blackheart in the Tomb of Lights to shut down the demon portal.
text.description: Demons! I feared as much.$B$BWe cannot let them leave that tomb. They musn't be allowed near Auchindoun!$B$BQuickly, go in and shut down the portal letting them in while I help rally the Auchenai's defenses. There must be a powerful warlock keeping it open. Kill him and the portal will fall apart!
text.completed: Report to Lady Liadrin at Goldendawn Camp.

text.title: Saberon Matriarch
text.objectives: Slay the Saberon Pridematron.
text.description:
The current matriarch of the Windswept Lowland saberon pride is bold.

She leads her pride in ambushes and attacks that some consider organized raids on our supply lines.

The intelligence she displays  is becoming a legitimate threat.

Take her out and perhaps she'll be replaced with a less dangerous leader.
text.completed: Return to Supplymaster Eri

text.title: 不该存在的土与火
text.objectives: 把熔火之心交给伊森拉图斯。
text.description: 这个熔火之心似乎是某个由土火构成的元素留下的变异残骸。$b$b熔渣元素不应该在高原上存在，这里的元素成分单一。$b$b你决定把它带到元素王座拿给伊森拉图斯看一看。$b$b也许伟大的火焰之怒知道这个熔火之心是怎么回事，并为你跟玛格迈尔的战斗指点一二。
text.completion: <Incineratus examines the core as you explain the circumstances behind its acquisition>$b$bIndeed, slag elementals should not exist upon the plateau. The plateau has grown unstable, causing the elemental spirits there to devolve and mutate.$b$bSo long as an earthen fury is absent from the throne, the imbalance in the elements will worsen.$b$bGordawg must return to the Throne of Elements if balance is to be maintained.
text.completed: I NEED TEXT

english.title: A Wrong of Earth and Fire
english.objectives: Deliver the Molten Core to Incineratus.
english.description: The molten core appears to be the mutated remains of an elemental that consisted of both earth and fire.$b$bSlag elementals should not exist upon the plateau where the elements live in purity.$b$bYou decide that the core should be taken to Incineratus at the Throne of Elements for examination.$b$bPerhaps the great fury of fire will know what to make of this core and your battle with Magmire.
english.completion: <Incineratus examines the core as you explain the circumstances behind its acquisition>$b$bIndeed, slag elementals should not exist upon the plateau. The plateau has grown unstable, causing the elemental spirits there to devolve and mutate.$b$bSo long as an earthen fury is absent from the throne, the imbalance in the elements will worsen.$b$bGordawg must return to the Throne of Elements if balance is to be maintained.
english.completed: I NEED TEXT

text.title: 颤尾的巢穴
text.objectives: 在霜火岭寻找颤尾的双亲。
text.description: 霜狼幼崽用一双大眼睛看着你。它盯着洞穴深处不断嗥叫。$b$b这么年幼的霜狼很少会独自游荡。颤尾的父母亲一定就在附近。
text.completion: Shivertail snuggles up to his mother. He is clearly happy to be reunited with most of his pack.
text.completed: Return to Shivertail near Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Shivertail's Den
english.objectives: Search for Shivertail's parents in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description: The Frostwolf pup looks at you with his big eyes. He howls and stares into the cave.$b$bIt's unusual for a wolf this young to be wandering around by itself. Shivertail's parents must be nearby.
english.completion: Shivertail snuggles up to his mother. He is clearly happy to be reunited with most of his pack.
english.completed: Return to Shivertail near Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge.

text.objectives: Help Deceptia
text.description: We need help! But not from you...
text.completion: Haha!

text.title: Avoiding Starvation
text.objectives: Collect 4 Battleboar Tenderloins for the Cooking Pot.
text.description: <You notice that this Cooking Pot is filled with boiling water containing twigs and ruffage. The corpse of a Bloodmaul Battleboar lays nearby, picked clean to the bone. $b$bIf you were to obtain fresh meat it would greatly aid the wounded and starving Frostwolf Slaves.>

text.title: Avenging The Fallen
text.objectives: Slay 15 Bloodmaul Brutes, 5 Bloodmaul Geomancers, and 1 Bloodmaul Pit Boss.
text.description: I tried to warn my people that any escape attempt would be futile until we receive reinforcements. My heart is heavy with guilt that I was unable to stop them.$b$bThe blood of my clan demands justice, $n!$B$BAs my people toil in the mines or lay dead in the snow, the Bloodmaul walk amongst us unscathed. Meet them in combat and redeem the honor of my fallen kin!
text.completed: Return to Rogash for your reward.

english.completed: Return to Rogash for your reward.

text.title: Destroying Their Supplies
text.objectives: Destroy the Mining Supplies.
text.description: The ogres have been pillaging Mining Supplies from trade caravans to equip their slaves for work.$b$b<Rogash spits upon the ground>$b$bIf you can destroy the stolen Mining Supplies within the camp, the remaining slaves will not have to toil so tirelessly against the rocks.

english.title: Destroying Their Supplies
english.objectives: Destroy the Mining Supplies.
english.description: The ogres have been pillaging Mining Supplies from trade caravans to equip their slaves for work.$b$b<Rogash spits upon the ground>$b$bIf you can destroy the stolen Mining Supplies within the camp, the remaining slaves will not have to toil so tirelessly against the rocks.

text.title: Outrider Urukag
text.objectives: Join Urukag on his hunt.
text.description: I can't believe I'm stuck here cooking while Urukag is out there hunting with the others.$b$bIf you hurry you might still be able to catch him, $n.
text.completed: Join Urukag near Grimfrost Hill in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Outrider Urukag
english.objectives: Join Urukag on his hunt.

english.completed: Join Urukag near Grimfrost Hill in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 还有雷象？！
text.objectives: 回卡雷布翻倒的货车附近把里奇交给他。
text.description: 这只小小的毛绒雷象如今已经风光不再。它被撕扯得面目全非，里面的绒毛都漏了出来。$b$b在小雷象左后脚的脚掌上绣着卡雷布三个字。什尔坎肯定是从货车里把它抢走了。那个小德莱尼也许会想要找回它。
text.progress: Where did you find Ricky?!
text.completion: Oh thank you, mister! I can't believe Sher'khaan got Ricky!$B$BYou're my hero!
text.completed: Return Ricky to Caleb at the overturned cart.

english.title: And the Elekk Too?!
english.objectives: Return Ricky to Caleb at the overturned cart.
english.description: The little stuffed elekk has seen better days. It's torn and the stuffing is poking out.$b$bThe name Caleb is sewn onto the bottom of the left back foot. Sher'khaan must have snatched it from the cart. The little draenei might appreciate its return.
english.progress: Where did you find Ricky?!
english.completion: Спасибо, $gдобрый путник:добрая странница;! Поверить не могу, что Шер'хаан утащил моего Рики.$b$bТы $gтакой храбрый:такая храбрая;!
english.completed: Return Ricky to Caleb at the overturned cart.

text.title: Deathweb Hollow
text.objectives: Find Ereis in Deathweb Hollow.
text.description: I sent Leonid and Ereis to Deathweb Hollow to take care of the fel-corrupted spiders there while you went into the Tomb of Lights to retrieve the Shard of Lights and stop the demons there.$B$BLeonid and Ereis never came back.$B$BNow I have to ask you to find them, or what's left of them, and finish the job.$B$BNyami's priests should be able to handle securing the final shard in Telmor. Find Ereis and do what you must. We cannot allow this fel taint to spread across the land.

text.title: Deathweb Hollow
text.objectives: Find Mehlar Dawnblade in Deathweb Hollow.
text.description: While you were retrieving the Shard of Lights and stopping the demons in the Tomb of Lights, I sent Mehlar and Althos to Deathweb Hollow to handle the corrupt spiders there.$B$BThey haven't returned, so I am left with no choice but to ask you to go in after them and get the job done.$B$BWe cannot just let the fel taint sweep across the land unchecked. I refuse to let this world fall to demons.

text.title: The Hunting Party
text.objectives: Find the Frostwolf Hunters in the Windswept Lowland.
text.description: Korga and her brothers have been out hunting for days and have not returned.$b$bThis is a common problem amongst our clan.$b$bCall them in so they can get some proper rest.
text.completed: Return to Krunk at the Muster Field in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 走失的兽群
text.objectives: 在霜火岭的沃高尔附近找到颤尾。
text.description: 陌生人，不知道小颤尾和他的同伴们跑到哪去了？他们通常会在差不多这个时候过来吃东西。$b$b我希望一切都好。
text.completion: You startle the small pup.

english.title: Missing Pack
english.objectives: Find Shivertail near Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description: Strange, I wonder where little Shivertail and his pack are? They normally show up for a feeding about now.$b$bI hope everything is alright.
english.completion: You scared the baby.

text.title: Missing Frostwolves
text.objectives: Search Bloodmaul for the missing Frostwolves.
text.description: $n, I'm glad you're here.$B$BSeveral Frostwolf patrols have gone missing recently around the Bloodmaul Compound. Search the area around Bloodmaul and report back to me when you're done.

english.title: Missing Frostwolves
english.objectives: Search Bloodmaul for the missing Frostwolves.
english.description: $n, I'm glad you're here.$B$BSeveral Frostwolf patrols have gone missing recently around the Bloodmaul Compound. Search the area around Bloodmaul and report back to me when you're done.

text.title: A Gift for Raa'la
text.objectives: Collect a Baby Rylak for Raa'la in the Windswept Lowlands.
text.description: I need to pack up this kill.  I promised my daughter Raa'la I would bring her home a gift from the hunt.$b$bThere are a couple baby Rylaks in the cave nearby. Maybe Raa'la would like one as a pet?$b$bWould you mind catching one while I finish up here?
text.completed: Return to Rakla at the Windswept Lowlands in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: A Gift for Raa'la
english.objectives: Collect a Baby Rylak for Raa'la in the Windswept Lowlands.

english.completed: Return to Rakla at the Windswept Lowlands in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 进入山谷
text.objectives: 在逝网之谷里消灭污染者埃克萨纳托斯并取回沙塔尔。
text.description: 我听说，在燃烧前线上落败后，暗影议会眼下正在用附近逝网蜘蛛的毒液来扩散邪能的腐化并壮大他们的军队。$B$B我们有位缚魂者看见一个恐惧魔王带着沙塔尔闯进了东边的矿井，那是奥金顿之心其余碎片中的一块。$B$B我要你从那个恐惧魔王身上夺取沙塔尔，把它带给我，勇士。
text.progress: Did the demon have Sha'tari as we thought?
text.completion: Just as I suspected. Thank you, $n. With Sha'tari back in our possession there is only one piece of the Heart left to retrieve.
text.completed: Return to Soulbinder Nyami at Light's Rest.

english.title: Into the Hollow
english.objectives: Kill Xanatos the Defiler in Deathweb Hollow and retrieve Sha'tari.
english.description: I've learned that the Shadow Council is using the nearby deathweb spiders' venom to spread fel corruption and augment their forces after their defeat at the Burning Front.$B$BOne of my soulbinders saw a dreadlord headed into the eastern mines with Sha'tari, one of the remaining pieces of the Heart of Auchindoun.$B$BI need you to wrest Sha'tari from the dreadlord's quivering corpse and bring it to me, champion.
english.progress: Ша'тар действительно оказался у демона, как мы и предполагали?
english.completion: Just as I suspected. Thank you, $n. With Sha'tari back in our possession there is only one piece of the Heart left to retrieve.
english.completed: Return to Soulbinder Nyami at Light's Rest.

text.title: You Sunk My Battleship!
text.objectives: Plant the Underwater Explosives on the Iron Horde boats.
text.description: They sunk my battleship, $n!$b$bI drove her in with a cargo of underwater explosives to place on the Iron Horde ships, but they spotted me and opened fire! Luckily I was able to salvage most of the explosives before she sank. Ain't nobody sinks my ship and gets away with it...nobody!$b$bTake the rest of the underwater charges and plant all of 'em on the western Battleship. You'll have to swim your way into the harbor to avoid detection.$b$bWhen you're done, swim into shore. I'll be waiting on the path!
text.completed: Meet Ticker inside Grommar harbor.

You'll have to swim your way into the harbor to avoid detection.$b$bWhen you're done, swim into shore. I'll be waiting on the path!
english.completed: Meet Ticker inside Grommar harbor.

text.title: 解毒药
text.objectives: 去逝网之谷收集$1oa枚逝网蛛牙。
text.description: 我很担心尼娅米。她太过专注于取回奥金顿之心，仿佛已经对其它一切全都视而不见了。$B$B抱歉，我并不是在小瞧她的智慧，可你看看四周！我们派进矿井里的所有士兵都被逝网蜘蛛给咬成了重伤。必须立即处理他们的伤口！$B$B拜托了，你能从那些蜘蛛身上取些毒牙来吗？我可以用它们来制作解毒药，可我得留在这里，确保伤员的病情稳定。
text.progress: Do you have the fangs? We don't have much time!
text.completion: Bless you, $n. There have been enough innocent lives taken today.
text.completed: Return to Soulbinder Tuulani in Deathweb Hollow.

english.title: Antivenin
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Deathweb Fangs in Deathweb Hollow.
english.description: I'm worried about Nyami. She's so focused on retrieving the Heart of Auchindoun that she seems to have lost sight of everything else.$B$BI'm sorry, I'm not trying to belittle her wisdom, but look around! Every soldier we sent into the mine has been gravely injured by the deathweb spiders. Their wounds need immediate attention!$B$BPlease, can you retrieve some fangs from the spiders? I can use them to create an antivenin, but I need to stay here and keep them stable until then.
english.progress: Нельзя терять ни минуты! Жвала у тебя?
english.completion: Bless you, $n. There have been enough innocent lives taken today.
english.completed: Return to Soulbinder Tuulani in Deathweb Hollow.

text.title: Goren Boss Kill and Collect
text.description: <Light bounces from within the gem creating rainbows on the nearby walls.>$b$bThis curious looking gem seems to have fallen from Pastrok's back. Perhaps a skilled gem-shaper or jewelcrafter would have a use for it.
text.completed: Return the gem to a nearby crystal-shaper or jewelcrafter.

text.title: 邪恶的污染者
text.objectives: 去逝网之谷摧毁$1oa块污染水晶。
text.description: 在附近矿井里泛滥成灾的蜘蛛吓坏了好多人，因为它们的毒液能够扭曲受害者的外形。很多当地人都离山谷远远的，可我担心暗影议会也知道了那些蜘蛛的厉害。$B$B据我的斥候们报告，他们的术士正在给这些蜘蛛灌注邪能，好让它们的毒液把受害者变成恶魔仆从！$B$B我们必须摧毁污染水晶，终止这场疯狂。
text.completion: We were wise to not underestimate the threat of a land turned against us.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Namuun at Light's Rest.

english.title: Vile Defilers
english.objectives: Destroy $1oa Defiling Crystals in Deathweb Hollow.
english.description: The spiders in the nearby overrun mine are feared by many, for their venom twists the very form of their victims. Many of the locals stay far away from their hollow, but I fear the Shadow Council has become privy to this information.$B$BOur scouts report that their warlocks are infusing these spiders with fel energy so that their venom turns their victims into demonic minions!$B$BWe must destroy the defiling crystals so this madness does not spread.
english.completion: We were wise to not underestimate the threat of a land turned against us.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Namuun at Light's Rest.

text.completion: Just as I suspected. Thank you, $n. With Sha'tari back in our possession there is only one piece of the Heart left to retrieve.

text.objectives: 去逝网之谷摧毁$1oa块污染水晶。
text.description: 逝网蜘蛛是可怕的怪物。它们的毒液会扭曲受害者的外形。$B$B我们并不是这个情况的唯一知情者。暗影议会已经派术士赶往逝网之谷，给那些蜘蛛灌注邪能，让它们用毒液将其它生物变成恶魔仆从！$B$B我们必须摧毁污染水晶，决不能让塔拉多的生灵屈服于塔隆戈尔的淫威之下！
text.completion: <Mehlar smiles.>$B$BIt would seem that the tide of this war is shifting in our favor.
text.completed: Return to Mehlar Dawnblade at Sunsworn Camp.

english.title: Vile Defilers
english.objectives: Destroy $1oa Defiling Crystals in Deathweb Hollow.
english.description: The deathweb spiders are remarkable creatures. Their venom twists the very form of their victims.$B$BWe are not the only ones privy to this information. The Shadow Council has already dispatched its warlocks to Deathweb Hollow to infuse the spiders with fel energy so that their venom turns creatures into demonic minions!$B$BWe must destroy the defiling crystals to prevent all of Talador from bending to Teron'gor's will!
english.completion: <Mehlar smiles.>$B$BIt would seem that the tide of this war is shifting in our favor.
english.completed: Return to Mehlar Dawnblade at Sunsworn Camp.

text.title: 临终遗愿
text.objectives: 从剑圣巴罗克身上取回阿姆的传家宝。
text.description:
我已经没救了，但还是要谢谢你来跟我说话。

剑圣巴罗克让他的手下饿死我，对我拳脚相加，还偷走了我家族在抵达德拉诺之前就代代相传的传家宝。

要是你能找到它的话，请让我再看它一眼，那样我也就死而无憾了。
text.progress: The Blademaster must pay...
text.completion: Thank you. Now that I know it is out of the hands of the Iron Horde, I can die peacefully.
text.completed: Return to Ahm in Archenon Siegeyard.

english.title: Dying Wish
english.objectives: Recover Ahm's Heirloom from Blademaster Bralok.
english.description:
I am too far gone to rescue, but thank you for speaking with me.

Blademaster Bralok had his men starve and beat me, and he stole an heirloom that has been in my family since before we arrived on Draenor.

Should you find it, please let me see it once more so I may die in peace.
english.progress: Мастер клинка за все заплатит…
english.completion: Thank you. Now that I know it is out of the hands of the Iron Horde, I can die peacefully.
english.completed: Return to Ahm in Archenon Siegeyard.

text.title: 最后一块
text.objectives: 从泰尔莫的沃匹尔·斩骨身上取得奥克纳鲁。
text.description: 我伤得太重，无法战斗了，$c。我辜负了我的城市和人民。这场战斗只能靠你了。$B$B沃匹尔就在前面。他正试图用奥克纳鲁的力量举行某种黑暗仪式。$B$B你必须去完成我没做到的事。消灭沃匹尔，把奥克纳鲁夺回来，好让奥金顿之心再次变得完整！
text.progress: We need the final piece of the Heart!
text.completion: Well done! I will take Auch'naaru to Auchindoun. The Shadow Council has no place in our lands.
text.completed: Return to Restalaan in Telmor.

english.title: The Final Piece
english.objectives: Take Auch'naaru from Vorpil Ribcleaver in Telmor.
english.description: I am too injured to fight, $c. I have failed my city and its people. This battle is yours.$B$BVorpil waits just ahead. He's trying to use Auch'naaru's powers for some sort of dark ritual.$B$BYou must do what I could not. Cut Vorpil down and retrieve Auch'naaru so the Heart of Auchindoun can be whole once more!
english.progress: Нам нужна последняя часть Сердца!
english.completion: Well done! I will take Auch'naaru to Auchindoun. The Shadow Council has no place in our lands.
english.completed: Return to Restalaan in Telmor.

text.title: 噬魂者的入侵
text.objectives: 在泰尔莫用熔炉点燃火把，焚烧$2oa个遗物堆。
text.description: <羊皮纸上潦草地写着一段话。>$B$B泰尔莫陷落了。暗影议会把战死者的遗物堆在一起，把他们的灵魂献给自己的首领。我的手上满是鲜血……$B$B要是有人能看到这张字条的话，请务必将死者的遗物焚化，以免被敌人利用……$B$B——卫兵队长瑞斯塔兰
text.progress: Ресталаан был бы рад узнать, что его волю исполнили.
text.completion: The souls of the citizens of Telmor will no longer be used to empower the Shadow Council leader.
text.completed: Speak to Restalaan in Telmor.

english.title: Invasion of the Soul Eaters
english.objectives: Use torches from a forge to burn $2oa body piles in Telmor.
english.description: <The note is scrawled hurriedly across the parchment.>$B$BTelmor is lost. The Shadow Council is dragging our fallen into piles and feeding the souls to their leader. There is blood on my hands...$B$BPlease, if anyone reads this message, burn the bodies of our fallen so our enemy cannot use them.$B$B- Restalaan, Captain of the Guard
english.progress: Ресталаан был бы рад узнать, что его волю исполнили.
english.completion: The souls of the citizens of Telmor will no longer be used to empower the Shadow Council leader.
english.completed: Speak to Restalaan in Telmor.

text.description: I have Hansel directing our counter-fire against the Iron Horde's war machines.$B$BI need to know what's going on and why some of the orcs slipped through. He's down the hill to the north.

text.title: Build Us A Backdoor
text.objectives: Help Nightstalker find a weak spot in the Stonemaul Slave Camp walls.
text.description: According to the prisoner here, the Stonemaul ogres are providing slaves and supplies to the Iron Horde. No creature should live a life in chains! And to add insult to injury, Orgrim Doomhammer is here to discuss terms with them!$b$bI sent my wolf Nightstalker ahead to find a weakness. If there is another way in, he will find it.$b$BGo, find my wolf near walls of the Stonemaul camp south of here. Test their defenses.$b$bIf you cannot find us a way in, then make one.
text.completed: Speak with Durotan at the Stonemaul Slave Camp in Gorgrond.

english.title: Build Us A Backdoor
english.objectives: Help Nightstalker find a weak spot in the Stonemaul Slave Camp walls.
english.description: According to the prisoner here, the Stonemaul ogres are providing slaves and supplies to the Iron Horde. No creature should live a life in chains! And to add insult to injury, Orgrim Doomhammer is here to discuss terms with them!$b$bI sent my wolf Nightstalker ahead to find a weakness. If there is another way in, he will find it.$b$BGo, find my wolf near walls of the Stonemaul camp south of here. Test their defenses.$b$bIf you cannot find us a way in, then make one.
english.completed: Speak with Durotan at the Stonemaul Slave Camp in Gorgrond.

text.title: We Are Leaving!
text.description: We have who we came for. Find the others. Tell them to get back to the caravan as soon as possible.$b$bIt will not be long before the ogres figure out how few of us there actually are. We will wait for you at the front gates.

english.title: We Are Leaving!
english.description: We have who we came for. Find the others. Tell them to get back to the caravan as soon as possible.$b$bIt will not be long before the ogres figure out how few of us there actually are. We will wait for you at the front gates.

text.title: 需要更多牙齿
text.objectives: 收集$1oa颗腐臭的棕黑食人魔牙齿。
text.description: <流浪者萨沙默默伸出手，拿出了一条用脏污皮革和腐臭的棕黑食人魔牙齿制成的项链，上面带有一股浓浓的腐烂气味。>$b$b<项链上有几处绳结，似乎少掉了几颗牙齿。>
text.progress: <Prowler Sasha stares at you with cold, merciless eyes.>
text.completion: <Prowler Sasha nods and assembles two necklaces.>
text.completed: Return to Prowler Sasha in the Stonemaul Slave Camp of Gorgrond.

english.title: Need More Teeth
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Putrid Brown Ogre Teeth.
english.description: <Prowler Sasha silently holds out his hand to reveal a necklace crafted of stained leather and putrid brown ogre teeth. All have a matching tone of rot to them.>$b$b<It has several knots that appear to be missing additional teeth.>
english.progress: <Prowler Sasha stares at you with cold, merciless eyes.>
english.completion: < Marauder Sasha nods and weaves two necklaces>
english.completed: Return to Prowler Sasha in the Stonemaul Slave Camp of Gorgrond.

text.title: 永世不忘
text.objectives: 去泰尔莫找回泰尔莫花名册、奥金尼祈祷书和叶之影。
text.description: 我们只得带上能抢救出来的一切逃离泰尔莫。$B$B有人破坏了叶之影的遮蔽力场，尽管我不知道是谁干的，但我怀疑可能是我们自己人。$B$B恢复生计并不难，但我们绝不能丢掉那些神圣的遗物。$B$B如果你能做到的话，就把叶之影、我们的花名册和祈祷书找到，并送到安全的地方。
text.progress: Some things are worth fighting for, $R. These are such things.
text.completion: With these, we can account for our fallen and rebuild. We will persevere.
text.completed: Return to Defender Artaal outside Telmor.

english.title: Never Forget
english.objectives: Recover the Telmor Registry, the Auchenai Prayerbook, and Leafshadow in Telmor.
english.description: We had to escape Telmor with what few we could save.$B$BSomeone disabled Leafshadow's cloaking field; I know not who, but I suspect it had to have been one of our own.$B$BWe will retrieve our livelihoods in time, but we cannot risk losing our sacred artifacts.$B$BIf you are able, bring Leafshadow, our town registry, and our prayerbook to safety.
english.progress: Некоторые вещи стоят того, чтобы за них бороться, |3-6($r).
english.completion: With these, we can account for our fallen and rebuild. We will persevere.
english.completed: Return to Defender Artaal outside Telmor.

text.title: The Shard of Shadows
text.objectives: Take the Shard of Shadows from Vorpil Ribcleaver in Telmor.
text.description: The entire thing was a damned distraction!$B$BWhile we were dealing with matters in the hollow, Teron'gor's forces launched an attack on Telmor to the west and slaughtered the entire town!$B$B$n, we already have two of the three shards of the key to Auchindoun. I refuse to let these savages have the third shard, let them devour my people or let Teron'gor devour more souls and grow stronger still.$B$BYou know what to do. Find the assault's leader and take the shard from his lifeless corpse!
text.completed: Speak to Lady Liadrin at Hub 3.

english.objectives: Take the Shard of Shadows from Vorpil Ribcleaver in Telmor.
english.description: The entire thing was a damned distraction!$B$BWhile we were dealing with matters in the hollow, Teron'gor's forces launched an attack on Telmor to the west and slaughtered the entire town!$B$B$n, we already have two of the three shards of the key to Auchindoun. I refuse to let these savages have the third shard, let them devour my people or let Teron'gor devour more souls and grow stronger still.$B$BYou know what to do. Find the assault's leader and take the shard from his lifeless corpse!
english.completed: Speak to Lady Liadrin at Hub 3.

text.title: Invasion of the Soul Eaters
text.objectives: Use torches from a forge to burn $2oa body piles in Telmor.
text.description: <The note is scrawled hurriedly across the parchment.>$B$BTelmor is lost. The Bonechewer orcs have allied with demons.$B$BThe orcs are eating our dead and feeding the souls to their leader. There is blood on my hands...$B$BPlease, if anyone reads this message, burn the bodies of our fallen so our enemy cannot use them...$B$B- Restalaan, Captain of the Guard
text.completed: Speak to Restalaan in Telmor.

english.title: Invasion of the Soul Eaters
english.objectives: Use torches from a forge to burn $2oa body piles in Telmor.
english.description: <The note is scrawled hurriedly across the parchment.>$B$BTelmor is lost. The Bonechewer orcs have allied with demons.$B$BThe orcs are eating our dead and feeding the souls to their leader. There is blood on my hands...$B$BPlease, if anyone reads this message, burn the bodies of our fallen so our enemy cannot use them...$B$B- Restalaan, Captain of the Guard
english.completed: Speak to Restalaan in Telmor.

text.title: Never Forget
text.objectives: Recover the Telmor Registry and Leafshadow in Telmor.
text.description: If you are reading this, I may have passed.$B$BOrc raids have become more frequent near Telmor, and other cities across the land have reported similarly.$B$BI fear the drums of war may soon echo through these woods. Should such travesty befall the good people of Telmor, I have but one request.$B$BBring Leafshadow, our town's sacred crystal, and our town registry to safety, so we may account for our fallen and keep them safe.$B$B- Guard Captain Restalaan
text.completed: Speak to Restalaan in Telmor.

english.title: Never Forget
english.objectives: Recover the Telmor Registry and Leafshadow in Telmor.
english.description: If you are reading this, I may have passed.$B$BOrc raids have become more frequent near Telmor, and other cities across the land have reported similarly.$B$BI fear the drums of war may soon echo through these woods. Should such travesty befall the good people of Telmor, I have but one request.$B$BBring Leafshadow, our town's sacred crystal, and our town registry to safety, so we may account for our fallen and keep them safe.$B$B- Guard Captain Restalaan
english.completed: Speak to Restalaan in Telmor.

text.title: 觉醒的暗影
text.objectives: 与耐奥祖对决。
text.description: 我们设法将耐奥祖困在了观星台里，但他还带走了不少人。$B$B他囚禁了伊瑞尔的姐妹萨玛拉。$B$B我得留下驻守阵地。拜托了，尽你所能把她救出来，英雄。
text.completion: Your aid in retaking Teluuna Observatory has not gone unnoticed, hero. I grow increasingly impressed at your prowess in battle.$B$BPerhaps you could share some of your knowledge with my disciples. They could learn much from a seasoned adventurer such as yourself.$B$BI have something for you, as a thanks for what you've done even in the short time you've been here. Perhaps it will help you get this garrison of yours on its feet.
text.completed: Speak to Prophet Velen at Embaari Village.

english.title: Shadows Awaken
english.objectives: Confront Ner'zhul.
english.description: We've managed to pin Ner'zhul inside the Observatory, but he's taken many down with him.$B$BHe has taken Yrel's sister, Samaara.$B$BI am needed to hold the line here. Please, do whatever you can to save her, hero.
english.completion: Your aid in retaking Teluuna Observatory has not gone unnoticed, hero. I grow increasingly impressed at your prowess in battle.$B$BPerhaps you could share some of your knowledge with my disciples. They could learn much from a seasoned adventurer such as yourself.$B$BI have something for you, as a thanks for what you've done even in the short time you've been here. Perhaps it will help you get this garrison of yours on its feet.
english.completed: Speak to Prophet Velen at Embaari Village.

text.title: Fungal Heart
text.objectives: Collect 3 Fungal Hearts.
text.description: The second ingredient I will need for the elixir is harder to obtain.$B$BAlong the river roam Marsh Giants - fungal monstrosities whose hunger is never sated. I will need three of their hearts.$B$BThe stronger the heart, the more potent the mixture, and the clearer my vision.
text.completed: Return to Prophet Velen at Twilight Glade in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Fungal Heart
english.objectives: Collect 3 Fungal Hearts.
english.description: The second ingredient I will need for the elixir is harder to obtain.$B$BAlong the river roam Marsh Giants - fungal monstrosities whose hunger is never sated. I will need three of their hearts.$B$BThe stronger the heart, the more potent the mixture, and the clearer my vision.
english.completed: Return to Prophet Velen at Twilight Glade in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 要塞战役：地震问题
text.objectives: 在你的要塞与初级勘测员多恩谈一谈。
text.description: 我们的一位初级勘测员一直在跟我胡扯什么异常地震活动。我实在很难相信，我们居然那么巧，刚好把堡垒建在了什么断层线上——我们事先可是再三检查过的！$B$B你能找他谈谈吗？
text.completion: Ach! $GSir:Miss; $p, ye've arrived just in time!
text.completed: 在你的要塞与初级勘测员多恩谈一谈。

english.title: Garrison Campaign: Seismic Matters
english.objectives: Speak with Jr. Surveyor Dorn at your garrison.
english.description: One of our junior surveyors has been harassing me about unusual seismic activity. I find it hard to believe that we accidentally built on some kind of fault line - we triple checked!$B$BCan you have a word with him?
english.completion: Ach! $GSir:Miss; $p, ye've arrived just in time!
english.completed: Speak with Jr. Surveyor Dorn at your garrison.

text.title: 地震数据
text.objectives: 在你的要塞里使用地震追踪器。
text.description: 没错，我们确实在建造之前再三检查过这个地方。当时地下深处就连一丁点动静也没有。$B$B可今天突然传来了隆隆声，而且距离我们越来越近了！我要告诉你的是这地方不太对劲！$B$B你可以不相信我说的话——反正地震追踪器就快完成数据收集了。你自己看看吧！
text.completion: I KNEW somethin' was wrong! IN YER FACE, Alexston!$B$BAh, excuse me.$B$BNow, where have I seen machines like this before?$B$BOh yeah! The Dark Iron!
text.completed: Speak with Jr. Surveyor Dorn in your garrison.

english.title: Groundbreaking Data
english.objectives: Use the Tremor-Tracker in your garrison.
english.description: Aye, we triple-checked the site before we set up here. Nary a peep from the ol' earthly deep.$B$BBut there's been rumblin's today, and they're gettin' closer! I tell ya somethin' ain't right!$B$BYe don't have to take my word for it - the Tremor-Tracker is just about finished collecting data. Check it out an' see fer yerself!
english.completion: I KNEW somethin' was wrong! IN YER FACE, Alexston!$B$BAh, excuse me.$B$BNow, where have I seen machines like this before?$B$BOh yeah! The Dark Iron!
english.completed: Speak with Jr. Surveyor Dorn in your garrison.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成地震追踪器的数据分析

text.title: 看上去很眼熟……
text.objectives: 在戈尔隆德找到塞林的车间。
text.description: 那么钢铁部落究竟要利用黑铁科技干什么呢？我知道该去问谁了！$B$B塞林·暗砧是来自黑铁氏族的天才工程师，他一直在德拉诺协助我们。你也许已经在旅途中见过他了吧？$B$B听说他在戈尔隆德的某个地方造了座地堡，其实就是一个秘密车间。要是你能找到他的话，他或许对这件事情略知一二。$B$B呃，记得要多加小心，黑铁氏族眼下也许是我们的盟友，但我对他们的信任也就那样了。
text.completion: Mmf! Mm- mff!!$B$B<You remove his gag.>$B$BTHEY GOT THAELIN!!
text.completed: Speak with Hansel Heavyhands at Thaelin's Workshop in Gorgrond.

english.title: These Look Familiar...
english.objectives: Find Thaelin's Workshop in Gorgrond.
english.description: So what is the Iron Horde doing with Dark Iron technology? I know who ta ask!$B$BThaelin Darkanvil is a genius engineer from the Dark Iron clan who's been helping us here on Draenor. You may have already met him in yer travels, eh?$B$BWord is he set up a bunker somewhere in Gorgrond, a secret workshop so-to-speak. If ye can find him, he may know somethin' about this.$B$BEr, and be cautious, eh? The Dark Iron may be our allies now, but I trust 'em about as far as I can throw 'em.
english.completion: Mmf! Mm- mff!!$B$B<You remove his gag.>$B$BTHEY GOT THAELIN!!
english.completed: Speak with Hansel Heavyhands at Thaelin's Workshop in Gorgrond.

text.title: 原型
text.objectives: 使用钻探机样机寻找塞林·暗砧。
text.description: 几天前，一群钢铁部落兽人到这里劫走了塞林。他们之所以还没除掉我，是想用我来威胁塞林，好让他跟他们合作。$B$B我也不知道他们把他带到哪儿去了，但我知道应该怎么去找他。$B$B塞林总是随身带着一个追踪装置——别问我他把它藏在哪里。他制作的任何会移动的东西，都带有一个“到爸爸这儿来”的按钮，命令它们向他的所在位置移动。$B$B现在想想，要是按下移动炸弹上的这个按钮，无疑会把主人害死……但对于钻探机来说却是个不错的功能！跳进去，我们出发吧！
text.completion: Close enough!
text.completed: Speak with Hansel Heavyhands in the Iron Siegeworks.

english.title: The Prototype
english.objectives: Use the Prototype Mole Machine to look for Thaelin Darkanvil.
english.description: A few days ago a bunch of Iron Horde orcs showed up and kidnapped Thaelin. They've been keeping me alive as collateral to make sure he cooperates.$B$BI don't know where they took him, but I know how to get us there.$B$BThaelin keeps a tracking device on him at all times - don't ask where he hides it. Anything he makes that can move has a "Come to Papa" button that sends it straight to him.$B$BIn retrospect, not a great feature for the walking bombs... but perfect for the mole machine! Jump in and let's go!
english.completion: Close enough!
english.completed: Speak with Hansel Heavyhands in the Iron Siegeworks.

text.title: 被抓走的工程师
text.objectives: 在钢铁军工厂里找到塞林·暗砧。
text.description: 啊……真抱歉，$p，可我已经没力气战斗了。他们虽然没有杀死我，但也只不过给我留了口气罢了。$B$B你去找塞林吧，我会留下照看钻探机。他应该就在附近！
text.completion: $p! Oh, yer a sight for sore eyes!$B$BThe prototype mole machine was able to track me here all the way from the shop? I even impress myself sometimes.$B$BNow that I know Hansel is safe, I can enact the brilliant escape plan I've been working on. Glad to have ye here for this!
text.completed: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil in the Iron Siegeworks.

english.title: The Captive Engineer
english.objectives: Find Thaelin Darkanvil in the Iron Siegeworks.
english.description: Argh... I'm sorry, $p, but I'm too weak to fight. They kept me alive, but just barely.$B$BI'll keep an eye on the mole machine while you look for Thaelin. He should be somewhere close!
english.completion: $p! Oh, yer a sight for sore eyes!$B$BThe prototype mole machine was able to track me here all the way from the shop? I even impress myself sometimes.$B$BNow that I know Hansel is safe, I can enact the brilliant escape plan I've been working on. Glad to have ye here for this!
english.completed: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil in the Iron Siegeworks.

text.title: 临别赠礼
text.objectives: 在钢铁军工厂里放置$1oa枚黑铁地雷。
text.description: 钢铁部落就这么想要我的发明？那我们就给他们留点吧。$B$B这些小美人儿会把坦克的踏板给炸下来，还能让坦克的履带化成尘埃。让我们看看她们的表现，并带着他们的劣质大炮离开这里吧！
text.completion: For the record, the mines don't have any voice commands.$B$BI learned that lesson awhile back...
text.completed: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil in the Iron Siegeworks.

english.title: Something to Remember Me By
english.objectives: Place $1oa Dark Iron Mines in the Iron Siegeworks.
english.description: The Iron Horde want my inventions so bad? Then we'll leave some behind.$B$BThese little beauties will blow the treads clear off a tank AND melt her chassis into the dirt. Let's see them try and drive their shoddy cannons out of this place!
english.completion: For the record, the mines don't have any voice commands.$B$BI learned that lesson awhile back...
english.completed: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil in the Iron Siegeworks.

text.title: 绝密资料
text.objectives: 从钢铁军工厂的黑铁领主身上找到塞林的笔记本。
text.description: 钢铁部落洗劫了我的车间之后，我并不是他们带走的唯一战利品。$B$B负责指挥这次行动的黑锤领主就是个疯子，竟然把我的笔记本据为己有。$B$B里面记录着制造技术、新发明的设计图和一些见不得人的涂鸦。$B$B那本簿子里记满了我的秘密！$B$B你能帮我把它找回来吗？
text.progress: That book has my working notes from the last five years. It's too dangerous to leave behind!
text.completion: Aye, there she is.$B$BThank you, $p. Let's get out of here, shall we?
text.completed: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil in the Iron Siegeworks.
text.giverWindow: 从技术上讲，他那把锤子应该是煤灰色。但没人有胆量指出这一点。

english.title: Privileged Information
english.objectives: Loot Thaelin's Notebook from Overlord Blackhammer in the Iron Siegeworks.
english.description: I'm not the only prize the Iron Horde brought back after raiding my workshop.$B$BOverlord Blackhammer, the maniac in charge of this operation, took my notebook as his own personal treasure.$B$BManufacturing techniques; schematics for new inventions; embarrassing doodles.$B$BIt's got all my secrets!$B$BCan I count on you to help me get it back?
english.progress: That book has my working notes from the last five years. It's too dangerous to leave behind!
english.completion: Aye, there she is.$B$BThank you, $p. Let's get out of here, shall we?
english.completed: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil in the Iron Siegeworks.
english.giverWindow: Technically, his hammer is more of a charcoal color. Nobody has dared to correct him.

text.title: 你搭乘的钻探机
text.objectives: 带塞林·暗砧去找钢铁军工厂里的汉瑟尔·重拳。
text.description: 我想我们已经让汉瑟尔等得够久了。你能带我去找他吗？然后我们一起坐钻探机离开这地方。
text.completion: So I guess it's safe to say my old workshop is compromised. We'll have to find a new place to set up shop...
text.completed: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil in your garrison. You may use the Prototype Mole Machine for a ride there.

english.title: And The Mole You Rode In On
english.objectives: Bring Thaelin Darkanvil to Hansel Heavyhands in the Iron Siegeworks.
english.description: I think we've kept Hansel waiting long enough. Can you take me to him? Then we can all hitch a ride out of here on the mole machine.
english.completion: So I guess it's safe to say my old workshop is compromised. We'll have to find a new place to set up shop...
english.completed: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil in your garrison. You may use the Prototype Mole Machine for a ride there.

text.title: 要塞战役：加工机械
text.objectives: 在雷霆小径附近把加兹鲁维的报酬交给加兹鲁维。
text.description: 指挥官！据驻守在雷霆小径的霜狼兽人报告，从峡谷里传出了刺耳的可怕噪音。我们怀疑那可能是钢铁部落的某种战争机器。$B$B加兹鲁维已经答应去调查一下，但他要收奖金。这群该死的地精！快去雷霆小径找他，把酬劳交给他吧。
text.progress: Yo! You got the dough?
text.completion: <Gazlowe's face brightens as you hand over the bulging bag of coins.>$B$BHeyyy! Now we're talking!$B$BI usually prefer not to get my hands dirty, but for that kind of cash you could get me to field-strip a kor'kron outhouse.$B$BGlad to have some muscle here to back me up - and since I'm such a nice guy, here's a little somethin' for your troubles.
text.completed: Deliver Gazlowe's Payment to Gazlowe near Thunder Pass.

english.title: Garrison Campaign: Grinding Gears
english.objectives: Deliver Gazlowe's Payment to Gazlowe near Thunder Pass.
english.description: Commanda! Da Frostwolf orcs at Thunder Pass have reported a horrible grinding noise boomin' tru da canyon. We suspect it's some kind of Iron Horde war machine.$B$BGazlowe has agreed ta investigate, but he be wantin' a cash bonus. Goblins! Meet wit him at Thunder Pass and deliver dis payment.
english.progress: Yo! You got the dough?
english.completion: <Gazlowe's face brightens as you hand over the bulging bag of coins.>$B$BHeyyy! Now we're talking!$B$BI usually prefer not to get my hands dirty, but for that kind of cash you could get me to field-strip a kor'kron outhouse.$B$BGlad to have some muscle here to back me up - and since I'm such a nice guy, here's a little somethin' for your troubles.
english.completed: Deliver Gazlowe's Payment to Gazlowe near Thunder Pass.

text.title: 对付钻机我在行！
text.objectives: 帮助加兹鲁维破坏钢铁挖掘机。
text.description: 那确实是台机器。是个钻机——而且是个大钻机！幸运的是，我们其实不用把那台机器整个拆掉。$B$B它们靠的是压力感应系统，用一对增压器把额外的压力输送到引擎里。一旦没有了压力，钻机就毫无用处了。$B$B进去拨开钻机背面的离合器。那可以将他们的注意力从涡轮上引开。$B$B我负责解决涡轮——你只要干掉那些嗜血的兽人就可以了。
text.completion: Ya know... this thing is actually pretty impressive.$B$BThe drive system seems... familiar...
text.completed: Speak with Gazlowe in Thunder Pass.

english.title: I Know The Drill!
english.objectives: Help Gazlowe sabotage the Iron Stonegrinder.
english.description: It's a machine alright. A drill - a BIG one! Fortunately, we don't have to take apart the whole thing.$B$BThey're relying on forced induction, using twin superchargers to pipe extra boost into the engine. Without that boost, the drill is useless.$B$BGet in there and open the clutch on the back of the drill. That'll draw some attention away from the turbines.$B$BI'll take care of the turbines - you just worry about the hordes of bloodthirsty orcs.
english.completion: Ya know... this thing is actually pretty impressive.$B$BThe drive system seems... familiar...
english.completed: Speak with Gazlowe in Thunder Pass.

text.title: 通缉：黑锤领主
text.objectives: 在钢铁军工厂里消灭黑锤领主。
text.description: 那么，我们现在可以走了。我们达到了自己的目的，我甚至还做了件小小的善事，帮塞林逃了出去。$B$B但还有一个问题没有解决。$B$B<加兹鲁维举起了一张纸片，上面画着一个长得特别邪恶的兽人。>$B$B这是军情七处的悬赏通缉令，目标是一位黑锤领主。他正好管理着这个工厂。你去帮我干掉他吧，我会给你酬劳的。然后我再把他的脑袋交给联盟领取赏金。这样的话所有人都不吃亏！$B$B呃，我是说除了黑锤之外的所有人。
text.completion: <Gazlowe fishes around in his pouch before producing a single gold piece.>$B$BErr... looks like I'm a little short. Personal bodyguard fees really add up!$B$BI'll give you a proper cut when we get back to your garrison. Come on, you know I'm good for it!
text.completed: Speak with Gazlowe in the Iron Siegeworks.
text.giverWindow: 技术上讲，他那把锤子应该是煤灰色。但没人有胆量指出这一点。

english.title: Wanted: Overlord Blackhammer
english.objectives: Slay Overlord Blackhammer in the Iron Siegeworks.
english.description: So, we COULD just leave now. We got what we came for, and I even did a little charity work to help Thaelin escape.$B$BBut there's also this.$B$B<Gazlowe holds up a scrap of paper showing a hand-drawn depiction of an especially mean looking orc.>$B$BIt's an SI:7 bounty for one Overlord Blackhammer, who just happens to operate out of this very facility. You help me take him out, I pay you. Then I take his head to the Alliance and collect on the bounty. Everyone wins!$B$BWell, everyone except for Blackhammer.
english.completion: <Gazlowe fishes around in his pouch before producing a single gold piece.>$B$BErr... looks like I'm a little short. Personal bodyguard fees really add up!$B$BI'll give you a proper cut when we get back to your garrison. Come on, you know I'm good for it!
english.completed: Speak with Gazlowe in the Iron Siegeworks.
english.giverWindow: Technically, his hammer is more of a charcoal color. Nobody has dared to correct him.

text.title: 制作者的款识
text.objectives: 在钢铁军工厂检查5个攻城零件。
text.description: 我不明白——钢铁部落大部分破烂的先进程度仅限于给戈隆加装火炮而已。即便是这台钻机本身也没什么特别的。可那个感应系统却是件艺术品……$B$B这根本不合常理！$B$B我绞尽脑汁也还是一头雾水，我得查清楚这东西究竟是谁制作出来的。我想到钢铁军工厂里面看看他们还藏了些什么。<加兹鲁维拍了拍他系在腰带上的钱袋。>$B$B你怎么说？愿意当我的保镖吗？
text.completion: That's Darkanvil's signature! I knew I'd seen that work somewhere before.$B$BThaelin Darkanvil is a Dark Iron dwarf who came to Draenor with the Alliance forces, and a damn brilliant engineer. We have what you might call a friendly rivalry.$B$BBut why's Thaelin making weapons for the Iron Horde?
text.completed: Speak with Gazlowe in the Iron Siegeworks.

english.title: Maker's Mark
english.objectives: Inspect 5 Siege Parts in the Iron Siegeworks.
english.description: I don't get it - most of the Iron Horde junk is about as advanced as strapping cannons to a gronn. Even the drill itself is nothing special. But that induction system was a work of art...$B$BThis don't add up at all!$B$BDespite my better judgment, I gotta find out who made this. I wanna look at more of what they got in the Iron Siegeworks, see if anything's been signed.$B$B<Gazlowe pats the sack of coins on his belt.>$B$BWhaddaya say? Wanna be my bodyguard?
english.completion: That's Darkanvil's signature! I knew I'd seen that work somewhere before.$B$BThaelin Darkanvil is a Dark Iron dwarf who came to Draenor with the Alliance forces, and a damn brilliant engineer. We have what you might call a friendly rivalry.$B$BBut why's Thaelin making weapons for the Iron Horde?
english.completed: Speak with Gazlowe in the Iron Siegeworks.

text.title: 顺手牵羊
text.objectives: 从钢铁军工厂里偷取一个黑石齿轮、一罐压缩气泉瓦斯和一个碳霜烈焰核心。
text.description: 我得承认，即便是对我来说，在错误的时间建立起一条通往原始世界的供给链也是十分困难的。我得想办法，呃，从“本地资源”着手。$B$B不管你想对钢铁部落做什么，在原材料的问题上，都是有关联的！在钢铁军工厂里注意寻找一些更有价值的货物。我准备了几只火箭鸡，可以用它们把那些好东西送到你的要塞里去。
text.completion: Not a bad haul. Here's yer cut!
text.completed: Speak with Gazlowe in the Iron Siegeworks.

english.title: Four Finger Discount
english.objectives: Steal a Blackrock Cog, Condensed Geyser Gas, and a Carbonfrost Flamecore from the Iron Siegeworks.
english.description: I gotta admit, establishing a supply chain to a primal world on the wrong side of time is tough, even for me. Gotta make due with, uh... "locally sourced" goods.$B$BSay what you want about the Iron Horde, but when it comes to raw materials, they got connections!$B$BKeep an eye out for some of the more valuable goods in the Iron Siegeworks. I packed a few rocket chickens we can use to send the good stuff back to your garrison.
english.completion: Not a bad haul. Here's yer cut!
english.completed: Speak with Gazlowe in the Iron Siegeworks.

text.title: 齿轮发烧友
text.objectives: 在钢铁军工厂里找到塞林·暗砧。
text.description: 这一定不是塞林卖给他们的。决不可能！他们肯定是把他关在这附近了。$B$B快来，$p。我知道他跟联盟在一起，而且我也明白你跟联盟是死对头，可我们都不愿意让他的作品落在钢铁部落的手里——相信我！
text.completion: Don't worry, Thaelin can handle himself. That was my good deed for the year - don't tell nobody!$B$BHey... you think I can write off that fuel as a business expense?
text.completed: Speak with Gazlowe in the Iron Siegeworks.

english.title: A Fellow Gearhead
english.objectives: Find Thaelin Darkanvil in the Iron Siegeworks.
english.description: There's no way Thaelin sold out. NO way! They gotta be holdin' him here somewhere.$B$BCome on, $p. I know he's with the Alliance, and I know they aren't your favorite people, but we do NOT want the Iron Horde having access to his work - trust me!
english.completion: Don't worry, Thaelin can handle himself. That was my good deed for the year - don't tell nobody!$B$BHey... you think I can write off that fuel as a business expense?
english.completed: Speak with Gazlowe in the Iron Siegeworks.

text.title: 至黑之夜
text.objectives: 到痛楚堡垒与先知维伦谈一谈。
text.description: 这枚钥石可以让携带者进入痛楚堡垒。$B$B拿着它到影月要塞外面与先知维伦见面吧。$B$B他打算正面迎战耐奥祖。
text.completion: Good, you've arrived. Rulkan's message said that you would not be long.

english.title: Darkest Night
english.objectives: Speak to Prophet Velen at Anguish Fortress.
english.description: This keystone will grant its bearer entry into Anguish Fortress.$B$BTake it and meet Prophet Velen outside the Shadowmoon fortress.$B$BHe intends to face Ner'zhul head-on.
english.completion: Good, you've arrived. Rulkan's message said that you would not be long.

text.title: 钻探机，回家吧
text.objectives: 从钢铁军工厂里将5台钻探机送回家。
text.description: 我的“到爸爸这儿来”专利语音指令还只是第一步。$B$B我还给所有钻探机输入了“回家”的程序命令，可自动钻探到预设地点——我在戈尔隆德的车间！$B$B我们赶快把钻探机都送回家吧，千万别让那群兽人用口臭和沾满汗渍的……皮裤把它们都熏臭了！$B$B<你听到塞林略微作呕了一下。>$B$B啊呸！
text.completion: There, my beauties are safely out of the hands of the Iron Horde. No more orcs poppin' out of the ground!$B$BThere's just one more thing I need to do before I can leave with a clear conscience.
text.completed: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil in the Iron Siegeworks.

english.title: "Mole Machine, Go Home"
english.objectives: Send 5 Mole Machines home from the Iron Siegeworks.
english.description: My patented "Come to Papa" voice command was only the first step.$B$BI also programmed all of my mole machines with a "Go Home" command that'll send 'em auto-diggin' to a pre-determined location - my workshop in Gorgrond!$B$BLet's send the mole machines home before the orcs stink 'em all up with their stupid breath and their sweaty... leather... thongs.$B$B<You hear Thaelin gagging a little from inside The Suit.>$B$BBlech!
english.completion: There, my beauties are safely out of the hands of the Iron Horde. No more orcs poppin' out of the ground!$B$BThere's just one more thing I need to do before I can leave with a clear conscience.
english.completed: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil in the Iron Siegeworks.

text.title: 月之阴暗面
text.objectives: 找到耐奥祖。
text.description: <先知维伦的声音还在继续。>$B$B我和伊瑞尔发现了督军耐奥祖的下落。他正在俯瞰痛楚堡垒的那座最高的祭坛上跟格罗玛什·地狱咆哮会面。$B$B到那找我们吧。我们必须阻止他。
text.completion: We saved everyone we could, $n. We were too late for the others... including my sister.$b$bProphet Velen is right. When it is asked of us, we ALL must fight. I promise this: I will never again let my loved ones suffer.$b$bNer'zhul is close to calling down the Dark Star. We are the only ones who can stop him.
text.completed: Return to Yrel at Embaari Village.

english.title: The Dark Side of the Moon
english.objectives: Find Ner'zhul.
english.description: <Prophet Velen's voice continues.>$B$BYrel and I have located Warlord Ner'zhul. He is meeting with Grommash Hellscream atop the highest altar overlooking Anguish Fortress.$B$BMeet us there. We must stop him.
english.completion: We saved everyone we could, $n. We were too late for the others... including my sister.$b$bProphet Velen is right. When it is asked of us, we ALL must fight. I promise this: I will never again let my loved ones suffer.$b$bNer'zhul is close to calling down the Dark Star. We are the only ones who can stop him.
english.completed: Return to Yrel at Embaari Village.

objectiveDetails.description: 在众星平台上找到维伦和伊瑞尔

text.title: Origin Unknown
text.objectives: Slay $1oa Voidborne Errants in Waning Crescent. Afterwards, shut down the portal in Waning Crescent.
text.description: For my first field assignment, I would say I'm doing quite well!$B$BI've discovered a strange portal in this cave that has unleashed a number of equally strange void creatures, and there's no clear reason why! Fascinating, isn't it?$B$BScientific inquiry aside, these things may be benign right now, but at the rate they're pulling energy in that won't last long.$B$BI need you to take them out, send their essences back to... wherever it is they came from, and shut down that portal!
text.completed: Return to Field Researcher Alduuri in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.objectives: Slay $1oa Voidborne Errants in Waning Crescent. Afterwards, shut down the portal in Waning Crescent.

english.completed: Return to Field Researcher Alduuri in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] Keeping Calm
text.objectives: Find Kaduz in the Cave of Spirits below Palemoon Village and rescue him from Ner'zhul's agent.
text.description: My husband, one of our shaman, went to the ritual cave just below the village to seek the advice of our ancestors.$B$BJust before you arrived I heard sounds of fighting coming up from there. I fear that one of Ner'zhul's agents has attacked him!$B$BPlease, will you go find him and return him home safely?
text.completed: Return to Dulga in Palemoon Village.

text.title: Enemies Above
text.objectives: Speak with Scout Ruk'gan near the Bones of Agurak.
text.description: We have dealt a crushing blow to the Thunderlords with the death of the Iron Wolf $n, but we can not rest yet.$B$BThe Thunderlord generals will be fighting like caged wolves to maintain their place in the Iron Horde and that means bad news for us.$b$bI sent Scout Ruk'gan to keep an eye on their movements but he hasn't reported back for some time now. If you would help us then seek out Ruk'gan. $B$B Lok'tar $n!

english.title: Enemies Above
english.objectives: Speak with Scout Ruk'gan near the Bones of Agurak.
english.description: We have dealt a crushing blow to the Thunderlords with the death of the Iron Wolf $n, but we can not rest yet.$B$BThe Thunderlord generals will be fighting like caged wolves to maintain their place in the Iron Horde and that means bad news for us.$b$bI sent Scout Ruk'gan to keep an eye on their movements but he hasn't reported back for some time now. If you would help us then seek out Ruk'gan. $B$B Lok'tar $n!

text.title: The Search For Drogguk
text.objectives: Find Drogguk in the Iron March.
text.description: Drogguk has taken it upon himself to watch the Iron Horde's movement to ensure they do not find our village.$B$BIt has been two days and he has not yet returned. If you are willing, I would ask that you seek him out and bring him home. His family worries.$B$BHe tends to make his post roughly southeast of here.

english.title: The Search For Drogguk
english.objectives: Find Drogguk in the Iron March.
english.description: Drogguk has taken it upon himself to watch the Iron Horde's movement to ensure they do not find our village.$B$BIt has been two days and he has not yet returned. If you are willing, I would ask that you seek him out and bring him home. His family worries.$B$BHe tends to make his post roughly southeast of here.

text.title: 野蛮复仇
text.objectives: 在霜火岭的阿古拉克之骨消灭10个钢铁雷霆卫士。
text.description: 雷神氏族真是个祸患，$n。$b$b<鲁甘厌恶地啐了一口。>$b$b我的女儿格里施纳被那些怪物杀死了。现在惟有他们的鲜血才能为我带来安宁。$b$b要是你愿意帮我的话，我需要你去分散他们的注意力，好让我溜到距离他们营地较近的位置。$b$b要是你能顺便干掉几个所谓的“钢铁雷霆卫士”就太完美了。
text.completion: You have done well, $C.$B$BNow before we can continue our assault we need to look for any supplies in the area that could help our fight.
text.completed: Return to Scout Ruk'gan at the Bones of Agurak in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Savage Vengeance
english.objectives: Kill 10 Iron Thunderguards within the Bones of Agurak in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description: The Thunderlord are a blight $n.$b$b<Ruk'gan spits in disgust.>$b$bMy daughter, Grishna, was killed by those monsters. Only their blood will bring me peace now.$b$bIf you would help me then I need you to cause a distraction so I can sneak to a position closer to their camp.$b$bKilling a few of their so called "Iron Thunderguard" would be perfect.
english.completion: Отличная работа, |3-6($c).$b$bПеред тем, как продолжить наступление, надо найти припасы, которые помогли бы нам в бою.
english.completed: Return to Scout Ruk'gan at the Bones of Agurak in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 收集绳子
text.objectives: 从阿古拉克之骨的雷神驯兽师身上收集5卷结实的绳索。
text.description: 这卷绳子非常结实，适合供雷神驯兽师们用来驾驭自己驯服的危险野兽。$b$b再去多找几卷，斥候鲁甘也许用得上它们。
text.progress: I'm growing tired of waiting, do you have anything to help our assault or not?
text.completion: Rope? Do you expect me to tie a noose and ask the Thunderlords to go hang themselves?$B$BWait... that gives me an idea. Yea, I think I can make this work with the right materials.$B$BGood Job.
text.completed: Return to Scout Ruk'gan at the Bones of Agurak in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: A Collection of Coils
english.objectives: Gather 5 Coils of Sturdy Rope from Thunderlord Wranglers in the Bones of Agurak.
english.description: This coil of rope has been woven thick, the better for the Thunderlord Wranglers to handle the dangerous beasts they tame.$b$bScout Ruk'gan might have a use for this and a few more like it.
english.progress: I'm growing tired of waiting, do you have anything to help our assault or not?
english.completion: The rope? What am I supposed to do with it? Tie a noose and tell Thunderbirds to hang themselves? Wait... and I have an idea. Yeah, I think I can find a way to use that rope. Great.
english.completed: Return to Scout Ruk'gan at the Bones of Agurak in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 取彼之矛
text.objectives: 在阿古拉克之骨里收集5根雷神长矛。
text.description: 这根雷神长矛既结实又轻巧。$b$b再去找些来，斥候鲁甘也许会用得上它们。
text.progress: What is it $C? Have you got something for me?
text.completion: Hrm, yes these spears look pretty good.$B$BNot bad! I know just what to use these for!
text.completed: Return to Scout Ruk'gan at the Bones of Agurak in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Getting the Points
english.objectives: Gather 5 Thunderlord Spears within the Bones of Agurak.
english.description: The Thunderlord Spear is extremely light and strong.$b$bScout Ruk'gan might be able to use this and a few more like it.
english.progress: What is it $C? Have you got something for me?
english.completion: Хм, да, эти копья очень хороши.$b$bНеплохо! Я знаю, что можно с ними сделать!
english.completed: Return to Scout Ruk'gan at the Bones of Agurak in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 牵一绳而动全身
text.objectives: 用倒钩鱼叉把5个雷神空骑兵从坐骑上拉下来，并将其消灭。
text.description: 有了你找来的这些长矛和绳子，雷神空骑兵对我们来说就不再遥不可及了。就连他们都将感受到我们的怒火！$b$b我已经把你给我找来的绳子系在了长矛上，做成了一把鱼叉。用它来猎捕在山谷上空飞翔的空骑兵吧。拿上鱼叉，看到他们盘旋而过时就掷过去。要是你瞄得够准，鱼叉上的倒钩应该会牢牢扎在他们身上，你可以直接把骑兵拽到自己面前来！$b$b要是你没能瞄准……呃……尽量不要失手吧。
text.completion: Well done $n! The removal of the Sky Riders takes the heat off us for a bit. Keep your weapon in hand though, we're not done with them yet.
text.completed: Return to Scout Ruk'gan at the Bones of Agurak in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: At the End of Your Rope
english.objectives: Use the Barbed Harpoon to unseat and kill 5 Thunderlord Sky Riders.
english.description: With the spears and rope you gathered the Thunderlord Sky Riders will no longer be out of our reach. Even they will feel our wrath!$b$bI've tied the rope to the spears you brought me to fashion a harpoon. Hunt the Sky Riders that are flying all over the valley. Take the Harpoon and throw it at them as they circle by. If your aim is true the barbs should allow the spear a firm hold allowing you to yank the rider right towards you!$b$bIf your aim is bad... well... try not to miss.
english.completion: Хорошая работа, $n! Наездники больше не угрожают нам. Но не спеши убирать оружие, для тебя еще найдется дело.
english.completed: Return to Scout Ruk'gan at the Bones of Agurak in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: Ending the Gloom
text.objectives: Place Velen's Staff near the arkonite crystal.
text.description: They lied to us about many things. Fortunately the crystal was not one of them.$B$BTake Velen's staff and place it in front of that arkonite crystal. You know the rest.
text.completed: Return to Aklana at Gloomshade Grove in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Ending the Gloom
english.objectives: Place Velen's Staff near the arkonite crystal.
english.description: They lied to us about many things. Fortunately the crystal was not one of them.$B$BTake Velen's staff and place it in front of that arkonite crystal. You know the rest.
english.completed: Return to Aklana at Gloomshade Grove in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 磨沥以须
text.objectives: 从阿古拉克之骨的黑色焦油身上收集5团粘稠的沥青。
text.description: 乌尔戈斯将军是这支雷神军队的首领。他是个懦夫，只会躲在小屋里隔着墙对他的战士们发号施令。$b$b我们得让他知道，他那脆弱的防御根本抵挡不了霜狼氏族的攻势！$b$b我需要一些沥青来实现我的计划。在南边有几个沥青坑，从那里的软泥怪身上收集几团沥青，并把它们带来给我。
text.progress: We need that tar soon $n! Get to it!
text.completion: Ugh, those smell awful! No, I don't need to see them. I'll take you at your word that you have them all.$B$BLet's get a move on before another Thunderlord patrol stumbles upon me.
text.completed: Return to Scout Ruk'gan at the Bones of Agurak in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Tar Get of Opportunity
english.objectives: Gather 5 Globs of Sticky Tar from the Black Tar's in the Bones of Agurak.
english.description: General Vul'gath leads this band of Thunderlord. He is a coward and hides in his hut, yelling orders at his warriors through the walls.$b$bWe will need to show him that his flimsy defenses can not stand against the Frostwolves!$b$bI'll need some tar to carry this out. There are a couple of tar pits to the south, go gather a few globs from the oozes that reside there and bring them to me.
english.progress: We need that tar soon $n! Get to it!
english.completion: Фу, ну и вонища! Нет-нет, не нужно мне их показывать – я охотно поверю тебе на слово.$b$bТеперь давай сматываться отсюда, пока меня не засек очередной патруль Громоборцев.
english.completed: Return to Scout Ruk'gan at the Bones of Agurak in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 烧光它们
text.objectives: 烧毁阿古拉克之陨里的雷神双头飞龙孵化笼。
text.description: 我们现在要开始攻击了，$n！$b$b去阿古拉克之陨，用这些焦油炸弹摧毁他们的双头飞龙孵化箱。$b$b在你执行任务时，我会溜进他们的营地，为我们的下一步进攻做好准备。等你把一切都烧干净之后，就到那里去找我吧。
text.completion: Good job $n, I was able to use the commotion from your work to sneak into the camp.$B$BNow we have only one thing left to do.
text.completed: Return to Scout Ruk'gan hiding within Agurak's Fall.

english.title: Burn Them Down
english.objectives: Burn down the Thunderlord Rylak Incubators within Agurak's Fall.
english.description: Now, we begin our assault, $n!$b$bGet down to Agurak's Fall and use these tarbombs to destroy their rylak egg incubators.$b$bWhile you are busy I will sneak down into their camp and prepare for the next phase of our attack. Meet me there once you have burned everything.
english.completion: Хорошая работа, $n, мне удалось во время неразберихи пробраться в лагерь.$b$bОсталась лишь одна задача.
english.completed: Return to Scout Ruk'gan hiding within Agurak's Fall.

text.title: 乌尔戈斯的末日
text.objectives: 在阿古拉克之陨里击败乌尔戈斯将军。
text.description: 乌尔戈斯的死期到了，$n。他手上沾满了我女儿的鲜血，现在就该让他用自己的鲜血来偿还！$b$b去干掉他，不要手软！
text.completion: Thank you,$n.$B$BI wish we could bring him back just to kill him again but I guess this will suffice.$B$BI hope the spirit of my little one will now know peace.
text.completed: Return to Scout Ruk'gan within Agurak's Fall in Frostfire Ridge.
text.giverWindow: 不管走到哪，都带着他的宠物“裂肠”。

english.title: Vul'gath's End
english.objectives: Kill General Vul'gath within Agurak's Fall.
english.description: Vul'gath's time has come to an end, $n. My daughter's blood is upon his hands, now his blood will be on ours!$b$bShow no mercy and strike him down!
english.completion: Спасибо, $n.$b$bКонечно, жаль, что нельзя воскресить его, чтобы убить снова, ну да ладно.$b$bНадеюсь, дух моей малышки теперь спокоен.
english.completed: Return to Scout Ruk'gan within Agurak's Fall in Frostfire Ridge.
english.giverWindow: Takes his pet "Gutgore" with him everywhere.

text.title: 服务酬劳
text.objectives: 将加兹鲁维带到钢铁军工厂中黑锤领主的要塞房顶上。
text.description: 我准备好离开这里了，而且我不打算步行穿过那些兽人。$B$B幸好我这还有几只备用的火箭鸡，能气派地把咱们送回你的要塞！我们到房顶上去吧，找个适合的起飞位置。
text.completion: Told you I was good for it!
text.completed: Speak with Gazlowe in your garrison. You may use the Rocket Chicken XL for a ride.

english.title: Payment Due for Services Rendered
english.objectives: Bring Gazlowe to the roof of Overlord Blackhammer's fortress in the Iron Siegeworks.
english.description: I'm ready to get outta here, and I ain't hoofin' it back through all those orcs.$B$BFortunately, I kept a few extra rocket chickens to get us back to your garrison in style! Let's get up to the roof and find a decent place to take off.
english.completion: Told you I was good for it!
english.completed: Speak with Gazlowe in your garrison. You may use the Rocket Chicken XL for a ride.

text.title: Mission Successful
text.objectives: Speak to Sergeant Gil'nath in Frostfire Ridge.
text.description: The Thunderlords are finished $n and our job is complete. I'll stay here and watch over the area.$b$bYou should head back to Sergeant Gil'nath. I'm certain he will have another task for you.
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Gil'nath in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Mission Successful
english.objectives: Speak to Sergeant Gil'nath in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description: The Thunderlords are finished $n and our job is complete. I'll stay here and watch over the area.$b$bYou should head back to Sergeant Gil'nath. I'm certain he will have another task for you.
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Gil'nath in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: Return To Sender
text.objectives: Return the Subdermal Tracking Device.
text.description: This tiny tracking device is used to collect biological data. It appears to have been fastened to a dart and fired from long range.$b$bAfter closely examining the device, you are able to trace the signal to a receiver nearby. The information contained within could be important; it's probably a good idea to find the owner and return it.

english.title: Return To Sender
english.objectives: Return the Subdermal Tracking Device.
english.description: This tiny tracking device is used to collect biological data. It appears to have been fastened to a dart and fired from long range.$b$bAfter closely examining the device, you are able to trace the signal to a receiver nearby. The information contained within could be important; it's probably a good idea to find the owner and return it.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] Keeping Calm
text.objectives: Speak to Dulga in Palemoon Village.
text.description: <These beads must belong to Kaduz, the shaman you rescued. They are engraved with the name "Dulga".>$B$B<He said to meet him in nearby Palemoon Village. You will surely find both Kaduz and Dulga there.>
text.completed: Return to Dulga in Palemoon Village.

english.title: [DEPRECATED] Keeping Calm
english.objectives: Speak to Dulga in Palemoon Village.
english.description: <These beads must belong to Kaduz, the shaman you rescued. They are engraved with the name "Dulga".>$B$B<He said to meet him in nearby Palemoon Village. You will surely find both Kaduz and Dulga there.>
english.completed: Return to Dulga in Palemoon Village.

text.title: 使用望远镜
text.objectives: 用塞林的旋翼侦察机看一看。
text.description:
你的一位名叫塞林的同伴正在帮助我们对抗钢铁部落。

他声称可以用这台设备监视敌人，甚至能在远距离之外听见他们说的话。

我不信任这种设备。试用一下，然后告诉我你看见了什么。
text.completion: Orgrim leads the Iron Horde in Talador... Now we know the face of our enemy.
text.completed: Return to Maraad at Fort Wrynn.

english.title: Through the Looking Glass
english.objectives: Look through Thaelin's Observicopter.
english.description:
An ally of yours, Thaelin, is helping us counter the Iron Horde.

He claims this device can be used to spy on the enemy, even so far as hearing what they are saying at great distance.

I do not trust such devices. Use it and let me know what you see.
english.completion: Orgrim leads the Iron Horde in Talador... Now we know the face of our enemy.
english.completed: Return to Maraad at Fort Wrynn.

objectiveDetails.description: 用塞林的旋翼侦察机看一看

text.title: 百炼成钢
text.objectives: 在莫戈兰伐木场消灭$1oa个钢铁部落。
text.description:
我们必须消灭侵犯我们土地的钢铁部落军队。

去把那些玷污我们伟大森林的家伙找出来，让他们瞧瞧正义之手的力量。
text.completion: The Iron Horde has no consideration for the wonders of the forest. In death, they will know respect.
text.completed: Speak to Maraad at Redemption Rise.

english.title: Too Many Irons in the Fire
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Iron Horde at Mor'gran Logworks.
english.description:
We must slay the Iron Horde troops who infest our lands.

Find those who would sully our great forest and show them the hand of justice.
english.completion: The Iron Horde has no consideration for the wonders of the forest. In death, they will know respect.
english.completed: Speak to Maraad at Redemption Rise.

text.title: 物资短缺
text.objectives: 收集$1oa包钢铁部落炸药。
text.description:
钢铁部落在他们伐木场的中心地带储存了爆炸装置。

我们必须找到这些东西，以免自己成为牺牲品。

我会留意玛尔拉德的……我担心他会不会莽撞行事。
text.progress: Have you found the Iron Horde Explosives yet?
text.completion: I believe we can use these explosives against the Iron Horde.
text.completed: Speak to Yrel at Redemption Rise.

english.title: In Short Supply
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Iron Horde Explosives.
english.description:
The Iron Horde has explosive devices stored throughout the heart of their logging camp.

We must recover them so they are not used against us.

I will keep an eye on Maraad... I worry for him in his anger.
english.progress: Do you already have the Iron Horde explosives?
english.completion: I believe we can use these explosives against the Iron Horde.
english.completed: Speak to Yrel at Redemption Rise.

text.title: 塞林的权宜之计
text.objectives: 摧毁雷神储备点、黑石熔炉和存储的木材。
text.description:
那些兽人果真喜欢把东西堆在同一个地方。那让我想到了个主意……

我为你造了这台智能装置！等你靠近目标后，它会提醒你，一旦完成安装，就等着看一场盛大的爆破好戏吧！
text.completion: Nothing like a good explosion to warm the heart.
text.completed: Speak to Thaelin at Redemption Rise.

english.title: Thaelin's Quick Fix
english.objectives: Destroy the Thunderlord Cache, Blackrock Forge, and Log Storage.
english.description:
Those orcs sure like to pile things up in one place. That gave me an idea...

I've built this ingenious device for ya! When you get near a target, it'll let you know, and you can deploy it for a big, satisfying, kerBOOM!
english.completion: Nothing like a good explosion to warm the heart.
english.completed: Speak to Thaelin at Redemption Rise.

text.title: 任务终止
text.objectives: 消灭工程师塔拉克，并找回报废的钢铁切割者。
text.description:
凯特娅·碎铁，

你的新型钢铁切割者对我们自己的士兵也构成了威胁。

停用那台样机，并把它妥善存放起来，直到你想出解决办法为止。

与此同时，我会派工程师塔拉克去配合你的。

——奥格瑞姆·毁灭之锤
text.completion: A prototype Iron Shredder, huh?! I bet we can get this thing working... they didn't have Thaelin Darkanvil to fix it!
text.completed: Speak to Thaelin at Redemption Rise.

english.title: Decommissioned Mission
english.objectives: Kill Engineer Trak and recover the Decommissioned Iron Shredder.
english.description:
Ketya Shrediron,

Your new Iron Shredders are a menace to our own soldiers.

Decommission the prototype and store it out of the way until you've worked out the kinks.

I will send Engineer Trak to work on it in the meantime.

- Orgrim Doomhammer
english.completion: A prototype Iron Shredder, huh?! I bet we can get this thing working... they didn't have Thaelin Darkanvil to fix it!
english.completed: Speak to Thaelin at Redemption Rise.

objectiveDetails.description: 将报废的钢铁切割者运送到救赎之地
偷取报废的钢铁切割者

text.title: 孤注一掷
text.objectives: 在安葛洛什废墟里收集安葛洛什法术书和束缚魔典，然后在安葛洛什祭坛处举行仪式。
text.description: 我们找到了塔隆戈尔营地的位置，但他的军队比我们此前面对过的任何敌人都要强大得多。必须尽快取得优势才行。$B$B我们古老的敌人——安葛洛什食人魔受诅咒的灵魂就徘徊在附近的废墟间。我要你去那里把安葛洛什法术书和束缚魔典找来。$B$B在他们的祭坛处举行书中记载的仪式，移除诅咒并寻求他们的帮助。$B$B虽然难度很大，可我们别无选择。
text.progress: Were you able to acquire the aid of the Ango'rosh?
text.completion: You radiate the power of the Ango'rosh!$B$B<Restalaan smiles.>$B$BIt is time to take this battle to Teron'gor's doorstep.
text.completed: Return to Restalaan at Retribution Point.

english.title: Desperate Measures
english.objectives: Gather the Ango'rosh Spellbook and the Grimoire of Binding, then perform the ritual at the Altar of Ango'rosh in the Ango'rosh Ruins.
english.description: We've identified the location of Teron'gor's compound, but his forces are already far stronger than anything we've ever faced. We need to gain an edge, and quickly.$B$BThe cursed spirits of the Ango'rosh ogres, our ancient enemies, linger in nearby ruins. Go there and gather the Ango'rosh Spellbook and the Grimoire of Binding.$B$BPerform the ritual described within at their altar to lift their curse and seek their aid.$B$BIt's a long shot, but we don't have any other options.
english.progress: Тебе удалось заручиться помощью клана Анго'рош?
english.completion: You radiate the power of the Ango'rosh!$B$B<Restalaan smiles.>$B$BIt is time to take this battle to Teron'gor's doorstep.
english.completed: Return to Restalaan at Retribution Point.

text.title: Getting the Points
text.objectives: Gather 5 Barbed Thunderlord Spears within the Bones of Agurak.
text.description: Those Thunderlords circling above us are a problem $n.$b$bThey fly their pathetic Rylaks leisurely across the valley, thinking they are safe to rain spears down on our heads. We need to show them they are not safe from Frostwolf Vengeance!$b$bI have a plan but we will need to gather some material. Go hunt across the valley for any of their spears that survived intact. I think five should be enough.
text.progress: What is it $n? Have you got something for me?
text.completion: Hrm, yes these spears look pretty good. Outstanding $n! I know just what to use these for!
text.completed: Return to Scout Ruk'gan at the Bones of Agurak in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Getting the Points
english.objectives: Gather 5 Barbed Thunderlord Spears within the Bones of Agurak.
english.description: Those Thunderlords circling above us are a problem $n.$b$bThey fly their pathetic Rylaks leisurely across the valley, thinking they are safe to rain spears down on our heads. We need to show them they are not safe from Frostwolf Vengeance!$b$bI have a plan but we will need to gather some material. Go hunt across the valley for any of their spears that survived intact. I think five should be enough.
english.progress: What is it $n? Have you got something for me?
english.completion: Hrm, yes these spears look pretty good. Outstanding $n! I know just what to use these for!
english.completed: Return to Scout Ruk'gan at the Bones of Agurak in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 第几卷第几页？
text.objectives: 从奥金诺攻城营地的兽人身上找到$1oa张手册内页。
text.description:
在那台切割机的座舱塞着一本使用手册，可却少了很多内页。要是我们能把那些内页找到的话，我用我第三根脚指头打赌，我一定能让切割机样机恢复工作。

我发誓我在奥金诺攻城营地上看见了几张内页。也许就在那边的兽人身上。
text.progress: Have you found those pages? These manuals are ridiculous.
text.completion: I wondered why the manual was so big... they write with really big letters!
text.completed: Return to Thaelin at Redemption Rise.

english.title: Vol. X Pages ?
english.objectives: Find $1oa Manual Pages on orcs at Archenon Siegeyard.
english.description:
That shredder had a manual jammed in the cockpit, but it's missing a lot o' pages. If we can find those manual pages, I'd bet my third toe I can get the prototype shredder working again.

I coulda swore I saw a few of those pages floatin' about in  Archenon Siegeyard. Maybe the orcs there carry them.
english.progress: Where are the pages? These manuals are just chickens to laugh ...
english.completion: I wondered why the manual was so big... they write with really big letters!
