english.completed: Return to Thaelin at Redemption Rise.

text.title: 摧钢破铁
text.objectives: 破坏$1oa辆钢铁部落攻城车。
text.description:
兽人本身并不是唯一的威胁。他们还拥有杀伤力强大的攻城武器。

他们已经开始对图雷姆使用了，我们决不能让这样的行动继续下去。

用你从伐木场收集到的炸药去破坏攻城武器吧。
text.completion: They will be unable to use those weapons against us when we attack Tuurem.
text.completed: Return to Yrel at Redemption Rise.

english.title: Iron Them Out
english.objectives: Destroy $1oa Iron Horde Siege Engines.
english.description:
The orcs themselves are not the only threat. They still have siege weapons of significant power.

They've already been used against Tuurem, and we must not allow for their continued operation.

Sabotage siege weapons using the explosives you collected from the logging camp.
english.completion: They will be unable to use those weapons against us when we attack Tuurem.
english.completed: Return to Yrel at Redemption Rise.

text.title: 间谍之眼
text.objectives: 用塞林的旋翼侦察机看一看。
text.description:
我马上就让切割机样机恢复工作！

用我的旋翼侦察机看看吧。看看你即将面对的敌人……
text.completion: That's a lot of orcs, eh? Glad I'm here tinkerin' away instead of in the thick of it.
text.completed: Return to Thaelin at Redemption Rise.

english.title: An Eye for a Spy
english.objectives: Look through Thaelin's Observicopter.
english.description:
I'll get the prototype shredder working right now!

Take a look through my Observicopter. You'll see what you're about to head into...
english.completion: That's a lot of orcs, eh? Glad I'm here tinkerin' away instead of in the thick of it.
english.completed: Return to Thaelin at Redemption Rise.

objectiveDetails.description: 用塞林的旋翼侦察机看一看

text.title: 为切割而生
text.objectives: 在图雷姆用钢铁切割者消灭$2oa个钢铁部落成员。
text.description:
我已经让这台切割者样机的大部分汽缸都运行起来了。

要是他们被自己的机器给切碎掉，你说会不会大吃一惊啊，伙计！

我已经迫不及待的想要从旋翼侦察机里看着你了！
text.completion: -- ENEMIES ELIMINATED --
text.completed: Check the shredder's warning display.

english.title: Born to Shred
english.objectives: Kill $2oa Iron Horde in Tuurem using the Iron Shredder.
english.description:
I've got this prototype shredder operating on most cylinders.

Boy, will they be surprised when you stomp them with their own machine!

Can't wait to watch you from the safety of the Observicopter.
english.completion: -- ENEMIES ELIMINATED --
english.completed: Check the shredder's warning display.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭图雷姆的钢铁部落

text.title: 酝酿她的死亡
text.objectives: 击败凯特娅·碎铁。
text.description: ——已发现创造者。警报！警报！——
text.completion: The screams of our enemies washed over me. The people of Tuurem are avenged.
text.completed: Speak to Maraad at Redemption Rise.

english.title: Engineering Her Demise
english.objectives: Defeat Ketya Shrediron.
english.description: -- THE MOTHER HAS BEEN DETECTED. WARNING! WARNING! --
english.completion: The screams of our enemies washed over me. The people of Tuurem are avenged.
english.completed: Speak to Maraad at Redemption Rise.

text.title: 沙塔斯之战
text.objectives: 将钢铁部落逐出沙塔斯。
text.description:
为了阻止钢铁部落，我们必须克服成见，进行必要的合作。

部落，联盟，过去，现在……在这样的强敌面前，一切都变得毫无意义。

我们将合力重新夺回沙塔斯……至死方休。
text.completion: Maraad is dead... but we must carry on. I will not let his sacrifice be for nothing.
text.completed: Speak with Yrel at Fort Wrynn.

english.title: The Battle for Shattrath
english.objectives: Repel the Iron Horde from Shattrath.
english.description:
To stop the Iron Horde, we must overcome prejudice and work together, if only for this purpose.

Horde, Alliance, past, present... all meaningless in the face of this enemy.

We will retake Shattrath together... or die trying.
english.completion: Maraad is dead... but we must carry on. I will not let his sacrifice be for nothing.
english.completed: Speak with Yrel at Fort Wrynn.

text.title: 反抗的旗帜
text.objectives: 在阿古拉克之陨将饱经战火的霜狼军旗插在6名雷神兽人的尸体上。
text.description: 当你抬眼注视霜狼军旗的时候，你想起了自己与霜狼氏族一路上所经历的艰难险阻。$b$b鲁甘在与雷神氏族的战斗中吃尽了苦头，如果你能尽情羞辱敌人的话，一定会让他感到欣慰。$b$b听着军旗随风飘扬所发出的沙沙响声，你不禁想到要让这面军旗在霜狼氏族敌人的尸体上高高飘扬。
text.completion: Good work,$n!$B$BSeeing Frostwolf banners standing proudly over our crushed foes fills me with pride!$B$BLet them forever fear the wrath of the Frostwolves!
text.completed: Return to Scout Ruk'gan hiding within Agurak's Fall in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: The Mark of Defiance
english.objectives: Use the Battle-Worn Frostwolf Banner on the corpses of 6 Thunderlord Orcs in Agurak's Fall.
english.description: As you look upon the Frostwolf banner you remember struggles that have led you and the Frostwolves to this point.$b$bRuk'gan has suffered in his battles with the Thunderlord and would appreciate an extra show of defiance. $b$bAs the banner rustles in the wind you're inspired to mark the foes of the Frostwolf with its standard.
english.completion: Отлично, $n! $b$bЗнамена клана Северного Волка, реющие над трупами наших врагов, наполняют мое сердце гордостью!$b$bПусть навеки запомнят гнев Северных Волков!
english.completed: Return to Scout Ruk'gan hiding within Agurak's Fall in Frostfire Ridge.

objectiveDetails.description: 将军旗插在雷神兽人的尸体上

text.title: 通缉：基尔尤恩
text.objectives: 猎杀基尔尤恩，并把它的鸟喙交给帕特里克·麦瑟。
text.description: 我这有一份悬赏令，目标是一只鸟，指挥官。没错，是鸟。$B$B问题是那家伙特别巨大，而且最后一次现身就在南边部落基地边上的林地中。当地人把它称作基尔尤恩。$B$B要是你愿意去追猎这只鸟，并把它的鸟喙带回来，我敢打赌那一定能为你的金库增加一两袋金币！
text.progress: Any luck tracking down that bird, commander?
text.completion: I have no idea how you managed to track down the creature so close to the Horde base, but well done $Gsir:madame;.
text.completed: Return to Patrick Messer in Fort Wrynn.

english.title: Wanted: Kil'uun
english.objectives: Hunt Kil'uun and bring its beak to Patrick Messer.
english.description: I have a bounty set on a bird, commander. Yes, a bird.$B$BThe issue is this thing is massive, and it was last sighted a stone's throw away from the Horde base to the south in the forest. The locals call it Kil'uun.$B$BIf you'd like to track the creature down and bring back its beak I wager it would fetch a sack or two of gold for your coffers!
english.progress: Ну как, нашлась та птица, командир?
english.completion: I have no idea how you managed to track down the creature so close to the Horde base, but well done $Gsir:madame;.
english.completed: Return to Patrick Messer in Fort Wrynn.

text.title: 通缉：希兰尼
text.objectives: 干掉希兰尼，并将一堆淡水兽肉块交给帕特里克·麦瑟。
text.description: 欧丽莱想要用一顿淡水兽大餐来犒劳我们辛苦劳作的农夫们。$B$B我不想浪费你的时间，让你一天到晚地去猎杀那些生物，指挥官。我们接到报告，在南边的湖里住着一只名叫希兰尼的巨大淡水兽，足够我们整座要塞中的成员吃上两顿。$B$B如果你有机会带些它的肉回来，弟兄们肯定会感激不尽的。
text.progress: Have you had time to kill Hilaani?
text.completion: Thank you, commander! The peasants will be singing songs about your generosity tomorrow.
text.completed: Return to Patrick Messer in Fort Wrynn.

english.title: Wanted: Hilaani
english.objectives: Kill Hilaani and bring the Pile of Riverbeast Meat to Patrick Messer.
english.description: O'riley wants to thank our peasants for their hard work with a riverbeast dinner.$B$I don't want to waste your time asking you to slaughter the things all day, commander. We've gotten reports of a huge riverbeast called Hilaani that would feed the whole fort twice over living in the lake to the south.$B$BIf you have a chance to bring cuts of her meat back, the men would be grateful.
english.progress: Тебе удалось убить Хилаани?
english.completion: Thank you, commander! The peasants will be singing songs about your generosity tomorrow.
english.completed: Return to Patrick Messer in Fort Wrynn.

text.title: 通缉：“重锤”拉托克
text.objectives: 在奥鲁纳海岸消灭“重锤”拉托克。
text.description: 我遇到了点麻烦，需要向你求助，指挥官。$B$B我们当中有几个人在这附近的峭壁间发现了一位钢铁部落副官。我们怀疑她正在指挥他们的军队前往奥鲁纳海岸上的战略要地。$B$B如果你能除掉她的话，我对这座要塞的安全性就会放心多了。
text.completion: All hail your glory, commander.
text.completed: Return to Patrick Messer in Fort Wrynn.

english.title: Wanted: Ra'tok the Hammer
english.objectives: Dispatch Ra'tok the Hammer in the Orunai Coast.
english.description: I've got an issue that could use your assistance, commander.$B$BA few of our men spotted an Iron Horde lieutenant wandering in the cliffs near here. We suspect she's directing their forces to strategic ground as they land on the Orunai Coast.$B$BI would feel much better about the safety of this fort if you could take her out.
english.completion: All hail your glory, commander.
english.completed: Return to Patrick Messer in Fort Wrynn.

text.title: 通缉：“重锤”拉托克
text.objectives: 在奥鲁纳海岸消灭“重锤”拉托克。
text.description: 钢铁部落毫无荣誉感。他们令我感到恶心。$B$B我们在距离基地不远的峭壁间发现了他们的一位副官。我相信她正在监视我们的一举一动，准备从奥鲁纳海岸发起某种形式的攻击。$B$B我知道你很忙，指挥官。但要是你有时间干掉她的话，我相信会对我们要塞的安全性大有益处。
text.completion: I knew you'd kill her. No Iron Horde is safe from your wrath.
text.completed: Return to Beastmaster Tagh in Vol'jin's Pride.

english.title: Wanted: Ra'tok the Hammer
english.objectives: Kill Ra'tok the Hammer in the Orunai Coast.
english.description: The Iron Horde have no honor. They disgust me.$B$BWe spotted one of their lieutenants wandering the cliffs not far from our base. I believe that she is tracking our movements to prepare for some sort of assault from the Orunai Coast.$B$BI understand you have much to do, commander. If you have the time, I believe it would be beneficial to our position's integrity.
english.completion: I knew you'd kill her. No Iron Horde is safe from your wrath.
english.completed: Return to Beastmaster Tagh in Vol'jin's Pride.

text.title: 通缉：希兰尼
text.objectives: 干掉希兰尼，并将一堆淡水兽肉块交给兽王塔格。
text.description: 我们需要更多肉，指挥官。$B$B我知道你在想什么。我身后那些肉又是怎么回事呢？$B$B问题就在这。就算我们走运，那些也只够我们吃一天而已。$B$B在南边的湖里住着一只淡水兽。当地人叫它希兰尼。体型庞大而丰满多肉。$B$B要是你能干掉那只野兽，把它的肉给我带回来的话，兄弟们的日子就好过多了。
text.progress: Good to see you, commander.
text.completion: Is that what I think it is? You are too kind, commander!
text.completed: Return to Beastmaster Tagh in Vol'jin's Pride.

english.title: Wanted: Hilaani
english.objectives: Slay Hilaani and bring a Pile of Riverbeast Meat to Beastmaster Tagh.
english.description: We need more meat, commander.$B$BI know what you're thinking. What about all of that meat right behind me?$B$BThat's the problem. It'll be gone in a day if we're lucky.$B$BThere's a riverbeast that lives in the lake to the south. Locals call her Hilaani. Massive, lots of meat.$B$BIf you would take down the beast and bring me her meat, your wolves will be better off for it.
english.progress: Good to see you, commander.
english.completion: Is that what I think it is? You are too kind, commander!
english.completed: Return to Beastmaster Tagh in Vol'jin's Pride.

text.title: 通缉：基尔尤恩
text.objectives: 把基尔尤恩的喙交给兽王塔格。
text.description: 就是那只该死的鸟！$B$B每隔几小时，这只遭天杀的家伙就会径直飞过这里，这些蠢货竟然没人敢阻止它。$B$B他们说“它的眼神很疯狂”。啊呸！$B$B指挥官，这只鸟简直令我不堪其扰。如果你看见它，能不能把它那蠢笨的鸟头切下来交给我？$B$B那会让我好过许多。
text.progress: If you decide to kill that creature, I will name my first-born in your honor.
text.completion: Praise to $n! For the Horde!
text.completed: Return to Beastmaster Tagh in Vol'jin's Pride.

english.title: Wanted: Kil'uun
english.objectives: Bring Kil'uun's Beak to Beastmaster Tagh.
english.description: It's that damned bird!$B$BEvery few hours, this blasted thing flies right past here, and none of these idiots will stop it.$B$B"It's got the crazy in its eyes," they tell me. Pah!$B$BCommander, this bird will be the end of me. If you see it, could you cut off its stupid head and give it to me?$B$BIt'd make me feel better.
english.progress: If you decide to kill that creature, I will name my first-born in your honor.
english.completion: Praise to $n! For the Horde!
english.completed: Return to Beastmaster Tagh in Vol'jin's Pride.

text.title: 食人魔外交
text.objectives: 在安葛洛什废墟里消灭$1oa个安葛洛什食人魔。
text.description: 别看他们是鬼魂，但那些安葛洛什成员毕竟还是食人魔。就算你把他们的书拿在手里，他们在你证明自己之前仍然不会敬你半分，而且想要赢得尊敬的方法只有一种。$B$B那就是干掉他们。$B$B进入废墟后，消灭尽可能多的安葛洛什食人魔鬼魂和他们的宠物吧。
text.completion: <Liadrin smiles.>$B$BI knew they'd see it our way.
text.completed: Return to Lady Liadrin at Retribution Point.

english.title: Ogre Diplomacy
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Ango'rosh in the Ango'rosh Ruins.
english.description: They may be spirits, but the Ango'rosh are still ogres. Even with their books in hand, they won't respect you until you prove yourself, and there's only one way to earn that.$B$BBy killing them.$B$BYou should take out as many of the Ango'rosh spirits and their pets as you can while in the ruins.
english.completion: <Liadrin smiles.>$B$BI knew they'd see it our way.
english.completed: Return to Lady Liadrin at Retribution Point.

text.title: 前往雷霆小径
text.objectives: 在霜狼阵地与洛卡拉交谈。
text.description: 没时间哀悼亡者或是舔舐伤口了。据你的斥候回报，他们发现一支钢铁部落大军即将通过雷霆小径。$b$b我建议让你的要塞军队继续守卫这片区域，你跟我率领剩下的霜狼成员前往东边的小径。$b$b是时候让钢铁部落见识一下霜狼氏族团结起来能爆发出多大的力量。
text.completion: I am glad to see you. Our clan has faced many challenges, but the sheer size of the army coming toward us is beyond anything we have attempted to face.$b$bWe need your experience.
text.completed: 在霜狼阵地与洛卡拉交谈。

english.title: To Thunder Pass
english.objectives: Speak with Lokra at Wolf's Stand.
english.description: There is no time to mourn our fallen or lick our wounds. Your scouts have already reported sighting a massive Iron Horde army making its way through Thunder Pass.$b$bI advise you let your garrison forces secure this area while you and I make for the pass east of here with the rest of the Frostwolves.$b$bIt is time to show this Iron Horde what a united Frostwolf clan can do.
english.completion: I am glad to see you. Our clan has faced many challenges, but the sheer size of the army coming toward us is beyond anything we have attempted to face.$b$bWe need your experience.
english.completed: Speak with Lokra at Wolf's Stand.

text.title: 雷霆小径之战
text.objectives: 保卫霜火岭免受钢铁部落的入侵。
text.description: 就在我们说话间，钢铁部落有一支人数多过我们十倍的大军正在前往雷霆小径。$b$b杜隆坦正在小径的入口处集结我们的军队。他正在竭尽全力地部署防御力量，但我们霜狼氏族并不擅长如此大规模的战争。$b$b他会需要你的专业技能的。$b$b拜托你，去帮他吧。
text.completion: This was a costly victory, and a very painful lesson. We chose to refuse the Iron Horde and live as we always have, but I see now they will never respect such neutrality.$b$bI am not about to wait for the Iron Horde to martial their forces. We will fight with you, and bring the Iron Horde to its knees.$b$bCommander, the Frostwolves stand ready!
text.completed: Speak with Durotan at Thunder Pass.

english.title: The Battle of Thunder Pass
english.objectives: Defend Frostfire Ridge from the Iron Horde.
english.description: The Iron Horde has an army tenfold our number marching down the Thunder Pass as we speak.$b$bDurotan is amassing our forces at the mouth of the pass. He is doing what he can to mount a defense but war on this scale is not what we Frostwolves are masters of.$b$bHe will need your expertise.$b$bPlease, go to him.
english.completion: This was a costly victory, and a very painful lesson. We chose to refuse the Iron Horde and live as we always have, but I see now they will never respect such neutrality.$b$bI am not about to wait for the Iron Horde to martial their forces. We will fight with you, and bring the Iron Horde to its knees.$b$bCommander, the Frostwolves stand ready!
english.completed: Speak with Durotan at Thunder Pass.

objectiveDetails.description: 保卫霜火岭免受钢铁部落的入侵

text.title: 圣光天罚
text.objectives: 在古尔罗克消灭$1oa个恶魔。
text.description: 到处都有黑暗爪牙，它们不遗余力地想要吞噬这个世界。惟有我们可以为圣光重铸平衡。$B$B你有力量彻底消灭塔隆戈尔的恶魔仆从。让它们粉身碎骨地滚回扭曲虚空去吧！
text.completion: Already I can feel the Light triumphing over darkness. We've done it!
text.completed: Return to Lady Liadrin at Retribution Point.

english.title: Retribution for the Light
english.objectives: Kill $1oa demons in Gul'rok.
english.description: There are agents of darkness everywhere, fighting tooth and nail to envelop the world. The Light relies on us to balance the scale.$B$BYou have the power needed to destroy Teron'gor's demonic minions once and for all. Send them to the Twisting Nether in pieces!
english.completion: Already I can feel the Light triumphing over darkness. We've done it!
english.completed: Return to Lady Liadrin at Retribution Point.

text.title: 目的地：未知
text.objectives: 消灭萨纳多斯遗迹的莫格索德。
text.description: 我抵达时，塔隆戈尔和古尔丹正要通过传送门离开……而我……我知道自己打不过他们。$B$B我会尽量保持传送门开启。只能靠你去给他们致命一击了。$B$B我们的命运都掌握在你手里，$n。
text.completion: Teron'gor and Gul'dan... they slaughtered everyone...$B$B...and then they just... disappeared... into the shadows...$B$BHow did they know where to go?
text.completed: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani in Auchindoun.

english.title: Destination: Unknown
english.objectives: Destroy Mongrethod in the Remains of Xandros.
english.description: Teron'gor and Gul'dan were just leaving through the portal as I arrived... and I... I know I won't be able to defeat them.$B$BI'll hold open the portal as long as I can. It will be up to you to strike the killing blow.$B$BOur fate is in your hands, $n.
english.completion: Teron'gor and Gul'dan... they slaughtered everyone...$B$B...and then they just... disappeared... into the shadows...$B$BHow did they know where to go?
english.completed: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani in Auchindoun.

text.title: 探查疯狂之心
text.objectives: 在古尔罗克的堕落之座与缚魂者尼娅米谈一谈。
text.description: $n，尼娅米自己跑去对付塔隆戈尔了。$B$B你得去找到她。她一个人去对付他简直是以卵击石。$B$B我必须留在这里重整军队，以应对新的攻势。救她的任务就交给你了。
text.completion: You have to hurry... Teron'gor just left!
text.completed: Speak to Soulbinder Nyami at the Seat of Depravity in Gul'rok.

english.title: Into the Heart of Madness
english.objectives: Speak to Soulbinder Nyami at the Seat of Depravity in Gul'rok.
english.description: $n, Nyami ran off to 'take down Teron'gor herself.'$B$BYou need to find her. She has no chance against him on her own.$B$BI must remain here and organize our ranks should another attack fall upon us. I'm counting on you.
english.completion: You have to hurry... Teron'gor just left!
english.completed: Speak to Soulbinder Nyami at the Seat of Depravity in Gul'rok.

text.title: 遁入黑暗
text.objectives: 在古尔罗克摧毁3个暗影宝珠。
text.description: <在你的脑海里响起了塔隆戈尔的声音。>$B$B仆从们，我们最后的行动决不能让奥金尼人知道。用古尔丹给我们的暗影宝珠把古尔罗克笼罩在黑暗之中。$B$B让军队准备好，听我的命令，向奥金顿进发。我们要尽情享用德莱尼人的灵魂，引领我们的恶魔盟友们进入这个世界！$B$B<摧毁这些暗影宝珠，应该会大大帮助到奥金顿的防御者。>
text.completion: Without the shadow orbs, the main Auchenai force will be able to march on Gul'rok safely.

english.title: Hiding in the Shadows
english.objectives: Destroy the three Shadow Orbs in Gul'rok.
english.description: <The voice of Teron'gor enters your mind.>$B$BOur final move must remain concealed from the Auchenai, my minions. Use the shadow orbs Gul'dan provided for us to veil Gul'rok in darkness.$B$BPrepare our forces, we march on Auchindoun on my order. We will feast on the souls of the draenei and usher our demonic allies into this world!$B$B<Destroying these shadow orbs would help the defenders at Auchindoun greatly.>
english.completion: Without the shadow orbs, the main Auchenai force will be able to march on Gul'rok safely.

text.title: 烧书
text.objectives: 在古尔罗克取得3本暗影议会法术书并把它们扔进卡尔索斯·晨怒旁边的火里烧掉。
text.description: 拜托……我没多少时间了，$n。$B$B暗影议会已经允许自己被塔隆戈尔和他的术士们变成恶魔！$B$B我有理由相信，那些影脉噬魂者正在用古尔丹赋予他们的法术来强化自己的恶魔兽人。把他们的法术书夺过来，丢进我旁边的火里烧掉……这能让我在临死前有个好心情。
text.completion: Thank you... kill a couple more for me on your way out, if you can...
text.completed: Return to Kor'thos Dawnfury in Gul'rok.

english.title: Book Burning
english.objectives: Obtain 3 Shadow Council Spellbooks and burn them in the fire by Kor'thos Dawnfury in Gul'rok.
english.description: Please, $n... I don't have much time.$B$BThe Shadow Council have allowed themselves to be turned into demons by Teron'gor and his warlocks!$B$BI have reason to believe that the shadowborne dementors are using spells given to them by Gul'dan to empower the demonic orcs. Take their spellbooks and cast them into the fire by me... it will be a pleasant sight to die to.
english.completion: Thank you... kill a couple more for me on your way out, if you can...
english.completed: Return to Kor'thos Dawnfury in Gul'rok.

text.title: Mutation Station
text.objectives: Assist Grulk in destroying the Mutation Lab by administering the Mutation Serum to him.
text.description: Grulk very weak...barely stand.$b$bGrulk not always look this way. Grulk once was orc...Iron Horde make Grulk mutant. Grulk angry at Iron Horde...so Iron Horde lock Grulk in cage...hurt Grulk.$b$bGrulk HATE Iron Horde...Grulk want SMASH them...make them PAY!$b$bTake serum...use on Grulk to make Grulk strong! Help Grulk SMASH Iron Horde!

english.title: Mutation Station
english.objectives: Assist Grulk in destroying the Mutation Lab by administering the Mutation Serum to him.
english.description: Grulk very weak...barely stand.$b$bGrulk not always look this way. Grulk once was orc...Iron Horde make Grulk mutant. Grulk angry at Iron Horde...so Iron Horde lock Grulk in cage...hurt Grulk.$b$bGrulk HATE Iron Horde...Grulk want SMASH them...make them PAY!$b$bTake serum...use on Grulk to make Grulk strong! Help Grulk SMASH Iron Horde!

objectiveDetails.description: Use the Mutation Serum on Grulk

text.title: 清理鬣蜥人
text.objectives: 在要塞矿井里消灭石牙。
text.description: 那个废弃的矿井已经被鬣蜥人占领了！它们似乎听命于来自矿井深处的某个大家伙。如果你能干掉他的话，其他鬣蜥人可能就会落荒而逃了。$b$b等你清理掉那些鬣蜥人后，我们就能让那矿井恢复运作了！
text.completion: Nice job, $n! Let's get this mining operation started!
text.completed: Return to Timothy Leens at the Garrison.

english.title: Things Are Not Goren Our Way
english.objectives: Kill Stonetooth in the Garrison Mine.
english.description: The abandoned mine shaft has been overrun with goren!  They seem to be responding to commands from a big one farther down in the mine.  If you can take him out, the rest will probably retreat.$b$bOnce you have those goren cleared out, we can get that mine up and working!
english.completion: Nice job, $n! Let's get this mining operation started!
english.completed: Return to Timothy Leens at the Garrison.

text.title: 清理种植园
text.objectives: 消灭8只霜壁啮咬者。
text.description: 这个洞穴中的气候条件正好适合供我们的要塞种植草药，但还有个小问题。就是这些可恶的啮咬者！$b$b我需要你去消灭它们，好让我们把这里变成种植园。
text.completion: Great work, $n! We will get started planting the garden right away.
text.completed: Return to Tarnon at the Garrison.

english.title: Clearing the Garden
english.objectives: Kill 8 Frostwall Nibblers.
english.description: This cave is the perfect climate to grow herbs for our Garrison, there is just one little problem.  All these damn nibblers!$b$bI need you to clear them out and we can get this garden growing.
english.completion: Great work, $n! We will get started planting the garden right away.
english.completed: Return to Tarnon at the Garrison.

text.title: 寻找帮手
text.objectives: 找到一位能够帮助我们的当地渔夫。
text.description: 我们这里有个可以利用的钓鱼场所，但好像用什么鱼饵都钓不上鱼来！我们得找个熟悉情况的当地渔夫来帮忙。到西北边去，看看你能否在海岸线上找到帮手。
text.completion: Time to see what you can do.
text.completed: Inquire the local fisherman for assistance.

english.title: Looking For Help
english.objectives: Find a local fisherman to help our cause.
english.description: We have an accessible fishing spot here, but no bait seems to work!  We need to find a local fisherman with some knowledge of the area to help us out.  Head northwest and see if you can find anyone on the shoreline.
english.completion: Time to see what you can do.
english.completed: Inquire the local fisherman for assistance.

text.title: 准予引见
text.objectives: 到霜风峭壁的索姆瓦尔外面找科达娜·邪歌。
text.description: 眼下发生了一件极为重要的事。在你离开的这段时间里，大法师卡德加联系了我。$B$B他正在北边调查恶魔之力造成的影响。$B$B卡德加毕竟是个人类，没有你的担保，霜狼氏族是不会接纳他的，也不会接受一位像我这样的暗夜精灵。$B$B我会在霜风峭壁的索姆瓦尔外面等你。
text.completion: Thank you for coming, $n. The archmage and I are in need of your assistance.

english.title: Vouchsafe Our Arrival
english.objectives: Meet Cordana Felsong outside of Thom'var in the Frostwind Crag.
english.description: A matter of great importance has arisen. While you were away, Archmage Khadgar contacted me.$B$BHe is investigating demonic influences to the north.$B$BBeing a human, the Frostwolves will not accept Khadgar without you there to vouch for him, nor will they accept a night elf such as myself.$B$BI will wait for you outside Throm'var in the Frostwind Crag.
english.completion: Thank you for coming, $n. The archmage and I are in need of your assistance.

text.title: They Have My Son
text.objectives: Find the Key to Corki's Cage and set him free.
text.description: Please, $p! Can you help me. I received a ransom note from a very corrupt and uncouth orc within the ranks of the Iron Horde.$b$bHe has my son!$b$BHe made sure to include a number of graphic words to describe what would happen if the ransom is not paid. Clearly he thinks my people conjure gold from the nether. And if I try to rescue him myself, both of us will be killed in the process.$b$bCan you go to Gron'mar for me and rescue my son?$b$bHis name is Corki.
text.completed: Return to Arechron in your Garrison.

english.title: They Have My Son
english.objectives: Find the Key to Corki's Cage and set him free.
english.description: Please, $p! Can you help me. I received a ransom note from a very corrupt and uncouth orc within the ranks of the Iron Horde.$b$bHe has my son!$b$BHe made sure to include a number of graphic words to describe what would happen if the ransom is not paid. Clearly he thinks my people conjure gold from the nether. And if I try to rescue him myself, both of us will be killed in the process.$b$bCan you go to Gron'mar for me and rescue my son?$b$bHis name is Corki.
english.completed: Return to Arechron in your Garrison.

text.title: 安全路线
text.objectives: 聆听科达娜·邪歌的故事。
text.description: 作为人类和暗夜精灵，大法师跟我肯定不会受到霜狼兽人的欢迎。$B$B我们需要你帮忙向索姆瓦尔的先知引荐一下。$B$B有许多事情需要讨论。要不要让我在前往村子的路上跟你介绍下情况？
text.completion: Wolf-$g brother:sister;, already word has traveled to us of your actions at Wor'gol. You have the eternal respect of the Frostwolf.$B$BNow, who are these strangers that you have brought to us and what is this urgent matter?
text.completed: Speak with Farseer Urquan at Throm'var.

english.title: Safe Passage
english.objectives: Hear Cordana Felsong's tale.
english.description: Being a human and a night elf, the archmage and I aren't likely to be well-received by the orcs of the Frostwolf clan.$B$BWe need you to make an introduction for us with the Throm'var farseer.$B$BThere is much to discuss. Shall I bring you up to speed on the way to the village?
english.completion: Wolf-$g brother:sister;, already word has traveled to us of your actions at Wor'gol. You have the eternal respect of the Frostwolf.$B$BNow, who are these strangers that you have brought to us and what is this urgent matter?
english.completed: Speak with Farseer Urquan at Throm'var.

objectiveDetails.description: 聆听科达娜·邪歌的故事

text.title: Smash Blon'sky!
text.objectives: Defeat Blon'sky.
text.description: Grulk not choose to be mutated. Grulk not monster like Blon'sky! Blon'sky evil... chose mutation for power!$b$bYou go to Grommar? Smash Blon'sky before he hurt innocents, make Grulk happy!
text.completed: Return to Grulk in your Garrison.

english.title: Smash Blon'sky!
english.objectives: Defeat Blon'sky.
english.description: Grulk not choose to be mutated. Grulk not monster like Blon'sky! Blon'sky evil... chose mutation for power!$b$bYou go to Grommar? Smash Blon'sky before he hurt innocents, make Grulk happy!
english.completed: Return to Grulk in your Garrison.

text.title: Creature Treasure: Iron Horde Stable Master

english.title: Creature Treasure: Iron Horde Stable Master

text.title: 必须完成的任务
text.objectives: 收殓狼母的遗骸，并安葬在北索姆瓦尔外面的墓地里。
text.description: 我相信我们已经见到你朋友们提到的这种恶魔腐化了。$B$B狼母近来表现得很不对劲。现在，她的狼群已经把她包围了。$B$B狼群们在保护我们的猎手，不肯让他们靠近。但他们应该不会阻止你。$B$B如果主母真的感染了这股邪能的话，那就必须将她消灭。$B$B如果你能把她的尸体带回来并妥善安葬的话，那一定会为霜狼氏族带来莫大的荣耀。
text.completion: Unfortunate that there are those that would pervert such noble creatures.$B$BYou have honored their family once more, $n. They will not forget.$B$BNow it is time to take the fight directly to the Shadow Council.
text.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Throm'var.
text.giverWindow: 结束她的痛苦，并把她的尸骸埋进墓地吧。

english.title: What Must Be Done
english.objectives: Collect the Mother of Wolves' Remains and bury it at the graveyard outside of northern Throm'var.
english.description: I believe we have seen this demonic corruption your friends speak of.$B$BThe Mother of Wolves has not been herself lately. Now, her pack has her surrounded.$B$BThe wolves are protecting our hunters and will not let them near. They're not likely to stop you, though.$B$BIf the alpha mother is infected with this fel-energy, then she must be put down.$B$BYou would greatly honor the Frostwolves by returning with her corpse and giving it a proper burial.
english.completion: Так грустно, что есть те, кто способен поразить Скверной столь благородных созданий.$B$BТы снова $gпомог:помогла; им, $n. Они не забудут этого.$B$BТеперь пора заняться Советом Теней.
english.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Throm'var.
english.giverWindow: End her suffering and bury her remains in the graveyard.

text.title: 虫子的线索
text.objectives: 杀死$1oa只废土岩虫。
text.description: 在我侦察时，我注意到在霜风峭壁的大部分地区都爬满了一种奇怪的虫子。$B$B这些虫子最大的威胁在于，它们会遁入地下，然后不知会从哪里突然冒出来袭击你。$B$B我在荒野里见过这些虫子攻击霜狼和其它野生动物。要是你能帮忙，兽人们肯定会非常高兴的。
text.completion: We haven't seen these creatures here in a generation.$B$BTheir sudden appearance and the shaking of the ground are most definitely connected.
text.completed: Speak with Farseer Urquan at Throm'var.

english.title: A Clew of Worms
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Wastes Rockworms.
english.description: While I was scouting, I noticed that most of Frostwind Crag is crawling with an odd species of worm.$B$BThe worst thing about them is that these things burrow under the ground and then spring on you from out of nowhere.$B$BI saw the worms attacking the frost wolves and other wildlife in the wastes. I'm certain the orcs would appreciate you helping out.
english.completion: Этих тварей не было видно давным-давно.$B$BДумаю, их внезапное появление и землетрясения связаны между собой.
english.completed: Speak with Farseer Urquan at Throm'var.

text.title: 睡魔苏醒
text.objectives: 消灭睡魔哈拉德。
text.description: 有东西唤醒了伟大的睡魔哈拉德。正是她引起了大地的震颤。$B$B<先知向空中打出一个结界符文，然后继续说道。>$B$B也许那些打扰了这只巨虫的家伙，正是你的朋友们要找的人？$B$B不论如何，一定要在睡魔哈拉德将整个北部沉入汪洋之前，让她永远地安息。
text.completion: I've heard of these strange Pale orcs you saw. They sound like the Warsingers of Nagrand. But no, that cannot be....$B$BAs for the ogre, his name is Cho'gall. You should kill him if you get the chance. He brings nothing but destruction in his wake.
text.completed: Return to Farseer Urquan at Throm'var.
text.giverWindow: 你必须消灭那只巨虫！

english.title: The Sleeper Has Awakened
english.objectives: Kill Shui Halad.
english.description: Something has awakened the great Shui Halad. She is causing the ground to quake.$B$B<The farseer makes a sign of warding in the air, and then continues.>$B$BPerhaps those who have disturbed the great worm are the same ones your friends are tracking down?$B$BEither way, Shui Halad must be put to eternal rest before her thrashing collapses all of the north into the ocean.
english.completion: Мы слышали о странных бледнокожих орках, которых ты $gвидел:видела;. Они похожи на воителей из Награнда. Хотя нет, этого не может быть...$B$BЧто до огра, его зовут Чо'Галл. Убей его, если сможешь. Он разрушает все на своем пути.
english.completed: Return to Farseer Urquan at Throm'var.
english.giverWindow: You must slay the great worm!

text.title: 以眼还眼
text.objectives: 从死灵屠夫奥格佐身上取得全视指环。
text.description: 狼母被恶魔法术腐化了。暗影议会一定想把这腐化之力扩散到其它霜狼身上，继而是索姆瓦尔。$B$B据猎手们回报，他们在西边的冰痕坟场看见了发光的绿眼睛。我们都知道那意味着什么。$B$B我有个主意……我们不如用暗影议会的“眼睛”对付他们自己，去发现他们的基地。只要找来首席术士的全视指环就可以了。
text.progress: The All-Seeing Ring. Do you have it?
text.completion: Yes, this will do nicely. Let's use the Shadow Council's magic against them.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar at Throm'var.
text.giverWindow: 消灭他，并夺取他的全视指环。

english.title: Eye Need That
english.objectives: Collect the All-Seeing Ring from Ogzor the Necrothurge.
english.description: The Mother of Wolves was infected with demon magic. The Shadow Council must have hoped to spread the corruption to the other frost wolves and then to Throm'var.$B$BThe hunters are reporting they've seen glowing green eyes down in the Icescar Boneyard to the west. We both know what that means.$B$BI have an idea... we're going to use the Shadow Council's "eyes" against them to reveal their base. All we need is the lead warlock's All-Seeing Ring.
english.progress: The All-Seeing Ring. Do you have it?
english.completion: Yes, that’s what you need. We use the magic of the Council of Shadows against themselves.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar at Throm'var.
english.giverWindow: Kill him and take his All-Seeing Ring.

text.title: 偿还
text.objectives: 在泰尔莫击溃$1oa个暗影议会的成员。
text.description: 我们以为有了叶之影的遮蔽，就能安全无虞。$B$B<守备官卡鲁德擦去了脸上的血迹。>$B$B有人把关闭水晶的方法告诉了暗影议会。我们开始还能挡得住他们……$B$B大多数镇民都在攻击中惨遭屠杀。拜托了，你必须为我们的亡者复仇。把这些入侵者彻底逐出泰尔莫！
text.completion: Excellent. The shards are at last together!
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Kaluud outside Telmor.

english.title: Payback
english.objectives: Rout $1oa Shadow Council forces in Telmor.
english.description: We thought we were safe behind Leafshadow's cloaking veil.$B$B<Vindicator Kaluud wipes the blood from his face.>$B$BSomeone told the Shadow Council's forces how to disable it. We were able to hold them off at first...$B$BMost of the town was slaughtered in the attack. Please, you must avenge our fallen. Rout these invaders out from Telmor forever!
english.completion: Excellent. The shards are at last together!
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Kaluud outside Telmor.

text.title: Payback
text.objectives: Take the Shard of Shadows from Vorpil Ribcleaver in Telmor.
text.description: The entire thing was a damned distraction!$B$BWhile we were dealing with matters in the hollow, Teron'gor's forces launched an attack on Telmor to the west and slaughtered the entire town!$B$B$n, we already have two of the three shards of the key to Auchindoun. I refuse to let these savages have the third shard, let them devour my people or let Teron'gor devour more souls and grow stronger still.$B$BYou know what to do. Find the assault's leader and take the shard from his lifeless corpse!
text.completed: Speak to Exarch Maladaar at Hub 3.

english.title: Payback
english.objectives: Take the Shard of Shadows from Vorpil Ribcleaver in Telmor.
english.description: The entire thing was a damned distraction!$B$BWhile we were dealing with matters in the hollow, Teron'gor's forces launched an attack on Telmor to the west and slaughtered the entire town!$B$B$n, we already have two of the three shards of the key to Auchindoun. I refuse to let these savages have the third shard, let them devour my people or let Teron'gor devour more souls and grow stronger still.$B$BYou know what to do. Find the assault's leader and take the shard from his lifeless corpse!
english.completed: Speak to Exarch Maladaar at Hub 3.

text.title: 取回碎片
text.objectives: 与泰尔莫外面的缚魂者图拉妮谈一谈。
text.description: 你在战斗中证明了自己过人的能力，$n。如你所知，在奥金顿各处或许都有暗影议会的军队，包括泰尔莫附近。$B$B作为一名灵魂祭司，图拉妮的力量还没有充分展现出来，单靠她自己的力量保护不了那块碎片。我需要你去泰尔莫协助她，一定要把水晶安全地送到奥金顿。
text.completion: It's not safe here. The Shadow Council has already taken the city!
text.completed: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani outsider Telmor.

english.title: Scheduled Pickup
english.objectives: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani outside Telmor.
english.description: You've proven yourself more than capable in battle, $n. As you know, there may be Shadow Council forces anywhere around Auchindoun, including near Telmor.$B$BTuulani's powers as a soulpriest have not yet fully manifested; she isn't capable of protecting the shard alone. I need you to join her at Telmor to make sure the crystal makes it to Auchindoun safely.
english.completion: It's not safe here. The Shadow Council has already taken the city!
english.completed: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani outsider Telmor.

text.title: 取回碎片
text.objectives: 在泰尔莫外面与缚魂者图拉妮谈一谈。
text.description: 你在战斗中证明了自己过人的能力，$n。在奥金顿各处或许都有暗影议会的军队，包括泰尔莫附近。$B$B我需要你去泰尔莫协助缚魂者图拉妮，一定要把水晶安全地送到奥金顿。我知道你一定能完成这项任务。
text.completion: It's not safe here. The Shadow Council has already taken the city!
text.completed: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani outsider Telmor.

english.title: Scheduled Pickup
english.objectives: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani outside Telmor.
english.description: You've proven yourself more than capable in battle, $n. There may be Shadow Council forces all around Auchindoun, including near Telmor.$B$BI want you to join Soulbinder Tuulani at Telmor to make sure the crystal makes it safely to Auchindoun. I know I can trust you to get it done.
english.completion: It's not safe here. The Shadow Council has already taken the city!
english.completed: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani outsider Telmor.

text.title: They Took My Father
text.objectives: Collect Anchorite Dolruu's three notes.
text.description: $p! I have a lead on what happened to my father. There have been reports that he was seen in the presence of Shadow Council orcs in ____.$b$bMy father was a powerful Anchorite with a vast amount of ancient knowledge. I dread to think what those within the Shadow Council would do to him to get that knowledge. $b$bCan you go to ___? Hunt down their officers and see what they know?
text.completed: Return to Anchorite Raleen in your garrison.

english.title: They Took My Father
english.objectives: Collect Anchorite Dolruu's three notes.
english.description: $p! I have a lead on what happened to my father. There have been reports that he was seen in the presence of Shadow Council orcs in ____.$b$bMy father was a powerful Anchorite with a vast amount of ancient knowledge. I dread to think what those within the Shadow Council would do to him to get that knowledge. $b$bCan you go to ___? Hunt down their officers and see what they know?
english.completed: Return to Anchorite Raleen in your garrison.

text.title: 收集绳子
text.objectives: 从阿古拉克之骨的雷神驯兽师身上收集5卷结实的绳索。
text.description: 任何雷神成员都休想在我的怒火面前逃脱！我们得找些东西把他们从天上拉下来，好让我手刃仇敌。$b$b他们的驯兽师应该随身带着用来驾驭野兽的绳子。干掉他们，把他们身上还能用的绳子找来交给我。
text.progress: I'm growing tired of waiting, do you have anything to help our assault or not?
text.completion: Rope? Do you expect me to tie a noose and ask the Thunderlords to go hang themselves?$B$BWait... that gives me an idea. Yea, I think I can make this work with the right materials.$B$BGood Job.
text.completed: Return to Scout Ruk'gan at the Bones of Agurak in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: A Collection of Coils
english.objectives: Gather 5 Coils of Sturdy Rope from Thunderlord Wranglers in the Bones of Agurak.
english.description: None of the Thunderlord can escape my wrath! We need something to pull them out of the skies so that they can greet our blades.$b$bTheir wranglers should carry rope with them for handling their beasts. Slay them, if they have any coils in good condition bring them to me.
english.progress: I'm growing tired of waiting, do you have anything to help our assault or not?
english.completion: The rope? What am I supposed to do with it? Tie a noose and tell Thunderbirds to hang themselves? Wait... and I have an idea. Yeah, I think I can find a way to use that rope. Great.
english.completed: Return to Scout Ruk'gan at the Bones of Agurak in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 戈达乌的宿命
text.objectives: 取回愤怒之心。
text.description: 凶狠地横亘在我们与内室之间的，正是我们想要送回元素王座的大地之怒。$b$b被奴役的戈达乌此刻就站在我们面前，它已经沦为白鬼及其神秘主子的奴隶。看到这样一位伟大的元素生物神志不清地被邪恶力量驱遣，我的内心感到无比沉重。$b$b没有退路可走了，要想继续往前，你只能从戈达乌的尸体上跨过去。$b$b尽管我也不忍心，但戈达乌必须死。$b$b等这件事做完后，我们要把愤怒之心带回元素王座。
text.progress: What of Gordawg? Has the great fury been brought to rest?
text.completion: Gordawg was a mighty ally. The elements will mourn the loss of the fury, but death was the only answer. Gordawg would not have wished to stay a slave to evil.$b$bThough Gordawg is no more, the heart of a fury is eternal and unbreakable. In time, this brightly glowing heart will take shape into a new earthen fury.$b$bSuch is the cycle of life upon the Elemental Plateau.
text.completed: Bring the Heart of the Fury to Kalandrios.
text.giverWindow: 只有死亡，才能帮助伟大的大地之怒摆脱古加尔的魔爪。

english.title: The Fate of Gordawg
english.objectives: Retrieve the Heart of the Fury.
english.description: Looming monstrously between us and the inner chamber is the great fury we have sought to return to the Throne of Elements.$b$bGordawg stands before us enthralled; a slave to the pale and their mysterious master. My heart is heavy with grief to see such a great creature mindless and enslaved by evil.$b$bThere is no going back, in order to push forward you must go through Gordawg.$b$bIt pains me, but Gordawg must be slain.$b$bWhen the deed is done, we will return the fury's heart to the Throne of Elements.
english.progress: What is the news about Gordaug? Did the great spirit of the earth find peace?
english.completion: Gordawg was a mighty ally. The elements will mourn the loss of the fury, but death was the only answer. Gordawg would not have wished to stay a slave to evil.$b$bThough Gordawg is no more, the heart of a fury is eternal and unbreakable. In time, this brightly glowing heart will take shape into a new earthen fury.$b$bSuch is the cycle of life upon the Elemental Plateau.
english.completed: Bring the Heart of the Fury to Kalandrios.
english.giverWindow: Death is the only way to free the great fury from Cho'gall's grasp.

text.title: 力挽狂澜
text.objectives: 摧毁$1oa个召唤法阵。
text.description: 在下方坟场里的暗影议会成员们正在布置法阵。单单除掉他们是不够的，我们还得摧毁他们的邪能装置才行。$B$B如果你摧毁了法阵，就能阻止被他们召唤出来的恶魔大军占据亡者的尸骨。
text.completion: We should have killed them all at the Dark Portal in the beginning and damn the consequences.
text.completed: Return to Cordana Felsong at Throm'var.

english.title: Stop the Flow
english.objectives: Destroy $1oa Summoning Circles.
english.description: The Shadow Council down in the boneyard are going to have magic circles. It's not enough to simply kill them; we also have to eliminate their infernal devices.$B$BIf you destroy the circles, you'll stop the flow of demons they're summoning to inhabit the bones of the dead.
english.completion: Надо было убить их еще у Темного портала, и пес с ними, с последствиями.
english.completed: Return to Cordana Felsong at Throm'var.

text.title: 亵渎亡者
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个死灵侍僧和魔狼。
text.description: 这些肮脏的术士在亵渎坟场里的亡者！$B$B<方寸大乱的先知浑身战栗着。>$B$B我要他们死！$B$B消灭那些死灵侍僧。消灭他们的恶魔生物。
text.completion: For what they've done, it is not enough.$B$B$n, when you find their base, you salt the earth.
text.completed: Return to Farseer Urquan at Throm'var.

english.title: Desecration of the Dead
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Necrophytes and Fel Wolves.
english.description: These filthy warlocks are desecrating the dead in the boneyard!$B$B<The farseer trembles as he fails to keep his composure.>$B$BI WANT THEM DEAD!$B$BDestroy the necrophytes. Destroy their demonic abominations.
english.completion: Чтобы отомстить за их злодеяния, этого недостаточно.$B$B$n, когда найдешь их лагерь, посыпь землю солью.
english.completed: Return to Farseer Urquan at Throm'var.

text.title: 水落石出
text.objectives: 暗中监视暗影议会。
text.description: 等你准备好就跟我说一声。$B$B我们要利用指环的力量召唤一只他们的“眼睛”。通过那只眼睛，我们可以发现暗影议会的藏身之处，并查明他们的真正意图。
text.completion: Gul'dan is there! We must move quickly to capture him.
text.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Throm'var.

english.title: All is Revealed
english.objectives: Spy on the Shadow Council.
english.description: Tell me when you're ready.$B$BWe'll invoke the power of the ring to summon one of their 'eyes.' Through it, we'll discover where the Shadow Council is located and what they're really up to.
english.completion: Gul'dan is there! To catch him, you must act very quickly!
english.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Throm'var.

text.title: 挣脱枷锁
text.objectives: 找到血槌镣铐钥匙，并救出欧文·加多克。
text.description: 那些家伙对我拳打脚踢，我到现在还头痛欲裂，但我会活下去的。但我得摆脱这些锁链才行。$b$b你能帮我把开锁的钥匙找来吗？它就在那个名叫纳布的大块头食人魔身上，你可以在平台的远端找到他。
text.progress: Dun ye worry about me. I'll sit here an' nurse me wounds.
text.completion: With that ball o' stone gone I be feelin' better already!
text.completed: Return to Owynn Graddock within the Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Out of the Chains
english.objectives: Obtain the Bloodmaul Shackle Key and free Owynn Graddock.
english.description: They roughed me up real good an' I have a splitting headache but I'll survive. I need to get out of this bit o' chain here though.$b$bCould ye get the key to it for me? A big ogre called Nub has it, he's over on the far side of the terrace.
english.progress: Dun ye worry about me. I'll sit here an' nurse me wounds.
english.completion: With that ball o' stone gone I be feelin' better already!
english.completed: Return to Owynn Graddock within the Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 要塞战役：寻找欧文·加多克
text.objectives: 前往霜火岭的石怒崖，并寻找欧文·加多克。
text.description: 指挥官，我有个坏消息要报告。$b$b特工加多克外出执行监视血槌的任务，却没有在规定的最后期限前返回。$b$b事情有些不太对劲，$n。$b$b如果欧文被抓住了的话，他们可能是把他和其他奴隶锁在一起了。$b$b到石怒崖去，看看你能不能找到他。
text.completion: Well I be a son of a gnome! Am I glad to see you! I was hoping fer a rescue but didn't expect da boss tae be here himself!
text.completed: Speak with Owynn Graddock within the Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Garrison Campaign: The Search for Owynn Graddock
english.objectives: Travel to the Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge and search for Owynn Graddock.
english.description: Commander, I have bad news to report.$b$bAgent Graddock was out on assignment to keep an eye on the Bloodmaul and he missed his deadline to check back in.$b$bSomething's not right, $n.$b$bIf Owynn was captured they may have locked him away with their slaves.$b$bHead over to Stonefury Cliffs and see if you can locate him.
english.completion: Well I be a son of a gnome! Am I glad to see you! I was hoping fer a rescue but didn't expect da boss tae be here himself!
english.completed: Speak with Owynn Graddock within the Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.

objectiveDetails.description: 从杜加尔·朗德瑞克处起飞

text.title: 装备加身
text.objectives: 找到欧文的匕首、锤子和装备。
text.description: 我被抓住时，他们抢走了我身上的装备，就给我留下这身破衣烂衫。他们拿我的锤子去凿石头，甚至还把我最锋利的匕首当成了餐叉！我真不敢想象我的盔甲遭到了什么样的对待，但我希望它还没报废。$b$b我需要点时间来疗伤，而且在没有装备的情况下我也没法帮忙作战。你能帮我把装备找回来吗？$b$b我最后一次见到我的护甲，是在南边那座高塔边上的一个箱子里，而我的锤子则在西边的熔岩区附近。
text.progress: Just need a bit of a refresher, being beat up by ogres makes ye a little sore. Who knew?
text.completion: Thank ye, looks like everything's still in good shape. Just give me a moment to put this on.
text.completed: Return to Owynn Graddock within the Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Gearing Up
english.objectives: Obtain Owynn's Dagger, Mace, and Gear.
english.description: When I was captured they took my gear and left me in rags. My mace is being used to crack stones and they're even using me best dagger as a dinner fork! I'd hate to know what happened to me armor but I hope its still usable.$b$bI'll need a wee bit to recover from me wounds and without my stuff I'm no help in a fight. Could ye go find my gear for me?$b$bLast I saw my armors in a chest next to that big tower south of here, my dagger was to the south west, and my mace over near that lava field to the west.
english.progress: Just need a bit of a refresher, being beat up by ogres makes ye a little sore. Who knew?
english.completion: Thank ye, looks like everything's still in good shape. Just give me a moment to put this on.
english.completed: Return to Owynn Graddock within the Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 寻求真相
text.objectives: 找到波加尔·毁灭之拳。
text.description: 好吧，现在该讨论正事了。$b$b血槌氏族挖出了一个可怕的神器，我听他们管它叫磨魂者。它具有某种恶心的巫术，使他们的酋长获得了难以想象的魔法力量，但却要通过不断地吞噬灵魂来维持它。因此而遇害的奴隶尸体每天都在增加。$b$b我们必须找到波加尔，摧毁这个磨魂者！
text.completion: Secluded cave across the lava, check.$B$BCreepy piles o' bones, check.$B$BOkay, this looks like the place. We're gonna have to watch ourselves, I'll bet Borgal isn't here alone.
text.completed: Speak to Owynn Graddock within the Bloodmaul Stronghold in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Seeking the Truth
english.objectives: Locate Borgal Doomfist.
english.description: Okay, now down to business.$b$bThe Bloodmaul have unearthed some monstrous artifact I've heard them call the Soulgrinder. It's a nasty bit o' sorcery that their chief uses to give himself incredible magical power, but it comes at the cost of needing to feed upon souls to maintain it. Every day, more and more corpses pile up from the slaves killed to maintain it.$b$bWe need to go find Borgal and get rid of this Soulgrinder!
english.completion: Secluded cave across the lava, check.$B$BCreepy piles o' bones, check.$B$BOkay, this looks like the place. We're gonna have to watch ourselves, I'll bet Borgal isn't here alone.
english.completed: Speak to Owynn Graddock within the Bloodmaul Stronghold in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 净化魂灵
text.objectives: 净化$1oa个疯狂之魂。
text.description: 并非所有灵魂都被磨魂者尽数消灭，有些灵魂像我一样或多或少地保持了完整。其它那些却被扭曲并发狂了。$B$B去结束它们的痛苦吧，拿上我的灵魂碎片去净化它们。愤怒遮蔽了它们的双眼，使它们对碎片能量的效力视若不见，所以你必须先将其击败才能使用碎片。
text.completion: Thank you, I am glad that the spirits have been released from their torment.
text.completed: Return to Orlana Strongbrow within the spirit realm in the Bloodmaul Stronghold.

english.title: Cleansing the Souls
english.objectives: Cleanse $1oa Crazed Souls.
english.description: Not all spirits are destroyed by the Soulgrinder. Some souls manage to survive more or less intact like myself. Others have become twisted and maddened.$B$BEnd their misery, take my soul shard and use it to purify them. Their rage will blind them to the effects of its energy so you must defeat them before you use it.
english.completion: Thank you, I am glad that the spirits have been released from their torment.
english.completed: Return to Orlana Strongbrow within the spirit realm in the Bloodmaul Stronghold.

text.title: 束缚图腾
text.objectives: 收集$1oa个波加尔的图腾。
text.description: 在波加尔开始使用磨魂者之前，他曾使用图腾束缚灵魂，驱使它们为他效力。$b$b如果我们能拿到几个那样的图腾，我或许可以利用他与它们之间的灵魂联系来强行建立连结。那他就会被迫现身在我们眼前！$b$b去帮我找几个图腾来，我也许就能实现我的计划，我想有5个应该就够了。
text.progress: Do you have those totems I asked for? He left them around the buildings nearby.
text.completion: Very good, I can feel that the magic in these is strong.
text.completed: Return to Orlana Strongbrow within the spirit realm in the Bloodmaul Stronghold.

english.title: The Totems That Bind
english.objectives: Collect $1oa of Borgal's Totems.
english.description: Before Borgal began to use the Soulgrinder, he used totems to bind spirits to his service.$b$bIf we can get a few of those totems I may be able to use the spiritual connection he's forged with them to force a link. He'll be compelled to appear before us!$b$bGo find me a few of those totems and I might be able to pull this off, I think five should do it.
english.progress: Do you have those totems I asked for? He left them around the buildings nearby.
english.completion: Very good, I can feel that the magic in these is strong.
english.completed: Return to Orlana Strongbrow within the spirit realm in the Bloodmaul Stronghold.

text.title: 磨魂幸存者
text.objectives: 放置波加尔的图腾，让奥兰娜开始仪式，然后消灭波加尔。
text.description: 波加尔的死期到了。$b$b我们必须找一个能量充沛的地方，那样我才有举行仪式的空间。西北边那个废弃的塔楼再合适不过了。到那找我们，把图腾放到那里的能量区域内。等放好以后，我会举行召唤波加尔的仪式。$b$b而你的任务会比较困难——那就是消灭波加尔！
text.completion: That was one hell of a battle! Bloody fine job there la... um commander. $B$BOrlana really helped us out there. I'll ask around, maybe a priest can think of something we can do for her. $B$BAt any rate, we still have this artifact to deal with. I think you better hold onto it for safe keeping before any power crazed lunatics comes looking for it.
text.completed: Speak to Owynn Graddock within the Bloodmaul Stronghold in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Soulgrinder Survivor
english.objectives: Place Borgal's totems so that Orlana can begin the ritual, then kill Borgal.
english.description: It is time for Borgal to die.$b$bWe must travel to a location of power where I have room for the ritual. There is a ruined tower to the northwest that will be perfect for this. Meet us there and place the totems in the areas of power you will find there. Once they are placed I will do the ritual that will summon Borgal to us.$b$bYour job will be the difficult one, kill him!
english.completion: That was one hell of a battle! Bloody fine job there la... um commander. $B$BOrlana really helped us out there. I'll ask around, maybe a priest can think of something we can do for her. $B$BAt any rate, we still have this artifact to deal with. I think you better hold onto it for safe keeping before any power crazed lunatics comes looking for it.
english.completed: Speak to Owynn Graddock within the Bloodmaul Stronghold in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 掏心掏肺
text.objectives: 从菲努斯身上取得菲努斯之心。
text.description: 你注意到那道保护洞穴入口的魔法屏障了吗？有恶魔水晶在给它供能。$B$B燃烧军团总喜欢用恶魔身上的部件充当这些装置的钥匙。$B$B到西边的阿塔加废墟去。寻找一个强大的恶魔，把它的心脏给我带回来。$B$B我会将自己的影像投射到废墟里。在完成任务之前，你就不必返回这里了。
text.progress: Do you have the demon key?
text.completion: A heart? How touching.$B$BQuickly. We must use it to destroy the fel crystals and get to Gul'dan.
text.completed: Speak with the Image of Archmage Khadgar at the Ruins of Ata'gar.
text.giverWindow: 那颗恶魔的心脏是进入深黯峰，接近古尔丹的关键所在。

english.title: Have a Heart
english.objectives: Collect the Heart of Fernus from Fernus.
english.description: Did you notice the magical barrier protecting the cave's entrance? It's being powered by demon crystals.$B$BThe Burning Legion has a habit of making demon parts serve as the keys to such devices.$B$BTravel west to the Ruins of Ata'gar. Look for a powerful demon therein and bring me its heart.$B$BI'll project an image of myself into the ruins. You won't have to come back here until we're done.
english.progress: Do you have the demon key?
english.completion: Сердце? Как мило.$B$BПоспешим. С его помощью мы должны уничтожить кристаллы Скверны и добраться до Гул'дана.
english.completed: Speak with the Image of Archmage Khadgar at the Ruins of Ata'gar.
english.giverWindow: The infernal's heart is the key to gaining access to Gul'dan inside the Gloomspire.

text.title: 肃清暗影议会
text.objectives: 去阿塔加废墟消灭$1oa个暗影议会成员。
text.description: 那些废墟里很快就会挤满暗影议会的走狗了。一旦你解决掉古尔丹，我们决不能让这些家伙再流窜到德拉诺各地。$B$B绝对不行，我们得把那些兽人尽数消灭。
text.completion: Necessary business. We don't dare risk letting them grow more powerful.
text.completed: Return to Cordana Felsong at Throm'var.

english.title: Eliminate the Shadow Council
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Shadow Council members at the Ruins of Ata'gar.
english.description: Those ruins are going to be full of Shadow Council flunkies. We can't afford to let them scatter all over Draenor once you've dealt with Gul'dan.$B$BNo, we need to eliminate every one of them down to the last orc.
english.completion: Мы должны покончить с ними сейчас. Нельзя рисковать, ведь они могут стать еще сильнее.
english.completed: Return to Cordana Felsong at Throm'var.

text.title: 肃清暗影议会
text.objectives: 去阿塔加废墟消灭$1oa个暗影议会成员。
text.description: 这片废墟里到处都是暗影议会的追随者。一旦你解决掉古尔丹，我们决不能让这些家伙再流窜到德拉诺各地。$B$B绝对不行，我们得把那些兽人尽数消灭。
text.completion: Necessary business. We don't dare risk letting them grow more powerful.
text.completed: Return to Cordana Felsong at Throm'var.

english.title: Eliminate the Shadow Council
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Shadow Council members at the Ruins of Ata'gar.
english.description: These ruins are full of Shadow Council adherents. We can't afford to let them scatter all over Draenor once Gul'dan has been dealt with.$B$BNo, we need to eliminate every one of them down to the last orc.
english.completion: Necessary business. We don't dare risk letting them grow more powerful.
english.completed: Return to Cordana Felsong at Throm'var.

text.title: 邪能水晶
text.objectives: 摧毁邪能水晶。
text.description: 你拿到钥匙了。现在就用它来摧毁邪能水晶吧。$B$B毁掉那些水晶后，挡在深黯峰入口处的魔法屏障就会失效。$B$B一旦屏障失效，你就可以进去对付古尔丹了。
text.completion: The barrier is down. Now it's time to capture Gul'dan.
text.completed: Return to the Image of Archmage Khadgar at the Ruins of Ata'gar.

english.title: The Fel Crystals
english.objectives: Destroy the Fel Crystals.
english.description: You have the key. Now use it to destroy the fel crystals.$B$BOnce they are eliminated, the magical barrier blocking the entrance to the Gloomspire will come down.$B$BAnd once the barrier is down, you'll go inside to confront Gul'dan.
english.completion: The barrier's been destroyed. Time to capture Gul'dan.
english.completed: Return to the Image of Archmage Khadgar at the Ruins of Ata'gar.

text.title: 抓捕古尔丹
text.objectives: 挑战古尔丹。
text.description: 古尔丹就在深黯峰深处的洞穴里。$B$B我们知道他正准备动身前往塔拉多和影月谷。你必须不择手段地抓住他，$n。$B$B我在索姆瓦尔等你。祝你好运。
text.completion: Unfortunate, but not surprising. At least we were able to defeat one of the inner council members.$B$BAll is not lost, $n. We know what the Shadow Council is up to and where they're heading.$B$BWe'll regroup in Talador. Together, we'll put an end to Teron'gor and his plans for Auchindoun.$B$BDid you hear that?...
text.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar at Throm'var.

english.title: To Capture Gul'dan
english.objectives: Confront Gul'dan.
english.description: Gul'dan is in the cave further into the Gloomspire.$B$BWe know that he's about to leave for Talador and Shadowmoon Valley. You must capture him by any means necessary, $n.$B$BI'll see you back at Throm'var. Good luck.
english.completion: Неприятно, но ничего удивительного. По крайней мере, нам удалось победить одного из членов Совета.$b$bНо не все потеряно, $n. Нам известны планы Совета Теней и то, куда они направляются.$b$bВ Таладоре мы соберем силы. Вместе мы сможем уничтожить Терон'крова и не позволим ему захватить Аукиндон.$b$bТы это $gслышал:слышала;?..
english.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar at Throm'var.

text.title: A Threat We Can't Ignore
text.objectives: Plant the Underwater Explosives on the Iron Horde battleship.
text.description: Ishnu-alah, $n. I trust that Khadgar and Mathias have adequately briefed you on this situation here in Grommar. Time is of the essence, so I will be brief.$b$bThe Iron Horde presence here represents an immediate threat to the safety of Shadowmoon Valley. Grommar has been receiving supplies and reinforcements via the harbor for some time now.$b$bThe most concerning of these reinforcements are the battleships docked in the harbor. Place these explosives on the nearest battleship undetected and report back.

english.title: A Threat We Can't Ignore
english.objectives: Plant the Underwater Explosives on the Iron Horde battleship.
english.description: Ishnu-alah, $n. I trust that Khadgar and Mathias have adequately briefed you on this situation here in Grommar. Time is of the essence, so I will be brief.$b$bThe Iron Horde presence here represents an immediate threat to the safety of Shadowmoon Valley. Grommar has been receiving supplies and reinforcements via the harbor for some time now.$b$bThe most concerning of these reinforcements are the battleships docked in the harbor. Place these explosives on the nearest battleship undetected and report back.

text.title: Mutation Station
text.objectives: Assist Grulk in destroying the Mutation Lab by administering the Mutation Serum to him.
text.description: Grulk very weak...barely stand.$b$bGrulk not always look this way. Grulk once was orc...Iron Horde make Grulk mutant. Grulk angry at Iron Horde...so Iron Horde lock Grulk in cage...hurt Grulk.$b$bGrulk HATE Iron Horde...Grulk want SMASH them...make them PAY!$b$bTake serum...use on Grulk to make Grulk strong! Help Grulk SMASH Iron Horde!

english.title: Mutation Station
english.objectives: Assist Grulk in destroying the Mutation Lab by administering the Mutation Serum to him.
english.description: Grulk very weak...barely stand.$b$bGrulk not always look this way. Grulk once was orc...Iron Horde make Grulk mutant. Grulk angry at Iron Horde...so Iron Horde lock Grulk in cage...hurt Grulk.$b$bGrulk HATE Iron Horde...Grulk want SMASH them...make them PAY!$b$bTake serum...use on Grulk to make Grulk strong! Help Grulk SMASH Iron Horde!

objectiveDetails.description: Use the Mutation Serum on Grulk

text.title: 要塞战役：寻找暗影猎手布迦
text.objectives: 前往石怒崖，并寻找暗影猎手布加。
text.description: 我们已经有好长时间没有暗影猎手布加的消息了，指挥官。$b$b她最后一次出现，是在霜火岭执行监视血槌食人魔的任务。$b$b那些食人魔只不过是一群奴隶主，所以肯定是出了什么大事，才使她无法回来汇报情况。$b$b请你到石怒崖去找找她。
text.completion: Oi dere mon! Glad to see a friendly face but I not expect da commander ta come out here for me himself!
text.completed: Speak with Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja within the Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Garrison Campaign: The Search for Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja
english.objectives: Travel to the Stonefury Cliffs and search for Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja.
english.description: It be a long time since we hear from Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja, commander. $b$bLast we know she be on assignment keeping an eye on dem Bloodmaul ogres up in Frostfire.$b$bDem ogres just be a bunch a slavers so something really big must be happening ta keep her from reporting in.$b$bGo over ta de Stonefury Cliffs an' find her.
english.completion: Oi dere mon! Glad to see a friendly face but I not expect da commander ta come out here for me himself!
english.completed: Speak with Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja within the Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 挣脱枷锁
text.objectives: 找到血槌奴隶钥匙，并救出暗影猎手布加。
text.description: 听着伙计，那群食人魔把一个带有强大巫术的神器用在了我身上。等我醒过来之后发现自己浑身骨头像散了架一般，腿上还绑着锁链。我祈求魂灵帮我挣脱，可这里的魂灵没给我任何回应。$b$b看来只能用土办法脱身了。在洞穴里有个名叫鲁古姆的大块头食人魔，他身上有解开我镣铐的钥匙。你能不能用利刃戳破他的肚子，把钥匙给我拿来？
text.progress: You no worry about me, mon. I be going nowhere.
text.completion: Ah now, dat be feeling much better!
text.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja within Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Out of the Chains
english.objectives: Obtain the Bloodmaul Slave Key and free Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja.
english.description: Lissen mon, dem ogres, got da jump on me wid an artifact wid powerful mojo. Next t'ing I know I wake here wid broken bones an' dis chain on me leg. I called to da spirits ta break it, but da spirits here no answer.$b$bGotta go wid da old methods ta get out. Dere be a big ogre in da cave here called Rugrum who has da key to me shackle. Could ye go put a blade in his belly and get me dat key?
english.progress: You no worry about me, mon. I be going nowhere.
english.completion: Ah now, dat be feeling much better!
english.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja within Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 装备加身
text.objectives: 找到布加的护甲、佩剑和面具。
text.description: 那群食人魔对我拳打脚踢。我胳膊断了，还折了几根肋骨，就连脾都被打得隐隐作痛。虽说没有巨魔恢复不了的伤，可我需要些时间来恢复元气。$b$b眼下我最需要的是我那身被食人魔夺走的装备。他们把我的护甲藏到了南边一座小屋边上的箱子里，我的佩剑则被放在碾骨者瞭望塔附近的箱子中，甚至还把我的面具给拿走了，就在距离熔岩的不远处！我得留下喘口气，你能不能去帮我把东西找来？
text.progress: Ah, hear dat? T'ink anudda rib just popped back inta place.
text.completion: Ah dat be me stuff! Give me a moment ta put me stuff on mon. Then, I gonna take me an ogre ear for every bone I had ta pop back in place.
text.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja within Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Gearing Up
english.objectives: Obtain Bwu'ja's garb, glave, and mask.
english.description: Dem ogres whipped me real good. My arm be broke, a few ribs snapped, t'ink even me spleen be hurtin' from dat beatin'. Nothin' a troll can't handle though but I be needin' a moment ta recover.$b$bWhat I really be needin' is me gear dem ogres took from me. Dey got me garb in a chest near a hut to da south, me glave in a chest next to da tower wid da Bonecrushers, dey even got me mask, it over near da lava! Could ye go find dem while I take a breather?
english.progress: Ah, hear dat? T'ink anudda rib just popped back inta place.
english.completion: Ah dat be me stuff! Give me a moment ta put me stuff on mon. Then, I gonna take me an ogre ear for every bone I had ta pop back in place.
english.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja within Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 寻求真相
text.objectives: 找到波加尔·毁灭之拳。
text.description: 听着伙计，几天前的晚上，那群食人魔发现了某种古老而强大的巫术。$b$b当时我正在熔岩流间的洞穴附近巡视，突然从灵魂世界传来了一声刺耳的尖叫声。我进去之后，看见食人魔酋长波加尔正在用被他们称为磨魂者的大石轮汲取奴隶们的灵魂。我试图把他们弄出去，可那玩意儿一下子就掏空了我所有的力气。$b$b食人魔手里掌握着那样的巫术，真是太危险了。
text.completion: This be da place. We gonna need ta be careful, Borgal an' da artifact be in there.
text.completed: Speak to Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja within the Bloodmaul Stronghold in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Seeking the Truth
english.objectives: Locate Borgal Doomfist.
english.description: Lissen mon, a few nights ago dem ogres found a bit o' old and powerful mojo.$b$bI was snooping around da cave across de lava flows when dere was a huge scream from da spirit world. I went in and saw Borgal, de ogre chief, he be draining da spirits from de slaves wid some big stone wheel dat I heard dem call de Soulgrinder. I tried ta take 'em out but a single shot from dat thing took all de strength from me.$b$bDat mojo too much of a threat in de hands of dem ogres.
english.completion: This be da place. We gonna need ta be careful, Borgal an' da artifact be in there.
english.completed: Speak to Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja within the Bloodmaul Stronghold in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 束缚图腾
text.objectives: 收集$1oa个波加尔的图腾。
text.description: 在波加尔开始使用磨魂者之前，他曾使用图腾束缚灵魂，驱使它们为他效力。$b$b如果我们能拿到几个那样的图腾，我或许可以利用他与它们之间的灵魂联系来强行建立连结。那他就会被迫现身在我们眼前！$b$b去帮我找几个图腾来，我也许就能实现我的计划，我想有5个应该就够了。
text.progress: Do you have those totems I asked for? He left them around the buildings nearby.
text.completion: Very good, I can feel that the magic in these is strong.
text.completed: Return to Orlana Strongbrow within the spirit realm in the Bloodmaul Stronghold.

english.title: The Totems That Bind
english.objectives: Collect $1oa of Borgal's Totems.
english.description: Before Borgal began to use the Soulgrinder, he used totems to bind spirits to his service.$b$bIf we can get a few of those totems I may be able to use the spiritual connection he's forged with them to force a link. He'll be compelled to appear before us!$b$bGo find me a few of those totems and I might be able to pull this off, I think five should do it.
english.progress: Do you have those totems I asked for? He left them around the buildings nearby.
english.completion: Very good, I can feel that the magic in these is strong.
english.completed: Return to Orlana Strongbrow within the spirit realm in the Bloodmaul Stronghold.

text.title: 磨魂幸存者
text.objectives: 放置波加尔的图腾，让奥兰娜开始仪式，然后消灭波加尔。
text.description: 波加尔的死期到了。$b$b我们必须找一个能量充沛的地方，那样我才有举行仪式的空间。西北边那个废弃的塔楼再合适不过了。到那找我们，把图腾放到那里的能量区域内。等放好以后，我会举行召唤波加尔的仪式。$b$b而你的任务会比较困难——那就是消灭波加尔！
text.completion: Dat was a battle for da ages mon! Bwu'ja be glad ye are here commanda, else I'd likely be back in da spirit world permanently.$B$BDat Soulgrinda be a nasty piece o' mojo. Ye be the best one to hold onto it.$B$BDat spirit, she helped us out a lot mon. I hope she find da peace she be seeking now.
text.completed: Speak to Owynn Graddock within the Bloodmaul Stronghold in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Soulgrinder Survivor
english.objectives: Place Borgal's totems so that Orlana can begin the ritual, then kill Borgal.
english.description: It is time for Borgal to die.$b$bWe must travel to a location of power where I have room for the ritual. There is a ruined tower to the northwest that will be perfect for this. Meet us there and place the totems in the areas of power you will find there. Once they are placed I will do the ritual that will summon Borgal to us.$b$bYour job will be the difficult one, kill him!
english.completion: Dat was a battle for da ages mon! Bwu'ja be glad ye are here commanda, else I'd likely be back in da spirit world permanently.$B$BDat Soulgrinda be a nasty piece o' mojo. Ye be the best one to hold onto it.$B$BDat spirit, she helped us out a lot mon. I hope she find da peace she be seeking now.
english.completed: Speak to Owynn Graddock within the Bloodmaul Stronghold in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 往昔的余烬
text.objectives: 血槌领地里的莫斯隆要求你给他带去$1oa堆元素灰烬。
text.description: 那些食人魔是我们一族的死敌。他们召唤并奴役我的族人，迫使他们不眠不休的工作，直到他们身上的热量散尽，化为尘埃。$b$b我们必须把他们的灰烬放回到熔岩流里去，这样他们才能重生！$b$b食人魔喜欢把那些灰烬放在贴身的口袋里，以为这能增强自己的力量。去消灭他们，把我族人的灰烬带回来！
text.progress: Do you bring me the remains of our fallen?
text.completion: Thank you flesh creature. In the lava the ashes will mix and the cycle shall continue as it has ever since the beginning.
text.completed: Return to Molthron within the Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Ashes Of The Past
english.objectives: Molthron within the Bloodmaul Territory wants you to bring him $1oa Piles of Elemental Ash.
english.description: The ogres are a plague upon my kind. They summon my kin and force them into servitude, working them without rest till their heat fades away and they crumble into dust.$b$bTheir ashes must return to the lava flows so that they can be reborn!$b$bThe Ogres keep the dust in pouches on their person thinking it would enhance their strength. Go slay them and recover the ashes of my people!
english.progress: Do you bring me the remains of our fallen?
english.completion: Thank you flesh creature. In the lava the ashes will mix and the cycle shall continue as it has ever since the beginning.
english.completed: Return to Molthron within the Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 大地之焰
text.objectives: 血槌领地里的莫斯隆想让你用烈焰锻铸的宝石解救$1oa个被束缚的熔岩元素。
text.description: 我在大地深处展开了搜寻，发现了打破禁锢我族人法术的方法，可它只能释放彻底被束缚的俘虏。我无法保护自己不被同样的法术束缚。$b$b而你，你是血肉之躯，并非由下面的烈焰所组成，他们的束缚法术影响不到你。$b$b请你拿上我的宝石，用它的力量解救我的族人吧！
text.completion: The lava already burns bright with the return of my people's freedom!$B$BWe will have our revenge upon the ogres for everything they have done to us, this I assure you. But for now, we shall rest.
text.completed: Return to Molthron within the Bloodmaul Territory in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Flames Of The Earth
english.objectives: Molthron within the Bloodmaul Territory wants you to use the Flamewrought Jewel to free $1oa Magma Elementals.
english.description: I've searched the depths of the earth and found the means to break the spells that hold my people captive, but it only functions to free one who is completely bound. I would be unable to prevent myself from becoming bound by the same magic.$b$bYou, flesh creature, are not of the flames below so their binding spells should not affect you.$b$bPlease take my jewel, use its power to free my people!
english.completion: The lava already burns bright with the return of my people's freedom!$B$BWe will have our revenge upon the ogres for everything they have done to us, this I assure you. But for now, we shall rest.
english.completed: Return to Molthron within the Bloodmaul Territory in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 扭转局势
text.objectives: 与惩戒岗哨的瑞斯塔兰谈一谈。
text.description: 是时候手刃这个敌人了。到惩戒岗哨来见我，我们一起去找暗影议会算总账。$B$B只要有我们在，塔隆戈尔就休想再吞噬任何灵魂！他的恐怖统治将在今天终结。
text.completion: Our enemy has been pushed back and Auchindoun's defenses restored thanks to your help, but we are not yet done here.
text.completed: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani outsider Telmor.

english.title: Changing the Tide
english.objectives: Speak to Restalaan at Retribution Point.
english.description: It is time to retaliate against this foe. Meet me at Retribution Point and we will take this fight to the Shadow Council.$B$BTeron'gor shall not feast on another soul so long as we stand in his way! His reign of terror ends today.
english.completion: Our enemy has been pushed back and Auchindoun's defenses restored thanks to your help, but we are not yet done here.
english.completed: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani outsider Telmor.

text.title: 要塞战役：战地乌鸦
text.objectives: 在戈尔隆德的天海岭与希萨莉·黑鸦谈一谈。
text.description: 我们的德鲁伊建立起了庞大的侦察网，来追查你从纳格兰搞来的情报。$B$B我们在戈尔隆德西部海岸的盐池附近，发现了一个可疑的钢铁部落挖掘场。$B$B我们有理由相信，这些兽人正在沙漠深处追寻一件珍贵的神器。$B$B我正准备派出一支小队去执行精确打击任务，正需要像你这么能干的$c帮忙。希望你能加入我们。
text.completion: Greetings, $C. You're the commander that Choluna mentioned?$B$B$B$BGood.

english.title: Garrison Campaign: Crows In The Field
english.objectives: Speak to Thisalee Crow at Skysea Ridge in Gorgrond.
english.description: Our druids set up a wide network of scouts to follow up on your intel from Nagrand.$B$BWe've identified a suspicious Iron Horde excavation near some salt pools on the western coast of Gorgrond.$B$BWe have reason to believe that these orcs are pursuing a valuable artifact deep in the desert.$B$BI'm putting together a small mission for a focused, surgical strike, and we could use a capable $c like yourself. I'd like you to be part of that team.
english.completion: Привет, |3-6($c). Это про тебя говорила Чолуна?$B$B<Тизали оглядывает вас с головы до ног и одобрительно кивает.>$B$BХорошо.

text.title: 伏击敌人
text.objectives: 收集5份车队货物和奥洛克中尉的徽记。
text.description: 看见南边水流另一侧的那个钢铁部落营地了吗？我们已经观察他们好多天了。$B$B我们发现他们的军官和钢铁部落在纳格兰的指挥部联系非常密切。$B$B我们必须破坏他们的行动。$B$B夺取他们的补给品，并把他们首领的徽记给我带回来。
text.progress: Those orcs were working on someone else's orders.
text.completion: I knew you were the right person for this job, $n. I just love results.
text.completed: Return to Thisalee Crow at Skysea Ridge.

english.title: Ambushing the Enemy
english.objectives: Collect 5 Caravan Shipments and Lieutenant O'rok's Head.
english.description: See that Iron Horde camp to the south, across the water? We've been watching their movements for days.$B$BWe've seen a lot of correspondence between their lieutenant and the Iron Horde command in Nagrand.$B$BWe need to disrupt their operation.$B$BGather their supplies, and bring me their leader's head.
english.progress: Those orcs were working on someone else's orders.
english.completion: Я и не сомневалась, что ты отлично справишься с этой работой, $n. Результаты меня очень порадовали.
english.completed: Return to Thisalee Crow at Skysea Ridge.

text.title: 羽颈之釜
text.objectives: 与楚伦娜谈一谈。
text.description: 一件珍贵的神器在羽颈之釜，哈？$B$B让我们试试能不能击败那些去寻找它的钢铁部落。$B$B赶快行动吧。去跟楚伦娜谈谈，我们这就出发。
text.completion: So this is it, huh? Let's see what's hiding in these depths.
text.completed: Speak to Thisalee Crow at Cragplume Cauldron.

english.title: The Giant Cauldron
english.objectives: Speak to Choluna.
english.description: A high value artifact at Cragplume Canyon, hmmm?$B$BLet's see if we can't beat the Iron Horde to it.$B$BLet's move fast. Speak to Choluna, and we'll be on our way.
english.completion: Так вот он какой! Ну давай посмотрим, что скрывается в этих глубинах.
english.completed: Speak to Thisalee Crow at Cragplume Cauldron.

text.title: 下行调查
text.objectives: 调查羽颈之釜。
text.description: 不管在这底下究竟有什么，它对钢铁部落肯定有大用，所以对我们而言也是一样。$B$B我需要你到坑底去展开调查。$B$B你先出发。我就跟在你后面。
text.progress: <Thisalee looks at you coolly.>
text.completion: That was close, $n. Good work.
text.completed: Speak to Thisalee Crow at Cragplume Cauldron.

english.title: The Descent
english.objectives: Investigate Cragplume Cauldron.
english.description: Whatever lies at the bottom of this cauldron is of great use to the Iron Horde, and therefore, of great interest to us.$B$BI need you to investigate the bottom of this crater.$B$BYou go ahead. I'll be right behind you.
english.progress: <Thisalee looks at you coolly.>
english.completion: Ты чудом $Gспасся:спаслась;, $n. Отличная работа.
english.completed: Speak to Thisalee Crow at Cragplume Cauldron.

text.title: 鬣蜥人的饮食
text.objectives: 收集8个饱胀的胃囊并检查里面的物质。
text.description: 鬣蜥人。这个火山口里到处都是鬣蜥人。我在这里都能闻到它们的臭味。$B$B我怀疑这些鬣蜥人不仅是未开化的野兽，但为了证明我的理论，我需要更多资料。$B$B在你执行任务时，如果碰巧杀死了一两只鬣蜥人的话，能不能替我检查下它们的胃？我想知道这些古怪的家伙们吃什么。
text.completion: Oh my, what an interesting variety! It appears that the goren will eat... anything!
text.completed: Return to Choluna at Cragplume Cauldron.

english.title: A Goren's Feast
english.objectives: Collect 8 Engorged Stomachs and examine their contents.
english.description: Goren. This caldera is full of them. I can even smell their stench from here.$B$BI suspect that these goren are more than just primitive beasts, but in order to prove my theories, I need more data.$B$BDuring your mission, if you should slay a goren or two, would you examine their stomachs for me? I'd like to know what these curious creatures eat.
english.completion: Ух ты, как интересно! Получается, что горены едят... вообще все подряд!
english.completed: Return to Choluna at Cragplume Cauldron.

text.title: 热力迸发
text.objectives: 在羽颈之釜嘶嘶作响的气泉附近使用爱伦的温度计。
text.description: 你好，$n。我研究戈尔隆德的蒸汽喷泉已经有段时间了。$B$B羽颈之釜是这个地区最大的火山口之一，可由于当地存在着危险生物，我们一直无法进行地质考察。$B$B既然你要到下面去，能不能麻烦你帮我采集下温度读数？$B$B这对我们掌握这些天然洞穴的情况很有帮助。
text.completion: Oh, my! Amazing! This caldera is hotter than hot! Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Aren Mistshade at Cragplume Cauldron.

english.title: Heating Up
english.objectives: Use Aren's Thermometer near the Hissing Geyser inside Cragplume Cauldron.
english.description: Greetings, $n. I have been conducting research on the steam geysers of Gorgrond for some time now.$B$BCragplume Cauldron is one of the largest caldera in this region, but we have been unable to do a geographical survey due to the dangerous creatures in this area.$B$BSince you are venturing into the depths, could you take a temperature reading for me?$B$BIt would add greatly to our understanding of these natural caverns.
english.completion: Ну ничего себе! Потрясающе! Эта кальдера не просто горячая – там все кипит! Спасибо тебе, $n.
english.completed: Return to Aren Mistshade at Cragplume Cauldron.

objectiveDetails.description: 采集嘶嘶作响的气泉的温度

text.title: 跃动之心
text.objectives: 把高格里克之心交给你要塞中的战争大师佐格。
text.description: 有一件事情是可以肯定的。我们现在拿到了一样对钢铁部落至关重要的东西。$B$B我们最好立即把这个……“高格里克之心”送往安全的地方。
text.completion: Good. We will keep the artifact safe here, in your garrison.

english.title: The Beating Heart
english.objectives: Deliver the Heart of Gorgorek to Warmaster Zog at your garrison.
english.description: One thing is certain. We now possess an item of great value to the Iron Horde.$B$BWe had better secure this... "Heart of Gorgorek" at once.
english.completion: Хорошо. Мы будем хранить артефакт здесь, в твоем гарнизоне.

text.title: 潜伏者
text.objectives: 收集$1oa剂潜伏者的毒液。
text.description: 这是个危险的地方，头儿。$b$b到处都是庞大的怪物和粗野的巨人。$b$b不过嘛，就像我家人曾经说的那样，“明的不行，咱就来暗的。”$b$B我们得从龟裂平原的潜伏者身上弄些毒液来。那些潜伏者非常鬼祟，而且非常恐怖。你得注意地下的响声和震颤。$b$b我会留在这里调配治疗药剂，以防你不小心中毒了。
text.progress: Dem lurkers scare ya off?
text.completion: Dem centipedes creep you out boss-mon? Touchin' ya with their teeny tiny legs? I ain't thought of a thing that makes me skin crawl more, except maybe mah sister's voice. Hee hee.
text.completed: Return to Rala at Darkspear's Edge in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Lurkers
english.objectives: Collect $1oa doses of Lurker Venom.
english.description: Dis be a dangerous place, boss-mon.$b$bFilled with big monsters and savage giants.$b$bWell, like my family loa say, 'If ya can't beat it, poison it.'$b$BWe gonna be needin' some venom from the lurkers out there on the Cracking Plains. Dem lurkers be mighty sneaky, and mighty creepy. Be watchin the ground for rumbles and shakes.$b$bI'll be stayin' here to make a cure in case you accidentally get too poisoned.
english.progress: Dem lurkers scare ya off?
english.completion: Dem centipedes creep you out boss-mon? Touchin' ya with their teeny tiny legs? I ain't thought of a thing that makes me skin crawl more, except maybe mah sister's voice. Hee hee.
english.completed: Return to Rala at Darkspear's Edge in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 制作毒药
text.objectives: 采集$1oa片雪霜花叶片。
text.description: 我们要捕猎的是一个超级巨大、超级野蛮的家伙，所以还需要另外一种毒药。我们得用到一大瓶毒药膏！$b$b那么……头儿，你能不能去摘几朵小花来？我们要找的是生长在龟裂平原岩石暗影间和边缘地带的雪霜花叶片。$b$b摘的时候千万要小心啊头儿！那可不是能随便摘的……
text.progress: I'd pick de flowers myself, but I got allergies. Ha ha!
text.completion: Haha! Ya brought 'em! I hope ya not offended I asked such a lowly task of ya. We needed the leaves, and I needed to settle a bet.
text.completed: Return to Rala at Darkspear's Edge in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Poulticide
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Frostbloom Leaves.
english.description: We be huntin' something so big, so savage, we gonna need anotha poison. We gonna need a big ol' poultice of poison!$b$bSo...  boss-mon? Ya think ya up for a little flower pickin'? We gonna need the leaves of them frostbloom plants that be growing along the shadows of rocks and ledges along the sides of the Cracking Plains.$b$bBe careful when pickin' them,  boss-mon! They not always be by themselves...
english.progress: I'd pick de flowers myself, but I got allergies. Ha ha!
english.completion: Haha! Ya brought 'em! I hope ya not offended I asked such a lowly task of ya. We needed the leaves, and I needed to settle a bet.
english.completed: Return to Rala at Darkspear's Edge in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 严霜之怒
text.objectives: 收集$1oa块严霜碎片。
text.description: 德拉诺的冰怒元素和艾泽拉斯上的元素看起来不太一样。但千万别被表象迷惑。它们当中有些是非常邪恶的，头儿。邪恶。$b$b我们得找到一些严霜碎片才能完成陷阱的制作。如果你愿意的话，可以从冰怒元素身上找到它们。$b$b那些冰怒元素就在龟裂平原上游荡，只要一接触到它们，就会被冻成冰块，邪恶得很。$b$b帮我们找些严霜碎片来吧，头儿，然后我们就能给你制成一个致命的陷阱。
