text.progress: A shadow huntah knows much of da spirits. We be talkin'. We be tradin'. But these ice furies, dey be wicked, boss-mon.
text.completion: Ah, now these be some fine trap making props. Ya know how to make a shadow huntah proud.
text.completed: Return to Mala at Darkspear's Edge in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Frosted Fury
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Frostshards.
english.description: The furies of Draenor are different than the elementals of Azeroth. But don't be fooled. Some be wicked, boss-mon. Wicked.$b$bThe trap we are making be needing some proper frostshards. You can get them, if ya willing, from the ice furies.$b$bDey be wandering the Cracking Plains, freezin' all dat dey touch, an' bein' wicked.$b$bBring us some o' these frostshards,  boss-mon, an' we gonna whip ya up one deadly trap.
english.progress: A shadow huntah knows much of da spirits. We be talkin'. We be tradin'. But these ice furies, dey be wicked, boss-mon.
english.completion: Ah, now these be some fine trap making props. Ya know how to make a shadow huntah proud.
english.completed: Return to Mala at Darkspear's Edge in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 刃怒的指令
text.objectives: 把刃怒的指令交给天海岭的希萨莉·黑鸦。
text.description: 奥洛克中尉：$B$B派遣精英突击队前往羽颈之釜。$B$B从盆地中夺取珍贵神器，并送到我在塔拉多北部的指挥所。$B$B率领所有剩余兵力前往高格里克之陨。保护并准备好古老的玛戈隆标本以备取用。$B$B立即行动，不得有误。$B$B- 刃怒
text.completion: These orders come straight from the leader of the Burning Blade!$B$BI've heard of her... the fierce orc with the blade that thirsts for death.$B$BYou've done well to bring this to me, $n.

english.title: Bladefury's Orders
english.objectives: Deliver Bladefury's Orders to Thisalee Crow at Skysea Ridge.
english.description: Lieutenant O'rok:$B$BSend an elite strike team to Cragplume Cauldron.$B$BRetrieve a high-value artifact from the crater and deliver it to my command post in northern Talador.$B$BWith your remaining forces, go to Gorgorek's Fall. Protect and prepare the ancient magnaron specimen for retrieval.$B$BImmediate action is required.$B$B- Bladefury
english.completion: Приказы напрямую от вождя клана Пылающего Клинка!$B$BО ней такое рассказывают... жестокая натура, беспощадный клинок...$B$BОчень хорошо, что ты сразу $gпринес:принесла; приказы мне, $n.

text.title: 真正的猎物
text.objectives: 找到冰穹巢穴，然后消灭强大的格罗什。
text.description: 呃，头儿。我们现在该去猎取真正的猎物了。在北边有个洞穴。洞里有个卑鄙的独眼魔，他们叫他“强大的格罗什”。那个独眼魔藏了一大堆抢来的皮革和毛皮，我们要塞的军队正需要这些。$b$b我用你找来的材料制成了一种特殊的毒药。这是一种魔法毒药，能把那独眼魔变得稍微容易对付一些。$b$b把这几个小瓶子带到洞穴里去，看看你能不能给我们找来宝贝。
text.completion: Now dat be a mighty fine haul. We gonna be keepin' all the folks at the garrison warm.$b$bIt seemed like a simple task but ya tackled it like a boss-mon. If ya need a shadow hunter in your ranks, I be willin' to serve.
text.completed: Return to Rala at Darkspear's Edge in Frostfire Ridge.
text.giverWindow: 这畜生从死在他手里的受害者身上积累了不少财富啊。

english.title: The Real Prey
english.objectives: Find Iceblister Den and then slay Grosh the Mighty.
english.description: Eh boss-mon. Time for us to be huntin' the real prey now. To the north, there be a cave. In the cave, there be right mean ogron dey call "Grosh the Mighty." That ogron got a big stash of pillaged hides and leathers we gonna be needin' for the troops at the garrison.$b$bI made a special poison from the stuff ya gathered. Dis be a magic poison, and it gonna put that ogron down to sometin' a bit more manageable. $b$bTake these vials to the cave and see if ya can't win us a treasure.
english.completion: Now dat be a mighty fine haul. We gonna be keepin' all the folks at the garrison warm.$b$bIt seemed like a simple task but ya tackled it like a boss-mon. If ya need a shadow hunter in your ranks, I be willin' to serve.
english.completed: Return to Rala at Darkspear's Edge in Frostfire Ridge.
english.giverWindow: This brute has accumulated a hoard of wealth from his victims.

text.title: 额外的水晶塔
text.objectives: 前往圣光之墓收集$1oa块阿肯尼特水晶和1个阿肯尼特晶塔。
text.description: 我们来这里是为了找到给奥金顿防御系统充能的备用晶塔，可却被暗影议会困在这里好几个小时了！$B$B我得把这些伤员送回大主教的避难所，但还是得找到备用系统才行！$B$B拜托了，尽快从墓穴里搜集阿肯尼特水晶和1个阿肯尼特晶塔，然后到避难所与我会合！
text.progress: Do you have the arkonite pylon and the crystals?
text.completion: Light bless you, hero! We need to hold out as long as we can so Nyami can track down the remaining power shards. This pylon will help take the load off of our soulpriests.
text.completed: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani at Exarch's Refuge in Talador.

english.title: We Must Construct Additional Pylons
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Arkonite Crystals and an Arkonite Pylon from the Tomb of Lights.
english.description: We came here to retrieve a reserve pylon to power Auchindoun's defenses, but we've been pinned to this position by the Shadow Council for hours!$B$BI need to get these injured back to Exarch's Refuge, but we still need the backup system!$B$BPlease, gather Arkonite crystals and an Arkonite pylon from the tomb and meet me at the refuge as quickly as you can!
english.progress: Do you have a caronite pylon and crystals?
english.completion: Light bless you, hero! We need to hold out as long as we can so Nyami can track down the remaining power shards. This pylon will help take the load off of our soulpriests.
english.completed: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani at Exarch's Refuge in Talador.

text.title: 黑潮防御者
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个黑潮盗贼和$2oa个黑潮工程师。
text.description: <雷克萨看着你检查地精的尸体。他显然希望你这么做。>
text.completion: <You have markedly reduced the number of goblins in the Dark Tide Nest. >

english.title: Darktide Defender
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Darktide Pilferers and $2oa Darktide Engineers.
english.description: <Rexxar looks at you as you inspect the dead goblin. It's clear what he wants you to do.>
english.completion: <You have markedly reduced the number of goblins in the Dark Tide Nest. >

text.title: 粉碎切割者
text.objectives: 在黑潮栖木摧毁黑潮切割者。
text.description: 双头飞龙在钢铁部落的科技面前毫无防御力。真正的猎手根本不需要用机器去捕捉猎物。$b$b摧毁钢铁切割者，并消灭操纵它们的渣子。斯比雷会助你完成任务。
text.completion: You are proving to be a great hunter, $n. But our work on this island is not yet complete.
text.completed: Return to Rexxar at Darktide Roost in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Shredder Suppressor
english.objectives: Destroy Darktide Shredders on Darktide Roost.
english.description: The rylaks have no defense against the Iron Horde's technology. A true hunter would not need machines to capture their prey.$b$bDestroy the Iron Shredders and the scum that pilot them. Spirit will join you on your quest.
english.completion: And you're $gexcellent hunter:excellent hunter;, $n. But our work on this island is not yet complete.
english.completed: Return to Rexxar at Darktide Roost in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 善终
text.objectives: 在黑潮栖木用雷克萨的斧子杀死受伤的双头飞龙。
text.description: 这群蠢货毫无荣誉感可言。$b$b他们似乎喜欢折磨这些可怜的野兽。我们眼下唯一能做的善事就是找到受伤的双头飞龙，并结束它们的痛苦。$b$b拿上这把斧子，对准它们的命门砍下去吧，$n。这些双头飞龙应该得到善终。
text.completion: You have done a good thing here today. Don't let the blood on your axe blind you.$B$BYou have given these rylaks the peace they deserve.
text.completed: Return to Rexxar at Darktide Roost in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: A Good Death
english.objectives: Use Rexxar's axe to kill Injured Rylaks at Darktide Roost.
english.description: These fools have no honor.$b$bThey seem to enjoy torturing these poor beasts. The only humane thing we can do at this point is find injured rylaks and put them out of their misery.$b$bTake this axe and aim for their vitals, $n.  These rylaks deserve a good death.
english.completion: You have done a good thing here today. Don't let the blood on your axe blind you.$B$BYou have given these rylaks the peace they deserve.
english.completed: Return to Rexxar at Darktide Roost in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 肮脏的老鼠
text.objectives: 在黑潮栖木用老鼠摧毁无人切割者。
text.description: 这些切割者比我想的还要麻烦。$b$b我一直在借助岛上老鼠的眼睛查看。在西边有不少无人看管的切割者。$b$b老鼠们对这诱饵有着无法控制的食欲。把它扔到无人切割者上去，让老鼠们从里面毁掉这些工具吧。
text.completion: With fewer machines these weaklings will quickly lose their foothold on this island.$B$BExcellent work, $n.
text.completed: Return to Rexxar at Darktide Roost in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Dirty Rats
english.objectives: Use the rats to destroy Unmanned Shredders on Darktide Roost.
english.description: These shredders are more of a hassle than I expected.$b$bI've been peering through the eyes of the rats on the island. There are number of unmanned shredders west of here.$b$bThe rats have an uncontrollable appetite for this bait. Throw it onto Unmanned Shredders and let the rats destroy them from the inside.
english.completion: Потеряв машины, эти слабаки быстрее сдадут свои позиции на острове.$b$bТы хорошо $gпотрудился:потрудилась;, $n.
english.completed: Return to Rexxar at Darktide Roost in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 暗影之门
text.objectives: 击败格鲁布诺·战胆，并追上波加尔。
text.description: 好吧，我们得动作快点。$b$b我以前见过波加尔制造魔法传送门，所以他很有可能会尝试利用传送门逃离。要是他真这样做的话，那我们只能跟上他们了。此外，他还常常把他的副官格鲁布诺带在身边，恐怕一场恶战在所难免。$b$b<欧文朝洞里瞥了一眼。>$b$b小心行事，里面有些事情不对劲。
text.completion: Blast it, he's given us the slip!$B$BTa make things worse the portal looks like it's closed from this side. We're gonna have to find a way to track Borgal down or we might be stuck in wherever this is.
text.completed: Speak to Owynn Graddock within the Bloodmaul Stronghold in Frostfire Ridge.
text.giverWindow: 他有点慢。

english.title: The Shadow Gate
english.objectives: Defeat Grubnor Wargut and follow after Borgal.
english.description: Okay, we're gonna have to be quick. $b$bI've seen Borgal form magical portals before so he might try to use one to escape. If he does that our only option will be to follow after 'em. On top of that he always keeps his lieutenant Grubnor nearby so we may have a bit of a tussle in store.$b$b<Owynn peeks into the cave.>$b$bKeep yer head down, something's going on in there.
english.completion: Blast it, he's given us the slip!$B$BTa make things worse the portal looks like it's closed from this side. We're gonna have to find a way to track Borgal down or we might be stuck in wherever this is.
english.completed: Speak to Owynn Graddock within the Bloodmaul Stronghold in Frostfire Ridge.
english.giverWindow: He's a bit slow.

text.title: 为了部落！
text.objectives: 插上部落旗帜以表明对土地的所有权。
text.description:
要是没有你，我们谁都到不了我故乡的海岸。你将成为我们在德拉诺的军事领袖。这里就是供你建造要塞的地方。

由你来插下旗帜，宣告领地的所有权吧。等你做好准备，我会让卡德加打开传送门，送来一些必要的援军。
text.completion: I'm under orders to obey your orders, commander.
text.completed: Speak with Gazlowe at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge

english.title: For the Horde!
english.objectives: Plant the Horde Banner to Claim the Land.
english.description:
Without you, none of us would have made it to the shores of my homeland. You will be the one to lead our forces here on Draenor. This is your garrison to found.

I leave it to you to plant the banner and claim this territory. When you are ready, I will have Khadgar open a portal to bring through a few necessary reinforcements.
english.completion: I'm under orders to obey your orders, commander.
english.completed: Speak with Gazlowe at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge

text.title: 释放双头飞龙
text.objectives: 在黑潮栖木释放笼中的双头飞龙。
text.description: 这群地精一直在对双头飞龙进行可怕的实验。这个蠢货向我提供了三个重要实验的地点。$b$b放掉这些变异的双头飞龙吧。也许自由能帮这些饱受折磨的灵魂在余生中寻获一些安宁。
text.completion: Excellent work, $n. You are proving to be a great ally.
text.completed: Return to Rexxar at Darktide Roost in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Releasing Rylak
english.objectives: Free the Caged Rylaks on Darktide Roost.
english.description: These goblins have been conducting horrible experiments on the rylaks. This fool gave me the location for three of their prized experiments.$b$bSet these mutated rylaks free. Maybe freedom will help these tortured souls find some peace in life.
english.completion: Чудесно, $n. Ты $gбесценный союзник:бесценная союзница;.
english.completed: Return to Rexxar at Darktide Roost in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 回去工作
text.objectives: 标记$1oa棵树。
text.description:
好吧，头儿。要想开始建造这座要塞，我们就需要一些木料。

只要你去标记一些要砍伐的树木，剩下的事就交给你的苦工吧。
text.completion: That should be plenty of wood for now.
text.completed: Return to Gazlowe at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge

english.title: Back to Work
english.objectives: Mark $1oa Trees.
english.description:
Alright, boss. We're gonna need some lumber if we're gonna get this garrison started off right.

If you mark some trees to be cut down, your peons will do the rest.
english.completion: That should be plenty of wood for now.
english.completed: Return to Gazlowe at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge

text.title: Ore Not to Be
text.objectives: Kill Munch.
text.description:
Okay, commander, here's the deal. You're gonna want spikes and all sorts of cool stuff on your garrison, right? To get started, we'll need some ore from a nearby cave.

Check out that cave to the southeast of us. Knowing what I know from being here for a no time at all, I bet there's something big and nasty inside.

Take care of it and the peons will get the ore for ya.
text.completed: Return to Gazlowe at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge

english.title: Ore Not to Be
english.objectives: Kill Munch.
english.description:
Okay, commander, here's the deal. You're gonna want spikes and all sorts of cool stuff on your garrison, right? To get started, we'll need some ore from a nearby cave.

Check out that cave to the southeast of us. Knowing what I know from being here for a no time at all, I bet there's something big and nasty inside.

Take care of it and the peons will get the ore for ya.
english.completed: Return to Gazlowe at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge

text.title: The Portal Home
text.description: [Ph] Khadgar is willing to open a portal to Azeroth, if only briefly, to get some of those we need to secure our foothold here.

english.title: The Portal Home
english.description: [Ph] Khadgar is willing to open a portal to Azeroth, if only briefly, to get some of those we need to secure our foothold here.

objectiveDetails.description: Ask Khadgar to Open a Portal

text.title: 建立你的要塞
text.objectives: 用监理视察镜查看你要塞的建造情况。
text.description: 重头戏来了！我们现在既有材料，又有人力，简直是万事俱备！$b$b让我们开始建造吧！$b$b西边的山脊上有一群我的助手。$b$b他们已经给你准备好了私人瞭望工具。$b$b到那边去，你应该能用它查看我们的建造进度。
text.completion: Right! I think we've got this well in hand now. And hardly an explosion to be found!
text.completed: Return to Gazlowe at your garrison.

english.title: Establish Your Garrison
english.objectives: Watch the construction of your garrison by using the Master Surveyor
english.description: It's time for the main event! We've got the materials, we've got the manpower, we've got another thing that starts with "m."$b$bLet's build this thing!$b$bI got a gaggle of assistants up on that ridge to the west.$b$bThey should have your personal surveying stand set up by now.$b$bHead on over there and you should be able to watch our progress from it.
english.completion: Right! I think we've got this well in hand now. And hardly an explosion to be found!
english.completed: Return to Gazlowe at your garrison.

objectiveDetails.description: 用监理视察镜查看你要塞的建造情况

text.title: 狼穴
text.objectives: 骑乘霜狼双头飞龙前往沃高尔。
text.description: 既然你已经建立了据点，杜隆坦想让我们加入他。我希望他会接受你的帮助。
text.completion: I hope you are finding your land agreeable.
text.completed: Speak with Durotan in Wor'gol

english.title: Den of Wolves
english.objectives: Ride the Frostwolf Rylak to Wor'gol.
english.description: Durotan wishes for us to join him now that you have established your foothold. I hope he will accept your help.
english.completion: I hope you are finding your land agreeable.
english.completed: Speak with Durotan in Wor'gol

objectiveDetails.description: 骑乘霜狼双头飞龙飞往沃高尔

text.title: 召集霜狼
text.objectives: 让德拉卡吹响战斗号角。
text.description: 还没等我们准备好，我兄弟就急匆匆地带领一些族人开始了对刀塔堡垒的进攻。$b$b德拉卡还在等我们吹响战斗号角。快去告诉她，现在是时候集合部族成员了！$b$b凭借你与你大军的力量，我们在与食人魔的战斗中也许还有一线获胜的希望。
text.completion: The clan is prepared. It is time for us to advance on Bladespire Citadel!
text.completed: Return to Durotan at Wor'gol.

english.title: Rally the Frostwolves
english.objectives: Ask Draka to sound the war horn.
english.description: My brother, in his haste, has already taken some of my clan with him and has begun an assault on Bladespire Citadel before we were ready.$b$bDraka awaits by our war horn. Please let her know that it is time to rally the clan!$b$bWith the aid of you and your forces, we might actually stand a chance at victory against the ogres.
english.completion: The clan is prepared. It is time for us to advance on Bladespire Citadel!
english.completed: Return to Durotan at Wor'gol.

objectiveDetails.description: 让德拉卡吹响战斗号角

text.title: 暗影之门
text.objectives: 击败格鲁布诺·战胆，并追上波加尔。
text.description: 洞穴里有食人魔，我闻到了他们的臭味。$b$b拿好武器，我们得全速前进，赶在食人魔使用巫术前干掉他们。$b$b<布加朝洞穴里看了看>$b$b小心点伙计，里面恐怕有危险。
text.completion: Dat ogre, he done give us de slip!$B$B<Bwu'ja looks around.>$B$BDis place, it be da spirit world! First time I ever walk here in da flesh.$B$BLooks like our path back be blocked and our prey be gone. We gonna have ta go find dat ogre ta get outta dis place.
text.completed: Speak to Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja within the Bloodmaul Territory in Frostfire Ridge.
text.giverWindow: 他有点慢。

english.title: The Shadow Gate
english.objectives: Defeat Grubnor Wargut and follow after Borgal.
english.description: Dere be ogres in da cave, I smell de stink of 'em.$b$bKeep ye weapon handy, we gonna have ta move quick and take down de ogres before dey start tossing da mojo.$b$b<Bwu'ja peeks into the cave.>$b$bWatch ye self mon, something be going down in dere.
english.completion: Dat ogre, he done give us de slip!$B$B<Bwu'ja looks around.>$B$BDis place, it be da spirit world! First time I ever walk here in da flesh.$B$BLooks like our path back be blocked and our prey be gone. We gonna have ta go find dat ogre ta get outta dis place.
english.completed: Speak to Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja within the Bloodmaul Territory in Frostfire Ridge.
english.giverWindow: He's a bit slow.

text.title: 猛攻结束
text.objectives: 破坏黑暗之门的2座邪能尖塔。
text.description: “用你们的生命看住古尔丹和他的暗影议会！少了这些囚犯的邪能魔法，传送门就无法正常运作。假如你们胆敢让我失望，你们所珍视的一切都将灰飞烟灭。$B$B-格罗玛什·地狱咆哮。”$b$b钢铁部落似乎囚禁了一些俘虏，对维持传送门的开启至关重要。仔细搜索附近的尖塔！
text.completion: The portal is weakened, but it remains open.$b$bOnly one option remains, $n.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar on the Dark Portal.

english.title: Onslaught's End
english.objectives: Disable the two fel spires of the Dark Portal.
english.description: "Guard Gul'dan and his Shadow Council with your lives! The portal cannot function without our prisoners' fel magic. Fail me and watch all that you hold dear turn to ash.$B$B-Grommash Hellscream."$b$bThe Iron Horde appear to be holding prisoners that are crucial to keeping the portal open. Search the nearby spires!
english.completion: The portal is weakened, but it remains open.$b$bOnly one option remains, $n.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar on the Dark Portal.

text.title: 传送门的能量
text.objectives: 进入黑暗之门下方的灵魂引擎，然后关闭黑暗之门。
text.description: 给这道传送门供能的既不是机械力量也不是奥术能量。$b$b看看我们的两侧吧，$n。惨死囚犯们哀号的灵魂正源源不断地被输送进传送门的中心。$b$b他们正在引导这些灵魂穿过古尔丹的身体。$b$b想办法进入我们下方的内室，不惜一切代价让古尔丹停止他的法术引导。我们最后一线希望都在你身上了，$n。
text.completion: Gul'dan... free. This was not the victory I'd planned for.$b$bGul'dan may be loose due to our actions, but I gladly bargain his freedom against the lives of the innocents on the other side of this portal. You made a wise decision, $n.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar atop the Dark Portal in Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: The Portal's Power
english.objectives: Enter the Soul Engine beneath the Dark Portal, then shut the Dark Portal down.
english.description: This portal is fueled by powers neither mechanical nor arcane.$b$bLook to either side of us, $n. The screaming souls of slain prisoners are being channeled into the heart of the portal itself.$b$bAnd they are channeling these souls through the body of Gul'dan.$b$bFind a way into the chamber beneath us, and do whatever it takes to get Gul'dan to stop his channeling. Our last hope rests on you, $n.
english.completion: Gul'dan... free. This was not the victory I'd planned for.$b$bGul'dan may be loose due to our actions, but I gladly bargain his freedom against the lives of the innocents on the other side of this portal. You made a wise decision, $n.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar atop the Dark Portal in Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 削弱黑潮
text.objectives: 干掉黑潮首领。
text.description: 为了这个可悲的求生借口，就可以出卖所有的同伴。只不过是被轻轻掐住了脖子而已。$b$b去找到指挥这场行动的首领，把他们的脑袋给我带来。哈拉萨会陪你一同完成任务。
text.progress: The Iron Horde has no concept of honor.
text.completion: With their leaders dead this operation will surely fall apart.
text.completed: Return to Rexxar at Darktide Roost in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Downsizing the Darktide
english.objectives: Takedown the Darktide leadership.
english.description: This pathetic excuse for life sold out all of his companions. All it took was a little squeeze of the neck.$b$bFind the leaders of this operation and bring me their heads. Haratha will accompany you on your quest.
english.progress: The Iron Horde has no concept of honor.
english.completion: Со смертью их лидеров эта операция обречена на провал.
english.completed: Return to Rexxar at Darktide Roost in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 黑暗之门
text.objectives: 到诅咒之地的黑暗之门下方与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
text.description:
$B|cFF660000                   注意了
英雄们$b
冒险者们$b
艾泽拉斯的守护者们|r$b
$b第二次大战中的英雄人物——大法师卡德加正在召集艾泽拉斯最强大的勇士们，勇敢地穿越黑暗之门，终止钢铁部落对艾泽拉斯的入侵。$b$b渴望荣耀的勇士可以到诅咒之地的黑暗之门下方去找卡德加。$b$b警告：人身安全概不负责。
text.completion: Looks to me like we ended up in the right place.
text.completed: Report to Archmage Khadgar on the Dark Portal in Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: The Dark Portal
english.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at the foot of the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands.
english.description: $B|cFF660000             ATTENTION HEROES$b                 ADVENTURERS$b        DEFENDERS OF AZEROTH|r$b$bArchmage Khadgar, hero of the Second War, is assembling a coalition of Azeroth's strongest to bravely step through the Dark Portal and stop the Iron Horde's invasion of Azeroth.$b$bChampions who are interested in glory can meet Khadgar at the base of the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands.$b$bSafety not guaranteed.
english.completion: Looks to me like we ended up in the right place.
english.completed: Report to Archmage Khadgar on the Dark Portal in Tanaan Jungle.

objectiveDetails.description: 与大法师卡德加谈一谈

text.title: 矿场的麻烦
text.objectives: 与守备官多鲁谈一谈。
text.description: 尤鲁恩矿场有麻烦了！$b$b我们不久前挖出了一块强大的巨型的奥术水晶。然而，局势迅速急转而下，水晶散发的能量也弥漫到了整个矿场中。$b$b奥金尼已经派出守备官到矿场里协助我们。$b$b到矿场里与守备官多鲁谈一谈，他知道你该怎样帮忙。
text.completion: The Vindicators welcome you, $n.

english.title: Trouble In The Mine
english.objectives: Speak with Vindicator Doruu.
english.description: The Jorune Mine is in trouble!$b$bWe recently unearthed an exceedingly large and powerful arcane crystal; however, something has gone terribly wrong and the energy from the crystal is flooding the mine.$b$bThe Auchenai have already sent their Vindicators into the mine to assist us.$b$bSpeak with Vindicator Doruu inside of the mine, he'll know how you can help.
english.completion: The Vindicators welcome you, $n.

text.title: 狂怒汲魔蛾
text.objectives: 对$oa只狂怒汲魔蛾使用奥术驱散器。
text.description: 在塔拉多有一种极为罕见的蛾子，名叫汲魔蛾。这些蛾子靠吃矿场里的奥术水晶尘为生。$b$b通常来说，它们只是偶尔造成一些麻烦。但现在它们却正在吞食从矿井里涌出的强烈奥术能量，变得极具领土意识和攻击性。$b$b我调节了这块水晶，可以用它驱散奥术能量。请你对狂怒汲魔蛾使用这块水晶来安抚它们吧。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. These moths are typically peaceful creatures and are deserving of mercy.
text.completed: Return to Ageilaa.

english.title: Frenzied Manafeeders
english.objectives: Use the Arcane Dissipator on $oa Frenzied Manafeeders.
english.description: There is a rare breed of moth in Talador known as the Manafeeder. These moths sustain themselves by feeding on arcane crystal dust from the mine.$b$bTypically speaking, these moths are nothing more than an occasional nuisance. However, they are now gorging themselves upon the intense arcane energy flooding out of the mine and have become highly territorial and aggressive.$b$bI have attuned this crystal to disperse arcane energy. Please use it on the Frenzied Manafeeders to soothe them.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. These moths are typically peaceful creatures and are deserving of mercy.
english.completed: Return to Ageilaa.

text.title: 奥术精华
text.objectives: 取得$1oa份奥术精华。
text.description: 只要凯尔娜拉还没把水晶里的最后一丝奥术能量汲取干净……并顺手毁掉整座矿场，她是不会罢休的。用普通手段无法穿透她用来保护自己的奥术护盾，可我已经想出了一个计划。$b$b要是我能有一块可以暂时穿透她护盾的聚焦水晶，凯尔娜拉就很容易对付了。$b$b幸运的是，我们眼下刚好可以造一块。先从在矿场里肆虐的怪物身上帮我找一些奥术精华来吧。
text.progress: Have you retrieved the arcane essence for me?
text.completion: This will do nicely, $n. All we need now is a suitable crystal...
text.completed: Return to Manduil Skycaller.

english.title: Arcane Essence
english.objectives: Retrieve $1oa Arcane Essence.
english.description: Kaelynara will not stop until she has drained every last drop of arcane energy from the crystal...and destroyed this entire mine in the process. The arcane shield she guards herself with cannot be penetrated by normal means, but I have a plan.$b$bIf I had a focusing crystal powerful enough to momentarily pierce her shield, Kaelynara could then be dealt with.$b$bFortunately, we are in the perfect place to build one. Start by bringing me arcane essence from the creatures rampaging throughout the mine.
english.progress: Have you retrieved the arcane essence for me?
english.completion: This will do nicely, $n. All we need now is a suitable crystal...
english.completed: Return to Manduil Skycaller.

text.title: 狼群与战士
text.objectives: 与杜隆坦同行。
text.description:
众多族人的回归令我们恢复了元气，我也要感谢你出手帮助他们脱险。

来吧，跟我一起骑行。我们还有很多事情要讨论。
text.completion: This land should serve our needs well. I leave it to you to decide how to best use it, commander.
text.completed: Speak with Thrall at Frostwall.

english.title: Of Wolves and Warriors
english.objectives: Ride with Durotan.
english.description:
The return of many of my people is a boon to us, and I thank you for your part in their survival.

Come, ride with me. We have much to discuss.
english.completion: This land should serve our needs well. I leave it to you to decide how to best use it, commander.
english.completed: Speak with Thrall at Frostwall.

text.title: 奥术精华
text.objectives: 取得$1oa份奥术精华。
text.description: 凯尔娜拉已经被自己对魔力的欲望吞噬，她对于这座矿场里的任何生命而言都是威胁。我们必须阻止她。$b$b不幸的是，只要她还有护盾保护，我们就无计可施。我们得设法穿透她的防护法术。$b$b要是我能制造出一块聚焦水晶的话，也许就能用它来削弱她的护盾……我要派你去水晶矿场里寻找一些必要的材料。$b$b首先，你得先从矿场里的水晶狂怒者和奥术幻影身上弄些奥术精华来。
text.progress: Have you collected enough arcane essence yet?
text.completion: Excellent work, $n. The arcane essence you've collected will do nicely. All we need now is a suitable crystal to attune...
text.completed: Return to Archmage Elandra.

english.title: Arcane Essence
english.objectives: Retrieve $1oa Arcane Essence.
english.description: Kaelynara's lust for arcane power has consumed her and she threatens the safety of all in this mine. She must be stopped.$b$bUnfortunately, there is nothing we can do while she shields herself. We will need to find a way to penetrate her shielding spell.$b$bPerhaps if I were to build a focusing crystal, I could use it to lower her shield...I'll need you to search the crystal mine for the necessary components.$b$bFirst, I'll need arcane essence from the Crystal Ragers and Arcane Wraiths in the mine.
english.progress: Ну что, у тебя достаточно чародейских сущностей?
english.completion: Отличная работа, $n. Собранные тобой чародейские сущности как раз подойдут. Теперь нам нужен лишь подходящий для настройки кристалл...
english.completed: Return to Archmage Elandra.

text.title: 异样的水晶
text.objectives: 收集$oa块能量水晶原石。
text.description: 即便是在德拉诺，如此巨大且能量充沛的奥术水晶也是相当罕见的。德莱尼人把沙塔斯和奥金顿建造在距离这座矿场这么近的地方并非偶然。$b$b我很想进一步研究这些特殊水晶及其奥术属性。$b$b把你能找到的任何能量水晶原石带回来交给我吧，我一定会让你的努力得到相应的回报。
text.progress: Have you collected the unrefined power crystals I need for my research?
text.completion: The crystals in this mine are most certainly unique. Thorough study of the samples you have provided should reveal why this is the case.
text.completed: Return to Manduil Skycaller.

english.title: Crystals of Unusual Power
english.objectives: Collect $oa Unrefined Power Crystals.
english.description: Arcane crystals of this size and power are quite rare even on Draenor. It is no coincidence that the Draenei built Shattrath and Auchindoun so close to this mine.$b$bI am interested in learning more about these particular crystals and their arcane nature.$b$bReturn to me with any unrefined power crystals that you may find and I will make sure that you are adequately compensated for your effort.
english.progress: Have you collected the unrefined power crystals I need for my research?
english.completion: The crystals in this mine are most certainly unique. Thorough study of the samples you have provided should reveal why this is the case.
english.completed: Return to Manduil Skycaller.

text.title: 陷入混乱
text.objectives: 救出$oa位受伤的矿工。
text.description: 当混乱发生时，德莱尼矿工们并没有全部安全逃离，$n。他们当中有很多人受了伤，至今仍被困在矿场里。$b$b凯尔娜拉的破坏使矿场变成了人间地狱。释放出的能量形成了奥术幻影，它们会攻击视线范围内的一切物体。在地下休眠的那些狂怒而危险的元素也从岩石里钻了出来。$b$b尽你所能去找到那些受伤的矿工，确保他们安然归来。
text.completion: Thank you for getting the workers our of the mine safely, $n.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Elandra.

english.title: Caught In The Chaos
english.objectives: Rescue $oa Injured Miners.
english.description: Not all of the Draenei miners made it out when the chaos erupted, $n. Many of them are injured and still trapped inside the mine.$b$bKaelynara's disruption has caused all hell to break loose. Arcane Wraiths are forming from the unleashed energy and attacking everything they see. The elementals that slumbered beneath the ground are emerging from the rocks frenzied and dangerous.$b$bPlease find as many injured miners as you can and ensure that they return safely.
english.completion: Спасибо тебе, что $gпомог:помогла; шахтерам выбраться в безопасное место, $n.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Elandra.

text.title: 坚守防线
text.objectives: 在燃烧前线上消灭$1oa个恶魔。
text.description: 再次见到你真是太好了，勇士。$B$B恶魔正在攻击奥金顿，而我们正在苦苦支撑。$B$B眼下需要把前线往前推，以免落得伤亡惨重的下场。$B$B如果你愿意与我们并肩作战，就用手中的利刃刺穿这些邪恶怪物的喉咙吧。
text.progress: Судьба Аукиндона и бесчисленного множества душ в нем зависит от нашего успеха.
text.completion: I only hope we are enough.
text.completed: Return to Exarch Maladaar at Exarch's Refuge in Talador.

english.title: Holding the Line
english.objectives: Slay $1oa demons in the Burning Front.
english.description: It is good to see you again, champion.$B$BDemons are assaulting Auchindoun and we are barely standing our ground against them.$B$BWe need to push our front lines forward lest our losses reach critical mass.$B$BIf your blade is with us, shove it into these foul creatures' throats.
english.progress: Судьба Аукиндона и бесчисленного множества душ в нем зависит от нашего успеха.
english.completion: I only hope we are enough.
english.completed: Return to Exarch Maladaar at Exarch's Refuge in Talador.

text.title: 要塞战役：战地乌鸦
text.objectives: 在戈尔隆德的天海岭与希萨莉·黑鸦谈一谈。
text.description: 我们的德鲁伊建立起了庞大的侦察网，来追查你从纳格兰搞来的情报。$B$B我们在戈尔隆德西部海岸的盐池附近，发现了一个可疑的钢铁部落挖掘场。$B$B我们有理由相信，这些兽人正在沙漠深处追寻一件珍贵的神器。$B$B我正准备派出一支小队去专门执行精确打击任务，我希望你也能加入这支队伍。
text.completion: Greetings, $C. You're the commander from the garrison?$B$B$B$BGood.

english.title: Garrison Campaign: Crows In The Field
english.objectives: Speak to Thisalee Crow at Skysea Ridge in Gorgrond.
english.description: Our druids set up a wide network of scouts to follow up on your intel from Nagrand.$B$BWe've identified a suspicious Iron Horde excavation near some salt pools on the western coast of Gorgrond.$B$BWe have reason to believe that these orcs are pursuing a valuable artifact deep in the desert.$B$BI'm putting together a small mission for a focused, surgical strike. I'd like you to be part of that team.
english.completion: Greetings, $C. You're the commander from the garrison?$B$B$B$BGood.

text.title: 跃动之心
text.objectives: 把高格里克之心交给你要塞中的莫希斯·轻翼。
text.description: 有一件事情是可以肯定的。我们现在拿到了一样对钢铁部落至关重要的东西。$B$B我们最好立即把这个……“高格里克之心”送往安全的地方。
text.completion: Never in my years have I seen anything like this, $n. You have done well today.

english.title: The Beating Heart
english.objectives: Deliver the Heart of Gorgorek to Morthis Whisperwing at your garrison.
english.description: One thing is certain. We now possess an item of great value to the Iron Horde.$B$BWe had better secure this... "Heart of Gorgorek" at once.
english.completion: Never in my years have I seen anything like this, $n. You have done well today.

text.title: Lumberstruck
text.objectives: Protect your peasants as they gather 100 lumber.
text.description: [Test Quest - Do Not Translate]$b$bThis box is empty, begging to be filled with wood.$b$bProtect your peasants as they gather materials from the region.
text.completed: Return to your lumber cart in Gorgrond.

english.title: Lumberstruck
english.objectives: Protect your peasants as they gather 100 lumber.
english.description: [Test Quest - Do Not Translate]$b$bThis box is empty, begging to be filled with wood.$b$bProtect your peasants as they gather materials from the region.
english.completed: Return to your lumber cart in Gorgrond.

text.title: 巨人安杜尔
text.objectives: 找回水晶巨人之心。
text.description: 为了冲破凯尔娜拉的奥术护盾，我们需要一块具有罕见力量和品质的聚焦水晶。$b$b在矿场里有个水晶巨人，德莱尼人管它叫安杜尔。那个巨人已经在地下岩层间沉睡多年，但现在已经被凯尔娜拉的鲁莽行动惊醒了。$b$b水晶巨人的心脏绝对是强大的神器。击败安杜尔，把水晶巨人之心给我带回来。等我拿到它之后，打造聚焦水晶的准备工作就完成了！
text.progress: Do you have the crystal giant heart?
text.completion: Excellent. Give me a moment and I will prepare the focusing crystal.
text.completed: Return to Manduil Skycaller.
text.giverWindow: 德拉诺的第八大奇迹。

english.title: An'dure The Giant
english.objectives: Retrieve the Crystal Giant Heart.
english.description: In order to break through Kaelynara's arcane shield, we will need a focusing crystal of rare power and quality.$b$bWithin the mine is a crystal giant known to the Draenei as An'dure. The giant has slept beneath the rocky earth for ages, but due to Kaelynara's recklessness it has awakened.$b$bThe heart of a crystal giant is a truly powerful artifact. Defeat An'Dure and return to me with a crystal giant heart. Once I have the heart, I will have everything I need to construct the focusing crystal!
english.progress: Do you have the crystal giant heart?
english.completion: Excellent. Give me a moment and I will prepare the focusing crystal.
english.completed: Return to Manduil Skycaller.
english.giverWindow: The eighth wonder of Draenor.

text.title: 巨人安杜尔
text.objectives: 找回水晶巨人之心。
text.description: 为了冲破凯尔娜拉的奥术护盾，我们需要一块具有罕见力量和品质的聚焦水晶。$b$b在矿场里有个水晶巨人，德莱尼人管它叫安杜尔。那个巨人已经在地下岩层间沉睡多年，但现在已经被凯尔娜拉的鲁莽行动惊醒了。$b$b水晶巨人的心脏绝对是强大的神器。击败安杜尔，把水晶巨人之心给我带回来。等我拿到它之后，打造聚焦水晶的准备工作就完成了！
text.progress: Do you have the crystal giant heart?
text.completion: It is sad to see such a mighty creature fall, but An'dure was a danger to all within the mine. The heart of the crystal giant will aid us in restoring peace to the Jorune Mine.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Elandra.
text.giverWindow: 德拉诺的第八大奇迹。

english.title: An'dure The Giant
english.objectives: Retrieve the Crystal Giant Heart.
english.description: In order to break through Kaelynara's arcane shield, we will need a focusing crystal of rare power and quality.$b$bWithin the mine is a crystal giant known to the Draenei as An'dure. The giant has slept far beneath the earth for ages, but due to Kaelynara's recklessness it has awakened.$b$bThe heart of a crystal giant is a truly powerful artifact. Defeat An'Dure and return to me with a crystal giant heart.$b$bWhen you return I will construct the focusing crystal and together we will stop Kaelynara.
english.progress: Сердце кристаллического гиганта у тебя?
english.completion: Печально, что столь могучее существо пришлось уничтожить, но Ан'дур был угрозой для всех в Иорунской шахте. Сердце кристаллического гиганта поможет нам восстановить мир.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Elandra.
english.giverWindow: The eighth wonder of Draenor.

text.title: 坚守防线
text.objectives: 在燃烧前线上消灭$1oa个恶魔。
text.description: 奥金顿遭到攻击了！$B$B奥金尼人本身都是勇猛无畏的战士，可即便是他们，也无法单枪匹马地抵挡住无穷无尽的恶魔大军。我们来这是为了阻止燃烧军团吞噬德拉诺……只有精诚合作才有获胜的希望。$B$B我要你去削减恶魔的数量，以便我们能够安全地重整大军，向燃烧前线推进。$B$B我们得立即阻止他们的入侵！
text.progress: Сегодня мы бьемся не во славу Орды, а ради священного Света.
text.completion: Your valor will give our men reprieve as they work to contain the threat completely. Well done.
text.completed: Return to Lady Liadrin at Exarch's Refuge in Talador.

english.title: Holding the Line
english.objectives: Slay $1oa demons in the Burning Front.
english.description: Auchindoun is under attack!$B$BThe Auchenai are valiant warriors in their own right, but they cannot hold against these endless demon hordes alone. We came here to stop the Legion from engulfing Draenor... working together is our best shot.$B$BI need you to thin out the demons' numbers so we can regroup our forces safely and push forward into the Burning Front.$B$BWe will stop their march here and now!
english.progress: Сегодня мы бьемся не во славу Орды, а ради священного Света.
english.completion: Your valor will give our men reprieve as they work to contain the threat completely. Well done.
english.completed: Return to Lady Liadrin at Exarch's Refuge in Talador.

text.title: 战争的代价
text.objectives: 跟随大法师卡德加。
text.description: 他们认为这是一次绝命行动，但我并不打算让任何人白白牺牲。$b$b所有人跟我来！
text.completion: With the Dark Portal disabled, we have a new mission: stay alive.$b$bWe must keep pressing on, even if only to honor those who stayed behind to secure our retreat.
text.completed: 在塔纳安丛林的血环之心与大法师卡德加谈一谈。

english.title: The Cost of War
english.objectives: Follow Archmage Khadgar.
english.description: They called this operation a suicide mission, but I don't plan on throwing away any lives meaninglessly.$b$bEverybody, with me!
english.completion: With the Dark Portal disabled, we have a new mission: stay alive.$b$bWe must keep pressing on, even if only to honor those who stayed behind to secure our retreat.
english.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Heartblood in the Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 鲜血流尽
text.objectives: 从血环之心的2个血环牢笼里救出奴隶。
text.description: <兽人说出了最后的遗言。>$b$b他们把我们关在笼子里。他们……吸我们的血，举行……仪式……$b$b<这个霜狼兽人剧烈地咳嗽着。>$b$b……许多人死了——$b$b——我的……族人……$b$b<这个兽人死了。>
text.completion: Well done, $n.$b$bGiven, they are injured, half-starved, and poorly-equipped... but there is no blade so sharp as a vengeful spirit, no armor so thick as a righteous cause.
text.completed: Return to Khadgar at Heartblood in the Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: Bled Dry
english.objectives: Free the slaves from the 2 Bleeding Hollow Cages in Heartblood.
english.description: <The orc spits out his last words.>$b$bThey kept us in cages. They... drain our blood, for... rituals...$b$b<The Frostwolf coughs violently.>$b$b...many left --$b$b    -- my... people...$b$b<The orc dies.>
english.completion: Well done, $n.$b$bGiven, they are injured, half-starved, and poorly-equipped... but there is no blade so sharp as a vengeful spirit, no armor so thick as a righteous cause.
english.completed: Return to Khadgar at Heartblood in the Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 荣耀之焰
text.objectives: 利用荧光珠摧毁8间血环小屋。
text.description: 我们不能永远留在这儿。得继续前进才行。但首先——我们需要分散敌人的注意力。$b$b<卡德加制造出了一小块宝石。>$b$b任何可燃物在你拿着这枚珠子靠近时都会燃烧。利用你的技能，还有一点点运气，你也许就可以把血环兽人的注意力从我们的队伍身上转移开。
text.completion: Out of the frying pan, into the woods.$b$bTake a breath, then get ready, $n. There's not much time to rest.
text.completed: Return to Khadgar at Heartblood in the Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: Blaze of Glory
english.objectives: Use the Lucifrium Bead to destroy 8 Bleeding Hollow huts.
english.description: We can't stay here forever. We NEED to keep moving. But first - we need a distraction.$b$b<Khadgar conjures a small gem.>$b$bThis bead should burn anything flammable that you get close to. With your skill, and a bit of luck, you might be able to take the attention of the Bleeding Hollow orcs off our group.
english.completion: Out of the frying pan, into the woods.$b$bTake a breath, then get ready, $n. There's not much time to rest.
english.completed: Return to Khadgar at Heartblood in the Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 祭坛争斗
text.objectives: 与阿里乌克谈一谈，然后帮他转移基尔罗格之眼的注意力。
text.description: 你看见下方那个祭坛没有，遍布彩色魔法淤泥的那个？在祭坛顶上有个魔法之眼，要是被它看见，恐怕我们队伍中的所有人都无法活着离开。$b$b去分散那只眼睛的注意力，$n。引起骚乱，击溃一些祭祀者，随便你做什么都行——只要能确保拖住那只眼睛，让我顺利指挥队伍中的其他成员避过它的目光。$b$b<卡德加向身后看了看。>$b$b带上那个魁梧的兽人吧。不是萨尔。
text.completion: <Khadgar looks concerned.>$b$bNo - we cannot wait for Ariok. He knew what he was getting into.$b$bHis sacrifice cannot go to waste. We must keep moving.
text.completed: Find Khadgar at the Kargathar Proving Grounds to the north.

english.title: Altar Altercation
english.objectives: Speak with Ariok, then help him distract the Eye of Kilrogg.
english.description: You see that altar down there? There's a magical eye settled at its peak, and I fear our group will not survive if it sees us.$b$bDistract the eye, $n. Cause a commotion, kill some ritualists, whatever you have to do - just occupy that thing long enough for me to guide the rest of our group past its gaze.$b$b<Khadgar looks over his shoulder.>$b$bBring that strapping orc with you. The one that's not Thrall.
english.completion: <Khadgar looks concerned.>$b$bNo - we cannot wait for Ariok. He knew what he was getting into.$b$bHis sacrifice cannot go to waste. We must keep moving.
english.completed: Find Khadgar at the Kargathar Proving Grounds to the north.

objectiveDetails.description: 护送阿里乌克前往血色祭坛
在塔索格大桥上找到卡德加

text.title: The Chase is On
text.objectives: Get to the Kargathar Proving Grounds.
text.description: Come on, let's move! Ariok's heroism can only buy us so much time.
text.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at the Kargathar Proving Grounds.

english.title: The Chase is On
english.objectives: Get to the Kargathar Proving Grounds.
english.description: Come on, let's move! Ariok's heroism can only buy us so much time.
english.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at the Kargathar Proving Grounds.

text.title: 卡加萨训练场
text.objectives: 跟随卡德加。
text.description: 这片区域的兽人看上去像是碎手氏族的成员。看他们的手就知道了。$b$b我们去跟其他人会合吧。我们必须想办法离开这。
text.completion: We will hold this position for now. We must allow these freed prisoners a moment to breathe.$b$bIt is not an ideal position. We will be moving again shortly.
text.completed: Report to Khadgar at Kargathar Proving Grounds in Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: The Kargathar Proving Grounds
english.objectives: Follow Khadgar.
english.description: The orcs in this area look like members of the Shattered Hand clan. You can tell by looking at their hands.$b$bLet's join up with the others. We must find a way out of here.
english.completion: We will hold this position for now. We must allow these freed prisoners a moment to breathe.$b$bIt is not an ideal position. We will be moving again shortly.
english.completed: Report to Khadgar at Kargathar Proving Grounds in Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 潜在的盟友
text.objectives: 在卡加萨训练场的火环附近使用霜风焦镜，释放先知德雷克塔尔。
text.description: 有位被俘的兽人正在受到某种……优待，这要看你怎么定义了。别人都被绑着受刑，可他却被绑在桩子上烧，捉拿他的人显然对此很得意。$b$b使用这块符文石。用它可以轻松对付他周围的烈焰之环。
text.completion: I owe my life to you, stranger. I offer you and your company my support. Together, we may make it out of this jungle alive.
text.completed: Report to Farseer Drek'Thar at the Kargathar Proving Grounds in Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: A Potential Ally
english.objectives: Use the Frostflurry Focus near the ring of fire in Kargathar Proving Grounds to free Farseer Drek'Thar.
english.description: One of the captured orcs is receiving some... preferential treatment, if you can call it that. While others are tied down and tortured, this one is tied to a stake and burned for the amusement of his captors.$b$bUse this runestone. It should handily deal with the ring of fire that surrounds him.
english.completion: I owe my life to you, stranger. I offer you and your company my support. Together, we may make it out of this jungle alive.
english.completed: Report to Farseer Drek'Thar at the Kargathar Proving Grounds in Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: To Even the Odds
text.objectives: Find Shattered Hand weapons and give them to Battered Frostwolf Prisoners or Battered Karabor Prisoners.
text.description: [TEMP] The Shattered Hand orcs are using their prisoners as living training dummies. Let's even the odds and give them some weapons.
text.completed: Return to Qiana Moonshadow at Kargathar Proving Grounds in Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: To Even the Odds
english.objectives: Find Shattered Hand weapons and give them to Battered Frostwolf Prisoners or Battered Karabor Prisoners.
english.description: [TEMP] The Shattered Hand orcs are using their prisoners as living training dummies. Let's even the odds and give them some weapons.
english.completed: Return to Qiana Moonshadow at Kargathar Proving Grounds in Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 兵来将挡
text.objectives: 在卡加斯的竞技场中存活下来。
text.description: 我看逃离这个陷阱的路只有一条，$n，必须从那竞技场中央穿过。$b$b我们也许都要葬身在这里了。
text.completion: You're still alive? Good.$b$bThat cave-in will only hold them for so long. We have to keep moving.
text.completed: Report to Archmage Khadgar in the Umbral Halls in Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: Kill Your Hundred
english.objectives: Survive Kargath's Arena.
english.description: I see only one way out of this trap, $n, and it's right through the middle of that arena.$b$bThis might be the end of us.
english.completion: You're still alive? Good.$b$bThat cave-in will only hold them for so long. We have to keep moving.
english.completed: Report to Archmage Khadgar in the Umbral Halls in Tanaan Jungle.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败竞技场中的争斗者

text.title: 暗影大师
text.objectives: 消灭安戈拉、监工古兰和堕落者安考瓦。
text.description: 那些坏兽人想抓住我，但我溜走了。我可会捉迷藏了。$b$b那些个坏兽人全都坏透了，但当中有几个最坏的，我记住了他们的名字，心想万一有人能来救我呢。$b$b<鲁卡深吸了一口气。>$b$b安戈拉、古兰，还有……呃……噢对了！还有安考瓦。$b$b你能保护我，不让我落在他们手里吗？
text.completion: Well done.$b$bBe ready to move. We may have had the element of surprise within this cave, but our advantage is fleeting.
text.completed: Return to Exarch Maladaar in the Umbral Halls in Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: Masters of Shadow
english.objectives: Slay Ungra, Taskmaster Gurran, and Ankova the Fallen.
english.description: The bad orcs tried to catch me, but I snuck away. I'm good at hiding.$b$bAll of the bad orcs are bad, but I've remembered the names of the meanest ones, just in case anybody came to save me.$b$b<Luuka takes a deep breath.>$b$bUngra, Gurran, and... umm... oh! Ankova.$b$bWill you protect me from them?
english.completion: Well done.$b$bBe ready to move. We may have had the element of surprise within this cave, but our advantage is fleeting.
english.completed: Return to Exarch Maladaar in the Umbral Halls in Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 影月氏族
text.objectives: 在暗影大厅中消灭10个影月兽人或虚空狼。
text.description: 我们会保护受伤的囚犯，并确保卡加斯无法穿过石堆。你先行一步清理洞穴吧，$n。
text.completion: You fight exceptionally well, $n... better than I could ever hope to.$b$bWith those orcs out of the way, Khadgar and Maraad should now be able to safely guide the rest of our group through the cave.
text.completed: Return to Qiana Moonshadow within the Umbral Halls in Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: The Shadowmoon Clan
english.objectives: Slay 10 Shadowmoon Orcs or Void Wolves within the Umbral Halls.
english.description: We will protect the wounded prisoners and make sure Kargath doesn't get through the rubble. You go ahead and clear the cave, $n.
english.completion: You fight exceptionally well, $n... better than I could ever hope to.$b$bWith those orcs out of the way, Khadgar and Maraad should now be able to safely guide the rest of our group through the cave.
english.completed: Return to Qiana Moonshadow within the Umbral Halls in Tanaan Jungle.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭暗影大厅中的敌人

text.title: Nullin' Void
text.objectives: Close 10 Shadowmoon Portals by using the Rune of Endless Ravening near them.
text.description: If I'm reading their spells correctly, it seems that these Shadowmoon orcs are opening portals to bring prisoners here to the slave camps. Brilliant magic, really.$b$bUnfortunately, it is easily nullified.$b$b<Khadgar places a small rune in your hand.>$b$bThis rune will deal with their void magic. Activate it near their portals, and they will instantly be nullified.
text.completed: Report to Exarch Maladaar within the Umbral Halls in Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: Nullin' Void
english.objectives: Close 10 Shadowmoon Portals by using the Rune of Endless Ravening near them.
english.description: If I'm reading their spells correctly, it seems that these Shadowmoon orcs are opening portals to bring prisoners here to the slave camps. Brilliant magic, really.$b$bUnfortunately, it is easily nullified.$b$b<Khadgar places a small rune in your hand.>$b$bThis rune will deal with their void magic. Activate it near their portals, and they will instantly be nullified.
english.completed: Report to Exarch Maladaar within the Umbral Halls in Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 伊瑞尔
text.objectives: 护送伊瑞尔前往安全地点。
text.description: 请原谅我的慌乱——我以前从没杀死过任何人。$b$b我叫伊瑞尔，是卡拉波的学徒。$b$b你说你带了一支军队来？看来圣光今天真的眷顾我了。$b$b那我愿意跟你走。带路吧，$n。
text.completion: Up there - that is Keli'dan the Breaker. No doubt he's been alerted to our presence, and he's attempting to tell his warlord about our little jailbreak.$b$bWe have to take him out, $n.
text.completed: Return to Yrel near the entrance of the Umbral Halls in Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: Yrel
english.objectives: Escort Yrel to safety.
english.description: Forgive me if I'm a bit flustered - I've never killed anyone before.$b$bMy name is Yrel, and I am a student of Karabor.$b$bYou say you have an ARMY with you? The Light must truly be watching over me today.$b$bI will follow you, then. Lead the way, $n.
english.completion: Up there - that is Keli'dan the Breaker. No doubt he's been alerted to our presence, and he's attempting to tell his warlord about our little jailbreak.$b$bWe have to take him out, $n.
english.completed: Return to Yrel near the entrance of the Umbral Halls in Tanaan Jungle.

objectiveDetails.description: 护送伊瑞尔抵达安全地点

text.title: 击碎者克里丹
text.objectives: 消灭击碎者克里丹。
text.description: 耐奥祖麾下的一名副官就在前方。经过他之后再走几步就是洞穴的出口。$b$b我要回去告诉卡德加，洞穴已经清理干净了。等你解决掉克里丹后，我们再会合！
text.completion: Fine job in the cave, but this is no time to rest.$b$bWe have momentum. We must stay in motion.
text.completed: Report to Archmage Khadgar at the Blackrock Quarry in the Tanaan Jungle.
text.giverWindow: 耐奥祖的副官。影月氏族的大巫师。

english.title: Keli'dan the Breaker
english.objectives: Slay Keli'dan the Breaker.
english.description: One of Ner'zhul's lieutenants remains, up ahead. The exit to the cave isn't much farther past him.$b$bI will go back and tell Khadgar that the cave is clear. We will rendezvous once you've taken care of Keli'dan!
english.completion: Fine job in the cave, but this is no time to rest.$b$bWe have momentum. We must stay in motion.
english.completed: Report to Archmage Khadgar at the Blackrock Quarry in the Tanaan Jungle.
english.giverWindow: Lieutenant to Ner'zhul. Master Sorcerer of the Shadowmoon.

text.title: 霜狼浪子
text.objectives: 到塔纳安丛林的黑石采石场向先知德雷克塔尔报告。
text.description: 等我用这把发臭的铲子捅穿几个黑石兽人的肚子……就会自己回去找德雷克塔尔了。
text.completion: You have my thanks, $n. Durotan, our chieftain, will be happy to hear that Ga'nar lives.

english.title: The Prodigal Frostwolf
english.objectives: Report to Farseer Drek'Thar at the Blackrock Quarry in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: I can get back to Drek'Thar myself... after I run this stinking shovel through a few Blackrock stomachs.
english.completion: You have my thanks, $n. Durotan, our chieftain, will be happy to hear that Ga'nar lives.

text.title: 锻炉大战
text.objectives: 消灭15个黑石兽人和3个独眼魔战地碾压者。
text.description: 我们的军队已经武装完毕——攻击时间到了！$b$b迅速出击，决不留情，$n！
text.completion: It's a good thing you got to high ground.$b$bLook at the dam!
text.completed: Report to Farseer Drek'Thar at the Blackrock Quarry in Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: The Battle of the Forge
english.objectives: Slay 15 Blackrock Orcs and 3 Ogron Warcrushers.
english.description: Our troops are armed - the time to strike is now!$b$bStrike swift and true, $n!
english.completion: It's a good thing you got to high ground.$b$bLook at the dam!
english.completed: Report to Farseer Drek'Thar at the Blackrock Quarry in Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: The Fewer, the Merrier
text.objectives: Slay 12 Blackrock Grunts.
text.description: We're vastly outnumbered down here, but at least we have the element of surprise.$b$bFor now.$b$bEvery Blackrock orc we slay in this quarry reduces the probability that we will be overwhelmed later. Go, and thin their ranks before they thin ours.
text.completed: Return to Cordana Felsong at the Blackrock Quarry in Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: The Fewer, the Merrier
english.objectives: Slay 12 Blackrock Grunts.
english.description: We're vastly outnumbered down here, but at least we have the element of surprise.$b$bFor now.$b$bEvery Blackrock orc we slay in this quarry reduces the probability that we will be overwhelmed later. Go, and thin their ranks before they thin ours.
english.completed: Return to Cordana Felsong at the Blackrock Quarry in Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 霜狼氏族的贾纳尔
text.objectives: 找到贾纳尔。
text.description: 我们必须继续前进，没时间耽误！$b$b我氏族中的长者贾纳尔就在那里的某个地方。我能感觉到他，可却找不到。$b$b留心寻找贾纳尔。他是一位意志坚强的兽人，囚禁会使他备受折磨。
text.completion: <The orc's lips and wrists quiver with restrained fury.>$b$bWho are you?$b$bWait, what's that you say? Drek'Thar is here?
text.completed: 在塔纳安丛林的黑石采石场里找到贾纳尔。

english.title: Ga'nar of the Frostwolf
english.objectives: Find Ga'nar.
english.description: We must move on, there isn't time to waste!$b$bOne of the elders of my clan, Ga'nar, is out there somewhere. I can sense him, but I cannot find him.$b$bKeep an eye out for Ga'nar. He is a strong-willed orc, and will languish in captivity.
english.completion: <The orc's lips and wrists quiver with restrained fury.>$b$bWho are you?$b$bWait, what's that you say? Drek'Thar is here?
english.completed: Find Ga'nar within the Blackrock Quarry in the Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 钢铁的味道
text.objectives: 进入灭世者侧面炮台，并消灭200个钢铁部落士兵。
text.description: 我看有两种办法可以阻止这辆坦克通过传送门：破坏坦克，或用那该死的坦克炸毁那该死的传送门。$b$b我能做到，但需要时间。到灭世者右舷方向的炮台里去，别让敌人接近我。
text.completion: Takin' away Gul'dan was one thing, but blowin' up the whole damned portal? That's my kind of solution.$b$bNow, I think we'd better get out of here before that army gets to us.
text.completed: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil in Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: A Taste of Iron
english.objectives: Enter the Worldbreaker Side Turret and destroy 200 Iron Horde troops.
english.description: The way I see it, there's two ways to keep this tank from going through the portal: break the tank, or USE the dang tank ta' BLOW UP the dang portal.$b$bI can get 'er workin', I just need time. Hop in that turret off the starboard bow and keep 'em off my back.
english.completion: Takin' away Gul'dan was one thing, but blowin' up the whole damned portal? That's my kind of solution.$b$bNow, I think we'd better get out of here before that army gets to us.
english.completed: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil in Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 冲刺阶段
text.objectives: 前往码头。
text.description: 如果说他们之前还没发火的话，现在一定是怒不可遏了。我们在这辆坦克上连一分钟都活不下去！$b$b赶快去跟其他人会合，离开这儿！！
text.completion: Against all odds, here we stand. Still alive, an entire army on our heels.$b$bOur ship is waiting. Shall we depart?
text.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar in Iron Bastion in the Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: The Home Stretch
english.objectives: Get to the docks.
english.description: If they weren't angry before, they sure are now. We won't survive a minute up on top o' this tank!$b$bLet's join up with the rest and get out of here!!
english.completion: Against all odds, here we stand. Still alive, an entire army on our heels.$b$bOur ship is waiting. Shall we depart?
english.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar in Iron Bastion in the Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 凯尔娜拉·猎日者
text.objectives: 挑战凯尔娜拉·猎日者。
text.description: 聚焦水晶已经制作完成了，$n。等你做好准备，我就会用它粉碎凯尔娜拉的护盾。$b$b但是，在矿场里和她交手太不安全了。只要她的护盾一失效，我就会把我们传送到尤鲁恩矿场外面的安全地点。当她远离水晶时就好对付得多了。$b$b等你准备好开始时就来与我交谈吧。
text.completion: A wise elder of my order once told me, "True power is the strength to act and the wisdom to know when not to act." May those words and the memory of Kaelynara stay with you on your journey, $n.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Doruu.

english.title: Kaelynara Sunchaser
english.objectives: Confront Kaelynara Sunchaser.
english.description: The focusing crystal is complete, $n. When you are ready I will use the crystal to shatter Kaelynara's shield.$b$bHowever, it is unsafe to confront her within the mine. The moment her shield is down I will teleport us to a safe location outside of the Jorune Mine. She will be much easier to deal with when she is far away from the crystal.$b$bSpeak with me when you are ready to begin.
english.completion: Один мудрый старейшина моего ордена как-то сказал: "Истинное могущество складывается из силы, позволяющей действовать, и мудрости, позволяющей не действовать попусту". Пусть эти слова и память о Келинаре навсегда останутся с тобой, $n.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Doruu.

text.title: 凯尔娜拉·猎日者
text.objectives: 挑战凯尔娜拉·猎日者。
text.description: 聚焦水晶已经制作完成了，$n。等你做好准备，我就会用它粉碎凯尔娜拉的护盾。$b$b但是，在矿场里和她交手太不安全了。只要她的护盾一失效，我就会把我们传送到尤鲁恩矿场外面的安全地点。当她远离水晶时就好对付得多了。$b$b等你准备好开始时就来与我交谈吧。
text.completion: A wise elder of my order once told me, "True power is the strength to act and the wisdom to know when not to act." May those words and the memory of Kaelynara stay with you on your journey, $n.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Doruu.

english.objectives: Confront Kaelynara Sunchaser.
english.description: The focusing crystal is complete, $n. When you are ready I will use the crystal to shatter Kaelynara's shield.$b$bHowever, it is unsafe to confront her within the mine. The moment her shield is down I will teleport us to a safe location outside of the Jorune Mine. She will be much easier to deal with when she is far away from the crystal.$b$bSpeak with me when you are ready to begin.
english.completion: Один мудрый старейшина моего ордена как-то сказал: "Истинное могущество складывается из силы, позволяющей действовать, и мудрости, позволяющей не действовать попусту". Пусть эти слова и память о Келинаре навсегда останутся с тобой, $n.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Doruu.

text.title: 拯救双头飞龙
text.objectives: 在黑潮栖木击败拉兹·里克托兹。
text.description: 我甚至设法从我们这里的小伙伴嘴里翘出了更多情报。$b$b黑潮主母就在山顶上。$b$b他们其中一位首席工程师正在试图用他所掌握的技术驯化那位主母。我们必须阻止他，$n。
text.completion: We have accomplished great things on this island today, $n. I look forward to the day we hunt again.
text.completed: Return to Rexxar at the Island to the east of Darktide Roost in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Rylak Rescue
english.objectives: Kill Razz Ricketroz at Darktide Roost.
english.description: I managed to squeeze even more information out of our little friend here.$b$bThe Darktide Matriarch is at the top of the hill.$b$bOne of their lead engineers is attempting to tame the matriarch with his technology. We must stop him, $n.
english.completion: Сегодня мы с тобой многого добились, $n. Жду не дождусь того дня, когда мы сможем поохотиться снова.
english.completed: Return to Rexxar at the Island to the east of Darktide Roost in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 誓日营地
text.objectives: 到塔拉多的誓日营地找女伯爵莉亚德琳。
text.description: 我们不再需要与奥金尼合作了，勇士。我已经安排他们的首席缚魂者继续为我们提供指引，但我相信眼下任何行动最好都由我们自己来完成。$B$B到东南边的誓日营地与我会面。我能在当地感觉到更多恶魔污染力，也许能在源头处追踪到剩余的能量水晶碎片。
text.completion: There is still much to be done before we can leave Auchindoun with peace of mind, champion.
text.completed: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani outsider Telmor.

english.title: Sunsworn Camp
english.objectives: Meet Lady Liadrin at Sunsworn Camp in Talador.
english.description: We no longer have a need to work alongside the Auchenai, champion. I have arranged for their lead soulbinders to continue to advise us, but I believe any action is best left to us at this point.$B$BMeet me at Sunsworn Camp, southeast of here. I can sense more demonic taint in the area, and we may be able to track down the remaining power crystal shards at its source.
english.completion: There is still much to be done before we can leave Auchindoun with peace of mind, champion.
english.completed: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani outsider Telmor.

text.title: 圣光之眠
text.objectives: 到塔拉多的圣光之眠找大主教玛拉达尔。
text.description: 既然敌人的强大战斗力已被瓦解，我们必须把注意力转移到应对后果上来，为任何即将到来的攻击做好准备。我们仍然需要恢复奥金顿的防御。$B$B到南边不远处的圣光之眠来找我吧。有报告称在那片区域出现了恶魔的腐化之力，我们也许能在源头追踪到其余的能量水晶碎片。
text.completion: We have our work cut out for us, champion. The Legion's stench fills the air.
text.completed: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani outsider Telmor.

english.title: Light's Rest
english.objectives: Meet Exarch Maladaar at Light's Rest in Talador.
english.description: With the brute force of our enemy neutralized, we must turn our sights on quelling the aftermath and preparing for any future assaults. We still need Auchindoun's defenses reinvigorated.$B$BMeet me at Light's Rest, not far south of here. We have reports coming in of demonic taint in the area, and we may be able to track down the remaining power crystal shards at its source.
english.completion: We have our work cut out for us, champion. The Legion's stench fills the air.
english.completed: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani outsider Telmor.

text.title: 放飞它们的心灵
text.objectives: 对被控制的双头飞龙使用双头飞龙精神控制仪。
text.description: 地精们就是用这个装置来控制双头飞龙的。$b$b在控制器上有个按钮，标签写着“请勿触摸”。$b$b到被控制的双头飞龙身边去，按下这个按钮。
text.completion: Устройство рассыпается у вас в руках.$b$bУдар по больному обязательно заставит Железную Орду задуматься о своей тактике управления рилаками.

english.title: Free their Minds
english.objectives: Use the Rylak Mind Controller on Controlled Rylaks.
english.description: This device is what the goblins are using to control the rylaks.$b$bThere is a button on the controller labeled do not touch.$b$bGet within range of a Controlled Rylak and touch the button.
english.completion: Устройство рассыпается у вас в руках.$b$bУдар по больному обязательно заставит Железную Орду задуматься о своей тактике управления рилаками.

objectiveDetails.description: 让双头飞龙的精神重获自由

text.title: 防御能量
text.objectives: 前往圣光之墓寻找缚魂者图拉妮。
text.description: 仅有的几名没上前线的灵魂祭祀，眼下正在不遗余力地维持着奥金顿的防御。单凭他们的力量坚持不了多久。$B$B缚魂者图拉妮到附近的圣光之墓中去寻找备用能量晶塔，到现在还没回来。我要你去找到她，然后把她和晶塔都安全地带回这里。
text.completion: You look like you can fight. We need to get out of here!
text.completed: 前往圣光之墓寻找缚魂者图拉妮。

english.title: Powering the Defenses
english.objectives: Find Soulbinder Tuulani in the Tomb of Lights.
english.description: What few soulpriests we don't have on the front lines are working fervently to maintain Auchindoun's defenses. They aren't going to be able to keep it up much longer alone.$B$BSoulbinder Tuulani went inside the nearby Tomb of Lights to retrieve a backup power pylon and hasn't returned. I need you to find her and get her and the pylon back here safely.
english.completion: You look like you can fight. We need to get out of here!
english.completed: Find Soulbinder Tuulani in the Tomb of Lights.

text.title: Powering the Defenses
text.objectives: Retrieve the Shard of Souls in the Tomb of Souls.
text.description: I know what the Bonechewer are after.$B$BAuchindoun is protected by a powerful barrier, which can only be disabled using an ancient key. No being could ever hope to penetrate it.$B$BThe Auchenai, my people, split the key into three shards long ago and hid each piece outside the mausoleum walls. We guard those shards with the same zeal as Auchindoun itself.$B$BGo into the Tomb of Souls and retrieve the key from Soulbinder X. The shards are no longer safe.
text.completed: Return to Soulbinder Nyami at the Auchindoun North Gate in Talador.

english.title: Powering the Defenses
english.objectives: Retrieve the Shard of Souls in the Tomb of Souls.
english.description: I know what the Bonechewer are after.$B$BAuchindoun is protected by a powerful barrier, which can only be disabled using an ancient key. english.completed: Return to Soulbinder Nyami at the Auchindoun North Gate in Talador.

text.title: 建造你的兵营
text.objectives: 找到并学习要塞图纸：兵营，然后使用建筑设计桌来建造你的兵营。
text.description:
你该建造兵营了，有了兵营才能狠狠地痛扁敌人。

第一步是去找到所需的图纸，然后学习它们。我想我把几张图纸放在这附近的什么地方了。

接下来，选择你想让我们据其建造的图纸。在我的建筑设计桌上指出来吧，然后我们就会立即动手开始建造。
text.completion: This will be a mighty fine barracks, I think. I am sure Warmaster Zog will complain about how it needs to be bigger, and with more spikes. He likes spikes...
text.completed: Return to Gazlowe at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge

english.title: Build Your Barracks
english.objectives: Find and learn the Garrison Blueprints: Barracks and then use the Architect's Table to build your barracks.
english.description:
You are going to want to build your barracks, which you're gonna need to properly bash faces.

The first step is to go find the blueprints and learn 'em. I think I left some blueprints lying around here somewhere.

Next ya gotta pick which plot you want us to build it on. Just point it out on my architect table and we'll get started constructing that thing right away.
english.completion: This will be a mighty fine barracks, I think. I am sure Warmaster Zog will complain about how it needs to be bigger, and with more spikes. He likes spikes...
english.completed: Return to Gazlowe at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge

objectiveDetails.description: 使用建筑设计桌来开始建造你的兵营
跟随加兹鲁维前往建筑工地
找到加兹鲁维丢失的图纸

text.title: 变换之风
text.objectives: 救出欧林·棕皮。
text.description: 指挥官，我带来了坏消息。欧林·棕皮——那个跟你一起从塔纳安丛林里逃出来的牛头人，在要塞东面的边界附近遭到了伏击。$b$b有人看见他被白鬼拖走了。这些是危险而恼人的怪物，据说有些原先是兽人。现在都变成了受黑暗魔法驱遣的行尸走肉。$b$b欧林足智多谋，但毕竟寡不敌众。我建议尽快向东组织营救，否则他们就会把他一点一点地……活活吃掉。
text.completion: Well done commander. Olin spoke to me of your bravery and has already offered to serve under your command.$b$bIf I may advise you in this matter, I would suggest accepting his service. We could make use of a tauren with his skill sets in a land like this.
text.completed: Return to Warmaster Zog at your Garrison.

english.title: Winds of Change
english.objectives: Rescue Olin Umberhide.
english.description: Commander, I have bad news. Olin Umberhide, the tauren who escaped with you from Tanaan, was ambushed when near the eastern perimeter of the Garrison.$b$bHe was seen being dragged off by the pale. These are dangerous, disturbing creatures that some believe were once orcs. Now they are husks of barely living flesh bent by dark magics.$b$bOlin is resourceful, but outnumbered. I would advise travelling east to effect a rescue as soon as possible, before they eat him alive... slowly.
english.completion: Well done commander. Olin spoke to me of your bravery and has already offered to serve under your command.$b$bIf I may advise you in this matter, I would suggest accepting his service. We could make use of a tauren with his skill sets in a land like this.
english.completed: Return to Warmaster Zog at your Garrison.

text.title: 神秘的戒指
text.objectives: 把神秘的戒指拿到塔拉多卡德加的法师塔，交给佐提·轮怒。
text.description: 在这枚工艺精美的指环上刻满了华丽的图案和符号，最醒目的就是一个闪闪发光的字母“V”。指环看上去渐明渐暗，仿佛是在时间的长河里往复穿梭。$b$b卡德加的法师塔里或许有人会对这样一件神器有兴趣。
text.progress: Time magic is a young field of research.
text.completion: Ah. Now what do you have there? This ring is going to require some extra research.$b$bIt seems like someone was trying to travel through time but in a very backward fashion.
text.completed: Bring the Mysterious Ring to Zooti Fizzlefury at Khadgar's Tower in Talador.

english.title: Mysterious Ring
english.objectives: Bring the Mysterious Ring to Zooti Fizzlefury at Khadgar's Tower in Talador.
english.description: This elegantly crafted ring is covered in ornate decorations and symbols, the most prominent of which being the letter "V" in a glowing rune. The ring seems to fade in and out of view as if passing back and forth through time.$b$bSomeone at Khadgar's Tower may have an interest in such an artifact.
english.progress: Time magic is a young field of research.
english.completion: Ah. Now what do you have there? This ring is going to require some extra research.$b$bIt seems like someone was trying to travel through time but in a very backward fashion.
english.completed: Bring the Mysterious Ring to Zooti Fizzlefury at Khadgar's Tower in Talador.

text.title: 神秘的长靴
text.objectives: 把神秘的长靴拿到塔拉多卡德加的法师塔，交给佐提·轮怒。
text.description: 这双闪光的华丽靴子在时间的长河里忽隐忽现，上面还有个格外显眼的字母“V”。$b$b卡德加的法师塔里或许有人会对这件奇怪物品的用处有自己的见解。
text.progress: I was wondering "when" I would see you again. Ah...? Ah...? Get it?$B$BLook, for as long as anyone was speaking the bronze dragons got to hog all of the good time jokes.$B$BWell now the guardians of time are taking a break and there is no one left to stop me!
text.completion: These boots are fantastic! You did the right thing bringing these to me.$B$BThey are actually trying to replace the space they occupy with a different timeline.$B$BThis will definitely require more study.
text.completed: Bring the Mysterious Boots to Zooti Fizzlefury at Khadgar's Tower in Talador.

english.title: Mysterious Boots
english.objectives: Bring the Mysterious Boots to Zooti Fizzlefury at Khadgar's Tower in Talador.
english.description: Phasing back and forward in time, these flickering ornate boots are adorned with a lavish "V" on them.$b$bSomeone at Khadgar's Tower might have insights to the nature of these strange items.
english.progress: I was wondering "when" I would see you again. Ah...? Ah...? Get it?$B$BLook, for as long as anyone was speaking the bronze dragons got to hog all of the good time jokes.$B$BWell now the guardians of time are taking a break and there is no one left to stop me!
english.completion: These boots are fantastic! You did the right thing bringing these to me.$B$BThey are actually trying to replace the space they occupy with a different timeline.$B$BThis will definitely require more study.
english.completed: Bring the Mysterious Boots to Zooti Fizzlefury at Khadgar's Tower in Talador.

text.title: 神秘的帽子
text.objectives: 把神秘的帽子拿到塔拉多卡德加的法师塔，交给佐提·轮怒。
text.description: 这顶神秘的帽子里有能量涌出，仿佛带有看不见的力量。被放在地上时，它会在时间流忽隐忽现时，还发出了嗡鸣声。$b$b卡德加的法师塔里一定有人会对这种东西非常感兴趣的。
text.progress: It is so nice to finally be able to research my passion without those interfering bronze dragons showing up.
text.completion: Now THAT is a hat. See how it flickers in and out of time as if someone were temporally jiggling it?$B$BI'd try putting it on if I weren't afraid it would wipe me from the timeline.
text.completed: Bring the Mysterious Hat to Zooti Fizzlefury at Khadgar's Tower in Talador.

english.title: Mysterious Hat
english.objectives: Bring the Mysterious Hat to Zooti Fizzlefury at Khadgar's Tower in Talador.
english.description: Energy flows from this mystical hat with an unseen strength. It hums as it drifts back and forward in time where it rests on the ground.$b$bThis is the sort of object that someone at Khadgar's Tower would find very interesting.
english.progress: It is so nice to finally be able to research my passion without those interfering bronze dragons showing up.
english.completion: That's a hat. Look how it moves in time back and forth! It's like it's being juggled by someone who's in the past, present, and future at the same time! I'd love to try it on, but I'm afraid to leave this reality by accident forever.
english.completed: Bring the Mysterious Hat to Zooti Fizzlefury at Khadgar's Tower in Talador.

text.title: 神秘法杖
text.objectives: 把神秘法杖拿到塔拉多卡德加的法师塔，交给佐提·轮怒。
text.description: 现实的时间流在这根法杖周围波动，以致于法杖上的字迹都已模糊难辨，只能看清在尖端有个格外醒目的大大的“V”字。$b$b这也许需要去卡德加的法师塔找人来鉴别一下。
text.progress: I did my time with fire and the other arcane arts. They were good. Nothing compares to hurling a giant ball of fire.$B$BBut temporal wizardry? So much fun!$B$BReally hard to master but you always have plenty of time.
text.completion: Hmm. This staff looks familiar. I wonder...$B$BYou did the right thing bringing it to me. I will investigate further!
text.completed: Bring the Mysterious Staff to Zooti Fizzlefury at Khadgar's Tower in Talador.

english.title: Mysterious Staff
english.objectives: Bring the Mysterious Staff to Zooti Fizzlefury at Khadgar's Tower in Talador.
english.description: Fluctuations in reality surround this staff so much that it is hard to identify any recognizable markings aside from a large, lavish "V" on its apex.$b$bThis might require help to identify by someone from Khadgar's Tower.
english.progress: I did my time with fire and the other arcane arts. They were good. Nothing compares to hurling a giant ball of fire.$B$BBut temporal wizardry? So much fun!$B$BReally hard to master but you always have plenty of time.
english.completion: Хм... Кажется, этот посох мне знаком. Может быть...$b$bТы молодчина, что $gпринес:принесла; его мне. Я изучу его более тщательно!
english.completed: Bring the Mysterious Staff to Zooti Fizzlefury at Khadgar's Tower in Talador.

text.title: 净化魂灵
text.objectives: 净化$1oa个疯狂之魂。
text.description: 并非所有灵魂都被磨魂者尽数消灭，有些灵魂像我一样或多或少地保持了完整。其它那些却被扭曲并发狂了。$B$B去结束它们的痛苦吧，拿上我的灵魂碎片去净化它们。愤怒遮蔽了它们的双眼，使它们对碎片能量的效力视若不见，所以你必须先将其击败才能使用碎片。
text.completion: Thank you, I am glad that the spirits have been released from their torment.
text.completed: Return to Orlana Strongbrow within the Spirit Realm in the Bloodmaul Stronghold.

english.title: Cleansing the Souls
english.objectives: Cleanse $1oa Crazed Souls.
english.description: Not all spirits are destroyed by the Soulgrinder. Some souls manage to survive more or less intact like myself. Others have become twisted and maddened.$B$BEnd their misery, take my soul shard and use it to purify them. Their rage will blind them to the effects of its energy so you must defeat them before you use it.
english.completion: Thank you, I am glad that the spirits have been released from their torment.
english.completed: Return to Orlana Strongbrow within the Spirit Realm in the Bloodmaul Stronghold.

text.title: 时空对接
text.objectives: 等佐提·轮怒完成时空仪式。
text.description: 我想我知道你找来的那些神秘的神器是做什么用的了。$b$b看来有人正试图从你原本所在的时间线把物品送回到我们当前所在的这条时间线，以此来影响时空的转换。$b$b技术上说，那应该是不可能的。可这位仁兄竟然做到了。$b$b我想我可能会尝试用仪式把那位旅行者带到这来。
text.completion: $n? Is that you? Fantastic! And they said it couldn't be done.$B$BThey said traversing the worlds in this way was the domain of the bronze dragonflight. Well, guess who's temporally laughing now!
text.completed: Speak with the Image of Archmage Vargoth.

english.title: Temporal Juxtaposition
english.objectives: Wait for Zooti Fizzlefury's temporal ritual to complete.
english.description: I think I figured out what those mysterious artifacts you collected were for.$b$bIt would seem someone is attempting to affect a temporal shift by sending items back into this timeline from your own timeline.$b$bTechnically that shouldn't be possible. But whoever this is found a way.$b$bI think I may try a ritual to bring the traveler through.
english.completion: $n? Is that you? Fantastic! And they said it couldn't be done.$B$BThey said traversing the worlds in this way was the domain of the bronze dragonflight. Well, guess who's temporally laughing now!
english.completed: Speak with the Image of Archmage Vargoth.

text.title: 潜在的盟友
text.objectives: 在卡加萨训练场的火环附近使用霜风焦镜，释放大主教玛拉达尔。
text.description: 有位被俘的德莱尼人正在受到某种……优待，这要看你怎么定义了。别人都被绑着受刑，可他却被绑在桩子上烧，捉拿他的人显然对此很得意。$b$b使用这块符文石。用它可以轻松对付他周围的烈焰之环。
text.completion: I owe my life to you, stranger. I offer you and your company my support. Together, we may make it out of this jungle alive.
text.completed: Report to Exarch Maladaar at Kargathar Proving Grounds in Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: A Potential Ally
english.objectives: Use the Frostflurry Focus near the ring of fire in Kargathar Proving Grounds to free Exarch Maladaar.
english.description: One of the captured draenei is receiving some... preferential treatment, if you can call it that. While others are tied down and tortured, this one is tied to a stake and burned for the orcs' amusement.$b$bUse this runestone. It should handily deal with the ring of fire that surrounds this draenei.
english.completion: I owe my life to you, stranger. I offer you and your company my support. Together, we may make it out of this jungle alive.
english.completed: Report to Exarch Maladaar at Kargathar Proving Grounds in Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: Bonus Objective: Kill Grimfrost Ogres
text.description: Free the Frostwolves being held by the Grimfrost ogres.

english.title: Bonus Objective: Kill Grimfrost Ogres
english.description: Free the Frostwolves being held by the Grimfrost ogres.

text.title: 卫兵队长瑞斯塔兰
text.objectives: 在泰尔莫找到瑞斯塔兰。
text.description: 他们杀死了艾德拉，把水晶从她手里抢走了！守卫队长瑞斯塔兰试图阻止他们，但却被带进了教堂！$B$B如果我们能找到这块水晶，就可以复原奥金顿之心，全面启动防御！这个时候绝不能失败。$B$B$n，现在能完成这项任务的只剩下你一个人了。你必须找到瑞斯塔兰！他知道水晶的下落。
text.completion: There is no time for pleasantries. The raid's leader is just ahead.
text.completed: 在泰尔莫找到瑞斯塔兰。

english.title: Restalaan, Captain of the Guard
english.objectives: Find Restalaan in Telmor.
english.description: They killed Aedraa and took the crystal from her! The captain of the guard, Restalaan, tried to stop them and they took him into the cathedral!$B$BIf we can just get this crystal, we can reunite the Heart of Auchindoun and turn its defenses on fully! We can't afford to fail now.$B$B$n, you're the only one left that can do it. You have to find Restalaan! He'll know where they took it.
english.completion: There is no time for pleasantries. The raid's leader is just ahead.
english.completed: Find Restalaan in Telmor.

text.title: Into the Jaws of the Jungle
text.objectives: Move further into Heartblood.
text.description: We've freed enough prisoners that I feel we're strong enough to move forward as a group. We cannot stay here long - Grommash Hellscream will be on our tail soon enough.$b$bLet me know when you're ready, and we'll press on.
text.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at the Bleeding Altar in the Tanaan Jungle.
