objectiveDetails.description: Group escorted to the Bleeding Altar

text.title: 除爪比赛
text.objectives: 收集$oa只刃牙虎人爪子。
text.description: 这些虎人怪物浪费了我很多钱，$c。$b$b我可不是个会免除债务的人，而且讨债的时间已经到了！$b$b给我们惹出最大麻烦的虎人就住在刃牙之喉。他们一直在沿途伏击我们的货运商队。$b$b<匹克西尼笑了。>$b$b是时候废掉这些虎人的爪子了。把他们的爪子给我带来，我们可以把品相最好的当成好运符在竞技场里出售。$b$b要是光靠卖爪子还不能帮他们抵债的话，就只好卸掉他们的胳膊或腿了！
text.progress: Do you have the saberon claws I asked for?
text.completion: <Pyxni examines the saberon claws.>$b$bWe're gonna make a killing selling these as good luck charms to all the wannabe gladiators here at the arena!$b$bFrom now on, the saberon will think twice about messing with the Steamwheedle Cartel!
text.completed: Return to Pyxni Pennypocket.

english.title: Declawing The Competition
english.objectives: Collect $oa Saberon Claws.
english.description: These saberon freaks have cost me a lot of money, $c.$b$bI'm not one to forgive a debt and it's time to collect!$b$bThe saberon that have been causing us the most trouble are the ones living in Sabermaw. They keep ambushing our trade shipments along the road.$b$b<Pyxni grins.>$b$bIt's time to declaw the competition. Bring me their claws; we'll sell the best ones as good luck charms here at the arena.$b$bIf the claw sales don't cover their debt, we'll just have to charge them an arm and a leg too!
english.progress: Do you have the saberon claws I asked for?
english.completion: <Pyxni examines the saberon claws.>$b$bWe're gonna make a killing selling these as good luck charms to all the wannabe gladiators here at the arena!$b$bFrom now on, the saberon will think twice about messing with the Steamwheedle Cartel!
english.completed: Return to Pyxni Pennypocket.

text.title: 悬赏：利爪！
text.objectives: 击败利爪。
text.description: 因其在试炼竞技场犯下袭击无辜罪，特此通缉！$b$b利爪在刃牙之喉附近，率众对沿途过往的旅行者发动数起突袭和伏击。$b$b最后出现在名为刃牙之喉的虎人巢穴周边区域。$b$b需要格外小心行事！$b$b完成后，热砂集团的匹克西尼·钱包会发放赏金。
text.completion: You fought your way into Sabermaw, killed Razorpaw...and lived?$b$bThat's incredible news!$b$bThe roads will be much safer now that he's dead! That means more money for me!$b$bAs promised, here's your reward!
text.completed: Return to Pyxni Pennypocket.
text.giverWindow: 滥杀无辜的通缉犯！

english.title: WANTED: Razorpaw!
english.objectives: Defeat Razorpaw.
english.description: Wanted for crimes against the innocent at the Ring of Trials!$b$bRazorpaw is responsible for leading several raids and ambushes against travelers on the road near Sabermaw.$b$bLast seen in the vicinity of the saberon den known as Sabermaw.$b$bExercise extreme caution!$b$bUpon completion, this bounty will be fulfilled by Pyxni Pennypocket of the Steamwheedle Cartel.
english.completion: You fought your way into Sabermaw, killed Razorpaw...and lived?$b$bThat's incredible news!$b$bThe roads will be much safer now that he's dead! That means more money for me!$b$bAs promised, here's your reward!
english.completed: Return to Pyxni Pennypocket.
english.giverWindow: Wanted for crimes against the innocent!

text.title: 他们抢走了货物！
text.objectives: 取回$oa件失窃的货物。
text.description: 那些虎人……他们的目标不只是俘虏……$b$b<咳嗽>他们还抢走了所有货物……$b$b绑架是一回事……可盗取地精的货物？那就涉及私人利益了！$b$b<咳嗽>……除非你把所有被盗的商品都找到，否则匹克西尼是不会高兴的。到刃牙之喉去，把我们的货物全都偷回来。$b$b完成后，回试炼竞技场找匹克西尼。$b$b她不会让你白忙的……
text.progress: Greexlex told you that the saberon stole our merchandise?$B$BWell, what are you standing around for? Get your butt over to Sabermaw and get it back!$B$BTime is money!
text.completion: You recovered the merchandise? Fantastic!$b$b<Pyxni rummages through the bags.>$b$bIt's all here too! I knew I could count on you! Here, take this reward.$b$bYou've earned it!
text.completed: Return to Pyxni Pennypocket.

english.title: They've Got The Goods!
english.objectives: Recover $oa Stolen Goods.
english.description: The Saberon...they weren't just after prisoners...$b$b<Cough>...they took all the merchandise too.$b$bKidnapping is one thing...but stealing a goblin's merchandise? That's making things personal!$b$b<Cough>...Pyxni ain't going to be happy unless you get all of the stolen goods back. Make your way into Sabermaw and steal back all our merch.$b$bWhen you're done, make your way back to Pyxni at the Ring of Trials.$b$bShe'll make it worth your while...
english.progress: Greexlex told you that the saberon stole our merchandise?$B$BWell, what are you standing around for? Get your butt over to Sabermaw and get it back!$B$BTime is money!
english.completion: You recovered the merchandise? Fantastic!$b$b<Pyxni rummages through the bags.>$b$bIt's all here too! I knew I could count on you! Here, take this reward.$b$bYou've earned it!
english.completed: Return to Pyxni Pennypocket.

text.title: 被劫持的地精
text.objectives: 救出$oa名地精商人。
text.description: 我们甚至都没意识到遭到了伏击……$b$b虎人无比迅速和猛烈的攻过来，我们几乎来不及反应。$b$b那些发育过度的杂种把其他人都拖走了，留我在这里等死……他们可能是觉得我已经踏入鬼门关了。$b$b我听见他们说喜欢吃新鲜的肉……$b<咳嗽>……但我可没那么容易死！$b$b不用担心我……<咳嗽>……再大的风浪我都闯过来了！不过你得去刃牙之喉走一趟，把别的商人救出来。$b$b他们应该都被关在那了……
text.completion: You got all of the captured traders out of Sabermaw? Fantastic!$b$bNow they owe me and I ain't one to let a debt go uncollected! As for you, take this reward for your trouble!
text.completed: Return to Pyxni Pennypocket.

english.title: Gobnapped
english.objectives: Rescue $oa Goblin Traders.
english.description: We never even saw the ambush coming...$b$bThe saberon hit us so hard and fast we barely had time to think.$b$bThose overgrown mongrels dragged the others away and left me here for dead...they probably thought I was too close to dying.$b$bI hear they like their meat fresh...$b<cough>....well I ain't going down that easy!$b$bDon't worry about me...<cough>...I've been through worse! You're gonna have to go to Sabermaw and get the other merchants out though.$b$bThey've probably got 'em all caged up in there...
english.completion: You got all of the captured traders out of Sabermaw? Fantastic!$b$bNow they owe me and I ain't one to let a debt go uncollected! As for you, take this reward for your trouble!
english.completed: Return to Pyxni Pennypocket.

text.title: 我的宝贝！
text.objectives: 找到巴兹维克斯失窃的宝贝。
text.description: 你得帮帮我！$b$b我当时就藏在货车里，在不远处的路上遭到了伏击。我在虎人发现前溜走了……可是……可是……$b$b他们偷走了我最珍贵的财产！$b$b你得帮我找回来！我看着他们把它拖进了刃牙之喉，带上了那座大山！$b$b谁知道那些肮脏的虎人会对它做什么！$b$b拜托了，我只是个孩子！你会帮我的对吧？
text.completion: You did a great job, $n. I couldn't have asked for a better sidekick!$b$bAnyway, now that I've got my treasure back...$b$bI've got to do...$b$b...things and...stuff.$b$bBye!
text.completed: Speak with Bazwix.

english.title: My Precious!
english.objectives: Find Bazwix's stolen treasure.
english.description: You've got to help me!$b$bI was hiding on the trade wagon that got ambushed just down the road from here. I snuck away before the saberon spotted me...but...but...$b$bTHEY STOLE MY MOST PRIZED POSSESSION!$b$bYou've got to help me get it back! I watched them drag it into Sabermaw and up that giant hill!$b$bWho knows what those filthy saberon will do to it!$b$bPlease, I'm just a kid! You've got to help me out, right?
english.completion: You did a great job, $n. I couldn't have asked for a better sidekick!$b$bAnyway, now that I've got my treasure back...$b$bI've got to do...$b$b...things and...stuff.$b$bBye!
english.completed: Speak with Bazwix.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到巴兹维克斯失窃的宝贝

text.title: 听你指挥
text.objectives: 选择采用哪种岗哨建筑。
text.description: 你在这儿真是太好了！$B$B乌瑞恩堡已经接近完工。我们只需要在这最后一块地上造好建筑就行了。$B$B巴隆斯提供了对应两座不同建筑的图纸，都适合这里——一座是炮塔，另一座是奥秘圣殿。$B$B你决定吧，指挥官。图纸就在绘图桌上供你查阅。
text.completion: Excellent. This will do nicely.
text.completed: Speak to Foreman Eksos in Talador.

english.title: At Your Command
english.objectives: Choose which outpost structure to construct.
english.description: I'm glad you're here!$B$BFort Wrynn is nearly complete. We only need to fill this last plot.$B$BBaros provided us with blueprints for two different structures that would fit this space - an Artillery Tower or an Arcane Sanctum.$B$BIt's your call, commander. The plans are on the drafting table for your perusal.
english.completion: Excellent. This will do nicely.
english.completed: Speak to Foreman Eksos in Talador.

text.title: Vignette: Yaga the Scarred
text.objectives: Destroy $1oa Goren Egg Clusters, $2oa Iceforge Ironchewers, and Broodmother Reeg'ak.
text.description: Goren are dangerous, especially in large numbers, and especially when we have a blind, under powered shaman with us.$b$bFortunately, they have very short lifespans. Unfortunately, they multiply fast and grow faster.$b$BIf we are going to do this we need to find the brood mother. Slaying her and her eggs should slow down the onslaught of goren. Check the burrows near the Forge Gates and I will to keep them off of Drek'Thar's scent.
text.completed: Return to Draka at the Forge Gates in Frostfire Ridge.

english.objectives: Destroy $1oa Goren Egg Clusters, $2oa Iceforge Ironchewers, and Broodmother Reeg'ak.
english.description: Goren are dangerous, especially in large numbers, and especially when we have a blind, under powered shaman with us.$b$bFortunately, they have very short lifespans. Unfortunately, they multiply fast and grow faster.$b$BIf we are going to do this we need to find the brood mother. Slaying her and her eggs should slow down the onslaught of goren. Check the burrows near the Forge Gates and I will to keep them off of Drek'Thar's scent.
english.completed: Return to Draka at the Forge Gates in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 采石场的困境
text.objectives: 在塔拉多乌瑞恩堡的外面与学徒米阿尔谈一谈。
text.description: 既然我们已经造好了炮塔，现在需要一些熟练的老手来管理它。$b$b我听说艾瑞德——沙塔斯最杰出的铁匠之一，在那座城市陷落时逃了出来。他应该就在北边的墙外，待在其他难民中间。$b$b看看你能不能说服他为我们工作吧。
text.completion: You are the commander of this fort, yes?$b$bMy master wanted to join your fight to reclaim our home but he grew ill and... I'm sorry, he was a great draenei and I will carry on his memory.$b$bYour new building would give me the means to see out my master's vision and honor his passing.$b$bIf you would allow me to do this then I would serve you.
text.completed: Speak to Apprentice Miall just outside of Fort Wrynn in Talador.

english.title: The Quarry Quandary
english.objectives: Speak to Apprentice Miall just outside of Fort Wrynn in Talador.
english.description: Now that we have the artillery tower built, we're going to need some skilled hands to run it.$b$bI've heard that Ared, one of the best smiths in Shattrath, managed to escape the city's fall. He should be just outside the north wall with the rest of the refugees.$b$bSee if you can convince him to work for us.
english.completion: You are the commander of this fort, yes?$b$bMy master wanted to join your fight to reclaim our home but he grew ill and... I'm sorry, he was a great draenei and I will carry on his memory.$b$bYour new building would give me the means to see out my master's vision and honor his passing.$b$bIf you would allow me to do this then I would serve you.
english.completed: Speak to Apprentice Miall just outside of Fort Wrynn in Talador.

text.title: 目的地：未知
text.objectives: 消灭萨纳多斯遗迹的莫格索德。
text.description: 我抵达时，塔隆戈尔和古尔丹正要通过传送门离开……而我……我知道自己打不过他们。$B$B我会尽量保持传送门开启。只能靠你去给他们致命一击了。$B$B我们的命运都掌握在你手里，$n。
text.completion: Teron'gor and Gul'dan... they slaughtered everyone...$B$B...and then they just... disappeared... into the shadows...$B$BHow did they know where to go?
text.completed: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani in Auchindoun.

english.title: Destination: Unknown
english.objectives: Destroy Mongrethod in the Remains of Xandros.
english.description: Teron'gor and Gul'dan were just leaving through the portal as I arrived... and I... I know I won't be able to defeat them.$B$BI'll hold open the portal as long as I can. It will be up to you to strike the killing blow.$B$BOur fate is in your hands, $n.
english.completion: Teron'gor and Gul'dan... they slaughtered everyone...$B$B...and then they just... disappeared... into the shadows...$B$BHow did they know where to go?
english.completed: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani in Auchindoun.

text.title: Tearing Up Talador
text.description: Commander, we have a bit of a problem.$b$bWe found a location in Talador to set up an outpost but the team that was sent to begin construction have been arguing with each other on what to build. This situation could really put a setback in our plans unless it's dealt with swiftly.$b$bTake a gryphon to Talador and speak with Foreman Eksos before this gets any worse.

english.description: Commander, we have a bit of a problem.$b$bWe found a location in Talador to set up an outpost but the team that was sent to begin construction have been arguing with each other on what to build. This situation could really put a setback in our plans unless it's dealt with swiftly.$b$bTake a gryphon to Talador and speak with Foreman Eksos before this gets any worse.

text.title: 听你指挥
text.objectives: 检查绘图桌并选择采用哪种岗哨建筑。
text.description: 指挥官，哨站已经接近全面运作了。$b$b加兹鲁维给我们提供了两份不同的图纸，在这最后一块地上进行建造——分别是军械库和奥秘圣殿。$B$B任何一座都会使我们火力大增，以阻止钢铁部落的进攻。$B$B图纸就在绘图桌上。你来决定吧。
text.completion: Your will be done.$B$BFor the Horde!
text.completed: Return to Foreman Grobash in Talador.

english.title: At Your Command
english.objectives: Inspect the Drafting Table and choose which outpost structure to construct.
english.description: Commander, the outpost is nearly fully operational.$b$bGazlowe provided us with two different blueprints to fill this final plot - an Arsenal or an Arcane Sanctum.$B$BEither one would provide us with the additional firepower we need to stop the Iron Horde's advance.$B$BThe plans are on the drafting table. It's your call.
english.completion: Your will be done.$B$BFor the Horde!
english.completed: Return to Foreman Grobash in Talador.

text.title: 眼见为实
text.objectives: 得到莫克斯·剑吼的帮助。
text.description: 既然我们的军械库已经造好了，我们现在需要一位熟练的铁匠来管理它。$b$b我们不久前抓到了一个钢铁部落逃兵，他声称自己曾经是黑石最优秀的钢铁工人之一。$b$b通常我根本不会理睬俘虏说的胡话，但我们从他背包里搜出的武器确实是我所见过锻造工艺最为精湛的作品。$b$b指挥官，我想我们应该验证下他到底有没有他说的那么厉害。
text.completion: You're the one in charge around here, right? I've heard the guards talk about your exploits and if I wasn't looking at you now I'd swear they were lying.$B$BI've only ever wanted to make the finest blades and put them in the hands of the strongest of fighters. I can tell already that you're exactly the type I want to carry my weapons.$B$BIf you can give me a chance I swear you will not be disappointed.
text.completed: 在塔拉多的沃金之傲与莫克斯·剑吼谈一谈。

english.title: The Quarry Quandary
english.objectives: Obtain Morketh Bladehowl's assistance.
english.description: Now that our arsenal is built we need a skilled smith to operate it.$b$bWe recently caught an Iron Horde deserter who claims he used to be one of the Blackrock's best iron workers.$b$bNormally I'd ignore the ravings of a captive, but the weapons we took out of his pack had the finest workmanship I've ever seen.$b$bCommander, I think we should see if he's as good as he claims.
english.completion: You're the one in charge around here, right? I've heard the guards talk about your exploits and if I wasn't looking at you now I'd swear they were lying.$b$bI've only ever wanted to make the finest blades and put them in the hands of the strongest of fighters. I can tell already that you're exactly the type I want to carry my weapons.$b$bIf you can give me a chance I swear you will not be disappointed.
english.completed: Speak to Morketh Bladehowl within Vol'jin's Pride in Talador.

text.title: REUSE
text.objectives: Slay Hurkan Skullsplinter in the Seat of Depravity.
text.description: Teron'gor and his master Gul'dan were here! I tried to stop them... they escaped through the demonic gateway behind me before I could finish them!$B$BI think I can activate the portal open just long enough for you to enter. We have no way of knowing where it leads, but I fear it may end inside Auchindoun!$B$BYou have to stop him once and for all!
text.completed: Speak to Exarch Maladaar in the Seat of Depravity.

english.objectives: Slay Hurkan Skullsplinter in the Seat of Depravity.

text.title: 熔炼木铁
text.objectives: 从库洛的领地里取得12块木铁矿石。
text.description: 艾瑞德跟我来到这里，是因为我们需要优质金属来制造他设计的作品，而库洛的领地矿井中的木铁矿石就是最上乘的金属。为了补给炮塔，我需要用到这种矿石。$b$b可惜那里近来被一群鬣蜥人占领了，所以你必须一路杀进去取得矿石，赶在鬣蜥人把它们吃掉前得手。$b$b应该没什么怪物能给你造成麻烦的。
text.progress: We need to get that ore before those goren eat it all.
text.completion: These look pretty good. Ared would have loved to get his hands on these.$b$b<Miall wipes away a tear.>$b$b I'm sorry, this is making me too emotional, these will do just fine.
text.completed: Speak to Miall at Fort Wrynn in Talador.

english.title: Out of Jovite
english.objectives: Obtain 12 chunks of Jovite Ore from within Kuuro's Claim.
english.description: Ared and I came this way because we needed a good supply of metal to build his designs and some of the best metal is the jovite that comes from the mine in Kuuro's Claim. In order to supply the artillery tower I'm going to need this metal.$b$bUnfortunately that place was recently overwhelmed by a pack of goren, so you're going to have to fight your way in to get the ore before they manage to devour it.$b$bNothing that should be too much of a problem for you.
english.progress: We need to get that ore before those goren eat it all.
english.completion: These look pretty good. Ared would have loved to get his hands on these.$b$b<Miall wipes away a tear.>$b$b I'm sorry, this is making me too emotional, these will do just fine.
english.completed: Speak to Miall at Fort Wrynn in Talador.

text.title: 消灭食人魔
text.objectives: 在马尔高克岗哨消灭$1oa个食人魔。
text.description: 食人魔法师的出现，说明悬槌部族已经加大了巡逻与进犯力度。$b$b削弱他们的数量，可以大大阻碍悬槌部族在纳格兰卷土重来的进程。$b$b然后去找我的姐妹米拉娜，她那应该会有更多消息。
text.completion: Perfect, they will have to concentrate more on base defense now. Hopefully things will get back to normal out there.
text.completed: Speak with Rangari Mirana at Mar'gok's Overwatch in Nagrand.

english.title: Obliterating Ogres
english.objectives: Kill $1oa ogres at Mar'gok's Overwatch.
english.description: With actual ogre mages present, the Highmaul have been increasing patrols and aggression.$b$bThinning their ranks will go a long way to deterring the Highmaul from making a comeback in Nagrand.$b$bHead up to my sister Mirana afterwards, she should have more news.
english.completion: Отлично. Теперь они вынуждены будут сосредоточить все усилия на обороне базы. Надеюсь, со временем здесь все нормализуется.
english.completed: Speak with Rangari Mirana at Mar'gok's Overwatch in Nagrand.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭马尔高克岗哨的食人魔

text.title: 找回铱金
text.objectives: 从库洛的领地的铱金晶簇上采集$1oa份铱金之尘。
text.description: 艾瑞德以前经常教育我，金属的纯度是关键。如果金属不够纯的话，一旦受力就会裂开，然后就报废了。$b$b为了让炮塔正常运作，我需要按我师傅的标准，使金属的纯度达到最高，因此我需要一种强力熔剂。$b$b铱金晶簇碎块上的粉尘勉强可用，不过我们得先找到才行。它们通常会聚合在地下，所以到附近库洛的领地的矿井里找找看吧。
text.progress: I'm going to need a lot of iridium dust to purify the metal to anywhere near my masters standards.
text.completion: This won't be as good as some of the stuff we had back at the forge in Shattrath, but it will do.
text.completed: Return to Miall at Fort Wrynn in Talador.

english.title: Iridium Recovery
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Iridium Dust from Iridium Geodes in Kuuro's Claim.
english.description: Ared used to always teach me that the purity of the metal is key. If the metal isn't pure it will crack under stress and be of no use to anyone.$b$bFor the artillery tower to function I'll need to make metal as pure as my master would, and for that I need a strong flux.$b$bThe dust from crushed iridium geodes would work in a pinch, but we need to find some first. They tend to congregate underground, so check out the mine in Kuuro's Claim nearby.
english.progress: I'm going to need a lot of iridium dust to purify the metal to anywhere near my masters standards.
english.completion: This won't be as good as some of the stuff we had back at the forge in Shattrath, but it will do.
english.completed: Return to Miall at Fort Wrynn in Talador.

text.title: 第三步：先知！
text.objectives: 在影月谷坠毁的钢铁部落舰船附近与先知维伦谈一谈。
text.description: 你已经抵达影月谷。是时候找先知谈谈了。
text.completion: <The prophet welcomes you with a curious look, then a warm nod.>$b$bSo it begins.
text.completed: Speak with Prophet Velen in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Step Three: Prophet!
english.objectives: Speak with Prophet Velen near the crashed Iron Horde Ship in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description: You have arrived in Shadowmoon Valley. It is time to speak with the prophet.
english.completion: <The prophet welcomes you with a curious look, then a warm nod.>$b$bSo it begins.
english.completed: Speak with Prophet Velen in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 找回铱金
text.objectives: 从库洛的领地的铱金晶簇上采集$1oa份铱金之尘。
text.description: 我的商品原本只提供给最出色的人，现在钢铁部落却用劣质金属做出复制品，还分发给所有人。$b$b我会在你的军械库里让他们瞧瞧正牌铁匠的手艺，但首先，我需要用一种强力熔剂来提纯金属，使其达到纯度极限。$b$b铱金晶簇碎块上的粉尘勉强可用，不过我们得先找到才行。它们通常会聚合在地下，所以到附近库洛的领地的矿井里找找看吧。
text.progress: I'm going to need a lot of iridium dust to purify the metal to anywhere near my standards.
text.completion: This won't be as good as some of the mixes we had back in the Blackrock foundries, but it will do.
text.completed: Speak to Morketh Bladehowl at Vol'jin's Pride in Talador.

english.title: Iridium Recovery
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Iridium Dust from Iridium Geodes in Kuuro's Claim.
english.description: My goods used to be for the very best, now the Iron Horde make copies out of poor metal and give them to everyone.$b$bI'm going to show them what a real smith can do in your arsenal, but first I'm going to need a powerful flux to make the metal as pure as it can get.$b$bThe dust from crushed iridium geodes would work in a pinch but we need to find some first. They tend to congregate underground, so check out the mine in Kuuro's Claim nearby.
english.progress: But to clean the metal by my standards, I need a lot of iridium dust.
english.completion: In the forges of the Black Mountain clan, we had better materials, but that will do too.
english.completed: Speak to Morketh Bladehowl at Vol'jin's Pride in Talador.

text.title: 熔炼木铁
text.objectives: 从库洛的领地里取得12块木铁矿石。
text.description: 若要打造像样的装备，必须要用到最上等的金属，在东边库洛的领地的矿井里有一种木铁矿石，就在上等金属之列。为了补给军械库，我需要用到这种金属。$b$b可惜那里近来被一群鬣蜥人占领了，所以你必须一路杀进去取得矿石，赶在鬣蜥人把它们吃掉前得手。$b$b应该没什么能给你造成真正的麻烦，$g先生:女士;。
text.progress: We need to get that ore before those damned goren eat it all.
text.completion: Good size chunks and without a lot of the matrix material on them.$B$BThese will do just fine.
text.completed: Return to Morketh Bladehowl at Vol'jin's Pride in Talador.

english.title: Out of Jovite
english.objectives: Obtain 12 chunks of Jovite Ore from within Kuuro's Claim.
english.description: Crafting good equipment requires the best metal and some of the best metal is the jovite that comes from the mine in Kuuro's Claim, just east of here. In order to supply the arsenal I'm going to need this metal.$b$bUnfortunately the place was recently overwhelmed by a pack of goren so you're going to have to fight your way in to get the ore before they manage to devour it.$b$bNothing that should be too much of a problem for you, $g sir:ma'am;.
english.progress: Нам надо добыть эту руду, пока проклятые горены не сожрали ее.
english.completion: Здоровые куски, и в них почти нет пустой породы.$b$bТо, что нужно.
english.completed: Return to Morketh Bladehowl at Vol'jin's Pride in Talador.

text.title: 前往戈杜尼
text.objectives: 前往古尔达要塞，并与米阿尔会面。
text.description: 我们现在有充足的木铁了，可矿井里的储备也支撑不了我们的炮塔太久。在南边有座山，满山都是这种材料，但有一个问题——食人魔！$b$b戈杜尼食人魔就住在山顶上，而且他们已经开始把木铁卖给钢铁部落了。$b$b我们得到那里去，把矿石夺过来。$b$b我会打包一些补给品，然后到南边他们的要塞附近与你会合。
text.completion: I crafted a few things before we left that we may need: some smoke grenades, a grappling hook, even was able to get Thaelin to throw together a rocket pack.$b$bI'm sure we'll find a use for everything.

english.title: Going to the Gordunni
english.objectives: Travel to Gordal Fortress and meet up with Miall.
english.description: We have a good supply of jovite now but there just isn't enough of the material in the mine to keep the artillery tower in stock for long. Down south of here there's a mountain that's just full of the stuff but there's one problem; Ogres!$b$bThe Gordunni live on top of that mountain and they have begun trading the jovite to the Iron Horde.$b$bWe need to go down there and secure the minerals for ourselves.$b$bI'll pack some supplies and meet you near their fortress down south.
english.completion: I crafted a few things before we left that we may need: some smoke grenades, a grappling hook, even was able to get Thaelin to throw together a rocket pack.$b$bI'm sure we'll find a use for everything.

text.title: 油老虎
text.objectives: 从库洛的领地的亮喉切割者和亮喉吞噬者身上取得$1oa份鬣蜥人气体样本。
text.description: $g先生:女士;，为了给你的军械库打造最优质的装备，我不仅要用到最上等的材料，还要使用最好的技术才行。$b$b多年来我已经发明了一种大大强化金属的方法，但却要用到一种奇特的材料：鬣蜥人肠气！$b$b在库洛的领地附近的矿井里正好有这种怪物作乱。眼下它们还在那里吞吃死者身上的金属和矿石。你能不能去为军械库补给品找几份样本来？消灭几个鬣蜥人，然后用这个抽气机吸一下它们的尸体就行。
text.completion: Thank you boss, this is just what I needed.$B$BBy the way, Goren gas is rather difficult to come by. We should probably hold off on clearing those guys out till we can stockpile enough.$B$BJust a thought.
text.completed: Return to Morketh Bladehowl at Vol'jin's Holdfast in Talador.

english.title: Gas Guzzlers
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa samples of Goren Gas from Glowgullet Shardshedders and Glowgullet Devourers within Kuuro's Claim.
english.description: $g Sir:Ma'am;, to make the best equipment for your arsenal I need not only the best materials, but to use the best techniques.$b$bOver the years I've developed a method to greatly strengthen my metal, but it does require an exotic resource: goren gut gas!$b$bThe nearby mine at Kuuro's Claim just came down with an infestation of the things. Could you collect a few samples for the arsenal supplies? Just kill a few goren and give their bodies a good prod with this gas extractor.
english.completion: Спасибо, босс, это именно то, что нужно.$b$bКстати... Газ горенов довольно трудно добывать. Возможно, не стоит вырезать этих тварей подчистую до тех пор, пока мы не сможем хранить его в достаточных количествах.$b$bЭто просто так, мысли вслух.
english.completed: Return to Morketh Bladehowl at Vol'jin's Holdfast in Talador.

text.title: 找到落脚点
text.objectives: 跟随先知维伦。
text.description: 那么，就是你把我的孩子们带回家的？我一直在等着你呢。$b$b钢铁部落的力量每一天都在壮大。$b$b我已经预见到了一场大战，可我的视野被遮蔽住了。好像时间静止了下来。$b$b可以肯定的是，你的到来具有重大意义。
text.completion: This will have to do.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Maraad at Lunarfall in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Finding a Foothold
english.objectives: Follow Prophet Velen.
english.description: So, you are the one that has led my children home? I have been waiting for you.$b$bThe Iron Horde grows stronger every day.$b$bI have foreseen a great battle, but my visions are clouded. It's as if time is sitting on top of itself. $b$bOne thing is certain, your presence here is of great importance.
english.completion: This will have to do.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Maraad at Lunarfall in Shadowmoon Valley.

objectiveDetails.description: 陪同先知维伦抵达坠落之月

text.title: 为了联盟！
text.objectives: 插下联盟旗帜。
text.description: 要不是有你的力量，我们根本无法活着逃出塔纳安，$n。许多德莱尼和联盟成员都对你无比感激。$B$B在我们动身前往黑暗之门前，乌瑞恩国王亲自下令，让我将你任命为我们在德拉诺的行动总指挥。在亲眼见识过你的战斗风采后，我非常认同他的决定。$B$B这就是你的要塞所在地。把旗帜插上，我们就会立刻开始建造了，指挥官。
text.completion: So this is Draenor? A bit darker than expected. Still, after building Stormwind, this project should be a walk in the park.$B$BWell then, are you ready to begin, commander?
text.completed: Speak with Baros Alexston at Lunarfall in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: For the Alliance!
english.objectives: Plant the Alliance banner.
english.description: We wouldn't have survived Tanaan without your strength, $n. Many draenei and Alliance alike owe you a great debt.$B$BBefore we departed for the Dark Portal, King Wrynn personally recommended that I place you in charge of our operations here in Draenor. After seeing you in action, I'm inclined to agree.$B$BThis is your garrison to found. Plant the banner and we'll begin construction immediately, commander.
english.completion: So this is Draenor? A bit darker than expected. Still, after building Stormwind, this project should be a walk in the park.$B$BWell then, are you ready to begin, commander?
english.completed: Speak with Baros Alexston at Lunarfall in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 寻找木材
text.objectives: 标记$1oa棵树木。
text.description: 这附近有些树看上去长得十分矮小，工人们应该能轻松砍伐。$b$b我们可以把体力活留给雪莉的工人们去做，但要是你愿意的话，可以帮他们标记出要砍的树木，那样一来就可以大大加快工作进程了。
text.completion: Perfect.$b$bNot only will this lumber do the job, it will look fantastic!
text.completed: Return to Baros Alexston at the Shadowmoon Ruins in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Looking for Lumber
english.objectives: Mark $1oa trees.
english.description: Some of the trees around here look small enough that the workers should be able to down them in no time.$b$bWe can leave the hard labor to Shelly's men, but if you'd be willing to mark the trees for them to start with, we should be able to get this operation rolling much faster.
english.completion: Perfect.$b$bNot only will this lumber do the job, it will look fantastic!
english.completed: Return to Baros Alexston at the Shadowmoon Ruins in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 震拳
text.objectives: 消灭震拳。
text.description: 我不断收到林中出现了巨兽的报告。$b$b有几位卡拉波护卫跟着它进了一个洞穴。坦白讲，我觉得我们的士兵肯定都不愿意去与那猛兽交战。$b$b也许你可以去调查一下？护卫们肯定会感谢你的帮助。
text.completion: The base is significantly more secure with that giant dead.$b$bYou have made quite an impression on the peacekeepers.
text.completed: Return to Yrel at Lunarfall in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Quakefist
english.objectives: Kill Quakefist.
english.description: I'm getting reports of a giant in the forest.$b$bA few of the Karabor peacekeepers have followed it to a cave. In all honesty I don't think any of our troops are willing to engage the beast.$b$bMaybe you could investigate? I'm sure the peacekeepers would appreciate the help.
english.completion: The base is significantly more secure with that giant dead.$b$bYou have made quite an impression on the peacekeepers.
english.completed: Return to Yrel at Lunarfall in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 建立你的要塞
text.objectives: 建造你的要塞。
text.description: 你在这么短的时间之内就召集到了这些人，真是令人刮目相看啊，指挥官。$b$b我想是时候在我们的基地周围盖起围墙，巩固周边防御了。
text.completion: The garrison is really starting to take shape.
text.completed: Speak with Baros Alexston at your Garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Establish Your Garrison
english.objectives: Build your garrison.
english.description: I'm impressed with how quickly you have pulled this group together, commander.$b$bI think it's time we start putting up some walls and establishing a firm perimeter around our base.
english.completion: The garrison is really starting to take shape.
english.completed: Speak with Baros Alexston at your Garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

objectiveDetails.description: 与巴隆斯交谈以建造你的要塞

text.title: 建造你的兵营
text.objectives: 找到并学习图纸，然后使用建筑设计桌来建造你的兵营。
text.description: 指挥官，我必须说的是，这座要塞真的已经初具规模了。$b$b我们有了足够多的材料，现在只需要找到我起草的图纸，我就能开始为你建造兵营了。$b$b嗯……我把那些图纸放哪了来着？
text.completion: How is the construction of the barracks coming along?
text.completed: Speak with Vindicator Maraad at your Garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Build Your Barracks
english.objectives: Find the blueprints, learn the blueprints, and use the Architect Table to build your barracks.
english.description: I must say, commander, this garrison has really come along.$b$bWe have enough materials, all we need now are the blueprints I drafted up and I can begin construction on your barracks.$b$bHmm... now where did I put those blueprints?
english.completion: How is the construction of the barracks coming along?
english.completed: Speak with Vindicator Maraad at your Garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: The Bounty of Bladespire
text.objectives: Speak with Gazlowe at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge
text.description: The sacking of this fortress is as much your victory as ours. It is only fair you should share in the bounty.$b$bI will have resources set aside as we find them. All you need do is report to your garrison and have them dispatch peons to collect these materials.
text.completed: Speak with Gazlowe at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge

english.title: The Bounty of Bladespire
english.objectives: Speak with Gazlowe at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge
english.description: The sacking of this fortress is as much your victory as ours. It is only fair you should share in the bounty.$b$bI will have resources set aside as we find them. All you need do is report to your garrison and have them dispatch peons to collect these materials.
english.completed: Speak with Gazlowe at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge

text.title: 麻烦的小戈隆
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa只霜火小戈隆。
text.description:
要是附近有小戈隆作乱，帮你建造要塞的难度就太大了。

我想这里没有别人能解决掉那些大块头的怪兽了，所以你恐怕得亲自上阵才行。
text.completion: Nasty beasts they got here on Draenor.
text.completed: Return to Gazlowe at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge

english.title: A Gronnling Problem
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Frostfire Gronnlings.
english.description:
It's gonna be quite a task to build you a fortress if there's gronnlings rampaging around.

I don't think anyone else here can handle taking those big beasts out, so you might need to take care of it yourself.
english.completion: Nasty beasts they got here on Draenor.
english.completed: Return to Gazlowe at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge

text.title: 获得食人魔进攻命令书
text.objectives: 在马尔高克岗哨收集库尔戈洛什的命令和索尔高克的命令。
text.description: 我的姐妹米拉娜正在绝壁上方侦察，而我则负责巡查地势较低的区域。我发现有两位特别的食人魔法师在底下发号施令。$b$b他们似乎随身携带着某些文书或卷轴，也许能帮我们分析出究竟发生了什么事。$b$b去收集情报，然后到上方的长阶梯上去见我的姐妹。
text.progress: Those orders would be really useful in piecing this whole thing together.
text.completion: Glad you are here. I almost got killed up there at the top. Oh what are these papers? This is much worse than I imagined!
text.completed: Take the orders to Rangari Mirana at Mar'gok's Overwatch in Nagrand.

english.title: Obtaining Ogre Offensive Orders
english.objectives: Collect Crulgorosh's Orders and Thulgork's Orders at Mar'gok's Overwatch.
english.description: My sister, Mirana, is scouting the upper bluff while I've checked out the lower area. There are two particular ogre mages that do a lot of bossing around in the lower area.$b$bThey seem to have some orders or scrolls on them that would help us figure out what's really going on.$b$bCollect that information and meet with my sister on the long stairway up there.
english.progress: Эти приказы очень помогут составить полную картину происходящего.
english.completion: Glad you are here. I almost got killed up there at the top. Oh what are these papers? This is much worse than I imagined!
english.completed: Take the orders to Rangari Mirana at Mar'gok's Overwatch in Nagrand.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到库尔戈洛什的命令

text.title: 瑞拉克的研究
text.objectives: 阻止大法师瑞拉克。
text.description: 这些食人魔一直在用古老的泰坦圣物给一小撮被他们称作破魔者的特殊单位灌注能量。大法师瑞拉克正在这里研究改进流程的方法。$B$B让我们中断他在峭壁上进行的仪式吧。
text.completion: That Felbreaker sounded tough! Good thing there's only a small number of them.$B$BNice job stopping Reglakk, but I'm sure he's safely back in Highmaul. The ogre capital will have to be dealt with sooner rather than later.
text.completed: Return to Rangari D'kaan at Telaari Station in Nagrand.

english.title: Reglakk's Research
english.objectives: Stop Grand Magister Reglakk.
english.description: These ogres have been using ancient Titan artifacts to empower a small cadre of specialized units called the Breakers. This Magister Reglakk is here studying ways to improve the process.$B$BLet's put a stop to whatever rituals he has going up on the bluff.
english.completion: That Felbreaker sounded tough! Good thing there's only a small number of them.$B$BNice job stopping Reglakk, but I'm sure he's safely back in Highmaul. The ogre capital will have to be dealt with sooner rather than later.
english.completed: Return to Rangari D'kaan at Telaari Station in Nagrand.

text.title: 销毁文献记录
text.objectives: 在马尔高克岗哨摧毁$1oa个食人魔研究盒。
text.description: 这个盒子里满是书页和图表，似乎都跟针对废除魔法所做的研究有关。$b$b最好把找到的所有研究文献全部销毁掉，让这些努力付之东流。
text.completion: Excellent job thinking on your feet.  The less research these ogres do, the better!
text.completed: Speak with Rangari Mirana at Mar'gok's Overwatch in Nagrand.

english.title: Removing the Paper Trail
english.objectives: Destroy $1oa Boxes of Ogre Research at Mar'gok's Overwatch.
english.description: This box is filled with writings and diagrams that oddly resemble research into the nullification of magic.$b$bIt would be best to ruin these efforts by destroying any research found.
english.completion: Excellent job thinking on your feet.  The less research these ogres do, the better!
english.completed: Speak with Rangari Mirana at Mar'gok's Overwatch in Nagrand.

text.title: 失踪的车队
text.objectives: 找到丢失的商队货物。
text.description: 我遇到了麻烦，而你看起来正好是能够胜任这项任务的$r！$b$b有一批贸易物资原本应该昨天到的，结果却不知所踪了。我这里货物短缺，需要有人去帮我查明究竟发生了什么事！$b$b要是让我猜的话，我想可能跟虎人脱不了干系。自打我们来到这里，那些畜生就一直令我们感到如芒在背！$b$b到刃牙之喉附近的路上寻找货车，动作要快！时间就是金钱！
text.completion: <Greezlex lifts his head to look up at you from the ground.>$b$b...No! Don't take me... I... wait...$b$bYou aren't a saberon... did Pyxni send you?$b$b

english.title: The Missing Caravan
english.objectives: Find the missing trade shipment.
english.description: I've got a problem and you look like you're just the $r for the job!$b$bA trade shipment was supposed to arrive yesterday, but it's nowhere to be found. I'm running low on merchandise here and I need somebody to go find out what happened!$b$bIf I were to guess, I'd say the saberon are probably involved. Those brutes have been a pain in our side ever since we got here!$b$bSearch for the wagon on the road near Sabermaw and hurry! Time is money!
english.completion: <Greezlex lifts his head to look up at you from the ground.>$b$b...No! Don't take me... I... wait...$b$bYou aren't a saberon... did Pyxni send you?$b$b

text.title: 制造墨水
text.objectives: 从赞加拉的孢子蝠和真菌巨人身上收集$1oa个脉动的脓包。
text.description: 我们得给你的法师塔制造一个人造枢纽。$B$B我知道去哪能找到导管，但它周围守卫森严。我们必须沉着冷静，用正确的办法去实现。$B$B我有个计划——需要用到群体传送卷轴。$B$B在下方的真菌巨人和蹒跚者身上长着充满油性物质的脓包。我们可以利用那种油来制作出临时的墨水替代品来书写卷轴。
text.progress: The giants are harder to take down, but they will yield more pustules!
text.completion: This isn't quite what they taught me in Dalaran, but it'll have to do!
text.completed: Return to Magister Serena in Khadgar's Tower.

english.title: Creating the Ink
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Pulsating Pustules from Sporebats and Fungal Giants in Zangarra.
english.description: We need a way to create an artificial nexus at your tower.$B$BI know where we can get the conduit to do that, but it's well-guarded. We need to keep our cool and do this the right way.$B$BI have a plan - a scroll of mass teleportation.$B$BThe fungal giants and shamblers down below are covered with pustules full of an oily substance. We can use the oil to craft a makeshift ink substitute for the scroll.
english.progress: Giants are more difficult to fill up, but there are more ulcers on them!
english.completion: Это не совсем то, чему нас учили в Даларане, но все равно должно сработать!
english.completed: Return to Magister Serena in Khadgar's Tower.

text.description: This lump of iron is bitterly cold. Morketh back at the armory might be able to find a use for it.
text.completed: Bring the Frost Iron Ingot to Morketh at the armory in Talador.

text.title: 制造卷轴
text.objectives: 从赞加拉休眠的古树上收集$1oa块树皮。
text.description: 我们需要用奥术羊皮纸来制造卷轴。$B$B在这个枢纽周围的奥术能量把古树困在了原地，能量还进到了树皮里面。$B$B如果我们能从还没被真菌生物毁掉的那几棵古树上取下一些树皮，我就能把他们做成羊皮纸。
text.completion: Yes, these will work great! I can freeze the pulp into a fine parchment.
text.completed: Return to Magister Serena in Khadgar's Tower.

english.title: Forming the Scroll
english.objectives: Rip $1oa Pieces of Bark off of Slumbering Ancients in Zangarra.
english.description: We'll need arcane parchment to make the scroll.$B$BThe arcane energy everywhere at this nexus froze the ancients in place and settled in their bark.$B$BIf we take pieces from the few that haven't been destroyed by the fungal creatures, I can mold them into parchment.
english.completion: Yes, this is just what you need! An excellent parchment comes out of this bark.
english.completed: Return to Magister Serena in Khadgar's Tower.

text.title: 贪婪的渡鸦
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa只坠月渡鸦。
text.description: 你看见没？刚刚有一只巨大的渡鸦飞过树冠了。$b$b我到不了那么高的地方。事实上，我都不知道我们当中有没有装备精良的成员能够应对那样的威胁。$b$b你想亲自去处理这个麻烦吗，指挥官？$b$b等解决掉那些渡鸦之后，我们就可以开始把更多军队派进林地了。那么我们究竟是一石二鸟好呢……还是用什么来个五鸟齐毙……$b$b<巴隆斯一时想不起应该用什么词来形容，挠了挠头。>$b$b你懂我的意思。
text.completion: This place is just full of surprises... terrifying surprises.
text.completed: Return to Baros Alexston at Lunarfall in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Ravenous Ravens
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Lunarfall Ravens.
english.description: Do you see that? There is a gigantic raven just past the tree line.$b$bI'm not getting anywhere near that. In fact, I'm not sure any of the men are sufficiently equipped to deal with a threat like that. $b$bDo you want to handle this one yourself, commander?$b$bOnce those ravens are gone we can start sending more troops into the woods. So we will be killing two birds with one stone... or should I say kill five birds with...$b$b<Confused by his own analogy, Baros scratches his head.>$b$bYou get the point.
english.completion: This place is just full of surprises... terrifying surprises.
english.completed: Return to Baros Alexston at Lunarfall in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 收集火花
text.objectives: 在赞加拉收集$1oa个奥术漩涡。
text.description: 我们需要奥术能量来完成卷轴。那样才能把卷轴拼合起来。$B$B我有一件神器，能够捕捉下方火山口中的能量漩涡，我们赶快行动吧。
text.completion: Perfect! We should have plenty of energy now.
text.completed: Return to Magister Serena in Khadgar's Tower.

english.title: Gathering the Spark
english.objectives: Harvest $1oa Arcane Vortexes in Zangarra.
english.description: We need arcane energy to complete our scroll. It needs that to coalesce the scroll together.$B$BI have an artifact that can capture energy vortexes in the caldera below, so let's get moving.
english.completion: Прекрасно! Теперь у нас достаточно энергии!
english.completed: Return to Magister Serena in Khadgar's Tower.

text.title: <UNUSED>
text.objectives: Find Master Smith Ared at the Quarry in Talador.
text.description: [PH] Now that we have the armory built we're going to need some skilled hands to run it.$bI've heard that the great smith Ared managed to survive Shattraths fall and he should be living nearby in the old quarry. See if you can convince him to work for us.
text.completed: Speak to Apprentice Miall at the Quarry in Talador.

english.objectives: Find Master Smith Ared at the Quarry in Talador.
english.description: [PH] Now that we have the armory built we're going to need some skilled hands to run it.$bI've heard that the great smith Ared managed to survive Shattraths fall and he should be living nearby in the old quarry. See if you can convince him to work for us.
english.completed: Speak to Apprentice Miall at the Quarry in Talador.

text.title: 油老虎
text.objectives: 从库洛的领地的亮喉切割者和亮喉吞噬者身上取得$1oa份鬣蜥人气体样本。
text.description: 为了完成我师傅的设计，并为炮塔做储备工作，我们需要用到一种奇特的材料，名叫鬣蜥人肠气。$b$b在附近库洛的领地的矿井里正好有这种怪物作乱。眼下它们还在那里吞吃死者身上的金属和矿石。你能不能去给我找几份样本来？那玩意儿浓度极强，所以有几份就足够了。干掉一个之后，用这个抽气机吸一下它们的尸体就行。
text.completion: Thank you, this is just what I needed.$b$bGoren gas is rather difficult to come by but thankfully we can make this supply go a long way.
text.completed: Return to Miall at Fort Wrynn in Talador.

english.title: Gas Guzzlers
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa samples of Goren Gas from Glowgullet Shardshedders and Glowgullet Devourers within Kuuro's Claim.
english.description: To complete my master's designs and to stock up the artillery tower we need to use an exotic resource, namely goren gut gas.$b$bThe nearby mine at Kuuro's Claim just came down with an infestation of the things. Could you collect a few samples for me? The stuff is concentrated, so only a few are needed. Just kill one and give its body a good prod with this gas extractor.
english.completion: Thank you, this is just what I needed.$b$bGoren gas is rather difficult to come by but thankfully we can make this supply go a long way.
english.completed: Return to Miall at Fort Wrynn in Talador.

text.title: 拜见大魔法师
text.objectives: 在塔拉多与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
text.description: 我很高兴地向你报告，你的奥秘圣殿已经建成并开始工作了，指挥官。$B$B一切都和图纸上画的别无二致……除了巴隆斯写在下方的这句注释。“别忘了把圣殿和能量线网连接起来！”$B$B指挥官，我只是个工头，不是法师。我……我完全不知道该怎样做。$B$B我们在不远处找到了大法师卡德加和其他一些肯瑞托成员。就在东边，靠近山的地方。也许我们应该请他们帮帮忙？
text.completion: Ah, so you've built an Arcane Sanctum! Splendid!$B$BTroubles connecting to the ley line network, I take it?

english.title: An Audience With The Archmage
english.objectives: Speak to Archmage Khadgar in Talador.
english.description: I'm pleased to report that your Arcane Sanctum is up and running, commander!$B$BEverything is exactly as the blueprint says... except for this note Baros scrawled on the bottom. "Don't forget to connect the sanctum to the ley line network!"$B$BCommander, I'm a foreman, not a mage. I... have absolutely no idea how to do that.$B$BWe've found Archmage Khadgar and some other Kirin Tor not far from here. To the east, near the mountains. Perhaps we should ask them for a hand?
english.completion: Oh, so you built a magical sanctuary! That's great! $B$BI take it you've had trouble connecting it to the power line network?

text.title: 拜见大魔法师
text.objectives: 在塔拉多与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
text.description: 你的奥秘圣殿建造得很顺利，指挥官。$B$B一切都符合规格……除了加兹鲁维在图纸下方标注的一个细节，“别忘了把圣殿和能量线网连接起来！”$B$B我，呃……我不知道该怎么做。$B$B抱歉，指挥官，但法术不是我的长项。我们在不远处发现了大法师卡德加和一些肯瑞托成员。就在东边，靠近山的地方。$B$B也许我们应该请他们帮帮忙？
text.completion: Ah, so you've built an Arcane Sanctum! Splendid!$B$BTroubles connecting to the ley line network, I take it?

english.title: An Audience With The Archmage
english.objectives: Speak to Archmage Khadgar in Talador.
english.description: Your Arcane Sanctum is coming along nicely, commander.$B$BEverything's built to spec... except for one detail Gazlowe scrawled in at the bottom of the blueprint. "Don't forget to connect the sanctum to the ley line network!"$B$BI, uh... I have no idea how to do that.$B$BI'm sorry commander, but magic just isn't my thing. We did spot Archmage Khadgar and some Kirin Tor not far from here. To the east, up near the mountains.$B$BMaybe we should ask them for help?
english.completion: Ah, so you've built an Arcane Sanctum! Splendid!$B$BTroubles connecting to the ley line network, I take it?

text.title: 制造墨水
text.objectives: 从赞加拉的孢子蝠和真菌巨人身上收集$1oa个脉动的脓包。
text.description: 我们得想办法在你的法师塔里创建一个人造枢纽。$B$B我知道该去哪找我们需要的东西，但它周围有重兵把守。凭我们的火力不足以跟他们在前门硬碰硬。$B$B我有个计划——需要用到群体传送卷轴。$B$B在下方的真菌巨人和孢子生物身上长着充满油性物质的脓包。如果能收集到足够的那种油，我就可以制作出临时的墨水替代品来书写卷轴。
text.progress: The giants have many more pustules than the sporebats, but are much tougher.
text.completion: These pustules are sizzling with energy. They'll do nicely.
text.completed: Return to Magister Krelas in Khadgar's Tower.

english.title: Creating the Ink
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Pulsating Pustules from Sporebats and Fungal Giants in Zangarra.
english.description: We're going to need a way to create an artificial nexus at your tower.$B$BI know where we can get what we need, but it's heavily protected. We don't have the firepower to just waltz in the front door.$B$BI have a plan - a scroll of mass teleportation.$B$BThe fungal giants and spore creatures down below are covered in pustules filled with an oily substance. If we gather enough of the oil I can craft a makeshift ink substitute for the scroll.
english.progress: The giants have many more pustules than the sporebats, but are much tougher.
english.completion: These pustules are sizzling with energy. They'll do nicely.
english.completed: Return to Magister Krelas in Khadgar's Tower.

text.title: 形成卷轴
text.objectives: 从赞加拉休眠的古树上收集$1oa块树皮。
text.description: 要想实现这个计划，我们需要灌能羊皮纸。$B$B这个枢纽的潜在奥术能量很快就将古树困在原地，能量还进入到了树皮之内。$B$B如果我们能从还没被真菌生物毁掉的那几棵古树上剥下点树皮来，我就能把它们做成羊皮纸。
text.completion: Such clean breaks on each piece! Fantastic.
text.completed: Return to Magister Krelas in Khadgar's Tower.

english.title: Forming the Scroll
english.objectives: Rip $1oa Pieces of Bark off of Slumbering Ancients in Zangarra.
english.description: For this plan to work, we'll need infused parchment.$B$BThe latent arcane energy at this nexus quickly froze the ancients in place and settled in their bark.$B$BIf we rip off strips from the few that haven't been destroyed by the fungal creatures, I can form them into parchment.
english.completion: Such clean breaks on each piece! Fantastic.
english.completed: Return to Magister Krelas in Khadgar's Tower.

text.title: 收集火花
text.objectives: 在赞加拉收集$1oa个奥术漩涡。
text.description: 我们得找到奥术能量来完成卷轴。这是最关键的一步。$B$B我手上的装置可以捕捉到下方空间中的能量，所以我们赶快行动吧。那些灌能生物对我们两个来说应该构不成威胁。
text.completion: Excellent. This ought to be just what we need.
text.completed: Return to Magister Krelas in Khadgar's Tower.

english.title: Gathering the Spark
english.objectives: Harvest $1oa Arcane Vortexes in Zangarra.
english.description: We need to get our hands on arcane energy to complete our scroll. It needs that fiery kick.$B$BI have a device capable of capturing energy in the space below, so let's get moving. The infused creatures shouldn't be an issue for the two of us.
english.completion: Excellent. This ought to be just what we need.
english.completed: Return to Magister Krelas in Khadgar's Tower.

text.title: 奇娅娜·月影
text.objectives: 与奇娅娜·月影谈一谈。
text.description: 如果我们想要打赢这场战争，光有步兵是不够的。还需要勇士。$b$b奇娅娜·月影在塔纳安丛林和日暮港的表现令人印象深刻。$b$b也许你应该去找她谈谈，希望她能在对抗钢铁部落的战斗中扮演更为重要的角色。
text.completion: Luuka is a little shaken up, but he is safe, and that's all that really matters.$B$BLook... commander, I owe you my life. All of us do honestly.$B$BI would be honored to serve as your agent here in Draenor. If you have need of me, you need only say the word.
text.completed: Speak with Qiana Moonshadow at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Qiana Moonshadow
english.objectives: Speak with Qiana Moonshadow.
english.description: If we are to win this war we are going to need more than foot soldiers. We need champions.$b$bQiana Moonshadow's performance in Tanaan and Eventide Landing was quite impressive.$b$bPerhaps you should speak with her about taking on a greater role in the battle against the Iron Horde.
english.completion: Luuka is a little shaken up, but he is safe, and that's all that really matters.$B$BLook... commander, I owe you my life. All of us do honestly.$B$BI would be honored to serve as your agent here in Draenor. If you have need of me, you need only say the word.
english.completed: Speak with Qiana Moonshadow at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 逃亡的鸦人
text.objectives: 与阿兰卡峰林的阿兹克谈一谈。
text.description:
我想你一定很熟悉鸦人吧，指挥官？鸦人是会飞的鸟人，身形巨大。极具领地意识。

然而，有些鸦人的翅膀萎缩了——或许是患上了某种疾病。他们似乎是被赶出了鸦人社会。你有时候会看见他们蹲在被遗忘的遗迹间，或是在路边叫卖饰品。

看来钢铁部落进驻鸦人领地的举动刺激到了他们，那些被放逐者纷纷离开了。

$B$B我们应该与这些被放逐者建立联系——他们手上可能会有宝贵的情报。
text.completion: <The arakkoa merchant looks you up and down.>$B$BWell-equipped, aren't we? Azik is betting you are someone of importance to your people.$B$BCome closer, friend. Speak with me for just a moment.
text.completed: 与阿兰卡峰林的阿兹克谈一谈。

english.title: Arakkoa Exodus
english.objectives: Speak with Azik in Spires of Arak.
english.description:
I assume you're familiar with the arakkoa, commander? Great, flying birdfolk. Extremely territorial.

Some, however, have withered wings - a disease, maybe. They seem to be outcast from arakkoa society. You find them now and then, squatting in forgotten ruins or peddling trinkets on the roadside.

It seems the Iron Horde has incited the arakkoa by moving into their lands, and the outcasts are fleeing in droves.

We should make contact with these outcasts - they could have valuable information.
english.completion: <The arakkoa merchant looks you up and down.>$B$BWell-equipped, aren't we? Azik is betting you are someone of importance to your people.$B$BCome closer, friend. Speak with me for just a moment.
english.completed: Speak with Azik in Spires of Arak.

text.title: Tracking Flag: Dagg Found at Daggermaw Ravine

english.title: Tracking Flag: Dagg Found at Daggermaw Ravine

text.title: 斯克提斯的暗影
text.objectives: 到斯克提斯向瑞沙德说出密语。
text.description: 我的族人陆陆续续地离开故乡。我出售护符来缓解他们旅途的疲累。$B$B可看来你对这些并不感兴趣……不，你是来寻找答案的。$B$B斯克提斯就在前面。那曾经是一座伟大的城市，是泰罗克为那些不受欢迎的人建造的避难所。现在却沦为了荒废的贫民窟。$B$B那里住着一位年老的说故事的人——名叫瑞沙德的藏卷人。找到他后，记得这么跟他说：“暗影蔽日……”他会明白你是他的朋友。$B$B赶快出发吧。你站在这妨碍我做生意了。
text.completion: Azik must have seen something in you. I will trust his judgment, for n-$B$B<Reshad is interrupted as a warm gust of wind surges through the hut.>$B$BOh dear... they've arrived.
text.completed: Speak with Reshad in Skettis.

english.title: The Shadows of Skettis
english.objectives: Speak the password to Reshad in Skettis.
english.description: My people flee our homeland in droves. I sell trinkets to ease the journey.$B$BBut I see that you are not interested in trinkets... No, what you seek are answers.$B$BSkettis lies just ahead. Once a great city built by Terokk as a refuge for the unwanted. Now a ruined slum.$B$BAn old storyteller lives there - a scrollkeeper named Reshad. Find him and speak these words: "Shadows gather." He will know you are a friend.$B$BNow go. Your presence is bad for business.
english.completion: Azik must have seen something in you. I will trust his judgment, for n-$B$B<Reshad is interrupted as a warm gust of wind surges through the hut.>$B$BOh dear... they've arrived.
english.completed: Speak with Reshad in Skettis.

text.title: 光天化日之下的秘密
text.objectives: 找回风化的翼刃和损坏的面具。
text.description: <瑞沙德开始匆匆忙忙地将卷轴塞进他的长袍里。>$B$B我本以为会有充足的准备时间！在斯克提斯各处藏着一些强大的遗物——要是我丢下它们离开，我可能也会死的。$B$B第一件是前门附近某个雕像手中握着的两把翼刃。你在进来的路上可能跟它们擦肩而过了。$B$B在废墟东边有另一座雕像，它脸上戴着一张白色的面具。$B$B把这两件遗物带来交给我，我就会为你揭开它们的秘密。
text.progress: Wingblades forged in the name of a sun god to bring freedom and glory to her children.$B$BA mask worn by a great king who would walk among his people in disguise to know their true nature.
text.completion: Who would expect to find these treasures draped over straw dolls, left to bake in the sun? Sometimes the best place to hide precious things is in plain sight.
text.completed: Return to Reshad in Skettis.

english.title: Hidden in Plain Sight
english.objectives: Retrieve the Weathered Wingblades and Ragged Mask.
english.description: <Reshad begins hastily stuffing scrolls into his robes.>$B$BI thought I would have more time to prepare! There are powerful relics hidden out there in Skettis - if I leave without them, I may as well have died.$B$BThe first is a pair of wingblades being held by an effigy near the front gate. You likely walked right past them on your way in.$B$BAnother effigy on the east side of the ruins bears a white mask over its face.$B$BBring those relics to me, and their secrets shall be yours.
english.progress: Клинки, изготовленные в честь богини солнца, должны были принести свободу и славу ее детям.$B$BА маску носил великий король, тайно наблюдавший за своими подданными, чтобы познать их истинные мысли.
english.completion: Who would expect to find these treasures draped over straw dolls, left to bake in the sun? Sometimes the best place to hide precious things is in plain sight.
english.completed: Return to Reshad in Skettis.

text.title: 太阳神的信徒
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa名信徒刀翼战士。
text.description: 通天峰的所有鸦人都在鲁克玛信徒的统治之下。他们恣意辱骂我们当中受到塞泰诅咒的人，并下令必须以太阳神之名净化我们。$B$B很快他们就会把目光投向阿兰卡以外的土地。$B$B去向他们的战士发起挑战。为我争取逃离的时间吧，和我一起让他们覆灭。
text.completion: Azik was right to guide you to me. If you were coming to help Skettis, we needed to meet.$B$BAnd if you were coming to attack us, well, I'd be dead either way, wouldn't I?$B$B<Reshad lets out a cawing laugh and stuffs another scroll into his robes.>$B$BThere, that's nearly everything.
text.completed: Return to Reshad in Skettis.

english.title: Adherents of the Sun God
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Adherent Bladewings.
english.description: The arakkoa from Skyreach are all ruled by the Adherents of Rukhmar. They revile those of us who bear the Curse of Sethe, and decree that we must be purged in the name of their sun god.$B$BSoon their gaze will turn to lands beyond Arak.$B$BChallenge their warriors. Buy me time to prepare my escape, and help me set into motion their downfall.
english.completion: Azik was right to guide you to me. If you were coming to help Skettis, we needed to meet.$B$BAnd if you were coming to attack us, well, I'd be dead either way, wouldn't I?$B$B<Reshad lets out a cawing laugh and stuffs another scroll into his robes.>$B$BThere, that's nearly everything.
english.completed: Return to Reshad in Skettis.

text.title: 高等鸦人首领
text.objectives: 从太阳贤者拉希克斯身上拾取信徒公告。
text.description: 鲁克玛的信徒们是高居尖塔顶端的统治阶级。他们有着绝对的影响力。他们的公告代表着鲁克玛本人的意志。$B$B领导此次净化行动的传令官肯定就是在执行这样的命令——他手上肯定有一份亟待肃清的人名与地名清单。$B$B在将来的日子里，那份清单会发挥无可估量的作用。把它给我找来，顺便让那位传令官闭嘴！
text.progress: <Reshad fastens another scroll to Percy, who squawks meekly in protest.>$B$BOh, stop whining.
text.completion: Ah yes, there's my name at the top of the list. And a few Talonpriests from the Shadowglade as well.$B$BThey fear the return of Terokk, as they should.
text.completed: Bring the Adherent Proclamation to Reshad outside of Skettis.

english.title: Orders From On High
english.objectives: Loot the Adherent Proclamation from Sun-Sage Rathyx.
english.description: The Adherents of Rukhmar are the ruling body atop the spires. Their influence is absolute. Their proclamations taken as the will of Rukhmar Herself.$B$BThe herald leading this purge is surely carrying out such orders - likely no more than a list of names and places they plan to erase.$B$BThat list would prove invaluable in the days to come. Acquire it for me, and shut that herald up!
english.progress: <Reshad hooks another scroll to Percy, and he tweeted in protest.>$B$BDon't be a noose.
english.completion: Ah yes, there's my name at the top of the list. And a few Talonpriests from the Shadowglade as well.$B$BThey fear the return of Terokk, as they should.
english.completed: Bring the Adherent Proclamation to Reshad outside of Skettis.

text.title: 长者
text.objectives: 在乌鸦小屋把密语说给奥耐卡听。
text.description: 你还记得我们的问候语吗，$p？$B$B“暗影蔽日，渡鸦吞天。”$B$B那不仅是一句古老的诗文——还是行动的召唤。老派的追随者们正在集结，而我必须加入他们。我想他们也需要你。$B$B沿着这条路前往乌鸦小屋。你会找到某个老太婆的家。用你跟我打招呼的方式去问候她，然后她会为你指明方向的。$B$B尽管你看不见我，可我就跟在你身后。
text.completion: I will point you in the right direction, but I cannot guarantee you'll survive the trip.$B$BKah-hah haha!
text.completed: Speak with Ornekka at Crow's Crook.

english.title: The Crone
english.objectives: Speak the password to Ornekka at Crow's Crook.
english.description: Do you remember our greeting, $p?$B$B"Shadows gather when the raven swallows the day."$B$BIt is more than an old verse - it is a call to action. Followers of the old ways are gathering, and I must join them. You are needed, too, I should think$B$BFollow this road down to Crow's Crook. There you will find the home of an old crone. Greet her as you greeted me, and she will guide the way.$B$BYou will not see me, but I will be close behind.
english.completion: I will point you in the right direction, but I cannot guarantee you'll survive the trip.$B$BKah-hah haha!
english.completed: Speak with Ornekka at Crow's Crook.

text.title: The Drudgeboat
text.objectives: Bring the Drudgeboat Schedule to Khadgar.
text.description: [TEMP]<The torn scroll outlines the schedule of several upcoming Frostwolf prisoner arrivals.>$b$b<It appears that they are being shipped in by boat. This could be your method of escape. Khadgar will want to see this.>
text.completed: Return to Khadgar at Kargathar Proving Grounds in Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: The Drudgeboat
english.objectives: Bring the Drudgeboat Schedule to Khadgar.
english.description: [TEMP]<The torn scroll outlines the schedule of several upcoming Frostwolf prisoner arrivals.>$b$b<It appears that they are being shipped in by boat. This could be your method of escape. Khadgar will want to see this.>
english.completed: Return to Khadgar at Kargathar Proving Grounds in Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 试炼竞技场：碾槌
text.objectives: 在试炼竞技场里击败碾槌。
text.description: 这么说，你是想进试炼竞技场试试身手是吧？真是不知死活啊，小家伙！$b$b你的第一个对手是块头无比巨大的狂怒食人魔——碾槌。还不止这样，你还必须干掉他身穿盔甲的野猪同伴，碾槌每次都会带它一起走进竞技场！$b$b我真心希望你已经把后事料理好了，因为碾槌的上一个对手是被装在运尸袋里送回家的……$b$b我看好你！快滚进竞技场，跟我的助手古祖克谈谈，开始战斗吧！
text.completion: Whoa! I couldn't tell if that was Porkchop squealing in there or if you had Crushmaul crying like a little baby!$b$bYou've got talent, kid!$b$bHere's your cut of the profit, but why stop there? Together we can make a mountain of gold!
text.completed: Return to Dexyl Deadblade.
text.giverWindow: 你的第一个对手是碾槌！

english.title: Ring of Trials: Crushmaul
english.objectives: Defeat Crushmaul in the Ring of Trials.
english.description: So you want to fight in the Ring of Trials do you? It's your funeral, bub!$b$bYour first fight is against an exceptionally large and angry ogre named Crushmaul. That's not all though, you'll have to take out his armored boar companion too; Crushmaul never goes into the ring without him!$b$bI hope your affairs are in order, because the last gladiator that fought Crushmaul went home in a body bag...$b$bI'm counting on you! Get your ass inside the arena and speak with my associate Guzrug to start the fight!
english.completion: Whoa! I couldn't tell if that was Porkchop squealing in there or if you had Crushmaul crying like a little baby!$b$bYou've got talent, kid!$b$bHere's your cut of the profit, but why stop there? Together we can make a mountain of gold!
english.completed: Return to Dexyl Deadblade.
english.giverWindow: Your first match is against Crushmaul!

objectiveDetails.description: 与古祖克交谈来开始战斗

text.title: 试炼竞技场：犁爪
text.objectives: 在试炼竞技场里击败犁爪。
text.description: 别看你击败了碾槌，可庆祝仪式已经结束了……还有一场对决在等着你！$b$b悬槌部族把决斗这件事看得很严肃，所以他们修建了试炼竞技场，到处搜罗最凶残的生物！$b$b你即将面对的是被那些食人魔叫做犁爪的恐怖巨鸦！我告诉你，$n，那只大鸟有些不对劲……我想它是真把杀戮当成乐事了！$b$b犁爪在吃掉上一个角斗士前，把它抓住玩了好几个小时。$b$b尽量活下来吧！
text.completion: You did it, $n! Raketalon has actually been defeated!$b$bI'd never have believed it if I hadn't seen it with my very own two eyes. You've got a fire in your belly and dollar signs in your eyes, kid!$b$bHere's your cut of the profit, but don't stop now! You're on a roll!
text.completed: Return to Dexyl Deadblade.
text.giverWindow: 不被犁爪吃掉的秘诀，就是避开它的鸟喙！

english.title: Ring of Trials: Raketalon
english.objectives: Defeat Raketalon in the Ring of Trials.
english.description: You may have defeated Crushmaul, but the party's over now...you've got another fight!$b$bThe Highmaul take gladiatin' seriously; so when they built the Ring of Trials, they searched far and wide for the most brutal creatures they could find!$b$bYou're up against a dread raven the ogres are calling Raketalon! I'm telling you, $n, something about that bird just ain't right...I think it truly enjoys the act of killing!$b$bRaketalon toyed with the last gladiator for hours before eating him.$b$bTry not to die!
english.completion: You did it, $n! Raketalon has actually been defeated!$b$bI'd never have believed it if I hadn't seen it with my very own two eyes. You've got a fire in your belly and dollar signs in your eyes, kid!$b$bHere's your cut of the profit, but don't stop now! You're on a roll!
english.completed: Return to Dexyl Deadblade.
english.giverWindow: The key to not being eaten by Raketalon is to avoid the beak!

objectiveDetails.description: 与古祖克交谈来开始战斗

text.title: 试炼竞技场：霍亚拉
text.objectives: 在试炼竞技场里击败霍亚拉。
text.description: 你打赢了头两场对决，但接下来的挑战更难应付！$b$b你的下一个对手是霍亚拉——曾经的游侠，与其他游侠一样有着狂热的斗志。$b$b不，也不一样……霍亚拉简直就是疯子！$b$b多年前，在执行侦察任务时，他凭借一己之力把整支游侠战队从一群铁颚狼的嘴里救了下来。可他从此以后就变得不正常了……$b$b没过多久，霍亚拉就彻底发了狂，转而对付起了他自己的兄弟们！$b$b好了，废话到此为止！进去大战一场吧！
text.completion: Watching you fight in the arena is like witnessing an artist create a masterpiece!$b$bWell, a masterpiece of blood and shattered bones... but hey, everyone's got to be good at something right?$b$bHere's your cut of the profit! That fight was so good I actually thought about giving you a bonus!
text.completed: Return to Dexyl Deadblade.
text.giverWindow: 曾是精英游侠组织的成员，他的攻击带有致命的精准性。

english.title: Ring of Trials: Hol'yelaa
english.objectives: Defeat Hol'yelaa in the Ring of Trials.
english.description: You won your first two fights, but it's only going to get tougher from here!$b$bYour next fight is against Hol'yelaa, a former rangari who is as crazy as they come.$b$bNo, really... Hol'yelaa is bonkers!$b$bYears ago, while on a scouting mission, he single handedly saved his entire rangari unit from a pack of Garn. But something inside of him snapped....$b$bIt wasn't long before Hol'yelaa went completely marbles and turned on his own unit!$b$bAlright, the pep talk is over! Get in there and kick some ass!
english.completion: Watching you fight in the arena is like witnessing an artist create a masterpiece!$b$bWell, a masterpiece of blood and shattered bones... but hey, everyone's got to be good at something right?$b$bHere's your cut of the profit! That fight was so good I actually thought about giving you a bonus!
english.completed: Return to Dexyl Deadblade.
english.giverWindow: A former member of the elite rangari, he attacks with deadly precision.

objectiveDetails.description: 与古祖克交谈来开始战斗

text.title: 试炼竞技场：爆火上尉
text.objectives: 在试炼竞技场里击败爆火上尉。
text.description: 你在竞技场里的表现已经让自己声名鹊起了，$n！$b$b不过别太兴奋了……名声也会惹来麻烦！有一位想要扬名的角斗新秀向你发起了挑战，听起来很熟悉是吧？$b$b你的下一个对手是爆火上尉，他是为钢铁部落战斗的雇佣兵。$b$b钢铁部落可不是随便撒钱的大方人，所以他跑来这赚外快了！$b$b他随身携带切割机，千万要小心机器的刀片……还有烈火……尤其是烈火！
text.completion: I ain't ever seen anybody dismantle a shredder quite like that before!$b$bYou've made me a lot of money, $n! Only the best gladiators survive this long in the arena; and yet, even with that in mind, there's still something different about you...$b$bIt's your eyes...they look as if they've stared death in the face a thousand times and never even blinked.$b$bTake your cut of the profit and rest up, the biggest fight is still ahead!
text.completed: Return to Dexyl Deadblade.
text.giverWindow: 击败爆火上尉和他的武装切割机！

english.title: Ring of Trials: Captain Boomspark
english.objectives: Defeat Captain Boomspark in the Ring of Trials.
english.description: You've been making a name for yourself in the arena, $n!$b$bDon't get too excited though...fame has its consequences! You've been challenged by an up-and-coming gladiator who is looking to make a name for himself, sound familiar?$b$bYour next fight is against Captain Boomspark, a mercenary who came here to fight for the Iron Horde.$b$bThe Iron Horde ain't exactly throwing piles of gold around, so now he's here!$b$bHe's got a shredder, so watch out for the blades... and the fire too... especially the fire!
english.completion: I ain't ever seen anybody dismantle a shredder quite like that before!$b$bYou've made me a lot of money, $n! Only the best gladiators survive this long in the arena; and yet, even with that in mind, there's still something different about you...$b$bIt's your eyes...they look as if they've stared death in the face a thousand times and never even blinked.$b$bTake your cut of the profit and rest up, the biggest fight is still ahead!
english.completed: Return to Dexyl Deadblade.
english.giverWindow: Defeat Captain Boomspark and his weaponized shredder!

objectiveDetails.description: 与古祖克交谈来开始战斗

text.title: 试炼竞技场：狂热者罗卡
text.objectives: 在试炼竞技场里击败罗卡。
text.description: 最后一场对决马上开始了，$n！你击败了所有最优秀的挑战者！现在距离巅峰只有一步之遥……下一个对手是试炼竞技场的守关擂主！$b$b当前的擂主是一位名叫狂热者罗卡的鸦人。罗卡是个疯子！他说他正在为烈日还是什么的进行一场神圣远征。$b$b不管是不是疯子，他都是我所见过最危险的角斗士之一，他甚至在悬槌竞技场里亮过相！$b$b我不骗你，你很可能会战死……祝你好运！
text.completion: Long live the champ! I knew you could do it!$b$bCould you hear the roar of the crowd in there? It shook the arena like thunder!$b$bThis is only the beginning! The Highmaul Coliseum awaits, and as the champion of the Ring of Trials you'll be expected to make an appearance!
text.completed: Return to Dexyl Deadblade.
text.giverWindow: 试炼竞技场的卫冕冠军，也是首屈一指的致命角斗士！

english.title: Ring of Trials: Roakk the Zealot
english.objectives: Defeat Roakk in the Ring of Trials.
english.description: The final match is at hand, $n! You've decimated all of the best challengers! There's nowhere to go from here but the very top...the reigning champion of the Ring of Trials!$b$bThe current champ is an arakkoa named Roakk the Zealot. Roakk is a lunatic! He says he's on some divine crusade for the sun or something.$b$bCrazy or not, he's one of the most dangerous fighters I've ever seen and has even fought in the Highmaul Coliseum!$b$bI'm not going to lie, you're probably going to die in there...good luck!
english.completion: Long live the champ! I knew you could do it!$b$bCould you hear the roar of the crowd in there? It shook the arena like thunder!$b$bThis is only the beginning! The Highmaul Coliseum awaits, and as the champion of the Ring of Trials you'll be expected to make an appearance!
english.completed: Return to Dexyl Deadblade.
english.giverWindow: The reigning champion of the Ring of Trials, and one of the deadliest combatants the arena has ever seen!

objectiveDetails.description: 与古祖克交谈来开始战斗

text.title: Professional Processing
text.objectives: Learn a Profession Building Blueprint from Gazlowe and then have Rezlak begin construction of the building.
text.description: Hey boss! We got ourselves quite a lot of raw materials ripe for some professional processing... if you know what I mean. Time to get us a building that can help put those materials to good, weaponizing use.$b$bI got a few extra plans we might be able to use to get you started, but you gotta' pick which one to make. Once you choose, talk to Rezlak and get construction started on it.
text.completed: Speak with Gazlowe at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge

english.objectives: Learn a Profession Building Blueprint from Gazlowe and then have Rezlak begin construction of the building.
english.description: Hey boss! We got ourselves quite a lot of raw materials ripe for some professional processing... if you know what I mean. Once you choose, talk to Rezlak and get construction started on it.
