text.title: 阿库麦尔的崛起
text.objectives: 消灭吞噬者阿库麦尔
text.description: 我们好不容易逃离了暮光之锤的祭坛，可其他人还在这些洞穴深处等待救援。要是这些邪教徒完成了他们的鲜血仪式，就会把吞噬者阿库麦尔放进这个世界。你必须阻止这一切的发生。
text.completion: That was incredible, $n! The Old Gods will think twice before trying to crawl out of their pit again.
text.completed: Return to Sentinel Aluwyn.
text.giverWindow: 小心阿库麦尔的头。

english.title: The Rise of Aku'mai
english.objectives: Kill Aku'mai the Devourer
english.description: We barely escaped the Twilight's Hammer sacrificial altar, but there are others who need help deeper within these caves. If these cultists complete their blood ritual, they will unleash Aku'mai the Devourer onto the world. You cannot let this happen.
english.completion: $n, that was something! The ancient gods will now think twice whether it's worth trying to get out of their holes again.
english.completed: Return to Sentinel Aluwyn.
english.giverWindow: Beware the heads of Aku'mai.

text.title: 阿库麦尔的崛起
text.objectives: 消灭吞噬者阿库麦尔
text.description: 我们好不容易逃离了暮光之锤的祭坛，可其他人还在里面等待救援。要是鲜血仪式完成的话，他们就会放出吞噬者阿库麦尔。你必须阻止这一切的发生，伙计。
text.completion: Dat was amazin', $n! De Old Gods be thinkin' twice before tryin' to take anudder bite outta you, mon.
text.completed: Return to Zeya.
text.giverWindow: 小心阿库麦尔的头。

english.title: The Rise of Aku'mai
english.objectives: Kill Aku'mai the Devourer
english.description: We barely escaped de Twilight's Hammer sacrificial altar, but others be needin' help deeper in. If de blood ritual be complete, they be unleashin' Aku'mai da Devourer. Don let this be happenin', mon.
english.completion: Dat was amazin', $n! De Old Gods be thinkin' twice before tryin' to take anudder bite outta you, mon.
english.completed: Return to Zeya.
english.giverWindow: Beware the heads of Aku'mai.

text.title: 纳格兰的战火
text.objectives: 与纳格兰车队的巴弗尔中尉谈一谈。
text.description:
**指挥官$n亲启**

鉴于塔拉游侠基地已经陷落，守备官伊瑞尔建议我们在纳格兰建立一处新据点。

我自作主张地派出了一些我们的人和补给品。游侠达坎报告称，一所新哨站已接近完工。他表示他们已经准备好迎接你的大驾光临了。

我已经为你准备好了一只狮鹫，等你准备好了就可以随时出发，它会把你送到驮满最新物资的车队那里，$g先生:女士;。

——军情七处伯德里克·格雷
text.completion: They came at us... from... nowhere.$B$B<The lieutenant nearly passes out.>

english.title: Taking the Fight to Nagrand
english.objectives: Speak with Lieutenant Balfor at the caravan in Nagrand.
english.description:
**Eyes Only -- Commander $n**

With the fall of the rangari base at Telaar, Vindicator Yrel, recommended we establish a new foothold in Nagrand.

I've taken the liberty of dispatching some of our men and supplies. Rangari D'kaan's already reporting that a new outpost is nearly complete. He has indicated that they are ready to receive you.

A gryphon is waiting to catch you up with the latest caravan shipment whenever you're ready, $g sir:ma'am;.

-- Bodrick Grey, SI:7
english.completion: They came at us... from... nowhere.$B$B<The lieutenant nearly passes out.>

text.title: 战歌氏族的力量
text.objectives: 在塔拉岗哨与游侠达坎谈一谈。
text.description: <军官承受着巨大的痛苦。他显然不久于世了。>$B$B战歌氏族发起了突然袭击。$B$B往西边……跑了。$B$B<他歇了一会继续说道。>$B$B他们带走了……图纸……$B$B<这些就是他的遗言。>
text.completion: Commander $n. It's good to see you. We have much to discuss.$B$BThe situation in Nagrand is rapidly deteriorating. We've lost Telaar.$B$BTo make matters worse, Grommash has named Garrosh Hellscream the new warlord of the Warsong clan.

english.title: The Might of the Warsong
english.objectives: Speak with Rangari D'kaan at Telaari Station.
english.description: <The officer is in a great deal of pain. It's clear that he's not long for this world.>$B$BThe Warsong. Surprise attack.$B$BHeaded... west.$B$B<He takes a moment, before continuing.>$B$BThey took the... blueprints....$B$B<These are his last words.>
english.completion: Commander $n. It's good to see you. We have much to discuss.$B$BThe situation in Nagrand is rapidly deteriorating. We've lost Telaar.$B$BTo make matters worse, Grommash has named Garrosh Hellscream the new warlord of the Warsong clan.

text.title: 关键路线
text.objectives: 与杜加尔·朗德瑞克谈一谈，飞往塔拉多。
text.description: 塔拉多的褐色森林正处于这片大陆上的重要战略位置，指挥官。钢铁部落的舰队已经从戈尔隆德启程，前往位于西岸的沙塔斯了。$B$B要是我们不赶去增援，塔拉多必将陷落。我自作主张地派出了监工艾克索斯，他已经开始在钢铁部落的登陆点附近为你的军队建造哨站了。他在等待你的命令，长官。
text.completion: I won't waste any of your time, $Gsir:madame;. Let us discuss strategy.

english.title: The Critical Path
english.objectives: Speak to Dungar Longdrink to secure a flight to Talador.
english.description: The auburn forests of Talador sit at a critical crossroads of this continent, commander. The Iron Horde's fleet is already en route from Gorgrond to Shattrath on the west coast.$B$BTalador will fall if we don't reinforce them. I took the liberty of dispatching Foreman Eksos, who has already begun construction on an outpost for your forces not far from the Iron Horde landing point. He awaits your orders sir.
english.completion: I won't waste any of your time, $Gsir:madame;. Let us discuss strategy.

text.title: 修理直升机
text.objectives: 找到杂乱的工程学零件、支撑转子和传动飞轮。
text.description: 战歌氏族重创了我们。我们失去了塔拉，可却获得了攻打战歌要害的良机。$B$B我们需要你的智慧和领导力来实现这一目标，$n。$B$B但首先，我们得把幸存者们送出塔拉。我的游侠已经准备好出击了。他们现在就等你了。$B$B塞林有架直升机，可以送你过去。可惜他光修理那该死的玩意儿就已经忙不过来了。$B$B你去帮他找找零件，修好直升机怎么样？
text.progress: $n, I can't tell you how great it is to see you.
text.completion: For me? Really you shouldn't have.$B$BOkay, this should do it.$B$BI hope.
text.completed: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil at Telaari Station.

english.title: Up and Running
english.objectives: Collect the Assorted Engineering Parts, Prop Rotor, and Transmission Flywheel.
english.description: The Warsong struck us hard. We lost Telaar, but we have a rare opportunity to strike at the heart of the Warsong.$B$BWe need your wisdom and leadership to pull it off, $n.$B$BFirst though, we're going to get our survivors out of Telaar. My rangari are ready to strike. We just need to get you to them.$B$BThaelin has a copter that can get you to them. Unfortunately, his hands are full just trying to keep the infernal thing running.$B$BHelp him get it up and running?
english.progress: $n, я даже не могу передать, как я рад тебя видеть.
english.completion: For me? Really you shouldn't have.$B$BOkay, this should do it.$B$BI hope.
english.completed: Speak with Thaelin Darkanvil at Telaari Station.

text.title: 策略问题
text.objectives: 与布罗恩·天角谈一谈，飞往塔拉多。
text.description: 钢铁部落用行动证明自己是强大的对手。$B$B他们设法把舰队从戈尔隆德转移到了塔拉多，而我的探子们居然毫无察觉。塔拉多位于整个大陆的十字路口。我们决不能让他们夺取它。$B$B别担心，头儿，我们有计划了。就在我们说话间，工头格罗巴什正在为我们的军队建造哨站。等你抵达时应该已经准备好了，指挥官。
text.completion: Your will be done. I require your advisement, commander.

english.title: It's a Matter of Strategy
english.objectives: Speak to Bron Skyhorn to secure a flight to Talador.
english.description: Da Iron Horde have proved themselves worthy foes.$B$BThey managed to get their fleet movin' to Talador from Gorgrond without my spies seein' a thing. Talador be a crossroads for the whole continent. We can't let them have it.$B$BDon't worry boss, we got a plan. Foreman Grobash be settin' up an outpost for our forces as we speak. They be ready for you when you arrive, commander.
english.completion: Your will be done. I require your advisement, commander.

text.title: 行动：奇袭小队
text.objectives: 使用塞林的直升机前往游侠侦察点。
text.description: 在战歌的攻击中幸存下来的人不多。少数几位侥幸逃脱的游侠都跑到俯瞰塔拉的一座断崖上去了。$B$B那些游侠在等着你。他们计划发起突然反击。$B$B我的直升机也是在那时遭到了重创。自动驾驶仪会带你飞过去的。我想这是她的最后一次飞行了。$B$B或许是吧。
text.completion: We've been expecting you, commander.$B$BThe situation is grim, but doable with your help.
text.completed: Speak with Rangari Ogir at the Rangari Overlook.

english.title: Operation: Surprise Party
english.objectives: Use Thaelin's Copter to get up to the Rangari Overlook.
english.description: There weren't many survivors of the Warsong attack. The few remaining rangari have gone up to one of the bluffs overlooking Telaar.$B$BThe rangari are waiting for you. They're planning a surprise counter-attack.$B$BMy copter's taken a beating. The auto-pilot's set to take you up there. I think she's got one last trip in her.$B$BMaybe.
english.completion: We've been expecting you, commander.$B$BThe situation is grim, but doable with your help.
english.completed: Speak with Rangari Ogir at the Rangari Overlook.

text.title: 抢先一步
text.objectives: 在塔拉多与杜隆坦谈一谈。
text.description: 头儿，杜隆坦带着德拉卡和加兹鲁维去追踪钢铁部落沿海岸的行动踪迹了。$B$B他们此刻正在西北边的悬崖上等着你。
text.completion: Ah, $n. I recognized your scent, friend. We have been waiting for your arrival to begin our task.

english.title: One Step Ahead
english.objectives: Speak to Durotan in Talador.
english.description: Boss, Durotan set off with Draka and Gazlowe to track da Iron Horde's movements along da coast.$B$BDey waitin' for ya on the cliffs to da northwest.
english.completion: Ah, $n. I recognized your scent, friend. We have been waiting for your arrival to begin our task.

text.title: One Step Ahead
text.objectives: Speak to Vindicator Maraad in Talador.
text.description: Commander, Vindicator Maraad took Yrel and Thaelin Darkanvil just up to the road from here to track the Iron Horde's forces in the forest.$B$BThey are already at work formulating a strategy to stop their operations. They await your arrival on the cliffs to the northwest.

english.title: One Step Ahead
english.objectives: Speak to Vindicator Maraad in Talador.
english.description: Commander, Vindicator Maraad took Yrel and Thaelin Darkanvil just up to the road from here to track the Iron Horde's forces in the forest.$B$BThey are already at work formulating a strategy to stop their operations. They await your arrival on the cliffs to the northwest.

text.title: 硝烟升腾
text.objectives: 在塔拉多的阿鲁纳附近找到塑晶者巴伦。
text.description: 阿鲁纳在燃烧。$B$B鸦人们从峰林上俯冲而下，把一切都烧成灰烬。德莱尼、塔布羊，甚至是兽人，就连效忠也打动不了他们。这些鸦人只想看着整个世界熊熊燃烧。$B$B我侥幸逃脱，捡回了一条命，可我最好的朋友巴伦却留在后面寻找他的女儿。别人都说你是一位伟大的勇士。拜托，当我求求你，去阿鲁纳找到他们吧。
text.completion: Kalaam sent you? By the Light, I knew I could count on him!

english.title: As the Smoke Rises
english.objectives: Find Crystal-Shaper Barum near Aruuna in Talador.
english.description: Aruuna burns.$B$BThe arakkoa swooped down from their spires and are turning everything to ash. Draenei, talbuk, even orc; they care not for allegiances. They merely want to watch the world burn.$B$BI barely escaped with my life, but my best friend, Barum, stayed behind to find his daughter. The others all say you are a great champion. Please, I beg of you, go to Aruuna and find them.
english.completion: Тебя прислал Калаам? Хвала Свету! Я знал, что могу на него рассчитывать!

text.title: This Too Shall Pass
text.objectives: Return to Foreman Eksos in Talador.
text.description: We have lost our homes before, and we persevered. So shall we persevere now.$B$BThank you for everything, $n. Melani is safe, and that is all I need to push forward.$B$BYou should return to your outpost. Surely much remains to be done.

english.description: We have lost our homes before, and we persevered. So shall we persevere now.$B$BThank you for everything, $n. Melani is safe, and that is all I need to push forward.$B$BYou should return to your outpost. Surely much remains to be done.

text.title: In Due Time
text.objectives: Return to Foreman Eksos in Talador.
text.description: We are leaving this place.$B$BThere are whispers of a powerful leader among us who has emerged with a plan to overthrow the Adherents. A once great hero who, like all of us, was discarded by the cruel society atop the spires.$B$BAt his behest, the shadows are gathering beneath the Spires of Arak.$B$BWe will find you when we are ready for you to aid our cause. For now, return to your people.

english.title: In Due Time
english.objectives: Return to Foreman Eksos in Talador.
english.description: We are leaving this place.$B$BThere are whispers of a powerful leader among us who has emerged with a plan to overthrow the Adherents. A once great hero who, like all of us, was discarded by the cruel society atop the spires.$B$BAt his behest, the shadows are gathering beneath the Spires of Arak.$B$BWe will find you when we are ready for you to aid our cause. For now, return to your people.

text.title: Just the Beginning
text.objectives: Speak to Yrel in Talador.
text.description: It... is over.$B$BWe should return to your outpost and discuss our next course of action. There are innocent people in danger across all of Talador that need our help.$B$BI will have Khadgar open a portal for us. Let us save our words for now.

english.title: Just the Beginning
english.objectives: Speak to Yrel in Talador.
english.description: It... is over.$B$BWe should return to your outpost and discuss our next course of action. There are innocent people in danger across all of Talador that need our help.$B$BI will have Khadgar open a portal for us. Let us save our words for now.

text.title: Just the Beginning
text.objectives: Speak to Durotan in Talador.
text.description: I forgive Orgrim. He acted as well all must - we do what our hearts tell us is right.$B$BWe should return to your outpost and discuss our next course of action. There is nothing left for us here.$B$BI will ask the human to open a portal for us. We shall speak again there.

english.objectives: Speak to Durotan in Talador.
english.description: I forgive Orgrim. He acted as well all must - we do what our hearts tell us is right.$B$BWe should return to your outpost and discuss our next course of action. There is nothing left for us here.$B$BI will ask the human to open a portal for us. We shall speak again there.

text.title: 德拉诺任务分派
text.objectives: 用指挥台为奇娅娜·月影指派任务。
text.description: 在德拉诺有太多工作要做，我们不可能全部亲力亲为。得开始委派他人了。$b$b在坠星岗哨有一群暗夜精灵正在寻找勇士。$b$b奇娅娜正是执行这一任务的理想人选。
text.completion: This is a good start, but we will need more champions to deal with the trials that lay ahead.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Thorn at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Delegating on Draenor
english.objectives: Use the Command Table to send Qiana Moonshadow on a mission.
english.description: There is more work to do on Draenor than we can possibly handle by ourselves. We need to start delegating.$b$bA group of night elves need a champion at Starfall Outpost.$b$bQiana is a perfect fit for this mission.
english.completion: This is a good start, but we will need more champions to deal with the trials that lay ahead.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Thorn at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: [Deprecated] Profession Quest
text.objectives: Construct a profession building.
text.description: We have cleared out quite a bit of land, commander.$b$bWe should continue to fortify the garrison.$b$bSpeak with Baros again, he will help you construct your choice of profession buildings.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Maarad at your Garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

objectiveDetails.description: Acquire a Profession Building Blueprint from Baros

text.title: 光明女士
text.objectives: 在塔拉多的燃烧前线与女伯爵莉亚德琳谈一谈。
text.description: 你是$n对吧？这里的负责人？我是骑士领主德兰纳卢斯，愿意为你效劳。$B$B女伯爵莉亚德琳对出现在奥金顿附近的可疑恶魔活动作出了回应，位置就在西南边。她明确提出要你帮忙确保不让奥金顿落入古尔丹的魔爪之中。$B$B如果你能尽快动身的话，我相信女伯爵肯定会感激不尽的。
text.completion: We'll have to catch up later. We have bigger problems!

english.title: The Lady of Light
english.objectives: Speak to Lady Liadrin at the Burning Front in Talador.
english.description: $n, yes? You are the one in charge here? I am Knight-Lord Dranarus, at your service.$B$BLady Liadrin has responded to a suspected demon presence near Auchindoun, southwest of here. She has asked specifically for your assistance in ensuring Auchindoun does not fall into Gul'dan's hands.$B$BIf you could set forth at your nearest convenience, I am sure the Lady would be most grateful.
english.completion: We'll have to catch up later. We have bigger problems!

text.title: 传奇再现
text.objectives: 在戈尔隆德的石槌竞技场附近找到卡什德拉克。
text.description: 如果你的军队想要学会与敌人交战，你就得给他们找来对手，最好实力过人！$b$b听说过卡什德拉克没？$b$b他是一位有名的大块头霜狼兽人战士，想要杀掉我们这些嘲颅成员。要不是被那些食人魔抓走的话，他应该也做到了。$b$b北边是石槌竞技场，食人魔把他跟其他大力的角斗士都带到那里去了。$b$b如果你能想办法救出他们的话，那这些人无疑会成为最称职的训练师。
text.completion: The Laughing Skull sent you? If they were any other clan I would find that ironic.$B$BI am Kash'drakor, hero of the Frostwolf clan, and champion of the slave pits of Stonemaul.$B$BAnd yet, despite all these titles, I need your help.
text.completed: 在戈尔隆德的石槌竞技场附近找到卡什德拉克。

english.title: A Rediscovered Legend
english.objectives: Find Kash'drakor near the Stonemaul Arena in Gorgrond.
english.description: If your troops are going to learn to fight people you better get people to fight! And they better be good.$b$bEver hear of Kash'drakor?$b$bHe's a big famous Frostwolf orc warrior type that tried to kill us Skulls. He would have won too, if the ogres hadn't snatched him.$b$bTo the north is the Stonemaul Arena where they took him and a bunch of other big bad mean fighter gladiators.$b$bIf you can find a way to free them, they could be the best trainers you could hope for.
english.completion: Тебя прислал орк из Веселого Черепа? Это было бы смешно, если бы на его месте был орк из любого другого клана.$b$bЯ – Кас'дракор, герой клана Северного Волка и лучший воин арены Каменного Молота.$b$bИ все же мне приходится просить тебя о помощи.
english.completed: Find Kash'drakor near the Stonemaul Arena in Gorgrond.

text.title: 奴隶猎手
text.objectives: 搜集波尔、卡拉戈和摩尔的吊坠。
text.description: 每当有角斗士逃离石槌奴隶营时，他们就会派出冷酷无情的奴隶猎手来抓我们。$b$b我自认为是一位骁勇的战士，在竞技场摸爬滚打多年的经验让我给自己下了这个结论。$b$b可这些奴隶猎手却用魔法将吊坠拴在了奴隶身上。有了这些吊坠，不管我们逃到哪里，都逃不出他们的手掌心，会在睡梦中或是防御松懈时惨遭他们的毒手。$b$b尽管我没资格叫你这么做，但能不能麻烦你到石槌奴隶营走一趟，把这些吊坠找来？
text.progress: Have you the pendants?
text.completion: You have shown more honor in this one act than I have seen in many years.$B$BWhen this is over, I will swear my axe to your forces and pass my knowledge on to your troops.
text.completed: Speak with Kash'drakor at the Stonemaul Arena in Gorgrond.

english.title: Slave Hunters
english.objectives: Collect the Pendants of Brol, Krag, and Mol.
english.description: Anytime a gladiator escapes Stonemaul, they send their hardened slave hunters after us.$b$bI consider myself a capable warrior, years of surviving in an arena have taught me that.$b$bBut these slave hunters keep pendants magically tethered to the slaves. With these pendants they can track us down anywhere we go, and kill us in our sleep or when our guard is down.$b$bI have no right to ask this, but can you enter Stonemaul and retrieve these pendants?
english.progress: Have you the pendants?
english.completion: Один твой поступок по чести своей превосходит все, что я видел за много лет.$b$bКогда мы закончим это дело, я принесу клятву верности твоим войскам и обучу их всему, что знаю сам.
english.completed: Speak with Kash'drakor at the Stonemaul Arena in Gorgrond.

text.title: 解救角斗士
text.objectives: 解救角斗士布鲁托、伊基什和角斗士瓦安达姆。
text.description: 当我们逃离石槌营地时，没来得及管其他人。$b$b要是我们回去救他们而且被认出来的话，食人魔就会看穿我们的意图，然后第一时间杀死我们的朋友们。$b$b幸好食人魔不认识你，这给了你奋力一搏的机会。$b$b进入石槌营地，找到其他的角斗士，帮他们摆脱桎梏吧。完成这个任务后，你将赢得我们的忠诚。
text.completion: Thank you, strange one. Now we are free to split that chieftain Kor'gall wide open!
text.completed: Speak with Bruto at Stonemaul Arena in Gorgrond.

english.title: Getting Gladiators
english.objectives: Rescue gladiators Bruto, Y'kish, and Pitfighter Vaandaam.
english.description: When we fled Stonemaul, we had to leave others behind.$b$bIf we try to rescue them and are recognized, the ogres will know our purpose, and the first thing they will do is kill our friends.$b$bThe ogres do not know you, which might give you a fighting chance.$b$bEnter Stonemaul, find the other gladiators, and release them from their bonds. Do this and you will have our loyalty.
english.completion: Спасибо тебе, $Gстранный воин:странная воительница;. Теперь-то мы можем разрубить вождя Кор'галла пополам!
english.completed: Speak with Bruto at Stonemaul Arena in Gorgrond.

text.title: 纳兹格雷尔
text.objectives: 救出纳兹格雷尔。
text.description: 逃离石槌地盘算不了什么。我的儿子还在那个统治深坑的食人魔渣滓手上。$b$b他们曾经用他来要挟我在竞技场中战斗。可现在我逃出来了，他们就会试着训练他来代替我。$b$b拜托了，去救救我的儿子。要是他们看见我，就会立刻杀死他的。
text.completion: This deed will never be forgotten as long as I or my son live. You have my gratitude, hero, and my loyalty.
text.completed: Speak with Kash'drakor at the Stonemaul Arena in Gorgrond.

english.title: Nazgrel
english.objectives: Rescue Nazgrel.
english.description: Escaping Stonemaul was the easy part. The ogre filth that rule the pits still have my son.$b$bFor a while they used him as leverage to ensure I would fight in their arenas. But now that I have escaped they will try to train him to replace me.$b$bPlease, rescue my son. If they see me they will kill him instantly.
english.completion: Пока я или мой сын живы, твое доброе дело не будет забыто. Я очень благодарен тебе, $gгерой:героиня;. У тебя теперь есть новый преданный друг.
english.completed: Speak with Kash'drakor at the Stonemaul Arena in Gorgrond.

text.title: 死者代言人
text.objectives: 在塔拉多的燃烧前线与大主教玛拉达尔谈一谈。
text.description: 噢，赞美圣光，你来了！大主教玛拉达尔让我一定要找到你。$B$B我们需要你的帮助。奥金顿遭到了恶魔的攻击！$B$B以最快的速度赶往西南边的燃烧前线！你是他信赖的为数不多的几个人之一，快去帮他领导防御力量。
text.completion: I will not allow a single demon to step foot inside Auchindoun. You will help me ensure that does not happen.

english.title: Speaker for the Dead
english.objectives: Speak to Exarch Maladaar at the Burning Front in Talador.
english.description: Oh, praise the Light, you're here! Exarch Maladaar asked for me to find you.$B$BWe need your help. Auchindoun is under attack by demons!$B$BGo to the Burning Front to the southwest as soon as possible! You're one of the few people he trusts to help lead the defense.
english.completion: I will not allow a single demon to step foot inside Auchindoun. You will help me ensure that does not happen.

text.title: 激怒对手
text.objectives: 在石槌竞技场里使用挑战之锣来击败奴隶主奥克默克。
text.description: 石槌氏族里有位酋长，还有个奴隶主。今天我们要把他们俩一起干掉。$b$b先来对付奴隶主奥克默克吧。我自小就在竞技场里战斗，所以我知道什么叫做残酷。奴隶主奥克默克就是残酷的代名词。$b$b想要成为一名真正的角斗士吗？到石槌竞技场去，敲响竞技场中央的那面锣，面对奴隶主放出的猛兽。$b$b要是你能把奥克默克惹得无比恼火，他也许就会跳下来亲自解决你。等他现身时，一定要先下手为强。
text.completion: Me watch you from afar. Me like your fighting skills, show much promise.
text.completed: Speak with Facebeater inside the Stonemaul Ogre Mound at Gorgrond.
text.giverWindow: 奴隶头子

english.title: Krav'ogra
english.objectives: Slay Slavemaster Ok'mok by using the Challenge Gong in Stonemaul Arena.
english.description: Stonemaul has chieftain, and it has slavemaster. Today, we kill both.$b$bFirst, Slavemaster Ok'mok. Me fight in arenas since me your size. Me know cruelty. Slavemaster Ok'mok is cruelty.$b$bWant to be true gladiator? Go to Stonemaul Arena, bang challenge gong in center of arena, and face beasts of slavemaster.$b$bMaybe you make Ok'mok so mad he jump down himself to kill you. If he do, kill him instead.
english.completion: Я смотреть за тобой издали. Ты хорошо драться. Из тебя выходить славный боец.
english.completed: Speak with Facebeater inside the Stonemaul Ogre Mound at Gorgrond.
english.giverWindow: Peddler of Flesh

objectiveDetails.description: 在石槌竞技场里消灭奴隶主奥克默克

text.title: 考戈尔的斧子
text.objectives: 消灭考戈尔，并取回他的战斧——塞拉希尔。
text.description: 复仇的时间到了！我们要消灭考戈尔，他的斧头则归你所有。$b$b冲破这道不堪一击的屏障，过桥继续往前走，直到你抵达酋长的宝座。$b$b是你给了我们自由，所以让他鲜血横流的首功是你的。你第一个动手，然后我们就会跟你一起将他开膛破肚。
text.progress: Kor'gall has ruled uncontested for far too long.
text.completion: This blade has caused enough pain and suffering for one lifetime. We shall see to it that it is properly disposed of.
text.completed: Speak with Gladiator Akaani near Stonemaul Arena in Gorgrond.
text.giverWindow: 石槌食人魔的残暴酋长

english.title: The Axe of Kor'gall
english.objectives: Kill Kor'gall and retrieve his axe, Serathil.
english.description: Time for vengeance! We are going to kill Kor'gall and you are going to take his axe.$b$bShatter this feeble barrier, follow the bridge beyond until you reach the chieftain's throne.$b$bYou freed us, so the honor of first blood is yours. Strike the first blow and we will join you in the cutting.
english.progress: Kor'gall has ruled uncontested for far too long.
english.completion: Этот топор за все время своего существования причинил достаточно боли и страданий. От него нужно избавиться.
english.completed: Speak with Gladiator Akaani near Stonemaul Arena in Gorgrond.
english.giverWindow: The cruel chieftain of Stonemaul

text.title: 传奇再现
text.objectives: 在戈尔隆德的石槌竞技场附近找到角斗士阿卡尼。
text.description: 这个格斗竞技场是个好的开始，但我们需要训练师来帮忙把你的士兵们打造成合格的战士。$b$b据报告称，有人在西边发现了一位德莱尼人，据描述和阿卡尼十分相似。$b$b这很有趣，因为我们所有人都以为她已经死了。她曾是德莱尼族中最出色的战士之一，几乎能够驾驭任何铸造或随手找到的武器。$b$b指挥官，她战技绝伦，请来做训练师再合适不过了。我建议你去把她找出来，如果真是她的话……
text.completion: You do not have the look of a Stonemaul bounty hunter.$B$BWe escaped the clutches of their vile arena but at a heavy cost. We were forced to leave too many allies behind and too many ogres breathing.$B$BWe could use a fresh face, one that is unknown to the ogres.
text.completed: 在戈尔隆德的石槌竞技场附近找到角斗士阿卡尼。

english.title: A Rediscovered Legend
english.objectives: Find Gladiator Akaani near Stonemaul Arena in Gorgrond.
english.description: This Sparring Arena is a good start, but we will need trainers to help mold your forces into worthy fighters.$b$bThere has been a reported spotting of a draenei to the west who matches the description of Akaani.$b$bThis is interesting, as we all believed her dead. She was one of the finest warriors the draenei have ever fielded and a master of nearly any weapon forged or found.$b$bCommander, you could not ask for a more skilled trainer. I advise seeking her out, if it is really her...
english.completion: Ты не $gпохож на охотника:похожа на охотницу; за головами из клана Каменного Молота.$b$bНам удалось вырваться из тисков их гнусной арены, но дорогой ценой. Позади осталось немало наших павших друзей – и слишком много живых огров.$b$bНам сейчас очень не помешает помощь новичка, чье лицо незнакомо ограм.
english.completed: Find Gladiator Akaani near Stonemaul Arena in Gorgrond.

text.title: 联合起来
text.objectives: 在沃金之傲与骑士领主德兰纳卢斯谈一谈。
text.description: 你在这里的工作已经完成了，$n。我会暂时留下帮忙消灭恶魔的残余势力。$B$B你应该返回你的哨站，让德兰纳卢斯知道我们成功了。他会把这个好消息传回艾泽拉斯的。
text.completion: Lady Liadrin was indeed wise in choosing you. I will let Vol'jin know of your victory immediately.

english.title: Come Together
english.objectives: Speak to Knight-Lord Dranarus at Vol'jin's Pride.
english.description: Your work is done here, $n. I will stay here for now and help clean up any remaining demons.$B$BYou should return to your outpost and let Dranarus know of our success. He can relay that information to Azeroth.
english.completion: Lady Liadrin was indeed wise in choosing you. I will let Vol'jin know of your victory immediately.

text.title: 联合起来
text.objectives: 在乌瑞恩堡与守备官伊西亚谈一谈。
text.description: 古尔丹和他的爪牙们一定会牢牢记住今天这个日子。我们奥金尼可不是好惹的。$B$B你应该回哨站把我们成功的好消息转达给守备官伊西亚。她会负责安排那些失散的难民和他们的家人。
text.completion: I will gather any remaining survivors so we can rebuild what we have lost.$B$BThank you.

english.title: Come Together
english.objectives: Speak to Vindicator Icia at Fort Wrynn.
english.description: Gul'dan and his cronies would do well to remember this day. We Auchenai are not to be trifled with.$B$BYou should inform Vindicator Icia in your outpost of our success. She can reach out to the scattered refugees and their families.
english.completion: I will gather any remaining survivors so we can rebuild what we have lost.$B$BThank you.

text.title: Vignette: Jehil the Climber
text.objectives: Destroy $1oa Goren Egg Clusters, $2oa Iceforge Ironchewers, and Broodmother Reeg'ak.
text.description: Goren are dangerous, especially in large numbers, and especially when we have a blind, under powered shaman with us.$b$bFortunately, they have very short lifespans. Unfortunately, they multiply fast and grow faster.$b$BIf we are going to do this we need to find the brood mother. Slaying her and her eggs should slow down the onslaught of goren. Check the burrows near the Forge Gates and I will to keep them off of Drek'Thar's scent.
text.completed: Return to Draka at the Forge Gates in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Vignette: Jehil the Climber
english.objectives: Destroy $1oa Goren Egg Clusters, $2oa Iceforge Ironchewers, and Broodmother Reeg'ak.
english.description: Goren are dangerous, especially in large numbers, and especially when we have a blind, under powered shaman with us.$b$bFortunately, they have very short lifespans. Unfortunately, they multiply fast and grow faster.$b$BIf we are going to do this we need to find the brood mother. Slaying her and her eggs should slow down the onslaught of goren. Check the burrows near the Forge Gates and I will to keep them off of Drek'Thar's scent.
english.completed: Return to Draka at the Forge Gates in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 人多力量大
text.objectives: 在塔拉多的尤鲁恩矿场与安吉拉谈一谈。
text.description: 西边的尤鲁恩矿场需要你的帮助！$B$B我的好朋友安吉拉派我来找帮手。大主教玛拉达尔把他可以调遣的守备官都派去了，但还是不够！$B$B你愿意去矿场帮帮我们吗？我们要用矿场里的水晶来强化防御，就跟你在燃烧前线上看到的水晶差不多。
text.completion: Aeun sent you? Help has arrived!

english.title: Every Bit Counts
english.objectives: Speak to Ageilaa at the Jorune Mine in Talador.
english.description: The Jorune Mine, west of here, needs your help!$B$BMy good friend Ageilaa sent me to look for help. Exarch Maladaar sent over what vindicators he could spare, but it isn't enough!$B$BWill you go to the mine and help us? We need the crystals from the mine to create more defenses like the crystals you see on the Burning Front.
english.completion: Aeun sent you? Help has arrived!

text.title: 人多力量大
text.objectives: 在塔拉多的尤鲁恩矿场与安吉拉谈一谈。
text.description: 曼杜尔·唤天者去尤鲁恩矿场执行某个敏感任务了，可他去了几个小时还没回来。$B$B我猜他肯定需要帮助。等你找到他，我会让他简单扼要地向你介绍下情况，但他很可能在矿场深处。$B$B你应该去向安吉拉报告，她是一位当地的德莱尼矿工，已经同意跟我们合作，条件是我们帮她重获矿场的控制权。
text.completion: Aeun sent you? Help has arrived!

english.title: Every Bit Counts
english.objectives: Speak to Ageilaa at the Jorune Mine in Talador.
english.description: Manduil Skycaller was sent on a sensitive mission to Jorune Mine, but he hasn't returned for hours.$B$BI suspect he requires assistance. I will let him brief you on the situation when you find him, but he is likely deep within the mine.$B$BYou should report to Ageilaa, a local draenei miner who has agreed to cooperate with us in exchange for helping her regain control of the mine.
english.completion: Aeun sent you? Help has arrived!

text.title: 庆祝的正当理由
text.objectives: 在乌瑞恩堡与魔导师赛琳娜谈一谈。
text.description: 我们要不要返回你的哨站？在那庆祝要好得多——也安全得多。$B$B我会把我们传送过去的。
text.completion: We can finally connect your tower to the ley line network with this crystal.$B$BI also edited your blueprint so you can actually read the thing. Should make building another one much easier.

english.title: Due Cause to Celebrate
english.objectives: Speak to Magister Serena at Fort Wrynn.
english.description: Shall we return to your outpost? It would be a much better - and safer - place to celebrate.$B$BI'll teleport us there.
english.completion: С помощью этого кристалла мы наконец подключим твою башню к сети силовых линий.$B$BЯ также немного подкорректировала чертеж, чтобы его легче было прочитать. Теперь строить следующее здание будет намного легче.

text.title: 庆祝的正当理由
text.objectives: 在沃金之傲与魔导师克雷拉斯谈一谈。
text.description: 我不认为这是最适合说话的地方。$B$B我们能不能返回你的哨站？在那庆祝要好多了。$B$B我会把我们传送过去。
text.completion: With this crystal, we can connect your tower to the ley line network at last!$B$BI also made some modifications to your blueprint that should make it much easier to build another tower in your garrison.

english.title: Due Cause to Celebrate
english.objectives: Speak to Magister Krelas at Vol'jin's Pride.
english.description: This isn't exactly my idea of the best place to talk.$B$BShall we return to your outpost? It will be a much better place to celebrate.$B$BI'll teleport us there.
english.completion: With this crystal, we can connect your tower to the ley line network at last!$B$BI also made some modifications to your blueprint that should make it much easier to build another tower in your garrison.

text.title: Frostfire Ridge: (RRP) - Treasure - Pale Leather Cache

english.title: Frostfire Ridge: (RRP) - Treasure - Pale Leather Cache

text.title: 守备官姆摩尔也许知道
text.objectives: 在塔拉找到守备官姆摩尔。
text.description: 我们知道袭击车队的战歌领袖就在塔拉。图纸就在她身上。$B$B我们不了解她确切的位置，但有个人可能知道。$B$B据说守备官姆摩尔还活着，不过已经沦为了俘虏。他也许会知道图纸究竟在哪。
text.completion: Please forgive me. I'm in no condition to stand, commander.

english.title: Mo'mor Might Know
english.objectives: Find Vindicator Mo'mor in Telaar.
english.description: We know the Warsong packleader that attacked the caravan is in Telaar. She has the blueprints.$B$BWe don't know where she is down there, but there's one who might.$B$BVindicator Mo'mor was last seen alive, but taken prisoner. If he's still alive, he might know where the blueprints are.
english.completion: Please forgive me. I'm in no condition to stand, commander.

text.title: 行动：指哪打哪
text.objectives: 在塔拉消灭$1oa名战歌兽人。
text.description: 不消多说，我们会帮你一起消灭野外的所有战歌兽人。$B$B你只要动起手来，我们就会干净利落地帮你扫尾。
text.completion: That bit of justice is sure to have lifted the spirits of my rangari.$B$BLosing Telaar and many of our friends has taken a heavy toll.$B$BThank you, commander.
text.completed: Return to Rangari D'kaan at Telaari Station.

english.title: Operation: Just Arrowhead
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Warsong forces at Telaar.
english.description: It goes without saying that we'll help you kill any of the Warsong out in the open down there.$B$BYou just start the fight, and we'll end it with extreme prejudice.
english.completion: That bit of justice is sure to have lifted the spirits of my rangari.$B$BLosing Telaar and many of our friends has taken a heavy toll.$B$BThank you, commander.
english.completed: Return to Rangari D'kaan at Telaari Station.

text.title: 其他人
text.objectives: 救出审讯者克安、看护菲拉妮与伊塞尔、汉瑟尔·重拳。
text.description: 还有少数几位幸存者。我看到他们一拥而上扑倒了审讯者克安。$B$B更重要的是，我能听见小伊塞尔的啜泣声。她就在附近。我希望她的母亲还活着。$B$B你的矮人朋友汉瑟尔想要杀进来救我们。他以为他能单枪匹马解决掉那些战歌兽人。我非常担心他现在的处境。
text.completion: Khan! No!... he just received his promotion. His whole life ahead of him and now, nothing.$B$BThank you for getting the others out. Light be... nevermind.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Mo'mor at Telaar.

english.title: The Others
english.objectives: Rescue Arbiter Khan, Caregiver Felaani & Isel, and Hansel Heavyhands.
english.description: There are yet a few survivors. I saw them pile onto Arbiter Khan during the fighting.$B$BMore importantly, I can hear little Isel's sobs. She's nearby. I hope her mother is still alive.$B$BYour dwarf friend, Hansel, came in to try to rescue us. He thought he could take the Warsong on his own. I'm afraid I don't know what happened to him.
english.completion: Khan! No!... he just received his promotion. His whole life ahead of him and now, nothing.$B$BThank you for getting the others out. Light be... nevermind.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Mo'mor at Telaar.

objectiveDetails.description: 救出看护菲拉妮与伊塞尔

text.title: ……还有我的锤子
text.objectives: 找回姆摩尔的圣光之锤。
text.description: 当他们抓住我时，那些战歌兽人抢走了我的锤子。你能帮我找回来吗？$B$B我之所以开口求你，是因为那是一件神圣的遗物。必须无条件的把它从这些兽人崽子手里夺过来，送回奥金顿。$B$B然后也许会有一位追随圣光的杰出守备官将它高高举起，击碎德莱尼的敌人。
text.progress: I'm having trouble seeing. I may not have long.
text.completion: Thank you for this kindness, $n. Perhaps I can still salvage some scrap of honor.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Mo'mor at Telaar.

english.title: ... and My Hammer
english.objectives: Retrieve Mo'mor's Holy Hammer.
english.description: When they captured me, the Warsong took my hammer. Will you help me to recover it?$B$BI ask only because it's a holy relic. It should be taken from these orc dogs for no other reason than to return it to Auchindoun.$B$BPerhaps then, a worthy vindicator of the Light will take it up to smite the enemies of the draenei.
english.progress: Я уже почти ничего не вижу. Наверное, мне недолго осталось жить.
english.completion: Thank you for this kindness, $n. Perhaps I can still salvage some scrap of honor.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Mo'mor at Telaar.

text.title: 行动：指哪打哪
text.objectives: 在塔拉消灭$1oa名战歌兽人。
text.description: 不消多说，必须解决塔拉的战歌兽人。游侠奥吉尔和他的手下就在瞭望台上，他们会帮你除掉任何在野外现身的兽人。$B$B你只要开始动手，他们就会干净利落地帮你扫尾。
text.completion: That bit of justice is sure to have lifted the spirits of my rangari.$B$BLosing Telaar and many of our friends has taken a heavy toll.$B$BThank you, commander.
text.completed: Return to Rangari D'kaan at Telaari Station.

english.title: Operation: Just Arrowhead
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Warsong forces at Telaar.
english.description: It goes without saying that the Warsong in Telaar need to be dealt with. Rangari Ogir and his forces on the overlook will help you kill any of the orcs that are out in the open.$B$BYou just start the fight, and they'll end it with extreme prejudice.
english.completion: That bit of justice is sure to have lifted the spirits of my rangari.$B$BLosing Telaar and many of our friends has taken a heavy toll.$B$BThank you, commander.
english.completed: Return to Rangari D'kaan at Telaari Station.

text.title: 寻找先知
text.objectives: 在塔拉多的暮秋岛与先知玛露妮谈一谈。
text.description: 我们一直在观察你，$n。$B$B先知玛露妮—记忆保管者要求与你见上一面，冒险者。$B$B她在很久之前就预见到会有一位伟大的英雄前来驱散潜藏的暗影。我们相信你就是她口中的那位英雄。$B$B到东南边不远处的暮秋岛去完成你的使命吧。
text.completion: I am Seer Malune, the great keeper of memories. It is an honor to finally meet you.

english.title: Seek Out the Seer
english.objectives: Speak to Seer Malune on Duskfall Island in Talador.
english.description: We've been watching you, $n.$B$BSeer Malune, keeper of memories, has requested an audience with you, adventurer.$B$BShe has long foretold the coming of a great hero to destroy the lurking shadow. We believe you are that hero.$B$BCome to Duskfall Island, not far southeast of here, and fulfill your destiny.
english.completion: Я – провидица Малунэ, великая хранительница воспоминаний. Наконец-то мне выпала честь встретиться с тобой.

text.title: 纳什拉的血誓
text.objectives: 接受剑圣纳什拉的血誓。
text.description: 你帮了我一个大忙。这柄利刃既是你的也是我的。$b$b我要为你送上这个血誓：我愿助你一臂之力，把我掌握的利刃和采矿方面的知识都贡献给你的军队。$b$B你愿意接受吗？
text.completion: You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine.$b$bI offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces.$b$BWill you accept it?
text.giverWindow: 作为一名新晋的剑圣，纳什拉无疑是一位强大的战士和武器大师。

text.title: 我们需要补给品
text.objectives: 到暗矛之刃与暗影猎手莱拉谈一谈。
text.description: 指挥官，我们的军队还没有做好在冰天雪地作战的准备。我自作主张地派了一些暗影猎手去北边建立补给基地了。$b$b你也许会想要过去看看他们现在的情况。寻找位于龟裂平原与蛮荒峭壁之间的那片山谷吧。
text.completion: Eh dere, boss-mon! Watch ya step. Da ground be cracklin' and breakin' everywhere.
text.completed: 到暗矛之刃与暗影猎手莱拉谈一谈。

english.title: We Be Needin' Supplies
english.objectives: Speak with Shadow Hunter Rala at Darkspear's Edge.
english.description: Commander, our forces are not prepared for frost fightin'. I took da liberty and sent some of our shadow hunters north to establish a supply base. $b$bYa might want to be headin' up dere and see what they be up to. Look for a hollow between the Crackling Plains and the Savage Crag.
english.completion: Eh dere, boss-mon! Watch ya step. Da ground be cracklin' and breakin' everywhere.
english.completed: Speak with Shadow Hunter Rala at Darkspear's Edge.

text.title: 暗影大师
text.objectives: 消灭安戈拉、监工古兰和堕落者安考瓦。
text.description: 那些坏兽人想抓住我，但我溜走了。我可会捉迷藏了。$b$b那些个坏兽人全都坏透了，但当中有几个最坏的，我记住了他们的名字，心想万一有人能来救我呢。$b$b<鲁卡深吸了一口气。>$b$b安戈拉、古兰，还有……呃……噢对了！还有安考瓦。$b$b你能保护我，不让我落在他们手里吗？
text.completion: Well done.$b$bBe ready to move. We may have had the element of surprise within this cave, but our advantage is fleeting.
text.completed: Return to Lady Liadrin in the Umbral Halls in Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: Masters of Shadow
english.objectives: Slay Ungra, Taskmaster Gurran, and Ankova the Fallen.
english.description: The bad orcs tried to catch me, but I snuck away. I'm good at hiding.$b$bAll of the bad orcs are bad, but I've remembered the names of the meanest ones, just in case anybody came to save me.$b$b<Luuka takes a deep breath.>$b$bUngra, Gurran, and... umm... oh! Ankova.$b$bWill you protect me from them?
english.completion: Well done.$b$bBe ready to move. We may have had the element of surprise within this cave, but our advantage is fleeting.
english.completed: Return to Lady Liadrin in the Umbral Halls in Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: Nullin' Void
text.objectives: Close 10 Shadowmoon Portals by using the Rune of Endless Ravening near them.
text.description: If I'm reading their spells correctly, it seems that these Shadowmoon orcs are opening portals to bring prisoners here to the slave camps. Brilliant magic, really.$b$bUnfortunately, it is easily nullified.$b$b<Khadgar places a small rune in your hand.>$b$bThis rune will deal with their void magic. Activate it near their portals, and they will instantly be nullified.
text.completed: Report to Lady Liadrin within the Umbral Halls in Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 影月氏族
text.objectives: 在暗影大厅中消灭10个影月兽人或虚空狼。
text.description: 我们会保护受伤的囚犯，并确保卡加斯不会从乱石堆里脱身。你先行一步清理洞穴吧，$n。
text.completion: You fight exceptionally well, $n... better than I could ever hope to.$b$bWith those orcs out of the way, Khadgar and Maraad should now be able to safely guide the rest of our group through the cave.
text.completed: Return to Olin Umberhide within the Umbral Halls in Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: The Shadowmoon Clan
english.objectives: Slay 10 Shadowmoon Orcs or Void Wolves within the Umbral Halls.
english.description: We will protect the wounded prisoners and make sure Kargath doesn't get through the rubble. You go ahead and clear the cave, $n.
english.completion: You fight exceptionally well, $n... better than I could ever hope to.$b$bWith those orcs out of the way, Khadgar and Maraad should now be able to safely guide the rest of our group through the cave.
english.completed: Return to Olin Umberhide within the Umbral Halls in Tanaan Jungle.

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭暗影大厅中的所有敌人

text.title: 伊瑞尔
text.objectives: 护送伊瑞尔前往安全地点。
text.description: 请原谅我的慌乱——我以前从没杀死过任何人。$b$b我叫伊瑞尔，是卡拉波的学徒。$b$b你说你带了一支军队来？看来圣光今天真的眷顾我了。$b$b那我愿意跟你走。带路吧，$n。
text.completion: Up there - that is Keli'dan the Breaker. No doubt he's been alerted to our presence, and he's attempting to tell his warlord about our little jailbreak.$b$bWe have to take him out, $n.
text.completed: Return to Yrel near the entrance of the Umbral Halls in Tanaan Jungle.

english.title: Yrel
english.objectives: Escort Yrel to safety.
english.description: Forgive me if I'm a bit flustered - I've never killed anyone before.$b$bMy name is Yrel, and I am a student of Karabor.$b$bYou say you have an ARMY with you? The Light must truly be watching over me today.$b$bI will follow you, then. Lead the way, $n.
english.completion: Up there - that is Keli'dan the Breaker. No doubt he's been alerted to our presence, and he's attempting to tell his warlord about our little jailbreak.$b$bWe have to take him out, $n.
english.completed: Return to Yrel near the entrance of the Umbral Halls in Tanaan Jungle.

objectiveDetails.description: 护送伊瑞尔抵达安全地点

text.title: 击碎者克里丹
text.objectives: 消灭击碎者克里丹。
text.description: 耐奥祖麾下的一名副官就在前方。经过他之后再走几步就是洞穴的出口。$b$b我要回去告诉卡德加，洞穴已经清理干净了。等你解决掉克里丹后，我们再会合！
text.completion: Fine job in the cave, but this is no time to rest.$b$bWe have momentum. We must stay in motion.
text.completed: Report to Archmage Khadgar at the Blackrock Quarry in the Tanaan Jungle.
text.giverWindow: 耐奥祖的副官。影月氏族的大巫师。

english.title: Keli'dan the Breaker
english.objectives: Slay Keli'dan the Breaker.
english.description: One of Ner'zhul's lieutenants remains, up ahead. The exit to the cave isn't much farther past him.$b$bI will go back and tell Khadgar that the cave is clear. We will rendezvous once you've taken care of Keli'dan!
english.completion: Fine job in the cave, but this is no time to rest.$b$bWe have momentum. We must stay in motion.
english.completed: Report to Archmage Khadgar at the Blackrock Quarry in the Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 破坏护盾！
text.objectives: 摧毁阿肯尼特水晶并从兽群领袖卡戈拉身上找到要塞图纸。
text.description: 你听说了吗？他们把护盾弄好了。现在没法进入塔拉。$B$B你必须去把护盾破坏掉。唯一的办法就是摧毁阿肯尼特水晶。$B$B别担心我。你的行动会达到一石二鸟的效果——你的图纸就是被兽群首领卡戈拉偷走的。
text.progress: Good news?
text.completion: Perfect! You retrieved the blueprints.$B$BThere's only one thing left to do.
text.completed: Return to Thaelin Darkanvil at Telaari Station.
text.giverWindow: 她身上有图纸。干掉她并摧毁阿肯尼特护盾。

english.title: Shields Down!
english.objectives: Destroy the Arkonite Crystal and Collect the Garrison Blueprints from Packleader Kargora.
english.description: Did you hear that? They got the shield up. There'll be no getting into Telaar now.$B$BYou must get that shield down. The only way to do it is to destroy the Arkonite crystal.$B$BDon't worry about me. You're going to kill two birds with one stone; Packleader Kargora is the one who stole your blueprints.
english.progress: Was everything successful?
english.completion: Perfect! You retrieved the blueprints.$B$BThere's only one thing left to do.
english.completed: Return to Thaelin Darkanvil at Telaari Station.
english.giverWindow: She has the blueprints. Kill her and destroy the arkonite shield.

text.title: 好啦！
text.objectives: 从塔拉多的湖底杀手身上收集$1oa个电磁囊。
text.description: 你得帮我修好这个机器人。我都快饿死了！$B$B我造出欢乐机器人8000是为了让它给我寻找德拉诺松露，结果它做了什么？它游到这个该死的岛屿上，还把它的能量波动器给弄短路了。$B$B我把它连到了这些电池上，可电池的能量还是不足以发动它。$B$B拜托你行行好，帮我从湖里的电鳗身上弄些电磁囊来，好吗？有那些应该就可以了。
text.progress: You got the stuff, buddy?
text.completion: Yeah, that's the stuff! You're a good business partner, considering you're a $C and all.$B$BNow let's just mash these into this port...
text.completed: Return to Ziz Fizziks on Duskfall Island in Talador.

english.title: Clear!
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Zapper Sacs from Lakebottom Zappers in Talador.
english.description: You gotta help me fix this robot. I'm friggin' hungry!$B$BI built the Pleasure-Bot 8000 to locate Draenor truffles, and what does it do? It swims to this stupid island and shorts its power fluctuator.$B$BI got it hooked up to these batteries, but it ain't enough juice to jump it.$B$BBe a doll and get me the zapper sacs from the electric eels in the lake, would ya? They oughta be enough.
english.progress: You got the stuff, buddy?
english.completion: Yes! That's what it takes. It's a pleasure doing business with you, even though you're |3-6($c).$B$B$When we put this in here...
english.completed: Return to Ziz Fizziks on Duskfall Island in Talador.

text.title: 迷人的假象
text.objectives: 使用$1oa个幻影护符来吸引信徒追猎刺客。
text.description: 瑞沙德可不像他表面看上去那么简单。你可能以为他只是个老朽的鸦人，一天到晚把自己的鸟喙埋在书卷之中。但我们需要他。$B$B在泰罗克鸦巢那座孤零零的尖塔底下，暗影正在积聚。瑞沙德必须安全抵达那里才行。$B$B你在沿途会找到带有幻象法术的护符。你只需要碰触那些护符就能变成瑞沙德的影像。$B$B信徒杀手们正在悄无声息地寻找这位身背卷轴的被放逐的老者。他们肯定会冲你来的。$B$B噢，可当幻象消散时，他们会不会大吃一惊呢？！嘻嘻嘻！
text.completion: How very noble of you to act as bait on my behalf. I will not forget this.
text.completed: Speak with Reshad at the Terokkar Wayshrine.

english.title: A Charming Deception
english.objectives: Use $1oa Illusion Charms to draw out Adherent Harriers.
english.description: Reshad is more than he appears; a mottled old crow with his beak in a book, certainly, but we need him.$B$BShadows gather beneath the lonely spire, in Veil Terokk. Reshad must make it there safely.$B$BAlong the path you'll find charms primed with illusion spells. You need only touch them to take on Reshad's image.$B$BAdherent assassins are on the prowl for an old outcast with scrolls on his back. They will fall upon you.$B$BOh, but won't they be surprised when the illusion fades?! Kee-hee-hee!
english.completion: How very noble of you to act as bait on my behalf. I will not forget this.
english.completed: Speak with Reshad at the Terokkar Wayshrine.

text.title: [PH] Elixir
text.objectives: Collect 1 Pristine Starflower.
text.description: The final ingredient is a rare flower that grows only in the heart of the Nightmarsh.$B$BThis flower feeds only on starlight, and dies when it falls under shadow.$B$BIf you can find such a flower, bring it to me. Only its essence will help me gain the clarity I need.
text.completed: Return to [] at Twilight Glade in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.objectives: Collect 1 Pristine Starflower.
english.description: The final ingredient is a rare flower that grows only in the heart of the Nightmarsh.$B$BThis flower feeds only on starlight, and dies when it falls under shadow.$B$BIf you can find such a flower, bring it to me. Only its essence will help me gain the clarity I need.
english.completed: Return to [] at Twilight Glade in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 寻找帮手
text.objectives: 找到一位能够帮助我们的当地渔夫。
text.description: 我们这有个适合垂钓的钓鱼地点，但好像用什么鱼饵都钓不上鱼来！我们得找个熟悉情况的当地渔夫来帮忙。到东南边去，看看能不能在海岸线上找到什么人。
text.completion: Time to see what you can do.
text.completed: Inquire the local fisherman for assistance.

english.title: Looking For Help
english.objectives: Find a local fisherman that can help our cause.
english.description: We have an accessible fishing spot here, but no bait seems to work!  We need to find a local fisherman with some knowledge of the area to help us out.  Head southeast and see if you can find anyone on the shoreline.
english.completion: Time to see what you can do.
english.completed: Inquire the local fisherman for assistance.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到一名当地渔夫并请求帮助

text.title: 好啦！
text.objectives: 从塔拉多的湖底杀手身上收集$1oa个电磁囊。
text.description: 噢，真该死！$B$B欢乐机器人8000连一份德拉诺松露都还没给我找来，自己就先坏了。它游到这儿来，还把能量波动器给弄短路了。$B$B又是这样！$B$B我正在为它供能，可能量不足以驱动波动器。$B$B你能不能帮我从湖里的电鳗身上找些囊来？我想那玩意儿正合适！
text.progress: Do you have the eel sacs?
text.completion: Those look perfect! By all that is mechanical, this had better work.$B$BNow let's just insert these here...
text.completed: Return to Torben Zapblast on Duskfall Island in Talador.

english.title: Clear!
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Zapper Sacs from Lakebottom Zappers in Talador.
english.description: Oh, the gnomanity!$B$BThe Pleasure-Bot 8000 broke before it could bring me a single Draenor truffle. It swam here and shorted its power fluctuator.$B$BAGAIN!$B$BI have power going to it, but it isn't enough to override the fluctuator.$B$BCould you get me the sacs from the electric eels in the lake? I think that would be just the ticket!
english.progress: Ты $gпринес:принесла; железы угрей?
english.completion: Those look perfect! By all that is mechanical, this had better work.$B$BNow let's just insert these here...
english.completed: Return to Torben Zapblast on Duskfall Island in Talador.

text.title: 斯库戈之巢
text.objectives: 消灭斯库戈。
text.description: 看来这场戈隆进犯的闹剧是不会自己收场的。你得用部落的方式让他们知道谁才是老大！$b$b既然附近有这么多小戈隆，那肯定还有个主事的成年戈隆。找到他……或她……性别无所谓了，消灭掉之后，剩下的那些小戈隆也许对我们在这里的小小行动就会失去兴趣了。
text.completion: Little known fact, old gronn grottos make for great farming soil.
text.completed: Return to Gazlowe at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge
text.giverWindow: 当地小戈隆的妈妈和/或爸爸。

english.title: The Den of Skog
english.objectives: Kill Skog.
english.description: So this gronn infestation ain't gonna solve itself. You're gonna have to show them who's boss, Horde style!$b$bWith this many gronnlings around there is bound to be a full grown, big mama of a gronn. Find him... it... her... or whatever, and take it out, and the rest of those gronnlings might lose interest in our little operation here.
english.completion: Little known fact, old gronn grottos make for great farming soil.
english.completed: Return to Gazlowe at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge
english.giverWindow: Mother and/or father of the local gronnlings.

text.title: 后勤梦魇
text.objectives: 找回$1oa个补给袋和$2oa份要塞记录。
text.description: 指挥官……我恐怕带来了……令人不安的……消息。$B$B这些虎人从戈尔隆德一路跟随我们扎营而来，还一直在偷窃我们的补给品，洗劫我们的账簿，甚至杀死我们的劳工！$B$B我也不愿意让你抽时间来解决这个麻烦，可我们所有人都必须驻守在营地里，以防任何更进一步的袭击。我们急需那些补给品，来执行你的命令！
text.progress: Commander! Have you had time to locate our supplies and ledgers?
text.completion: I never doubted you for a moment. You are truly a commander of the people.$B$BLok'tar ogar!
text.completed: Return to Provisioner Naya in Vol'jin's Pride.

english.title: Logistical Nightmare
english.objectives: Retrieve $1oa Sacks of Supplies and $2oa Garrison Records.
english.description: Commander, I am afraid I have... troubling... news.$B$BThese saberon followed our encampment from Gorgrond, and have been stealing our supplies, ransacking our ledgers, and slaughtering our peons!$B$BI hate to ask of your time to deal with the matter, but all of our men are stationed guarding the camp from any further raids. We desperately need those supplies so we may enact your will!
english.progress: Commander! Have you had time to locate our supplies and ledgers?
english.completion: I never doubted you for a moment. You are truly a commander of the people.$B$BLok'tar ogar!
english.completed: Return to Provisioner Naya in Vol'jin's Pride.

text.title: 作出选择
text.objectives: 用绘图桌来选择建造兽栏还是坦克工厂。
text.description: 我们已经做好准备工作了。现在只需要你来作出选择。$B$B看看绘图桌上的图纸。$B$B我们是要造兽栏还是坦克工厂呢？
text.completion: This is a momentous occasion, commander. I'll have Thaelin and his people get to work right away.$B$BYou'll see; this decision is going to be critical in our efforts against the Warsong.
text.completed: Speak with Rangari D'kaan at Telaari Station.

english.title: A Choice to Make
english.objectives: Use the Drafting Table to choose between the construction of a Corral or a Tankworks.
english.description: We're just about ready to go here. All that's needed now is for you to make your choice.$B$BTake a look at the blueprints on the drafting table.$B$BAre we going to construct a corral or a tankworks?
english.completion: This is a momentous occasion, commander. I'll have Thaelin and his people get to work right away.$B$BYou'll see; this decision is going to be critical in our efforts against the Warsong.
english.completed: Speak with Rangari D'kaan at Telaari Station.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择建造兽栏还是坦克工厂

text.title: 剑圣的荣耀
text.completion: I am without a clan. The Burning Blade are dead to me. Perhaps someday I will create a clan of my own.$B$BIn the meantime, it would be an honor to fight at your side. You freed me and fought well.$B$BThere is much we could learn from each other. What do you say?

english.title: The Honor of a Blademaster
english.completion: I am without a clan. The Burning Blade are dead to me. Perhaps someday I will create a clan of my own.$B$BIn the meantime, it would be an honor to fight at your side. You freed me and fought well.$B$BThere is much we could learn from each other. What do you say?

text.title: 酒去哪儿了？
text.objectives: 取回$1oa把步兵长剑和$2oa个雷酒桶。
text.description: 指挥官……我们遇到了……一点儿……麻烦。$B$B这群虎人从戈尔隆德就跟着我们，还一直在偷窃我们步兵的佩剑，杀死我们的农民！$B$B我也不愿意占用你的时间，可我们所有人都在守卫营地，以防任何更进一步的袭击。另外……$B$B<军需官欧丽莱压低声音悄悄说道。>$B$B他们还抢走了我们的啤酒！
text.progress: Commander! Have ye had a moment to deal with the saberon?
text.completion: Oh thank goodness, I knew ye would come through!$B$BAt your service, as always.
text.completed: Return to Quartermaster O'Riley in Fort Wrynn.

english.title: Why Is The Brew Gone?
english.objectives: Retrieve $1oa Footman Longswords and $2oa Thunderbrew Kegs.
english.description: Commander, we have a bit of a... uh... problem.$B$BThis group o' saberon followed us from Gorgrond, and they've been stealin' our footmen's swords an' slaughtering our peasants!$B$BI hate to ask fer your time, but all of yer men are guardin' the camp from any further raids. Plus...$B$B<Quartermaster O'Riley lowers her voice to a whisper.>$B$BThey took our beer!
english.progress: Командир! Ты уже $gразобрался:разобралась; с саблеронами?
english.completion: Oh thank goodness, I knew ye would come through!$B$BAt your service, as always.
english.completed: Return to Quartermaster O'Riley in Fort Wrynn.

text.title: 布林顿5000
text.completion: You will accept this gift, and you will like it.  To do otherwise will automatically engage my organic incineration weapons.  Thank you.

english.title: Blingtron 5000
english.completion: You will accept this gift, and you will like it.  To do otherwise will automatically engage my organic incineration weapons.  Thank you.

text.title: 可执行的任务
text.objectives: 用指挥台为欧林·棕皮指派任务。
text.description: 尽管欧林·棕皮在不久前惨遭俘获，但他似乎仍然是一个战技颇为出众的牛头人。他无疑已经学会了如何吸引敌人的注意力。$b$b我这有个任务，太适合让他的技能发挥威力了。$b$b等你准备好，就用我面前的指挥台来发布命令吧，我们会立刻派他出发。
text.completion: As additional missions come to my attention I will make them available here.
text.completed: Return to Warmaster Zog at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Mission Probable
english.objectives: Use the Command Table to send Olin Umberhide on a mission.
english.description: Despite his recent captures, Olin Umberhide seems to be a tauren of some skill in combat. He certainly has learned how to get an enemy's attention.$b$bI have a mission available that might prove ideal for his skill sets.$b$bWhen you are ready, simply issue the order via the command table in front of me and we will dispatch him immediately.
english.completion: As additional missions come to my attention I will make them available here.
english.completed: Return to Warmaster Zog at your Garrison in Frostfire Ridge.

objectiveDetails.description: 用指挥台为欧林·棕皮指派任务

text.title: 奥金顿守门人
text.objectives: 在战斗中击败守备官达鲁和缚魂者哈拉尔。
text.description: 钢铁部落在去往奥金顿的途中袭击了我们的车队，我沦为了俘虏。$B$B后来我逃了出来，可这些灵魂却不许我通过，不让我加入我的誓日同伴们，除非有人能在战斗中击败他们！$B$B拜托了，你能帮我打败他们吗？
text.completion: Thank you, $n. I am truly in your debt.$B$BWhen I fulfill my duties to Lady Liadrin I will come find you.
text.completed: Return to Aeda Brightdawn in Talador.

english.title: Gatekeepers of Auchindoun
english.objectives: Defeat Vindicator Dalu and Soulbinder Halaari in combat.
english.description: I was taken captive by the Iron Horde when they raided our caravan en route to Auchindoun.$B$BI escaped, but these spirits won't let me through to join my fellow Sunsworn until someone defeats them in combat!$B$BPlease, will you help me defeat them?
english.completion: Thank you, $n. I am truly in your debt.$B$BWhen I fulfill my duties to Lady Liadrin I will come find you.
english.completed: Return to Aeda Brightdawn in Talador.

text.title: 奥金顿守门人
text.objectives: 击败守备官达鲁和缚魂者哈拉尔。
text.description: 奥金顿遭到了攻击，陌生人，而我打算帮忙保卫它。$B$B眼下唯一的问题是，我手头上仅有一套爷爷留下的旧盔甲，想要穿着它击败那些挡在通往奥金顿必经之路上的灵魂是不可能的。$B$B你能击败他们，带我一起通过大门吗？我会想办法报答你的！
text.completion: You have my eternal gratitude, hero. I will find a way to repay you someday.
text.completed: Return to Defender Illona in Talador.

english.title: Gatekeepers of Auchindoun
english.objectives: Defeat Vindicator Dalu and Soulbinder Halaari.
english.description: Auchindoun is under attack, stranger, and I intend to help defend it.$B$BThe only problem is the only armor I could find was my grandfather's old set, and it isn't nearly enough to defeat the spirits blocking the path toward Auchindoun.$B$BWould you defeat them and let me through the gate with you? I will find a way to repay you!
english.completion: You have my eternal gratitude, hero. I will find a way to repay you someday.
english.completed: Return to Defender Illona in Talador.

text.title: 移民劳工
text.objectives: 在你的要塞里与工头链爆谈一谈，然后到艾洛多尔外面去见工人们。
text.description: $n，每个小时都有新成员抵达你的要塞。我们的食物很快就要短缺了。$b$b我已经跟大主教阿卡玛取得了联系，希望他能帮忙从这山谷的产粮区艾洛多尔弄些口粮来。他同意了，但前提是我们要派人收割。这样安排对谁都好。$b$b要是你认同我的计划，就到院子里找工头链爆谈谈吧——他已经把能上阵的工人都召集起来了。我跟阿卡玛会护送他们到东边的艾洛多尔与你见面！
text.completion: You made it!$b$bBut... one of our wagons didn't. Have you seen Maraad? He's still out there somewhere.
text.completed: Speak with Zipfizzle outside of Elodor in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Migrant Workers
english.objectives: Speak with Foreman Zipfizzle in your garrison, then meet with the laborers outside of Elodor.
english.description: $n, more recruits arrive at your garrison every hour. We will soon run out of food.$b$bI have made contact with Exarch Akama in hopes of securing rations from Elodor, the breadbasket of this valley. He has agreed, provided we supply labor for the harvest. Everyone wins.$b$bIf you agree with my plan, speak with Foreman Zipfizzle here in the courtyard - he has gathered together available laborers. Akama and I will escort them and meet you at Elodor, far to the east!
english.completion: You made it!$b$bBut... one of our wagons didn't. Have you seen Maraad? He's still out there somewhere.
english.completed: Speak with Zipfizzle outside of Elodor in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 掉队的马车
text.objectives: 找到玛尔拉德和失踪的工人，并把他们送回艾洛多尔农场。
text.description: 我们有辆车掉队了，消失在了西北边的树林中。守备官玛尔拉德跟你的几名工人都被困在那了。$b$b去找到他们，把他们带回来！
text.completion: I am keeping the sickles. They remind me of a lesson so many of us draenei forget - that the Light lives in every farmer as much as in any priest.$b$bYou fight well, and I am pleased to call you friend. Your laborers will be safe here in Elodor. If you are not convinced, speak to Exarch Hataaru here. His devices secure all the draenei strongholds.
text.completed: Talk to Exarch Akama at Elodor Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Circle the Wagon
english.objectives: Find Maraad and the lost laborers and escort them back to Elodor Fields.
english.description: One of our wagons fell behind, and disappeared somewhere in the woods to the northwest. Vindicator Maraad and several of your workers are stranded out there.$b$bFind them and bring them back!
english.completion: I am keeping the sickles. They remind me of a lesson so many of us draenei forget - that the Light lives in every farmer as much as in any priest.$b$bYou fight well, and I am pleased to call you friend. Your laborers will be safe here in Elodor. If you are not convinced, speak to Exarch Hataaru here. His devices secure all the draenei strongholds.
english.completed: Talk to Exarch Akama at Elodor Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 无形的壁垒
text.objectives: 把充能的共鸣水晶带到主能量塔、次级能量塔和三级能量塔处。
text.description: 大主教阿卡玛太过谨慎了，可我们也不应该忽视来自影月氏族的威胁。有你在这真好！$b$b自从我们到德拉诺之后，我就一直专注于重建被我们抛弃的科技。这个巨大的构造体是个防御结界。它应该能够抵挡住影月氏族的攻势——但前提是我们要给它充满能量才行。$b$b我在南边的车间里准备了共鸣水晶。每次搬运一块，逐次将它们运送到结界附近的三个能量塔处，然后启动旁边的控制面板！
text.completion: The console thrums with energy and lights up as you draw near, as though sensing your presence. Simply touching the main panel brings the defense crystal to life outside.$b$bIf this is the kind of technology Hataaru was able to cobble together from spare parts, you can only imagine the splendor of the world he came from.
text.completed: Activate the Defense Pylon Control Console at Elodar Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Invisible Ramparts
english.objectives: Carry charged resonance crystals to the primary, secondary, and tertiary pylons.
english.description: Exarch Akama is too cautious, but we shouldn't ignore a threat from the Shadowmoon clan. It is good you are here!$b$bSince we arrived on Draenor I have dedicated myself to recreating the technology we left behind. This large structure here is a defense ward. It should counter a Shadowmoon advance - provided we power it up.$b$bI have prepared resonance crystals at my workshop to the south. Carry one crystal at a time to the three pylons that surround the ward, then activate the control panel nearby!
english.completion: The console thrums with energy and lights up as you draw near, as though sensing your presence. Simply touching the main panel brings the defense crystal to life outside.$b$bIf this is the kind of technology Hataaru was able to cobble together from spare parts, you can only imagine the splendor of the world he came from.
english.completed: Activate the Defense Pylon Control Console at Elodar Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.

objectiveDetails.description: 把水晶带到次级能量塔
把水晶带到三级能量塔

text.title: 背水一战
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa名影月袭击者或影月黑暗女祭司。
text.description: 能量一涌入外面的水晶，你便听见远方传来了如雷贯耳的战吼与警报声。艾洛多尔遭到了攻击！$b$b如果你想让你的工人们毫发无伤地安全返家，最好帮忙守卫城镇。击退入侵的敌人，然后返回控制台重设防御。
text.completion: You saved the town! The controls shut down as you approach, but many of the indicators are still blinking frantically. Something seems wrong.$b$bHataaru yells out to get your attention outside...
text.completed: Return to the Control Console at Elodor Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Defenstrations
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Shadowmoon Raiders or Dark Priestesses.
english.description: No sooner does power rush to the crystal outside than you hear distant war cries and shouts of alarm. Elodor is being attacked!$b$bIf you want your laborers to come home in one piece, you'd best help with the defense of the town. Defeat the invasion and then return to the control console to reset the defenses.
english.completion: You saved the town! The controls shut down as you approach, but many of the indicators are still blinking frantically. Something seems wrong.$b$bHataaru yells out to get your attention outside...
english.completed: Return to the Control Console at Elodor Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 主教议会
text.objectives: 在艾洛多尔与大主教奥萨尔谈一谈。
text.description: 你在大门那表现得很出色！出于某种原因，影月兽人们一直在寻找囚犯。他们的入侵帮了我们大忙。$b$b跟我来。我要把你介绍给主教议会——“先知之手”。我始终在尽力劝说主教们支持我们的行动，并对钢铁部落采取攻势，可他们却是一如既往的谨慎过头，优柔寡断。$b$b来吧，我要向山上的大主教奥萨尔举荐你。也许与一位联盟英雄的会面能够影响到议会的决定。
text.completion: <Exarch Othaar is a towering, intimidating figure. His eyes bore into you, determining if you are friend or foe.>$b$bSo, you are $n, esteemed $c of this "Alliance" that has appeared on our shores. On behalf of the Exarch Council, I welcome you to Elodor.
text.completed: 在影月谷的艾洛多尔找大主教奥萨尔谈一谈。

english.title: The Exarch Council
english.objectives: Speak with Exarch Othaar in Elodor.
english.description: Good work at the gates! The Shadowmoon orcs have been seeking prisoners for some reason. Their aggression helps our cause.$b$bCome with me. I would like to introduce you to the Exarch Council, "The Hand of the Prophet." I have been trying to convince the Exarchs to support our cause and go on the offensive against the Iron Horde, but they are - as always - too cautious and slow to act.$b$bCome with me, I will introduce you to Exarch Othaar up the hill. Perhaps meeting an Alliance hero can sway the council.
english.completion: <Exarch Othaar is a towering, intimidating figure. His eyes bore into you, determining if you are friend or foe.>$b$bSo, you are $n, esteemed $c of this "Alliance" that has appeared on our shores. On behalf of the Exarch Council, I welcome you to Elodor.
english.completed: Speak with Exarch Othaar at Elodor in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 游侠奈丽
text.objectives: 到游侠飞地与大主教奈丽谈一谈。
text.description: 我正在召集主教议会共同聆听你的诉求。我们所有人都深信这个“钢铁部落”是个威胁，却无法在应对策略上达成共识。现在要由你和守备官玛尔拉德出面将大主教们集和起来。$b$b大主教奈丽是游侠——“先知之眼”的领袖。这些游侠是我们的斥候，寂静无声地潜伏在德拉诺最偏远的地带。到西北边的游侠飞地去找她吧。
text.completion: $n! You have only just arrived but already your name is the talk of Elodor.$b$bI will gladly support your cause for the Exarch Council - it has always been my opinion that the draenei need to get out and be proactive in our world instead of hiding behind our walls.$b$bBut first, I need your help with something...
text.completed: 到影月谷的游侠飞地与大主教奈丽谈一谈。

english.title: Naielle, The Rangari
english.objectives: Speak to Exarch Naielle in the Rangari Enclave.
english.description: I am calling the Exarch Council to order to hear your petition. None of us doubt that this "Iron Horde" is a threat, but few can agree on what we should do about it. It is up to you and Vindicator Maraad to gather the Exarchs together.$b$bExarch Naielle is the leader of the Rangari, the "Eyes of the Prophet." They are our scouts who silently stalk the farthest corners of Draenor. Seek her out in the Rangari Enclave northwest of here.
english.completion: $n! You have only just arrived but already your name is the talk of Elodor.$b$bI will gladly support your cause for the Exarch Council - it has always been my opinion that the draenei need to get out and be proactive in our world instead of hiding behind our walls.$b$bBut first, I need your help with something...
english.completed: Speak to Exarch Naielle at the Rangari Enclave in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 真菌把戏
text.objectives: 用荧光蘑菇安全地采集$oa个不稳定的孢子。
text.description: 我们身为游侠的职责就是探索和了解这个世界。你所在的地方叫黯影沼泽。在我们最初发现这个地方时，许多德莱尼人失去了性命。那些不稳定的孢子只要一有人接近就会发生爆炸。$b$b但我们通过不断地观察……最后终于弄明白了。$b$b你可以在沼泽各处找到“荧光蘑菇”，它们有着橘黄色的发光菌伞，很容易分辨。这种蘑菇上的粉尘可以让你对那些爆炸性的孢子隐形。去取得那些孢子——千万要慢慢拿！然后带来交给我。$b$b我们将把这荒蛮的世界打造成武器。
text.progress: Remember, unless you are covered in shimmershroom dust, the spores will explode as soon as you get near.
text.completion: Careful with those... hand them here. Wonderful!$b$bI will have my rangari bury these around the perimeter of Elodor. If the Shadowmoon orcs dare attack us again, they are in for a nasty surprise!$b$bDraenor is a hostile world, but if we take the time to learn and understand it, we can turn it to our advantage.$b$bI will finish up here and meet with the Exarch Council shortly. I will be sure to back your proposal.
text.completed: Bring the spores to Exarch Naielle at the Rangari Enclave in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Fun with Fungus
english.objectives: Use the Shimmershrooms to safely gather $oa Volatile Spores.
english.description: It is our mission as rangari to explore and understand this world. Around you is the Umberfen. Many draenei lost their lives when we first discovered this place. The volatile spores burst whenever anyone approaches.$b$bBut we watched... and we learned.$b$bAround the swamp you'll notice "Shimmershrooms," distinguished by their orange glowcaps. Their dust will make you invisible to the volatile spores. Grab the spores - gently! - and bring them to me.$b$bWe will forge this savage world into a weapon.
english.progress: Remember, unless you are covered in shimmershroom dust, the spores will explode as soon as you get near.
english.completion: Careful with those... hand them here. Wonderful!$b$bI will have my rangari bury these around the perimeter of Elodor. If the Shadowmoon orcs dare attack us again, they are in for a nasty surprise!$b$bDraenor is a hostile world, but if we take the time to learn and understand it, we can turn it to our advantage.$b$bI will finish up here and meet with the Exarch Council shortly. I will be sure to back your proposal.
english.completed: Bring the spores to Exarch Naielle at the Rangari Enclave in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 技师哈塔鲁
text.objectives: 到艾洛多尔挖掘场外面与大主教哈塔鲁谈一谈。
text.description: 我还需要你去找大主教哈塔鲁。我知道你在大门那里帮他稳固了我们的防御。$b$b哈塔鲁是我们的首席技师——他比任何人都要了解我们的科技，而且一直不知疲倦地想要再创我们昔日的辉煌文明。$b$b他已经转移到了艾洛多尔挖掘场外面的车间，艾洛多尔挖掘场是我们的水晶矿场，就在东南边。到矿场入口去找他吧。
text.completion: Ah, $n! I suspected I would see you again soon.$b$bI am willing to speak on your behalf at the Exarch Council, but an emergency situation has come up...
text.completed: 到影月谷的艾洛多尔挖掘场外面与大主教哈塔鲁谈一谈。

english.title: Hataaru, the Artificer
english.objectives: Speak with Exarch Hataaru outside of the Elodor Dig.
english.description: I will also need you to call upon Exarch Hataaru. I understand you were helping him with our defenses at the gate.$b$bHataaru is our Chief Artificer - he understands our technology better than any other and has been working tirelessly to recreate the glory of the civilization we left behind.$b$bHe has moved to his workstation outside of the Elodor Dig, our crystal mines located just to the Southeast. Look for him at the mine entrance.
english.completion: Ah, $n! I suspected I would see you again soon.$b$bI am willing to speak on your behalf at the Exarch Council, but an emergency situation has come up...
english.completed: Speak with Exarch Hataaru outside of the Elodor Dig in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 贪吃的鬣蜥人
text.objectives: 从艾洛多尔挖掘场里的晶喉鬣蜥人身上收集$1Oa块晶化鬣蜥人鳞片。
text.description: 想必你就是那位给大主教哈塔鲁留下深刻印象的$c吧。你能帮忙吗？$b$b我身后的艾洛多尔挖掘场被诡异的岩石生物侵占了。这些所谓的鬣蜥人会吞食矿物，在体内进行新陈代谢，然后从手臂和背上长出晶体组织。跟这世界大多数的野生生物一样，它们令我们百思不得其解。$b$b拜托你去尽量多消灭一些这种怪物，并帮我收集它们身上的水晶鳞片。这样一来你既保护了我们的挖土工，又帮助了我们的研究。
text.progress: What's the status inside the dig?
text.completion: <The artificer withdraws a loop and peers intently at the scales you've brought him.>$b$bUnreal. The crystalline matrix is flawless, as if produced from one of our forges on Argus.$b$bI wish we could hook up these creatures to our machinery... but I suspect the Exarch would take issue with that.$b$bThank you for your help!
text.completed: Return to Apprentice Artificer Andren outside the Elodor Dig in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Engorged Goren
english.objectives: Collect $1Oa Crystallized Goren Scales from Crystalmaw goren in the Elodor Dig.
english.description: You must be the $c that so impressed Exarch Hataaru. Can you help?$b$bThe Elodor Dig just behind me is overrun by strange stone creatures. These so-called goren actually devour minerals, metabolize them, and grow crystalline structures from their arms and back. Like most of the wildlife on this world, they completely baffle us.$b$bPlease slay as many as you can and gather their crystal scales for me. You'll be protecting our earthworkers and aiding our research at the same time.
english.progress: How are you doing in your career?
english.completion: <The artificer withdraws a loop and peers intently at the scales you've brought him.>$b$bUnreal. The crystalline matrix is flawless, as if produced from one of our forges on Argus.$b$bI wish we could hook up these creatures to our machinery... but I suspect the Exarch would take issue with that.$b$bThank you for your help!
english.completed: Return to Apprentice Artificer Andren outside the Elodor Dig in Shadowmoon Valley.
